import { allFiltered, tenantCheck } from './activities.mjs';
import { CATALOG,FACTOR_NOTICE,round,fail } from './shared.mjs';
export function metadata(db,user) {
  return { university:db.prepare('SELECT * FROM universities WHERE id=?').get(user.university_id),
    campuses:db.prepare('SELECT id,name,code FROM campuses WHERE university_id=? ORDER BY name').all(user.university_id),
    buildings:db.prepare('SELECT id,name,campus_id AS campusId FROM buildings WHERE university_id=? ORDER BY name').all(user.university_id),
    reportingPeriods:db.prepare('SELECT id,name,start_date AS startDate,end_date AS endDate,status FROM reporting_periods WHERE university_id=? ORDER BY start_date DESC').all(user.university_id),
    categories:CATALOG.map(({factor,...rest})=>rest),factors:db.prepare('SELECT * FROM emission_factors ORDER BY category').all(),
    factorNotice:FACTOR_NOTICE,demoOnly:true,invoiceSupport:{maxMB:10,types:['PDF','PNG','JPEG','TXT'],ocr:false,humanReviewRequired:true},
    workflow:['DRAFT','SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW','VERIFIED','CALCULATED'] };
}
export function dashboard(db,user,query={}) {
  tenantCheck(user,query.universityId);
  const activities=allFiltered(db,user,query);const calculated=activities.filter(a=>a.status==='CALCULATED'&&a.calculation);
  const sum=calculated.reduce((n,a)=>n+a.calculation.kgCO2e,0);
  const group=(key)=>{
    const grouped=new Map();
    for(const a of calculated){const label=a[key]??'Unassigned';const prev=grouped.get(label)??{name:label,kgCO2e:0,count:0};prev.kgCO2e+=a.calculation.kgCO2e;prev.count++;grouped.set(label,prev);}
    return [...grouped.values()].map(x=>({...x,kgCO2e:round(x.kgCO2e),tCO2e:round(x.kgCO2e/1000),share:sum?round(x.kgCO2e/sum*100,2):0})).sort((a,b)=>b.kgCO2e-a.kgCO2e);
  };
  const months=new Map();
  for(const a of calculated){const m=a.activityDate.slice(0,7);const prev=months.get(m)??{month:m,SCOPE_1:0,SCOPE_2:0,total:0};prev[a.scope]+=a.calculation.kgCO2e;prev.total+=a.calculation.kgCO2e;months.set(m,prev);}
  const statusCounts={};for(const a of activities)statusCounts[a.status]=(statusCounts[a.status]??0)+1;
  const evidenceCount=calculated.filter(a=>a.documentId).length;
  const consumption=new Map();for(const a of calculated){const key=a.category;const p=consumption.get(key)??{category:key,unit:a.unit,quantity:0};p.quantity+=a.quantity;consumption.set(key,p);}
  return {demoOnly:true,factorNotice:FACTOR_NOTICE,totalKgCO2e:round(sum),totalTCO2e:round(sum/1000),totalActivities:activities.length,calculatedActivities:calculated.length,
    pendingReview:(statusCounts.SUBMITTED??0)+(statusCounts.UNDER_REVIEW??0),drafts:statusCounts.DRAFT??0,
    verifiedAwaitingCalculation:statusCounts.VERIFIED??0,evidenceCoverage:calculated.length?round(evidenceCount/calculated.length*100,1):0,evidenceCount,
    totalInvoices:db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM documents WHERE university_id=?').get(user.university_id).n,
    statusCounts,byScope:group('scope'),byCampus:group('campusName'),byCategory:group('category'),byBuilding:group('buildingName'),
    consumption:[...consumption.values()].map(x=>({...x,quantity:round(x.quantity,4)})),
    monthly:[...months.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.month.localeCompare(b.month)).map(x=>({month:x.month,scope1TCO2e:round(x.SCOPE_1/1000),scope2TCO2e:round(x.SCOPE_2/1000),totalTCO2e:round(x.total/1000)})),
    recentActivities:activities.sort((a,b)=>b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt)).slice(0,6),
    insight:calculated.length?`${group('category')[0]?.name.replaceAll('_',' ').toLowerCase()} is the largest calculated category in this selection.`:'No approved and calculated activities in this selection.'};
}
export function auditList(db,user,query={}) {
  const page=Number(query.page??1);const limit=Number(query.limit??25);
  if(!Number.isInteger(page)||page<1||!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1||limit>100)fail(422,'INVALID_PAGINATION','Use page >= 1 and limit between 1 and 100.');
  const total=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM audit_logs WHERE university_id=?').get(user.university_id).n;
  const rows=db.prepare(`SELECT a.*,u.name AS user_name FROM audit_logs a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE a.university_id=? ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.rowid DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`).all(user.university_id,limit,(page-1)*limit);
  return {items:rows.map(r=>({id:r.id,action:r.action,entityType:r.entity_type,entityId:r.entity_id,user:r.user_name,createdAt:r.created_at,requestId:r.request_id,before:r.before_json?JSON.parse(r.before_json):null,after:r.after_json?JSON.parse(r.after_json):null})),pagination:{page,limit,total,pages:Math.ceil(total/limit)}};
}
export function report(db,user,query={}) {
  return {title:'CarbonSynq University Carbon Summary',university:metadata(db,user).university.name,generatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),demoOnly:true,factorNotice:FACTOR_NOTICE,filters:query,summary:dashboard(db,user,query),activities:allFiltered(db,user,query)};
}
function csvCell(value) {
  let v=String(value??'');if(/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(v))v="'"+v;return '"'+v.replaceAll('"','""')+'"';
}
export function reportCsv(data) {
  const rows=[['DEMO ONLY - NOT AN AUDITED INVENTORY',data.factorNotice],['Activity ID','Date','Campus','Building','Category','Scope','Quantity','Unit','Source','Status','kgCO2e (calculated only)','Factor','Factor version','Factor source','Invoice amount INR (not consumption)','Vendor','Invoice number','Description']];

import {mkdirSync,existsSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync,unlinkSync} from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
export function ensureStopped(dataDir) {
 const pidFile=path.join(dataDir,'server.pid');
 if(!existsSync(pidFile))return;
 const pid=Number(readFileSync(pidFile,'utf8'));
 if(Number.isInteger(pid)&&pid>0){
  try{process.kill(pid,0);}catch(error){if(error.code==='ESRCH'){unlinkSync(pidFile);return;}throw error;}
  throw new Error(`The demo may already be running (PID ${pid}). Stop it with Ctrl+C before starting another copy, backing up or resetting.`);
 }
 throw new Error('Invalid server.pid file. Check that the demo is stopped before removing this file.');
}
export function acquireRuntimeLock(dataDir) {
 mkdirSync(dataDir,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});ensureStopped(dataDir);
 const filename=path.join(dataDir,'server.pid');writeFileSync(filename,String(process.pid),{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});
 return ()=>{try{if(readFileSync(filename,'utf8')===String(process.pid))unlinkSync(filename);}catch{}};
}

import {DatabaseSync,backup} from 'node:sqlite';
import {existsSync,mkdirSync,renameSync} from 'node:fs';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';
import {ensureStopped} from './lib/runtime.mjs';
const here=path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const dataDir=path.resolve(process.env.DEMO_DATA_DIR??path.join(here,'.local-data'));
const file=path.join(dataDir,'demo.sqlite');
const stamp=new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-');
try {
 ensureStopped(dataDir);
 if(!existsSync(file))throw new Error('No local demo database exists yet. Start the demo once before using this command.');
 const check=new DatabaseSync(file,{readOnly:true});
 let isDemo;try{isDemo=check.prepare("SELECT id FROM universities WHERE code='GFU-DEMO'").get();}finally{check.close();}
 if(!isDemo)throw new Error('This is not the recognized local demo database. No files were changed.');
 const command=process.argv[2];
 if(command==='backup') {
  const targetDir=path.join(here,'.backups');mkdirSync(targetDir,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});
  const target=path.join(targetDir,`demo-${stamp}.sqlite`);
  const db=new DatabaseSync(file);try{await backup(db,target);}finally{db.close();}
  console.log(`Backup saved: ${target}\nIt contains original invoices and local account data. Keep it private.`);
 } else if(command==='reset') {
  if(!process.argv.includes('--confirm-local-demo-reset'))throw new Error('Reset needs explicit confirmation. Stop the demo, then run: npm run demo:reset -- --confirm-local-demo-reset\nThe current data folder will be retained as a timestamped backup, not deleted.');
  const target=dataDir+'-before-reset-'+stamp;renameSync(dataDir,target);
  console.log(`Previous data preserved at: ${target}\nStart the demo again to create a fresh sample dataset.`);
 } else throw new Error('Use backup or reset. This tool never connects to your original Neon database.');
} catch(error){console.error(error.message);process.exitCode=1;}

```javascript
/**
 * Complete API example for the supplied synthetic dataset.
 * Run: npm run demo:flow
 * Starts its own loopback HTTP server with an in-memory SQLite database.
 * It does not modify the normal demo database or contact the original Neon app.
 * Human review is simulated ONLY for the known synthetic sample below.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { createDemoServer } from '../server.mjs';

/**
 * @param {string} baseURL
 * @param {string} route
 * @param {{method?: string, token?: string, json?: object, form?: FormData, headers?: Record<string,string>}} options
 * @returns {Promise<any>} Unwrapped API data, or an error with its request ID.
 */
async function api(baseURL, route, options = {}) {
  const { method = 'GET', token, json, form, headers = {} } = options;
  if (json !== undefined && form !== undefined) {
    throw new TypeError('Use either a JSON body or a multipart form, not both.');
  }
  const requestHeaders = { ...headers };
  if (token) requestHeaders.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  if (json !== undefined) requestHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
  const response = await fetch(baseURL + route, {
    method,
    headers: requestHeaders,
    body: form ?? (json === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(json)),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
  });
  const body = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok || body.success !== true) {
    throw new Error(`${method} ${route}: HTTP ${response.status}, ${body.error?.code ?? 'BAD_RESPONSE'}: ${body.error?.message ?? 'Unexpected response'} (request ${body.requestId ?? 'unknown'})`);
  }
  return body.data;
}

async function main() {
  const { server } = createDemoServer({ dbPath: ':memory:', quiet: true });
  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.once('error', reject);
      server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve);
    });
    const address = server.address();
    if (!address || typeof address === 'string') throw new Error('No loopback port assigned.');
    const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}`;
    const login = async (email) => (await api(base, '/api/v1/auth/login', {
      method: 'POST', json: { email, password: 'Demo@12345' },
    })).token;

    const entryToken = await login('entry@carbonsynq.demo');
    const reviewerToken = await login('reviewer@carbonsynq.demo');
    const leadershipToken = await login('ceo@carbonsynq.demo');
    const meta = await api(base, '/api/v1/meta', { token: entryToken });
    const campus = meta.campuses.find((item) => item.code === 'NC');
    const period = meta.reportingPeriods.find((item) => item.status === 'OPEN');
    assert.ok(campus && period, 'The synthetic campus and reporting period must exist.');
    const building = meta.buildings.find((item) => item.campusId === campus.id && item.name === 'Academic Block');
    assert.ok(building, 'The synthetic Academic Block must exist.');
    const before = await api(base, '/api/v1/dashboard', { token: leadershipToken });
    const common = {
      reportingPeriodId: period.id,
      campusId: campus.id,
      buildingId: building.id,
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
      unit: 'kWh',
    };

    // 1. Manual entry: preview is read-only, then save a draft.
    const manualInput = {
      ...common,
      quantity: 1250,
      activityDate: '2026-10-02',
      description: 'Synthetic API example - manual electricity consumption',
    };
    const preview = await api(base, '/api/v1/activity-data/preview', {
      method: 'POST', token: entryToken, json: manualInput,
    });
    assert.equal(preview.kgCO2e, 887.5);
    let manual = await api(base, '/api/v1/activity-data', {
      method: 'POST', token: entryToken, json: manualInput,
      headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': 'example-manual-001' },
    });
    assert.equal(manual.status, 'DRAFT');
    const draftDashboard = await api(base, '/api/v1/dashboard', { token: leadershipToken });
    assert.equal(draftDashboard.totalKgCO2e, before.totalKgCO2e);

    // Always use the response's current version, not a guessed version counter.
    const act = async (activity, action, token) => api(base,
      `/api/v1/activity-data/${activity.id}/${action}`, {
        method: 'POST', token, json: { version: activity.version },
      });
    const approve = async (activity) => {
      let current = await act(activity, 'submit', entryToken);
      current = await act(current, 'start-review', reviewerToken);
      current = await act(current, 'verify', reviewerToken);
      return act(current, 'calculate', reviewerToken);
    };
    manual = await approve(manual);
    assert.equal(manual.status, 'CALCULATED');
    assert.equal(manual.calculation.kgCO2e, 887.5);

    // 2. Upload original synthetic PDF bytes using the multipart file field.
    const original = await readFile(new URL('../samples/sample-electricity.pdf', import.meta.url));
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('file', new Blob([original], { type: 'application/pdf' }), 'sample-electricity.pdf');
    const document = await api(base, '/api/v1/documents/upload', {
      method: 'POST', token: entryToken, form,
    });
    assert.equal(document.status, 'REVIEW_REQUIRED');
    assert.equal(document.extraction.ocrAvailable, false);
    assert.equal(document.extraction.fields.quantity, 12500);
    assert.equal(document.extraction.fields.amountInr, 112500);

    // This fixture confirms predetermined sample data. For REAL invoices, a
    // person must inspect the evidence before setting reviewConfirmed=true.
    let invoiceActivity = await api(base, `/api/v1/documents/${document.id}/create-activity`, {
      method: 'POST', token: entryToken,
      json: {
        ...common,
        version: document.version,
        reviewConfirmed: true,
        quantity: 12500,
        activityDate: '2026-09-30',
        description: 'Synthetic sample invoice - known fixture values',
        vendor: 'Greenfield Utilities (Demo)',
        invoiceNumber: 'DEMO-ELEC-2026-0930',
        amountInr: 112500,
      },
    });
    assert.equal(invoiceActivity.documentId, document.id);
    assert.equal(invoiceActivity.quantity, 12500);
    assert.equal(invoiceActivity.amountInr, 112500);
    invoiceActivity = await approve(invoiceActivity);
    assert.equal(invoiceActivity.calculation.kgCO2e, 8875);

    // 3. Leadership sees only the approved/calculated changes.
    const after = await api(base, '/api/v1/dashboard', { token: leadershipToken });
    const report = await api(base, '/api/v1/reports/summary', { token: leadershipToken });
    const delta = after.totalKgCO2e - before.totalKgCO2e;
    assert.ok(Math.abs(delta - 9762.5) < 0.000001);
    assert.equal(after.calculatedActivities, before.calculatedActivities + 2);
    assert.equal(after.evidenceCount, before.evidenceCount + 1);
    assert.equal(report.summary.totalKgCO2e, after.totalKgCO2e);

    // Download and compare evidence bytes, rather than trusting only metadata.
    const download = await fetch(`${base}/api/v1/documents/${document.id}/download`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${leadershipToken}` },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
    });
    assert.equal(download.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(await download.arrayBuffer()), original);

    for (const token of [entryToken, reviewerToken, leadershipToken]) {
      await api(base, '/api/v1/auth/logout', { method: 'POST', token });
    }
    console.log(JSON.stringify({
      result: 'PASS',
      mode: 'Isolated in-memory database and real loopback HTTP requests',
      manualActivity: { quantityKWh: 1250, kgCO2e: manual.calculation.kgCO2e, status: manual.status },
      invoiceActivity: { quantityKWh: 12500, amountInr: 112500, kgCO2e: invoiceActivity.calculation.kgCO2e, status: invoiceActivity.status },
      dashboardDeltaKgCO2e: Number(delta.toFixed(6)),
      calculatedActivitiesAdded: 2,
      originalInvoiceBytesPreserved: true,
      reportReconciles: true,
      illustrativeFactorsOnly: true,
      ocrConnected: false,
      persistentDemoDatabaseChanged: false,
    }, null, 2));
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      server.close(resolve);
      server.closeAllConnections();
    });
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(`Workflow example failed: ${error.message}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

### 16. `examples/api.http`

```http
# Plain HTTP request examples. Run the root backend with npm start first.
# Paste login tokens and actual IDs/versions returned by the API below.
# Full request/response schemas: docs/openapi.json.
@base = http://localhost:5050
@entryToken = PASTE_ENTRY_TOKEN
@reviewerToken = PASTE_REVIEWER_TOKEN
@periodId = PASTE_PERIOD_ID_FROM_META
@campusId = PASTE_CAMPUS_ID_FROM_META
@activityId = PASTE_ACTIVITY_ID

### Health
GET {{base}}/health

### Data-entry login
POST {{base}}/api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{"email":"entry@carbonsynq.demo","password":"Demo@12345"}

### Metadata - obtain real IDs before creating a record
GET {{base}}/api/v1/meta
Authorization: Bearer {{entryToken}}

### Create manual activity - choose a new idempotency key for a NEW request
POST {{base}}/api/v1/activity-data
Authorization: Bearer {{entryToken}}
Content-Type: application/json
Idempotency-Key: manual-example-001

{
  "reportingPeriodId": "{{periodId}}",
  "campusId": "{{campusId}}",
  "category": "PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY",
  "quantity": 1250,
  "unit": "kWh",
  "activityDate": "2026-10-02",
  "description": "Manual electricity entry - demo"
}

### Submit the draft. Replace version with the current response value.
POST {{base}}/api/v1/activity-data/{{activityId}}/submit
Authorization: Bearer {{entryToken}}
Content-Type: application/json

{"version":1}

### Separate reviewer login
POST {{base}}/api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{"email":"reviewer@carbonsynq.demo","password":"Demo@12345"}

### Start review - response contains the next version
POST {{base}}/api/v1/activity-data/{{activityId}}/start-review
Authorization: Bearer {{reviewerToken}}
Content-Type: application/json

{"version":2}

### Verify - cannot be the creating account
POST {{base}}/api/v1/activity-data/{{activityId}}/verify
Authorization: Bearer {{reviewerToken}}
Content-Type: application/json

{"version":3}

### Calculate - only after verification
POST {{base}}/api/v1/activity-data/{{activityId}}/calculate
Authorization: Bearer {{reviewerToken}}
Content-Type: application/json

{"version":4}

### Dashboard
GET {{base}}/api/v1/dashboard
Authorization: Bearer {{reviewerToken}}

### CSV report
GET {{base}}/api/v1/reports/export?format=csv
Authorization: Bearer {{reviewerToken}}

# For a complete executable multipart invoice upload and human-review fixture,
# run npm run demo:flow or read examples/full-workflow.mjs.
```

 assert.equal(x.method,'BASIC_PDF_TEXT');assert.equal(x.fields.quantity,12500);assert.equal(x.fields.unit,'kWh');assert.equal(x.fields.amountInr,112500);assert.equal(x.fields.category,'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY');assert.equal(x.fields.activityDate,'2026-09-30');assert.equal(x.fields.vendor,'Greenfield Utilities (Demo)');

});
test('invoice parser cannot turn a money-only invoice into consumption',()=>{const x=parseInvoiceText('Vendor: Test\nInvoice number: A-001\nTotal amount: INR 12500.00');assert.equal(x.fields.amountInr,12500);assert.equal(x.fields.quantity,undefined);});
test('ambiguous multi-line consumption requires manual review',()=>{const x=parseInvoiceText('Consumption: 1200 kWh\nConsumption: 1800 kWh');assert.equal(x.fields.quantity,undefined);assert.match(x.warnings.join(' '),/Multiple consumption/);});
test('MWh normalization is explicit',()=>{const x=parseInvoiceText('Consumption: 1.5 MWh');assert.equal(x.fields.quantity,1500);assert.equal(x.fields.unit,'kWh');assert.match(x.warnings.join(' '),/converted/);});
test('scanned PNG never claims OCR or fabricated extracted fields',()=>{const x=extractInvoice(sample('scanned-electricity.png'),'image/png');assert.equal(x.method,'MANUAL_REVIEW');assert.equal(x.ocrAvailable,false);assert.deepEqual(x.fields,{});});

test('file signature, MIME, extension, empty and size validation',()=>{
 assert.throws(()=>validateFile('x.pdf','application/pdf',Buffer.from('not a pdf')),/content and extension/);
 assert.throws(()=>validateFile('x.exe','application/pdf',sample('sample-electricity.pdf')),/content and extension/);
 assert.throws(()=>validateFile('x.pdf','image/png',sample('sample-electricity.pdf')),/content type/);
 assert.throws(()=>validateFile('x.txt','text/plain',Buffer.alloc(0)),/non-empty/);
 assert.throws(()=>validateFile('x.txt','text/plain',Buffer.alloc(10*1024*1024+1,65)),/10 MB/);

});

});

import test,{before,after} from 'node:test';

let server,db,base,meta;const tokens={};let serial=17000;
const OTHER='99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999';
async function request(route,{actor='entry',method='GET',body,form,headers={}}={}) {
 const h={...headers};if(actor&&tokens[actor])h.Authorization='Bearer '+tokens[actor];
 let payload=form;
 if(body!==undefined){h['Content-Type']='application/json';payload=JSON.stringify(body);}
 const response=await fetch(base+route,{method,headers:h,...(payload===undefined?{}:{body:payload})});
 const output=response.headers.get('content-type')?.includes('application/json')?await response.json():await response.text();
 return {status:response.status,body:output,data:output?.data,headers:response.headers};
}
function activity(extra={}) {
 const campus=meta.campuses.find(c=>c.name==='North Campus');
 const building=meta.buildings.find(b=>b.campusId===campus.id&&b.name==='Academic Block');
 return {reportingPeriodId:meta.reportingPeriods[0].id,campusId:campus.id,buildingId:building.id,category:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',quantity:serial++,unit:'kWh',activityDate:'2026-10-02',description:'Integration test consumption',...extra};
}

async function step(a,action,actor='reviewer',extra={}) {
 const r=await request(`/api/v1/activity-data/${a.id}/${action}`,{actor,method:'POST',body:{version:a.version,...extra}});assert.equal(r.status,200,JSON.stringify(r.body));return r.data;
}
function fileForm(name='sample-electricity.pdf',content=null,type='application/pdf') {
 const data=content??readFileSync(new URL('../samples/'+name,import.meta.url));const form=new FormData();form.set('file',new Blob([data],{type}),name);return form;
}

 await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));base=`http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;

  assert.equal(r.status,200,JSON.stringify(r.body));tokens[actor]=r.data.token;
 }
 meta=(await request('/api/v1/meta')).data;
});

 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/activity-data?universityId='+OTHER)).status,403);

});

test('complete maker-checker flow calculates once and updates dashboard exactly',async()=>{
 const start=(await request('/api/v1/dashboard')).data.totalKgCO2e;

 assert.ok(Math.abs((await request('/api/v1/dashboard')).data.totalKgCO2e-start-710.71)<0.000001);
 await step(a,'calculate');assert.equal(db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM calculations WHERE activity_id=?').get(a.id).n,1);
 assert.ok(Math.abs((await request('/api/v1/dashboard')).data.totalKgCO2e-start-710.71)<0.000001);
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/activity-data/${a.id}`,{method:'PATCH',body:{version:a.version,quantity:333}})).status,409);
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/activity-data/${a.id}`,{method:'DELETE',body:{version:a.version}})).status,409);
});

});

 a=await step(a,'reject','reviewer',{reason:'Please check the meter reading against the original record.'});assert.equal(a.status,'REJECTED');
 const r=await request(`/api/v1/activity-data/${a.id}`,{method:'PATCH',body:{version:a.version,description:'Corrected meter record'}});assert.equal(r.status,200);assert.equal(r.data.status,'DRAFT');assert.equal(r.data.rejectionReason,null);
});
test('locked reporting period blocks activity writes until admin unlocks it',async()=>{
 const pid=meta.reportingPeriods[0].id;
 try {
  assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/reporting-periods/${pid}/lock`,{actor:'entry',method:'POST',body:{}})).status,403);
  assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/reporting-periods/${pid}/lock`,{actor:'admin',method:'POST',body:{}})).status,200);
  const r=await request('/api/v1/activity-data',{method:'POST',body:activity()});assert.equal(r.status,409);assert.equal(r.body.error.code,'PERIOD_LOCKED');
 }finally{assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/reporting-periods/${pid}/unlock`,{actor:'admin',method:'POST',body:{}})).status,200);}
});
test('cross-tenant activity reads and mutations do not reveal records',async()=>{
 const a=await create();
 for(const method of ['GET','PATCH','DELETE']){const r=await request(`/api/v1/activity-data/${a.id}`,{actor:'isolation',method,...(method==='GET'?{}:{body:{version:a.version,quantity:42}})});assert.equal(r.status,404);}
});
let uploaded;
test('multipart PDF upload extracts actual quantity separately from money',async()=>{
 const r=await request('/api/v1/documents/upload',{method:'POST',form:fileForm()});assert.equal(r.status,201,JSON.stringify(r.body));uploaded=r.data;
 assert.equal(uploaded.extraction.fields.quantity,12500);assert.equal(uploaded.extraction.fields.amountInr,112500);assert.equal(uploaded.status,'REVIEW_REQUIRED');assert.equal(uploaded.extraction.ocrAvailable,false);
 const duplicate=await request('/api/v1/documents/upload',{method:'POST',form:fileForm()});assert.equal(duplicate.status,409);assert.equal(duplicate.body.error.details.documentId,uploaded.id);
});
test('invoice download preserves bytes and checks authentication and tenant',async()=>{
 const r=await fetch(base+`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/download`,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+tokens.ceo}});assert.equal(r.status,200);assert.equal(sha256(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer())),uploaded.sha256);
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/download`,{actor:null})).status,401);
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/download`,{actor:'isolation'})).status,404);
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}`,{actor:'isolation'})).status,404);
});
test('invoice confirmation requires human review and consumption, not totalAmount',async()=>{
 const common={...activity({quantity:12500,activityDate:'2026-09-30'}),version:uploaded.version,vendor:'Greenfield Utilities (Demo)',invoiceNumber:'DEMO-ELEC-2026-0930',amountInr:112500};
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body:common})).status,422);
 const {quantity,...moneyOnly}=common;
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body:{...moneyOnly,reviewConfirmed:true,totalAmount:112500}})).status,422);
 const r=await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body:{...common,reviewConfirmed:true}});
 assert.equal(r.status,201,JSON.stringify(r.body));assert.equal(r.data.quantity,12500);assert.equal(r.data.scope,'SCOPE_2');assert.equal(r.data.amountInr,112500);assert.equal(r.data.status,'DRAFT');assert.equal(r.data.inputSource,'INVOICE');assert.equal(r.data.documentId,uploaded.id);
 const doc=(await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}`)).data;assert.equal(doc.status,'LINKED');
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${uploaded.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body:{...common,version:doc.version,reviewConfirmed:true}})).status,409);
});
test('different files with the same vendor and invoice number cannot double count',async()=>{
 const r=await request('/api/v1/documents/upload',{method:'POST',form:fileForm('sample-electricity.txt',null,'text/plain')});assert.equal(r.status,201);
 const before=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM activities').get().n;
 const body={...activity({quantity:9876}),version:r.data.version,vendor:'greenfield utilities (demo)',invoiceNumber:'demo-elec-2026-0930',amountInr:112500,reviewConfirmed:true};
 const result=await request(`/api/v1/documents/${r.data.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body});assert.equal(result.status,409);assert.equal(result.body.error.code,'DUPLICATE_INVOICE');
 assert.equal(db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM activities').get().n,before);
 assert.equal((await request(`/api/v1/documents/${r.data.id}`)).data.status,'REVIEW_REQUIRED');
});
test('scanned invoice supports explicit manual fields without fake OCR',async()=>{
 const r=await request('/api/v1/documents/upload',{method:'POST',form:fileForm('scanned-electricity.png',null,'image/png')});assert.equal(r.status,201);assert.equal(r.data.extraction.method,'MANUAL_REVIEW');assert.deepEqual(r.data.extraction.fields,{});
 const body={...activity({quantity:9800,activityDate:'2026-10-01'}),version:r.data.version,vendor:'Campus Energy Services (Demo)',invoiceNumber:'DEMO-SCAN-2026-1001',amountInr:88200,reviewConfirmed:true};
 const result=await request(`/api/v1/documents/${r.data.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body});assert.equal(result.status,201);assert.equal(result.data.quantity,9800);
});
test('uploads reject invalid signatures, multiple files and read-only actors',async()=>{

 const form=fileForm();form.append('extra',new Blob(['bad'],{type:'text/plain'}),'extra.txt');assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/documents/upload',{method:'POST',form})).status,422);
 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/documents/upload',{actor:'ceo',method:'POST',form:fileForm()})).status,403);
});
test('invoice-linked calculation updates evidence coverage using consumption',async()=>{
 const doc=(await request('/api/v1/documents/'+uploaded.id)).data;
 let a=(await request('/api/v1/activity-data/'+doc.activityId)).data;
 const start=(await request('/api/v1/dashboard')).data;
 a=await step(a,'submit','entry');a=await step(a,'start-review');a=await step(a,'verify');a=await step(a,'calculate');
 assert.equal(a.calculation.kgCO2e,8875);const end=(await request('/api/v1/dashboard')).data;
 assert.equal(end.evidenceCount,start.evidenceCount+1);assert.ok(Math.abs(end.totalKgCO2e-start.totalKgCO2e-8875)<0.000001);
});
test('audit records cannot be edited or deleted and are scoped to the caller',async()=>{
 assert.throws(()=>db.prepare("UPDATE audit_logs SET action='ALTERED'").run(),/cannot be changed/);
 assert.throws(()=>db.prepare('DELETE FROM audit_logs').run(),/cannot be deleted/);
 const log=await request('/api/v1/audit-logs?limit=100',{actor:'ceo'});assert.equal(log.status,200);assert.ok(log.data.items.some(x=>x.action==='ACTIVITY_CALCULATED'));
 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/audit-logs?universityId='+OTHER)).status,403);
 const other=(await request('/api/v1/audit-logs',{actor:'isolation'})).data;assert.ok(other.items.every(x=>x.action==='LOGIN'));
});
test('report totals reconcile with calculation rows and factor snapshots',async()=>{
 const r=await request('/api/v1/reports/summary',{actor:'ceo'});assert.equal(r.status,200);assert.equal(r.data.demoOnly,true);
 const sum=db.prepare('SELECT SUM(kg_co2e) AS n FROM calculations WHERE university_id=?').get(meta.university.id).n;
 assert.ok(Math.abs(r.data.summary.totalKgCO2e-sum)<0.000001);
 const csv=await request('/api/v1/reports/export?format=csv',{actor:'ceo'});assert.equal(csv.status,200);assert.match(csv.body,/DEMO ONLY/);assert.match(csv.body,/DEMO-v1/);assert.match(csv.body,/not consumption/);
});
test('pagination, review queue and malformed JSON return stable API errors',async()=>{
 assert.equal((await request('/api/v1/activity-data?limit=1000')).status,422);
 const page=await request('/api/v1/activity-data?limit=2&page=2');assert.equal(page.data.items.length,2);assert.equal(page.data.pagination.page,2);
 const queue=await request('/api/v1/activity-data?status=REVIEW_QUEUE');assert.ok(queue.data.items.every(a=>['SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW','VERIFIED'].includes(a.status)));

test('file-backed SQLite data persists through closing and reopening',()=>{
 const dir=mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(),'carbonsynq-persistence-'));const filename=path.join(dir,'demo.sqlite');
 try{const first=openDatabase(filename);first.prepare('INSERT INTO universities VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)').run('persistence','Persistent campus','PERSIST','Test','2026-10-02T00:00:00Z');first.close();
 const second=openDatabase(filename);assert.equal(second.prepare('SELECT name FROM universities WHERE id=?').get('persistence').name,'Persistent campus');second.close();}
 finally{rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true});}

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {mkdtempSync,mkdirSync,copyFileSync,existsSync,readFileSync,readdirSync,rmSync} from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {DatabaseSync} from 'node:sqlite';
import {openDatabase,seed} from '../lib/db.mjs';
import {acquireRuntimeLock,ensureStopped} from '../lib/runtime.mjs';
function fixture(){
 const dir=mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(),'carbonsynq-operations-'));
 const data=path.join(dir,'data');mkdirSync(path.join(dir,'lib'));
 copyFileSync(new URL('../tools.mjs',import.meta.url),path.join(dir,'tools.mjs'));
 copyFileSync(new URL('../lib/runtime.mjs',import.meta.url),path.join(dir,'lib/runtime.mjs'));
 const db=openDatabase(path.join(data,'demo.sqlite'));seed(db);db.close();
 const run=(...args)=>spawnSync(process.execPath,[path.join(dir,'tools.mjs'),...args],{env:{...process.env,DEMO_DATA_DIR:data},encoding:'utf8',timeout:10000});
 return {dir,data,run,clean:()=>rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true})};
}
test('runtime lock blocks a second live process and backup while running',()=>{
 const f=fixture();let release;
 try{release=acquireRuntimeLock(f.data);assert.throws(()=>ensureStopped(f.data),/already be running/);assert.throws(()=>acquireRuntimeLock(f.data),/already be running/);const result=f.run('backup');assert.equal(result.status,1);assert.match(result.stderr,/already be running/);release();ensureStopped(f.data);assert.equal(existsSync(path.join(f.data,'server.pid')),false);}finally{release?.();f.clean();}
});
test('backup command creates a consistent reopenable SQLite snapshot',()=>{
 const f=fixture();try{const result=f.run('backup');assert.equal(result.status,0,result.stderr);const files=readdirSync(path.join(f.dir,'.backups'));assert.equal(files.length,1);const db=new DatabaseSync(path.join(f.dir,'.backups',files[0]),{readOnly:true});try{assert.equal(db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM activities').get().n,38);assert.equal(db.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check').get().integrity_check,'ok');}finally{db.close();}}finally{f.clean();}
});
test('reset refuses missing confirmation and preserves the current database',()=>{
 const f=fixture();try{const before=readFileSync(path.join(f.data,'demo.sqlite'));const result=f.run('reset');assert.equal(result.status,1);assert.match(result.stderr,/explicit confirmation/);assert.deepEqual(readFileSync(path.join(f.data,'demo.sqlite')),before);}finally{f.clean();}
});
test('confirmed reset preserves the old folder rather than deleting it',()=>{
 const f=fixture();try{const result=f.run('reset','--confirm-local-demo-reset');assert.equal(result.status,0,result.stderr);assert.equal(existsSync(f.data),false);const folders=readdirSync(f.dir).filter(n=>n.startsWith('data-before-reset-'));assert.equal(folders.length,1);const db=new DatabaseSync(path.join(f.dir,folders[0],'demo.sqlite'),{readOnly:true});try{assert.equal(db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM activities').get().n,38);}finally{db.close();}}finally{f.clean();}
});

Every approval leaves a record.</div><a href="/api-docs" target="_blank" rel="noopener">API reference &nearr;</a><div class="profile"><div class="avatar">${esc(state.user.name.split(' ').map(w=>w[0]).slice(0,2).join(''))}</div><div><strong>${esc(state.user.name)}</strong><small>${esc(roles[state.user.role])}</small></div></div></div></aside><main class="main"><header class="topbar"><div class="breadcrumb">Workspace <span>/ ${esc(state.meta.university.name)}</span></div><div class="row"><span class="local"><span class="status-dot" style="display:inline-block;background:#57845b;margin-right:5px"></span>Local database connected</span><button class="btn small" data-action="switch-role">${icon('users')} Switch role</button><button class="btn small ghost" data-action="logout">Sign out</button></div></header><div class="content"><div class="notice"><strong>DEMO ENVIRONMENT</strong> &nbsp; Synthetic campus data and illustrative factors. }

function progress(items){return `<div class="progress-list">${items.length?items.map(i=>`<div><div class="progress-label"><span>${esc(label(i.name))}</span><strong>${n(i.tCO2e)} t <span class="muted">&middot; ${n(i.share)}%</span></strong></div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${Math.min(100,i.share)}%"></div></div></div>`).join(''):'<p class="muted">No calculated activity yet.</p>'}</div>`;}
function workflowButtons(a){let buttons=`<button class="btn small" data-detail="${a.id}">View</button>`;
  if(canWrite()&&['DRAFT','REJECTED'].includes(a.status)&&(state.user.role==='ORGANISATION_ADMIN'||a.enteredById===state.user.id)){buttons+=`<button class="btn small" data-edit="${a.id}">Edit</button>`;if(a.status==='DRAFT')buttons+=`<button class="btn small primary" data-workflow="submit" data-id="${a.id}">Submit</button>`;}

  return buttons;
}
function activityTable(items,{compact=false}={}){
  for(const a of items)state.activities.set(a.id,a);
  if(!items.length)return '<div class="empty">No activities match this view.<br>Change the filters or add a new consumption record.</div>';
  return `<div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Activity / location</th><th>Date</th><th class="numeric">Consumption</th><th>Status</th>${compact?'':'<th class="numeric">Emissions</th>'}<th class="numeric">Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>${items.map(a=>`<tr><td><strong>${esc(label(a.category))}</strong><small>${esc(a.campusName)}${a.buildingName?' / '+esc(a.buildingName):''}${a.inputSource==='INVOICE'?' &middot; Invoice-linked':''}</small></td><td>${esc(a.activityDate)}</td><td class="numeric">${n(a.quantity,4)} <span class="muted">${esc(a.unit)}</span></td><td>${badge(a.status)}</td>${compact?'':`<td class="numeric">${a.calculation?`${n(a.calculation.kgCO2e,2)} <small>kgCO2e</small>`:'<span class="muted">Not calculated</span>'}</td>`}<td><div class="table-actions">${workflowButtons(a)}</div></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function pagination(p){return `<div class="pagination"><span>${p.total} records &middot; Page ${p.page} of ${Math.max(1,p.pages)}</span><div class="row"><button class="btn small" data-page="${p.page-1}" ${p.page<=1?'disabled':''}>Previous</button><button class="btn small" data-page="${p.page+1}" ${p.page>=p.pages?'disabled':''}>Next</button></div></div>`;}
async function renderDashboard(){
  const d=await api('/dashboard?'+filtersQuery());const monthMax=Math.max(1,...d.monthly.map(m=>Math.max(m.scope1TCO2e,m.scope2TCO2e)));
  const scope2=d.byScope.find(s=>s.name==='SCOPE_2');const share=scope2?.share??0;
  return heading('Campus impact, in focus.','A connected view of consumption, evidence and operational emissions.',canWrite()?`<button class="btn" data-action="upload">${icon('upload')} Upload invoice</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="new-activity">${icon('plus')} Manual entry</button>`:'')+
  `<div class="stack"><div class="row between wrap">${scopeFilters()}<span class="badge green">${d.calculatedActivities} CALCULATED RECORDS</span></div><div class="kpis"><article class="kpi featured"><div class="caption">Calculated emissions ${icon('leaf')}</div><div class="value">${n(d.totalTCO2e,2)}<small>tCO2e</small></div><div class="foot">Approved, calculated activities only</div></article><article class="kpi"><div class="caption">Activity records ${icon('list')}</div><div class="value">${n(d.totalActivities,0)}</div><div class="foot">${d.drafts} drafts &middot; ${d.calculatedActivities} calculated</div></article><article class="kpi"><div class="caption">Awaiting review ${icon('clock')}</div><div class="value">${n(d.pendingReview,0)}</div><div class="foot">${d.verifiedAwaitingCalculation} verified, awaiting calculation</div></article><article class="kpi"><div class="caption">Invoice-backed records ${icon('file')}</div><div class="value">${n(d.evidenceCoverage,1)}<small>%</small></div><div class="foot">${d.evidenceCount} of ${d.calculatedActivities} calculated records have evidence</div></article></div>
  <div class="grid-two"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-header"><div><h2>Emissions over time</h2><p>Monthly calculated totals &middot; tCO2e</p></div><div class="legend"><span><i class="swatch light"></i>Scope 1</span><span><i class="swatch"></i>Scope 2</span></div></div><div class="panel-body"><div class="chart-wrap"><div class="chart" role="img" aria-label="Monthly emissions: ${esc(d.monthly.map(m=>m.month+' '+m.totalTCO2e+' tCO2e').join('; '))}">${d.monthly.map(m=>`<div class="chart-col"><div class="chart-total">${n(m.totalTCO2e,1)}</div><div class="chart-bars"><div class="chart-bar light" style="height:${m.scope1TCO2e/monthMax*88}%" title="Scope 1: ${m.scope1TCO2e} tCO2e"></div><div class="chart-bar" style="height:${m.scope2TCO2e/monthMax*88}%" title="Scope 2: ${m.scope2TCO2e} tCO2e"></div></div><div class="chart-label">${new Date(m.month+'-15').toLocaleDateString('en',{month:'short'})}</div></div>`).join('')}</div></div></div><div class="panel-footer">Unverified activity is excluded. Seeded history is synthetic demonstration data.</div></section>
  <section class="panel"><div class="panel-header"><div><h2>Where emissions come from</h2><p>Operational boundary &middot; Scope 1 and Scope 2</p></div></div><div class="panel-body"><div class="scope-layout"><div class="donut" style="background:conic-gradient(#1b654d 0% ${share}%,#b9d58d ${share}% 100%)" role="img" aria-label="Scope 2 share ${share} percent"><div class="donut-label"><strong>${n(share,0)}%</strong><small>Scope 2 share</small></div></div><div class="scope-list">${['SCOPE_2','SCOPE_1'].map(key=>{const s=d.byScope.find(x=>x.name===key);return `<div class="scope-item"><div class="name"><i class="swatch ${key==='SCOPE_1'?'light':''}"></i>${key==='SCOPE_2'?'Purchased electricity':'Direct fuel combustion'}</div><strong>${n(s?.tCO2e,2)} <small>tCO2e</small></strong></div>`;}).join('')}</div></div></div><div class="panel-footer">Scope 3 and market-based electricity accounting are outside this demo.</div></section></div>
  <div class="grid-two"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-header"><div><h2>Campus contribution</h2><p>Share of calculated emissions</p></div>${icon('building')}</div><div class="panel-body">${progress(d.byCampus)}</div></section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-header"><div><h2>Activity mix</h2><p>Highest-emitting consumption categories</p></div>${icon('bolt')}</div><div class="panel-body">${progress(d.byCategory)}</div></section></div>
  <div class="insight">${icon('leaf')}<div><strong>Leadership insight</strong><br>${esc(d.insight)} Review the underlying quantities and factor sources before using this estimate for decisions.</div></div>
  <section class="panel"><div class="panel-header" style="padding-bottom:18px"><div><h2>Recent activity</h2><p>Every entry has a visible owner and workflow status.</p></div><button class="btn small" data-tab="activities">View ledger ${icon('arrow')}</button></div>${activityTable(d.recentActivities.slice(0,4),{compact:true})}</section></div>`;
}
async function renderActivities(review=false){
  const q={page:String(state.page),limit:'15',...(review?{status:'REVIEW_QUEUE'}:state.status?{status:state.status}:{}),...(state.search?{search:state.search}:{})};
  const data=await api('/activity-data?'+filtersQuery(q));
  return heading(review?'Review with confidence.':'Your activity ledger.',review?'Check the evidence, verify the quantity, then calculate. Self-approval is blocked.':'Track campus consumption from its first draft to its final calculation.',!review&&canWrite()?`<button class="btn primary" data-action="new-activity">${icon('plus')} Manual entry</button>`:'')+
    `<div class="stack">${review?'<div class="notice"><strong>Workflow:</strong> Submitted &rarr; Review &rarr; Verify &rarr; Calculate. Only calculated records contribute to the dashboard.</div>':''}<section class="panel"><div class="table-toolbar">${scopeFilters()}${review?`<span class="tag">${canReview()?'Reviewer permissions active':'Read-only queue'}</span>`:`<div class="filters"><label class="sr-only" for="statusFilter">Status</label><select id="statusFilter"><option value="">All statuses</option>${['DRAFT','SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW','VERIFIED','CALCULATED','REJECTED'].map(s=>`<option value="${s}" ${state.status===s?'selected':''}>${label(s)}</option>`).join('')}</select><form id="search-form"><label class="sr-only" for="searchInput">Search activities</label><input id="searchInput" name="search" value="${esc(state.search)}" placeholder="Search category or note"><button type="submit" class="btn small">Search</button></form></div>`}</div>${activityTable(data.items)}${pagination(data.pagination)}</section></div>`;
}
async function renderInvoices(){
  const data=await api(`/documents?page=${state.page}&limit=12`);for(const d of data.items)state.documents.set(d.id,d);
  return heading('Keep the evidence connected.','Upload once. Review the values. Link the original invoice to a consumption record.',canWrite()?`<button class="btn primary" data-action="upload">${icon('upload')} Upload invoice</button>`:'')+
  `<div class="stack">${canWrite()?`<section class="upload-zone">${icon('upload')}<h2>From invoice to a reviewable draft.</h2><p>PDF, PNG, JPEG or TXT &middot; Maximum 10 MB. Simple text PDFs can suggest fields. Scans and complex layouts use manual review, never fabricated OCR.</p><button class="btn" data-action="choose-file">Choose invoice</button><input id="invoiceFile" type="file" accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.txt" hidden><div class="sample-links"><a href="/samples/sample-electricity.pdf" download>Sample electricity PDF</a><a href="/samples/sample-diesel.pdf" download>Sample diesel PDF</a><a href="/samples/scanned-electricity.png" download>Sample scanned invoice</a></div></section>`:''}
  <div class="row between"><h2>Invoice library</h2><span class="muted" style="font-size:12px">${data.pagination.total} original documents &middot; All university periods</span></div>${data.items.length?`<div class="invoice-grid">${data.items.map(d=>`<article class="invoice-card"><div class="row between"><div class="file-icon">${icon('file')}</div>${badge(d.status)}</div><div><div class="file-name">${esc(d.originalName)}</div><p>${n(d.fileSize/1024,1)} KB &middot; ${esc(d.createdAt.slice(0,10))}</p></div><div class="file-meta">${d.extraction.method==='MANUAL_REVIEW'?'Manual field review needed':`${d.extraction.fieldsDetected.length} fields suggested - verification required`}<br>SHA-256: ${esc(d.sha256.slice(0,18))}...</div><div class="row"><button class="btn small ${d.status==='REVIEW_REQUIRED'&&canWrite()?'primary':''}" data-invoice="${d.id}">${d.status==='REVIEW_REQUIRED'&&canWrite()?'Review & create draft':'View evidence'}</button>${d.activityId?`<button class="btn small" data-detail="${d.activityId}">Activity</button>`:''}</div></article>`).join('')}</div>`:'<section class="panel"><div class="empty">No invoices yet. Start with the sample electricity PDF above.<br>The file stays in the local database with its hash and upload history.</div></section>'}${pagination(data.pagination)}</div>`;
}
async function renderReports(){
  const data=await api('/reports/summary?'+filtersQuery());const d=data.summary;
  return heading('A traceable leadership summary.','Export the evidence-backed ledger, with calculation factors and their versions.',`<button class="btn" data-export="json">${icon('download')} JSON</button><button class="btn primary" data-export="csv">${icon('download')} Export CSV</button>`)+
    `<div class="stack">${scopeFilters()}<div class="report-grid"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-body"><span class="eyebrow muted">${esc(data.university)}</span><div class="report-number">${n(d.totalTCO2e,3)} <span class="muted" style="font-size:16px">tCO2e</span></div><p class="muted" style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.7">${d.calculatedActivities} calculated records &middot; ${d.pendingReview} awaiting review<br>Generated ${new Date(data.generatedAt).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</p></div></section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-body"><h2>What this report includes</h2><p class="muted" style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;margin-top:14px">Consumption, unit, campus, category and source.<br>Workflow status and calculated emissions.<br>Factor value, version and provenance.<br>Invoice amounts kept separate from consumption.</p></div></section></div><div class="notice">${esc(data.factorNotice)} No Scope 3, offsets, credits or avoided-emissions claims are included.</div><section class="panel"><div class="panel-header" style="padding-bottom:18px"><div><h2>Transparent demonstration factors</h2><p>Frozen version DEMO-v1 &middot; 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027</p></div><span class="badge amber">NOT APPROVED FOR REPORTING</span></div><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>Scope</th><th class="numeric">Factor</th><th>Unit</th><th>Source / version</th></tr></thead><tbody>${state.meta.factors.map(f=>`<tr><td>${esc(label(f.category))}</td><td>${esc(label(f.scope))}</td><td class="numeric">${n(f.value,4)}</td><td>kgCO2e / ${esc(f.unit)}</td><td>${esc(f.version)}<small>${esc(f.source)}</small></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-body"><h2>Consumption by category</h2><p class="muted" style="font-size:12px;margin-top:9px">Unlike units are never added together.</p></div><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Category</th><th class="numeric">Quantity</th><th>Unit</th></tr></thead><tbody>${d.consumption.map(c=>`<tr><td>${esc(label(c.category))}</td><td class="numeric">${n(c.quantity,4)}</td><td>${esc(c.unit)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></section></div>`;
}
async function renderAudit(){const data=await api(`/audit-logs?page=${state.page}&limit=15`);return heading('Every action, accounted for.','Append-only application audit records for this university. Local administrators can still control the database file.')+`<section class="panel"><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>When / actor</th><th>Action</th><th>Entity</th><th>Change record</th></tr></thead><tbody>${data.items.map(a=>`<tr><td><strong>${esc(new Date(a.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-IN'))}</strong><small>${esc(a.user??'System')}</small></td><td><span class="audit-action">${esc(a.action)}</span></td><td>${esc(a.entityType)}<small class="code">${esc(a.entityId.slice(0,18))}...</small></td><td><details><summary>View changes</summary><pre class="code" style="max-width:440px;white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:12px">${esc(JSON.stringify({before:a.before,after:a.after,requestId:a.requestId},null,2))}</pre></details></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>${pagination(data.pagination)}</section>`;}
async function loadView(){const loadId=++state.loadId;const view=$('#view');if(!view)return;view.innerHTML='<div class="loading">Loading workspace data...</div>';document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('active',e.dataset.tab===state.tab));
  try{const html=state.tab==='dashboard'?await renderDashboard():state.tab==='activities'?await renderActivities():state.tab==='review'?await renderActivities(true):state.tab==='invoices'?await renderInvoices():state.tab==='reports'?await renderReports():await renderAudit();if(loadId===state.loadId&&state.user)view.innerHTML=html;}
  catch(e){if(loadId===state.loadId&&state.user)view.innerHTML=`<div class="error-box" style="margin-top:25px">${esc(e.message)} <button class="btn small" data-action="refresh">Retry</button></div>`;}}
function navigate(tab){state.tab=tab;state.page=1;state.search='';state.status='';loadView();}
let blobUrls=[];
function closeModal(){const modal=$('#modal');if(modal.open)modal.close();for(const url of blobUrls)URL.revokeObjectURL(url);blobUrls=[];modal.innerHTML='';}
function modal(title,subtitle,html,wide=false){closeModal();const m=$('#modal');m.className=wide?'wide':'';m.innerHTML=`<div class="modal-head"><div><h2 id="modal-title">${esc(title)}</h2><p>${esc(subtitle)}</p></div><button class="btn ghost small" data-action="close-modal" aria-label="Close dialog">${icon('close')}</button></div><div class="modal-body">${html}</div>`;m.showModal();}
function localToday(){const d=new Date();return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;}
function activityFields(a={}){const category=a.category??'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY';const cat=state.meta.categories.find(c=>c.category===category);const campusId=a.campusId??state.campus??'';const cid=campusId||state.meta.campuses[0]?.id;return `<div class="form-grid"><label class="field">Reporting period<select name="reportingPeriodId" required>${state.meta.reportingPeriods.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}" ${(a.reportingPeriodId??state.period)===p.id?'selected':''}>${esc(p.name)}${p.status==='LOCKED'?' - LOCKED':''}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label class="field">Activity date<input name="activityDate" type="date" value="${esc(a.activityDate??localToday())}" required></label><label class="field">Campus<select name="campusId" required>${state.meta.campuses.map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}" ${cid===c.id?'selected':''}>${esc(c.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label class="field">Building<select name="buildingId"><option value="">Campus total / no building</option>${state.meta.buildings.filter(b=>b.campusId===cid).map(b=>`<option value="${b.id}" ${a.buildingId===b.id?'selected':''}>${esc(b.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label class="field full">Activity category<select name="category" required>${state.meta.categories.map(c=>`<option value="${c.category}" ${category===c.category?'selected':''}>${esc(c.label)} - ${esc(label(c.scope))}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label class="field">Consumption quantity<input name="quantity" type="number" min="0.0001" step="0.0001" max="1000000000" value="${a.quantity??''}" placeholder="e.g. 1250" required><small>Actual consumption. Do not enter the invoice amount here.</small></label><label class="field">Consumption unit<input name="unit" value="${esc(a.unit??cat?.unit??'kWh')}" readonly required><small>Scope and unit follow the selected category.</small></label><label class="field full">Description / meter reference<textarea name="description" maxlength="2000" placeholder="e.g. Academic Block meter reading, September">${esc(a.description??'')}</textarea></label></div><details style="margin-top:15px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)"><summary>Separate genuine record matching an existing entry?</summary><label class="check-row"><input type="checkbox" name="allowDuplicate">Allow a matching activity only with a clear explanation.</label><label class="field" style="margin-top:10px">Duplicate justification<input name="duplicateReason" maxlength="500" placeholder="e.g. Different meter; reference MTR-002"></label></details>`;}
function formData(form){const raw=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));const body={...raw,quantity:Number(raw.quantity),allowDuplicate:raw.allowDuplicate==='on'};if(!body.buildingId)delete body.buildingId;if(!body.duplicateReason)delete body.duplicateReason;return body;}
function formError(form,error){const target=form.querySelector('.form-feedback');target.innerHTML=`<div class="error-box">${esc(error.message)}${error.code==='POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE'?'<br>Use the duplicate-justification section only for a separate legitimate record.':''}</div>`;target.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'});}
async function openManual(activityId=null){const a=activityId?await api('/activity-data/'+activityId):{};
  modal(activityId?'Edit consumption record':'Add a manual activity',activityId?'Changes return the record to draft. Prior decisions remain in the audit trail.':'Create a draft. It will not affect the dashboard until it is verified and calculated.',`<form id="activity-form" data-id="${activityId??''}" data-version="${a.version??''}" data-key="${crypto.randomUUID()}"><div class="form-feedback"></div>${activityFields(a)}<div id="calculation-preview"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn" data-action="preview-calculation">Preview estimate</button><button class="btn primary" type="submit">${activityId?'Save changes':'Save draft'}</button></div></form>`);
}
async function openDetail(activityId){const a=await api('/activity-data/'+activityId);state.activities.set(a.id,a);
  const detail=(title,value)=>`<div class="detail-item"><small>${title}</small><strong>${esc(value??'Not provided')}</strong></div>`;
  modal('Activity record',a.id,`<div class="stack"><div class="row between">${badge(a.status)}<span class="tag">Version ${a.version}</span></div><div class="detail-grid">${detail('Category',label(a.category))}${detail('Consumption',n(a.quantity,4)+' '+a.unit)}${detail('Campus / building',a.campusName+' / '+(a.buildingName??'Campus total'))}${detail('Activity date',a.activityDate)}${detail('Source',a.inputSource)}${detail('Entered by',a.enteredBy)}${detail('Verified by',a.verifiedBy)}${detail('Invoice amount - NOT consumption',a.amountInr===null?'Not provided':'INR '+n(a.amountInr,2))}${detail('Vendor',a.vendor)}${detail('Invoice number',a.invoiceNumber)}</div>${a.description?`<p class="muted" style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.7">${esc(a.description)}</p>`:''}${a.rejectionReason?`<div class="error-box">Rejection reason: ${esc(a.rejectionReason)}</div>`:''}${a.calculation?`<div class="calc-preview"><strong>${n(a.calculation.kgCO2e,4)} kgCO2e</strong> = ${n(a.quantity,4)} ${esc(a.unit)} &times; ${a.calculation.factor} kgCO2e/${esc(a.unit)}<br>${esc(a.calculation.version)} &middot; ${esc(a.calculation.source)}</div>`:'<div class="notice">Not included in dashboard totals until verified and calculated.</div>'}${a.documentId?`<button class="btn" data-invoice="${a.documentId}">${icon('file')} View original invoice evidence</button>`:''}<div class="row wrap">${workflowButtons(a).replace(/<button class="btn small" data-detail="[^"]+">View<\/button>/,'')}${canWrite()&&['DRAFT','REJECTED'].includes(a.status)?`<button class="btn small danger" data-delete="${a.id}">Delete draft</button>`:''}</div></div>`);
}
async function openInvoice(documentId){
  const d=await api('/documents/'+documentId);const response=await api(`/documents/${documentId}/download`,{raw:true});const blob=await response.blob();const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const editable=d.status==='REVIEW_REQUIRED'&&canWrite();
  const pdfText=d.extraction.textPreview;
  const original=d.mimeType==='application/pdf'?`${pdfText?`<div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:12px"><strong>Readable PDF text - unverified.</strong><br>This is extracted text, not the original layout. Open the original PDF below or download it before confirming.</div><pre>${esc(pdfText)}</pre>`:''}<details ${pdfText?'':'open'} style="margin-top:14px"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:12px">Open original PDF preview</summary><iframe title="Original invoice PDF" src="${url}"></iframe><p class="muted" style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;margin-top:8px">PDF preview depends on your browser. Use Download original if the preview is unavailable.</p></details>`:d.mimeType.startsWith('image/')?`<img src="${url}" alt="Original uploaded invoice">`:`<pre>${esc(await blob.text())}</pre>`;
  const fields=d.extraction.fields;const isManual=d.extraction.method==='MANUAL_REVIEW';
  const body=editable?`<form id="invoice-review-form" data-id="${d.id}" data-version="${d.version}"><div class="form-feedback"></div><div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:17px"><strong>${isManual?'Manual review required.':'Suggestions only - verify every field.'}</strong> ${esc(d.extraction.warnings.join(' '))}</div><div class="form-grid" style="margin-bottom:17px"><label class="field">Vendor<input name="vendor" maxlength="150" value="${esc(fields.vendor??'')}" required></label><label class="field">Invoice number<input name="invoiceNumber" maxlength="80" value="${esc(fields.invoiceNumber??'')}" required></label><label class="field full">Invoice amount in INR (optional)<input name="amountInr" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="${fields.amountInr??''}" placeholder="Money only; not used for emissions"></label></div>${activityFields({...fields,...(!fields.activityDate?{activityDate:''}:{}),...(!fields.category?{category:'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY'}:{})})}<label class="check-row"><input type="checkbox" name="reviewConfirmed" required>I checked the original invoice, the consumption quantity, its unit, date and campus. The amount in rupees is not the consumption.</label><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn primary" type="submit">Confirm review & create draft</button></div></form>`:`<div class="stack">${badge(d.status)}<div class="notice">${editable?'':'This view is read-only. '}${d.status==='LINKED'?'The original invoice is linked to its activity.':'Sign in as an administrator or data-entry user to confirm fields.'}</div><h3>${d.reviewed?'Reviewed values':'Extracted suggestions'}</h3><pre class="code" style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.8">${esc(JSON.stringify(d.reviewed??fields,null,2))}</pre>${d.activityId?`<button class="btn primary" data-detail="${d.activityId}">Open linked activity</button>`:''}</div>`;
  modal('Invoice evidence',d.originalName,`<div class="invoice-review"><section class="preview-pane">${original}<div class="file-meta" style="margin-top:10px">Original file &middot; ${n(d.fileSize/1024)} KB<br>SHA-256 <span class="code">${esc(d.sha256)}</span></div><button class="btn small" style="margin-top:12px" data-download-invoice="${d.id}">Download original</button></section><section>${body}</section></div>`,true);blobUrls.push(url);
}
async function workflow(action,activityId){const a=state.activities.get(activityId)??await api('/activity-data/'+activityId);const updated=await api(`/activity-data/${activityId}/${action}`,{method:'POST',body:{version:a.version}});state.activities.set(activityId,updated);closeModal();toast(action==='calculate'?`Calculated: ${n(updated.calculation.kgCO2e,2)} kgCO2e. Dashboard updated.`:`Activity is now ${label(updated.status).toLowerCase()}.`);await loadView();}
async function download(route,filename){const response=await api(route,{raw:true});const url=URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob());const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),2000);}
async function upload(file){if(!file)return;toast('Uploading invoice and checking for readable text...');const form=new FormData();form.set('file',file);try{const d=await api('/documents/upload',{method:'POST',body:form});state.tab='invoices';state.page=1;await loadView();await openInvoice(d.id);toast('Original saved. Verify the values before creating a draft.');}catch(e){if(e.code==='DUPLICATE_FILE'&&e.details?.documentId){toast('This file is already uploaded. Opening the existing record.');await openInvoice(e.details.documentId);}else throw e;}}
async function chooseFile(){if(state.tab!=='invoices'){state.tab='invoices';state.page=1;await loadView();}$('#invoiceFile')?.click();}

document.addEventListener('click',async event=>{
  const button=event.target.closest('button');if(!button||button.disabled)return;const d=button.dataset;
  try{
    if(d.fillRole){const form=$('#login-form');form.elements.email.value=`${d.fillRole}@carbonsynq.demo`;form.elements.password.value='Demo@12345';return;}
    if(d.tab){navigate(d.tab);return;}
    if(d.page){state.page=Number(d.page);await loadView();return;}
    if(d.detail){await openDetail(d.detail);return;}
    if(d.edit){await openManual(d.edit);return;}
    if(d.invoice){await openInvoice(d.invoice);return;}
    if(d.workflow){button.disabled=true;await workflow(d.workflow,d.id);return;}
    if(d.reject){const a=state.activities.get(d.reject);modal('Reject activity','A reason is required and will be visible to the data-entry team.',`<form id="reject-form" data-id="${a.id}" data-version="${a.version}"><div class="form-feedback"></div><label class="field">Reason<textarea name="reason" minlength="5" maxlength="1000" required placeholder="Explain what needs correcting"></textarea></label><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn danger" type="submit">Reject activity</button></div></form>`);return;}
    if(d.delete){const a=state.activities.get(d.delete);modal('Delete this draft?','The deletion is permanent, but its audit record remains.',`<p class="muted">${esc(label(a.category))} &middot; ${n(a.quantity,4)} ${esc(a.unit)}</p><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn" data-action="close-modal">Cancel</button><button class="btn danger" data-confirm-delete="${a.id}" data-version="${a.version}">Delete draft</button></div>`);return;}
    if(d.confirmDelete){await api(`/activity-data/${d.confirmDelete}`,{method:'DELETE',body:{version:Number(d.version)}});closeModal();toast('Draft deleted. Audit history retained.');await loadView();return;}
    if(d.downloadInvoice){const doc=await api('/documents/'+d.downloadInvoice);await download(`/documents/${d.downloadInvoice}/download`,doc.originalName);return;}
    if(d.export){await download('/reports/export?'+filtersQuery({format:d.export}),`CarbonSynq-DEMO-report.${d.export}`);toast('Demonstration report exported.');return;}
    if(d.demoSwitch){button.disabled=true;await api('/auth/logout',{method:'POST'});state.token=null;closeModal();await enter(`${d.demoSwitch}@carbonsynq.demo`,'Demo@12345');toast(`Switched to ${roles[state.user.role]}.`);return;}
    if(d.action==='logout'){await api('/auth/logout',{method:'POST'});state.token=null;state.user=null;closeModal();showLogin();return;}
    if(d.action==='switch-role'){modal('Switch demo role','Use separate identities to demonstrate the maker-checker workflow.',`<div class="role-options">${accounts.map(([key,title,sub])=>`<button class="role-option" data-demo-switch="${key}">${title}<small>${sub}</small></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="notice" style="margin-top:18px">This shortcut signs in to a separate local demo account. It is not a production impersonation feature.</div>`);return;}
    if(d.action==='new-activity'){await openManual();return;}
    if(d.action==='close-modal'){closeModal();return;}
    if(['upload','choose-file'].includes(d.action)){await chooseFile();return;}
    if(d.action==='refresh'){await loadView();return;}
    if(d.action==='preview-calculation'){const form=$('#activity-form');if(!form.reportValidity())return;try{const p=await api('/activity-data/preview',{method:'POST',body:formData(form)});$('#calculation-preview').innerHTML=`<div class="calc-preview"><strong>${n(p.kgCO2e,4)} kgCO2e</strong> = ${n(p.quantity,4)} ${esc(p.unit)} &times; ${p.factor} ${esc(p.factorUnit)}<br>Preview only &middot; ${esc(p.factorVersion)} &middot; Not yet included in dashboard.</div>`;}catch(e){formError(form,e);}return;}
  }catch(e){toast(e.message);}finally{if(button.isConnected)button.disabled=false;}
});
document.addEventListener('submit',async event=>{
  const form=event.target;if(!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement))return;event.preventDefault();const button=form.querySelector('[type=submit]');if(button)button.disabled=true;
  try{
    if(form.id==='login-form'){const fields=new FormData(form);await enter(fields.get('email'),fields.get('password'));}
    else if(form.id==='search-form'){state.search=new FormData(form).get('search');state.page=1;await loadView();}
    else if(form.id==='activity-form'){const body=formData(form);const aid=form.dataset.id;if(aid)body.version=Number(form.dataset.version);await api('/activity-data'+(aid?'/'+aid:''),{method:aid?'PATCH':'POST',body,headers:aid?{}:{'Idempotency-Key':form.dataset.key}});closeModal();state.tab='activities';state.page=1;await loadView();toast('Draft saved. Submit it for independent review.');}
    else if(form.id==='invoice-review-form'){const body=formData(form);body.amountInr=body.amountInr===''?null:Number(body.amountInr);body.reviewConfirmed=body.reviewConfirmed==='on';body.version=Number(form.dataset.version);const a=await api(`/documents/${form.dataset.id}/create-activity`,{method:'POST',body});closeModal();state.tab='activities';state.page=1;await loadView();await openDetail(a.id);toast('Invoice-linked draft created. Submit it for review.');}
    else if(form.id==='reject-form'){await api(`/activity-data/${form.dataset.id}/reject`,{method:'POST',body:{reason:new FormData(form).get('reason'),version:Number(form.dataset.version)}});closeModal();await loadView();toast('Activity rejected with a recorded reason.');}
  }catch(e){if(form.id==='login-form')$('#login-error').innerHTML=`<div class="error-box" style="margin-bottom:15px">${esc(e.message)}</div>`;else if(form.querySelector('.form-feedback'))formError(form,e);else toast(e.message);}
  finally{if(button?.isConnected)button.disabled=false;}
});
document.addEventListener('change',async event=>{
  const e=event.target;
  try{
    if(e.id==='periodFilter'){state.period=e.value;state.page=1;await loadView();}
    else if(e.id==='campusFilter'){state.campus=e.value;state.page=1;await loadView();}
    else if(e.id==='statusFilter'){state.status=e.value;state.page=1;await loadView();}
    else if(e.id==='invoiceFile'){await upload(e.files[0]);e.value='';}
    else if(e.name==='category'){const cat=state.meta.categories.find(c=>c.category===e.value);e.form.elements.unit.value=cat.unit;const p=$('#calculation-preview');if(p)p.innerHTML='';}
    else if(e.name==='campusId'){const select=e.form.elements.buildingId;select.innerHTML='<option value="">Campus total / no building</option>'+state.meta.buildings.filter(b=>b.campusId===e.value).map(b=>`<option value="${b.id}">${esc(b.name)}</option>`).join('');}
  }catch(error){toast(error.message);}
});
$('#modal').addEventListener('cancel',()=>{for(const url of blobUrls)URL.revokeObjectURL(url);blobUrls=[];});
showLogin();
