### 23. `public/api-docs.html`

SHA-256: `efa95c909d495ccf9100ea0bf08dede82c2197969aa14f7f85ddd399c391758c`

```html
<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>CarbonSynq - API reference</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f4f6f3;color:#17382d;font:15px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}main{max-width:1150px;margin:auto;padding:48px 28px}h1{font-size:40px;letter-spacing:-1.5px;line-height:1.1}h2{font-size:23px;margin-top:35px}a{color:#1d674e}p{color:#5b7066}.eyebrow{font-size:12px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:2px}code,pre{font:12px/1.7 ui-monospace,monospace}pre{background:#133f30;color:#eef5df;padding:24px;border-radius:14px;overflow:auto}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;background:white}td,th{text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid #e5eae3;padding:18px;vertical-align:top}th{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;background:#eaf0e7}td p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:12px}.method{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;background:#e5f1ce;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:5px}.notice{padding:18px;border:1px solid #cbddb5;background:#edf4e1;border-radius:12px}.table{overflow:auto;border-radius:12px}nav{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}.small{font-size:12px}li{margin-bottom:7px}
</style></head><body><main><div class="eyebrow">CARBONSYNQ / UNIVERSITY DEMO</div><h1>Backend API reference.</h1><p>Offline documentation for the isolated local Node/SQLite application.</p><nav><a href="/">Open workspace</a><a href="/openapi.json" download="CarbonSynq-openapi.json">Download OpenAPI 3.0 JSON</a></nav><h2>Before using the API</h2><div class="notice">Local demo only. Synthetic records and illustrative factors. Every business route requires a bearer session; tenant identity comes from that session. Uploaded scans do not undergo AI OCR.</div><p>Base address: <code>http://localhost:5050/api/v1</code>. Use <code>Content-Type: application/json</code> for JSON operations. Uploads use multipart field <code>file</code>. The original Express/Neon application's contract is separate.</p><h2>Sign in</h2><pre>POST /api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{"email":"admin@carbonsynq.demo","password":"Demo@12345"}</pre><p>Read <code>data.token</code> from the result and send <code>Authorization: Bearer TOKEN</code>. Other accounts: <code>entry@carbonsynq.demo</code>, <code>reviewer@carbonsynq.demo</code>, <code>ceo@carbonsynq.demo</code>, all using the same local demo password. Sessions expire after eight hours; logout revokes them.</p><h2>Create a manual draft</h2><pre>POST /api/v1/activity-data
Authorization: Bearer TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json
Idempotency-Key: unique-request-id

{
  &quot;reportingPeriodId&quot;: &quot;44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444&quot;,
  &quot;campusId&quot;: &quot;22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222&quot;,
  &quot;category&quot;: &quot;PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY&quot;,
  &quot;quantity&quot;: 1250,
  &quot;unit&quot;: &quot;kWh&quot;,
  &quot;activityDate&quot;: &quot;2026-10-02&quot;,
  &quot;description&quot;: &quot;CEO demo manual consumption&quot;
}</pre><p>Get building and campus IDs from <code>GET /api/v1/meta</code>. Quantity is actual consumption, not an invoice's rupee amount. Canonical units: electricity kWh; diesel/petrol litre; LPG kg; natural gas m3.</p><h2>Review, verify and calculate</h2><p>Use <code>POST /activity-data/ID/submit</code> as the entry's author/admin with <code>{"version":1}</code>. Use the version returned by each call for the next transition. Sign into a separate reviewer and call <code>start-review</code>, <code>verify</code>, then <code>calculate</code>. Verify blocks self-approval, including administrators. Only calculated records change emissions totals. Repeated calculation cannot add another result.</p><h2>Invoice evidence</h2><p>Upload one PDF, PNG, JPEG or TXT under 10 MB, inspect <code>data.extraction</code>, download the original with authenticated <code>/documents/ID/download</code>, and confirm through <code>/documents/ID/create-activity</code>. Submit all activity fields, <code>version</code>, <code>vendor</code>, <code>invoiceNumber</code>, optional <code>amountInr</code>, and <code>reviewConfirmed:true</code>. Text suggestions are never approved automatically.</p><h2>Response and conflict handling</h2><pre>{"success":true,"data":{...},"requestId":"..."}
{"success":false,"error":{"code":"STALE_VERSION","message":"..."},"requestId":"..."}</pre><p>Downloads and reports return file bytes directly. Refresh records after HTTP 409 rather than overwriting newer data. Do not automatically resubmit a non-idempotent request under a new key after a network failure. File and logical invoice duplicates also return 409. JSON is limited to 64 KB; API lists accept page and limit (maximum 100).</p><h2>Endpoint index</h2><div class="table"><table><thead><tr><th>Method</th><th>Route and purpose</th><th>Notes</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/health</code><p>Check local service and database</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/auth/login</code><p>Sign in with a local demo account</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/auth/me</code><p>Get the authenticated identity</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/auth/logout</code><p>Revoke the current bearer session</p></td><td>No request body required.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/meta</code><p>Get tenant, campuses, buildings, periods and categories</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/emission-factors</code><p>Get illustrative factor catalog</p></td><td>Demo factors only; not verified official accounting factors.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/dashboard</code><p>Get calculated-only operational dashboard</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data</code><p>List consumption activities</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data</code><p>Create a manual draft</p></td><td>Admin/data-entry only. Same-key same-payload retry is safe; conflicting key or unjustified domain duplicate returns 409.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/preview</code><p>Preview a consumption estimate without writing</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}</code><p>Get a tenant-owned activity and calculation</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">PATCH</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}</code><p>Edit a draft or rejected record</p></td><td>Original author or administrator. Editing a rejected record returns it to DRAFT.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">DELETE</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}</code><p>Delete a draft or rejected record</p></td><td>Original author or administrator. Audit retained; linked document returns to review required. A JSON body with version is required.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}/submit</code><p>Submit an activity</p></td><td>Author or admin: DRAFT to SUBMITTED.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}/start-review</code><p>Start review an activity</p></td><td>Reviewer or admin: SUBMITTED to UNDER_REVIEW.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}/verify</code><p>Verify an activity</p></td><td>Reviewer or admin, never the author: UNDER_REVIEW to VERIFIED.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}/reject</code><p>Reject an activity</p></td><td>Reviewer or admin: UNDER_REVIEW to REJECTED. Reason required.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/activity-data/{id}/calculate</code><p>Calculate an activity</p></td><td>Reviewer or admin: VERIFIED to CALCULATED. Already-calculated replay returns the existing calculation.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/documents</code><p>List original invoice evidence</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/documents/upload</code><p>Upload one original invoice</p></td><td>Admin/data-entry only. PDF, PNG, JPEG or TXT; one file up to 10 MB. Simple text extraction only, no AI OCR. Always requires human review.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/documents/{id}</code><p>Get invoice metadata and suggested/reviewed fields</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/documents/{id}/download</code><p>Download the exact original bytes</p></td><td>Authenticated same-tenant evidence download, recorded in the audit trail.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/documents/{id}/create-activity</code><p>Confirm reviewed fields and create an invoice-linked draft</p></td><td>Admin/data-entry only. Manual human confirmation required; money is not consumption. One document to one activity.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/audit-logs</code><p>List tenant audit events</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/reports/summary</code><p>Get full activity ledger and calculated-only summary</p></td><td></td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">GET</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/reports/export</code><p>Download a JSON or CSV report</p></td><td>Exports all filtered activity statuses. Emissions/factors are filled only for calculated records; summary totals exclude pending activities. Not an audited inventory.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/reporting-periods/{id}/lock</code><p>Lock a reporting period</p></td><td>Administrator only. JSON object body required; pending entries do not prevent locking. API-only control in this demo.</td></tr><tr><td><span class="method">POST</span></td><td><code>/api/v1/reporting-periods/{id}/unlock</code><p>Unlock a reporting period</p></td><td>Administrator only. JSON object body required; pending entries do not prevent locking. API-only control in this demo.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><h2>Source and operations</h2><p>See <code>university-demo/docs/HLD.md</code>, <code>DEMO_GUIDE.md</code> and <code>docs/VERIFICATION.md</code> inside the package. Run tests with <code>npm run demo:test</code>. Stop the server before backup/reset.</p><p class="small">No cloud deployment, production OCR, real university data or official factor library is included.</p></main></body></html>
```

```json
    "securitySchemes": {
      "bearerAuth": {
        "type": "http",
        "scheme": "bearer",
        "bearerFormat": "Opaque session token"
      }
    },
    "schemas": {
      "Error": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "success",
          "error",
          "requestId"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "success": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "enum": [
              false
            ]
          },

            "type": "object",
            "required": [

              "message": {

              },
              "details": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": true
              }
            }
          },
          "requestId": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "uuid"
          }
        }
      },
      "Login": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "email",
          "password"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "email",
            "example": "admin@carbonsynq.demo"
          },
          "password": {
            "type": "string",
            "example": "Demo@12345"
          }
        }
      },
      "LoginResult": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "token": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Opaque bearer token; store in memory, not a URL."
          },
          "expiresAt": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "date-time"
          },
          "user": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
          }
        }
      },
      "ActivityInput": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "reportingPeriodId",
          "campusId",
          "category",
          "quantity",
          "unit",
          "activityDate"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reportingPeriodId": {
            "type": "string",
            "example": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
          },
          "campusId": {
            "type": "string",
            "example": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
          },
          "buildingId": {
            "type": "string",
            "nullable": true,
            "description": "Optional. Must belong to the selected campus."
          },
          "category": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY",
              "DIESEL",
              "PETROL",
              "LPG",
              "NATURAL_GAS"
            ]
          },
          "scope": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "SCOPE_1",
              "SCOPE_2"
            ],
            "description": "Optional; derived from category. A supplied inconsistent value is rejected."
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "number",
            "minimum": 0.0001,
            "maximum": 1000000000.0,
            "description": "Actual consumption, at most 4 decimal places. Never the currency amount.",
            "example": 1250
          },
          "unit": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "kWh",
              "litre",
              "kg",
              "m3"
            ],
            "description": "Must match the canonical category unit.",
            "example": "kWh"
          },
          "activityDate": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "date",
            "example": "2026-10-02"
          },
          "description": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 2000
          },
          "allowDuplicate": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "default": false
          },
          "duplicateReason": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 500,
            "description": "Required with allowDuplicate for a separate matching record."
          }
        }
      },
      "ActivityUpdate": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "version"
        ],

          "version": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1
          },

            "example": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
          },
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  importJobsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/activityDataImportV1.js';
import { stagingStore } from '../services/stagingStore.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let buildingId: string;
let floorId: string;
const activityIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    headers: {} as Record<string, string>,
    setHeader(name: string, value: string) {
      res.headers[name] = value;
    },
    send(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any; headers?: Record<string, string> };
}

function makeCsv(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]): Buffer {
  const sheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(
    rows.map((r) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).map(([k, v]) => [k, v == null ? '' : String(v)]))),
  );
  return Buffer.from(XLSX.utils.sheet_to_csv(sheet));
}

function fileReq(buffer: Buffer, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return {
    body,
    file: { originalname: `imp-${RUN}.csv`, buffer, mimetype: 'text/csv', size: buffer.length },
  } as unknown as Request;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `Imp Org ${RUN}`, code: `IMP-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  const [other] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `Imp Other ${RUN}`, code: `IMPO-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  if (!org || !other) throw new Error('seed org failed');
  orgId = org.id;
  otherOrgId = other.id;

  const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId,
    name: `Imp Period ${RUN}`,
    startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
    endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T00:00:00.000Z'),
    status: 'OPEN',
  }).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = period!.id;

  const [campus] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: 'Main Campus', code: `MC-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'CAMPUS',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  const [building] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, parentId: campus!.id, name: 'Alpha Building', code: `ALP-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  const [floor] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, parentId: building!.id, name: 'Ground Floor', code: `G1-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'FLOOR',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  buildingId = building!.id;
  floorId = floor!.id;

    // Seed at LOCAL midnight: xlsx's CSV date parsing (cellDates) produces local-midnight
    // Dates for bare 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings, mirroring V1's own timezone-sensitive behavior.
    const [dupe] = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '50.0000',
      unit: 'L',
      activityDate: new Date(2025, 2, 1),
      status: 'DRAFT',
    }).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityIds.push(dupe!.id);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(importJobsTable).where(eq(importJobsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'ImportJob'));
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('C2 GET /activity-data/import/template', () => {
  it('returns the exact CSV bytes with attachment headers and no envelope', () => {
    const res = resMock();
    controller.downloadTemplate({} as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers?.['Content-Type']).toBe('text/csv');
    expect(res.headers?.['Content-Disposition']).toContain('activity_data_template.csv');
    expect(String(res.body)).toBe(
      'activityDate,category,quantity,unit,building,floor,description\n'
      + '2026-08-01,PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY,10000,kWh,Main Building,Ground Floor,Monthly electricity\n'
      + '2026-08-02,DIESEL,500,L,Generator,,Generator fuel',
    );
  });
});

describe('C3 POST /activity-data/import/preview', () => {
  it('rejects missing body fields', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(makeCsv([]), {}) as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId and reportingPeriodId are required');
  });

  it('rejects a missing file', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport({ body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId } } as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('No file uploaded');
  });

  it('validates rows with exact V1 error strings', async () => {
    // A row is dropped by the sheet reader only when EVERY cell is empty, so keep one
    // non-empty cell to exercise the missing-field errors for date/category/quantity.
    const buf = makeCsv([
      { activityDate: '', category: '', quantity: '', unit: 'L' },
      { activityDate: 'nope', category: 'NUCLEAR', quantity: -5, unit: '' },
      { activityDate: '2025-04-01', category: 'diesel', quantity: 10, unit: 'L', building: 'Missing Hall' },
    ]);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.totalRows).toBe(3);
    expect(res.body.data.validRows).toBe(0);
    expect(res.body.data.rows[0].errors).toEqual([
      'Missing required field: activityDate',
      'Missing required field: category',
      'Missing required field: quantity',
    ]);
    expect(res.body.data.rows[1].errors.join('|')).toContain('Invalid activityDate format');
    expect(res.body.data.rows[1].errors.join('|')).toContain('Unknown category: NUCLEAR');
    expect(res.body.data.rows[2].errors).toEqual(['Building not found: Missing Hall']);

    const unitBuf = makeCsv([{ activityDate: '2025-04-02', category: 'LPG', quantity: 1, unit: '' }]);
    const unitRes = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(unitBuf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, unitRes);
    expect(unitRes.body.data.rows[0].errors).toEqual(['Missing required field: unit']);
  });

  it('normalizes category case, derives scope, resolves building/floor by name and code', async () => {
    const buf = makeCsv([
      { activityDate: '2025-05-01', category: 'purchased_electricity', quantity: 100, unit: 'kWh', building: 'alpha building', floor: 'ground floor' },
      { activityDate: '2025-05-02', category: 'PETROL', quantity: 20, unit: 'L', building: `ALP-${RUN}` },
    ]);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, res);

        expect(res.body.data.validRows).toBe(2);
    const [rowA, rowB] = res.body.data.rows;
    expect(rowA.data.category).toBe('PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY');
    expect(rowA.data.scope).toBe('SCOPE_2');
    expect(rowA.data.buildingId).toBe(buildingId);
    expect(rowA.data.floorId).toBe(floorId);
    expect(rowB.data.scope).toBe('SCOPE_1');
    expect(rowB.data.buildingId).toBe(buildingId);
    expect(rowB.data.floorId).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('flags duplicates against existing activity rows without blocking validity', async () => {
    const buf = makeCsv([{ activityDate: '2025-03-01', category: 'DIESEL', quantity: 50, unit: 'L' }]);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.data.rows[0]).toMatchObject({ isValid: true, isDuplicate: true });
  });

  it('persists CSV, XLSX and XLS mime types untruncated into import_jobs.file_type', async () => {
    const mimeCases = [
      'text/csv',
      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
      'application/vnd.ms-excel',
    ];

    for (const mimetype of mimeCases) {
      const res = resMock();
      await controller.previewImport(
        {
          body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId },
          file: { originalname: `mime-${RUN}`, buffer: makeCsv([{ activityDate: '2025-09-01', category: 'LPG', quantity: 1, unit: 'kg' }]), mimetype, size: 10 },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res,
      );
      expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

      const jobs = await db.select().from(importJobsTable).where(eq(importJobsTable.id, res.body.data.jobId));
      expect(jobs[0]!.fileType).toBe(mimetype);
    }
  });

  it('creates a PREVIEW job, stages rows and writes IMPORT_STARTED audit', async () => {
    const buf = makeCsv([{ activityDate: '2025-06-01', category: 'LPG', quantity: 5, unit: 'kg' }]);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, res);

    const jobId = res.body.data.jobId;
    expect(stagingStore.get(jobId)!.length).toBe(1);

    const jobs = await db.select().from(importJobsTable).where(eq(importJobsTable.id, jobId));
    expect(jobs[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'PREVIEW', totalRows: 1 });

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, jobId));
    expect(audits[0]).toMatchObject({ action: 'IMPORT_STARTED', entity: 'ImportJob', description: 'Data import preview started' });
  });
});

describe('C4 POST /activity-data/import/confirm', () => {
  it('requires universityId, reportingPeriodId and jobId', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport({ body: {} } as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Missing required fields');
  });

  it('rejects unknown or non-PREVIEW jobs', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, jobId: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid or expired import job');
  });

  it('reports expired staging through IMPORT_FAILED audit and exact message', async () => {
    const [job] = await db.insert(importJobsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId, fileName: 'gone.xlsx', fileType: 'text/csv', totalRows: 1, status: 'PREVIEW',
    }).returning({ id: importJobsTable.id });

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, jobId: job!.id } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Preview data expired. Please upload again.');

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, job!.id));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'IMPORT_FAILED' && a.description === 'Preview data expired')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('inserts staged valid rows with most-granular entity mapping and completes the job', async () => {
    // Stage through the real preview path so data matches production shape.
    const buf = makeCsv([
      { activityDate: '2025-07-01', category: 'NATURAL_GAS', quantity: 11, unit: 'm3', building: 'Alpha Building', floor: 'Ground Floor', description: 'Gas bill' },
      { activityDate: '2025-07-02', category: 'REFRIGERANT', quantity: 2, unit: 'kg', building: 'Alpha Building' },
      { activityDate: '2025-03-01', category: 'DIESEL', quantity: 50, unit: 'L' }, // duplicate flag -> prefix
    ]);
    const preview = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, preview);
    const jobId = preview.body.data.jobId;
    
    const skipped = [preview.body.data.rows.find((r: any) => !r.isValid)?.row].filter(Boolean) as number[];
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, jobId, sourceFileId: 'doc-1', skippedRows: skipped } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['success', 'message', 'importedRows']));
    expect(res.body.importedRows).toBe(3);

    const inserted = await db.select().from(activityDataTable)
      .where(eq(activityDataTable.sourceFileId, 'doc-1'));
    expect(inserted.length).toBe(3);
    const gas = inserted.find((a) => a.description === 'Gas bill');
    expect(gas).toMatchObject({ status: 'DRAFT', inputSource: 'EXCEL', sourceFileId: 'doc-1' });
    expect(gas!.physicalEntityId).toBe(floorId);

    const refrig = inserted.find((a) => a.category === 'REFRIGERANT');
    expect(refrig!.physicalEntityId).toBe(buildingId);

    const dupe = inserted.find((a) => a.category === 'DIESEL');
    expect(dupe!.description).toBe('POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: ');

    const jobs = await db.select().from(importJobsTable).where(eq(importJobsTable.id, jobId));
    expect(jobs[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'COMPLETED', successfulRows: 3 });

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, jobId));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'IMPORT_COMPLETED')).toBe(true);

    expect(stagingStore.get(jobId)).toBeUndefined();
    activityIds.push(...inserted.map((a) => a.id));

  });

  it('skips requested rows and rejects zero-row confirms', async () => {
    const buf = makeCsv([
      { activityDate: '2025-08-01', category: 'PETROL', quantity: 3, unit: 'L' },
      { activityDate: '2025-08-02', category: 'LPG', quantity: 4, unit: 'kg' },
    ]);
    const preview = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, preview);
    const rows: any[] = preview.body.data.rows;

    const skipAll = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, jobId: preview.body.data.jobId, skippedRows: rows.map((r) => r.row) } } as unknown as Request,
      skipAll,
    );
    expect(skipAll.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(skipAll.body.message).toBe('No valid rows to import');

    const partial = resMock();
    await controller.previewImport(fileReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, partial);
    const keepFirst = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, jobId: partial.body.data.jobId, skippedRows: [rows[1].row] } } as unknown as Request,
      keepFirst,
    );
    expect(keepFirst.body.importedRows).toBe(1);
    const kept = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.organisationId, orgId));
    activityIds.push(
      ...kept.filter((a) => a.category === 'PETROL' && a.quantity === '3.0000').map((a) => a.id),
    );
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { and, eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  calculationsTable,
  documentsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { updateActivityDataSchema } from '../validators/activityDataCreate.js';
import { getActivityDataById } from '../services/activityDataGetById.js';
import { updateActivityData } from '../services/activityDataUpdate.js';
import { deleteActivityData } from '../services/activityDataDelete.js';
import { getActivityDataByIdController } from '../controllers/activityDataGetById.js';
import { updateActivityDataController } from '../controllers/activityDataUpdate.js';
import { deleteActivityDataController } from '../controllers/activityDataDelete.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let campusId: string;
let buildingId: string;
let floorId: string;
let campus2Id: string;
let building2Id: string;
let floor2Id: string;
let electricityTaxonomyId: string | null;

const createdActivityIds: string[] = [];
const efIds: string[] = [];

async function seedActivity(values: {
  physicalEntityId?: string | null;
  category?: string;
  scope?: string;
  quantity?: number;
  unit?: string;
  activityDate?: Date | null;
  status?: string;
  description?: string | null;
}): Promise<string> {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      physicalEntityId: values.physicalEntityId ?? null,
      category: (values.category ?? 'DIESEL') as never,
      scope: (values.scope ?? 'SCOPE_1') as never,
      quantity: (values.quantity ?? 100).toFixed(4),
      unit: values.unit ?? 'litre',
      activityDate:
        values.activityDate === undefined
          ? new Date('2025-06-15T10:30:00.000Z')
          : values.activityDate,
      status: (values.status ?? 'DRAFT') as never,
      description: values.description ?? 'item-test-row',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(id);
  return id;
}

async function seedDoc(activityId: string, fileName: string): Promise<string> {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(documentsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      activityDataId: activityId,
      documentType: 'FUEL_INVOICE',
      fileName,
      originalName: fileName,
      fileUrl: `https://example.com/${fileName}`,
      mimeType: 'application/pdf',
      fileSize: 1234,
    })
    .returning({ id: documentsTable.id });
  return rows[0]!.id;
}

async function latestAudit(entityId: string, action: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(auditLogsTable)
    .where(and(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, entityId), eq(auditLogsTable.action, action as never)))
    .orderBy(auditLogsTable.createdAt);
  return rows[rows.length - 1] ?? null;
}

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

function call(
  controller: (req: Request, res: Response) => Promise<void>,
  req: Partial<Request>,
) {
  const res = resMock();
  return { res, run: controller(req as Request, res) };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org AD Item V1', code: 'test-adi-' + RUN, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgRows[0]!.id;

  const otherOrgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org AD Item V1 Other', code: 'test-adi-other-' + RUN, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  otherOrgId = otherOrgRows[0]!.id;

  const periodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      name: 'Test Period ADI ' + RUN,
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = periodRows[0]!.id;

  async function insertEntity(parentId: string | null, name: string, subtype: string, type: string) {
    const rows = await db
      .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .values({
        organisationId: orgId,
        parentId,
        name,
        code: `ADI-${subtype}-${RUN}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
        type: type as never,
        subtype: subtype as never,
      })
      .returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
    return rows[0]!.id;
  }

  campusId = await insertEntity(null, 'Item Campus One', 'CAMPUS', 'LOCATION');
  buildingId = await insertEntity(campusId, 'Item Building One', 'BUILDING', 'FACILITY');
  floorId = await insertEntity(buildingId, 'Item Floor One', 'FLOOR', 'LOCATION');
  campus2Id = await insertEntity(null, 'Item Campus Two', 'CAMPUS', 'LOCATION');
  building2Id = await insertEntity(campus2Id, 'Item Building Two', 'BUILDING', 'FACILITY');
  floor2Id = await insertEntity(building2Id, 'Item Floor Two', 'FLOOR', 'LOCATION');

  const taxRows = await db
    .select({ id: taxonomyActivitiesTable.id })
    .from(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.code, 'ENERGY.ELECTRICITY'))
    .limit(1);
  electricityTaxonomyId = taxRows[0]?.id ?? null;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  if (createdActivityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entityId, createdActivityIds));
  }
  if (efIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(inArray(emissionFactorsTable.id, efIds));
  }
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('updateActivityDataSchema (V1 PATCH contract)', () => {
  it('is partial and omits universityId/reportingPeriodId without the create refinement', () => {
    expect(updateActivityDataSchema.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);

    const stripped = updateActivityDataSchema.parse({
      universityId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      quantity: 10,
    });
    expect(stripped.quantity).toBe(10);
    expect('universityId' in stripped).toBe(false);
    expect('reportingPeriodId' in stripped).toBe(false);

    const mixedScope = updateActivityDataSchema.safeParse({ scope: 'SCOPE_2', category: 'DIESEL' });
    expect(mixedScope.success).toBe(true);

    expect(updateActivityDataSchema.safeParse({ quantity: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateActivityDataSchema.safeParse({ quantity: -5 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateActivityDataSchema.safeParse({ sourceDocumentUrl: 'not-a-url' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('C7 GET /activity-data/:id', () => {

    expect(data.buildingId).toBe(buildingId);

    expect(data.assetId).toBeNull();
    expect(data.category).toBe('DIESEL');
    expect(data.scope).toBe('SCOPE_1');
    expect(data.quantity).toBe(500.5);
    expect(typeof data.quantity).toBe('number');
    expect(data.unit).toBe('litre');
    expect(data.activityDate).toBe('2025-06-15T10:30:00.000Z');
    expect(data.status).toBe('DRAFT');
    expect(data.enteredById).toBeNull();
    expect(data.verifiedById).toBeNull();
    expect(data.verifiedAt).toBeNull();
    expect(data.rejectionReason).toBeNull();
    expect(data.inputSource).toBe('MANUAL');

    expect(typeof data.createdAt).toBe('string');

    expect(typeof data.documents[0].createdAt).toBe('string');
  });

  it('returns null hierarchy levels and an empty documents array for a campus-level row', async () => {

    expect(data.buildingId).toBeNull();

  it('rejects missing universityId with the V1 message', async () => {

  it('hides records from other tenants behind the not-found message', async () => {

});

describe('C8 PATCH /activity-data/:id', () => {
  it('updates a single field and returns a flat V1 row without relation keys', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ physicalEntityId: floorId, description: 'before-patch' });
    const before = (await getActivityDataById(id, orgId)) as Record<string, any>;

    const data = (await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ description: 'after-patch' }))) as Record<string, any>;

    expect(data.description).toBe('after-patch');
    expect(data.quantity).toBe(100);
    expect('campus' in data).toBe(false);
    expect('building' in data).toBe(false);
    expect('floor' in data).toBe(false);
    expect('createdBy' in data).toBe(false);

    expect(new Date(data.updatedAt).getTime()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
      new Date(before.updatedAt).getTime(),
    );

    expect(dbRow.physicalEntityId).toBe(floorId);
  });

    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'patch-quantity-precision' });

    expect(data.quantity).toBe(100.1235);
  });

    expect(dataA.category).toBe('PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY');

    expect(dbRowB.taxonomyActivityId).toBeNull();
  });

  it('accepts an in-bounds activityDate change', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'patch-date-ok' });
    const data = (await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ activityDate: '2025-03-03T08:00:00.000Z' }))) as Record<string, any>;
    expect(data.activityDate).toBe('2025-03-03T08:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('rejects an out-of-period activityDate with the exact V1 message', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'patch-date-bad' });
    await expect(

    ).rejects.toThrow('Activity date must be within reporting period bounds');

    await expect(

    ).rejects.toThrow('Cannot edit activity data that is VERIFIED. Request correction to move to DRAFT.');

    const rejectedId = await seedActivity({ status: 'REJECTED', description: 'patch-locked-r' });
    await expect(
      updateActivityData(rejectedId, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ description: 'x' })),
    ).rejects.toThrow('Cannot edit activity data that is REJECTED. Request correction to move to DRAFT.');
  });

  it('returns the V1 not-found error for missing or foreign records', async () => {
    const foreignId = await seedActivity({ description: 'patch-isolation' });
    await expect(
      updateActivityData(foreignId, otherOrgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ description: 'x' })),
    ).rejects.toThrow('Activity data not found');
    await expect(
      updateActivityData('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ description: 'x' })),
    ).rejects.toThrow('Activity data not found');
  });

  it('resolves D-11 building-only patches to the new building and its ancestors', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ physicalEntityId: floorId, description: 'd11-building' });
    const data = (await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ buildingId: building2Id }))) as Record<string, any>;

    expect(data.buildingId).toBe(building2Id);
    expect(data.campusId).toBe(campus2Id);
    expect(data.floorId).toBeNull();
    const dbRow = (await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, id)))[0]!;
    expect(dbRow.physicalEntityId).toBe(building2Id);
  });

  it('resolves D-11 campus-only patches to the campus alone', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ physicalEntityId: floorId, description: 'd11-campus' });
    const data = (await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ campusId: campus2Id }))) as Record<string, any>;

    expect(data.campusId).toBe(campus2Id);
    expect(data.buildingId).toBeNull();
    expect(data.floorId).toBeNull();
  });

  it('resolves D-11 floor-only patches to the floor plus its ancestor chain', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ physicalEntityId: campusId, description: 'd11-floor' });
    const data = (await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ floorId: floor2Id }))) as Record<string, any>;

    expect(data.floorId).toBe(floor2Id);
    expect(data.buildingId).toBe(building2Id);
    expect(data.campusId).toBe(campus2Id);
  });

  it('preserves the stored entity when no hierarchy fields are supplied', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ physicalEntityId: floorId, description: 'd11-none' });
    const data = (await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ unit: 'gallon' }))) as Record<string, any>;

    expect(data.floorId).toBe(floorId);
    expect(data.buildingId).toBe(buildingId);
    expect(data.campusId).toBe(campusId);
    expect(data.unit).toBe('gallon');
  });

  it('persists inputSource and source fields on update', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'patch-source-fields' });
    const data = (await updateActivityData(
      id,
      orgId,
      updateActivityDataSchema.parse({
        inputSource: 'CSV',
        sourceFileId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',
        sourceFileName: 'readings.csv',
        sourceDocumentUrl: 'https://example.com/readings.csv',
      }),
    )) as Record<string, any>;

    expect(data.inputSource).toBe('CSV');
    expect(data.sourceFileId).toBe('11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111');
    expect(data.sourceFileName).toBe('readings.csv');
    expect(data.sourceDocumentUrl).toBe('https://example.com/readings.csv');
  });

  it('audits ACTIVITY_UPDATED with old and new quantities', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ quantity: 100, description: 'patch-audit' });
    await updateActivityData(id, orgId, updateActivityDataSchema.parse({ quantity: 250 }));

    const audit = await latestAudit(id, 'ACTIVITY_UPDATED');
    expect(audit).not.toBeNull();
    expect(audit!.entity).toBe('ActivityData');
    expect(audit!.description).toBe('Activity data updated');
    expect((audit!.oldValue as any).quantity).toBe(100);
    expect((audit!.newValue as any).quantity).toBe(250);
  });

  it('controller returns the D-2 envelope for invalid bodies and message envelope for missing tenant', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'patch-controller' });

    const bad = call(updateActivityDataController, {
      params: { id },
      query: { universityId: orgId },
      body: { quantity: 0 },
    });
    await bad.run;
    expect(bad.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(bad.res.body).toMatchObject({ success: false, error: 'Invalid request body' });
    expect((bad.res.body as any).details[0].field).toBe('quantity');

    const noTenant = call(updateActivityDataController, { params: { id }, query: {}, body: {} });
    await noTenant.run;
    expect(noTenant.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(noTenant.res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
  });
});

describe('C9 DELETE /activity-data/:id', () => {
  it('hard deletes the record and returns the V1 message envelope', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'delete-success' });

    const { res, run } = call(deleteActivityDataController, {
      params: { id },
      query: { universityId: orgId },
    });
    await run;

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: true, message: 'Activity data deleted successfully' });
    expect('data' in (res.body as object)).toBe(false);

    const rows = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, id));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('blocks deleting VERIFIED records and reports missing/foreign records as not found', async () => {
    const verifiedId = await seedActivity({ status: 'VERIFIED', description: 'delete-locked' });
    await expect(deleteActivityData(verifiedId, orgId)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Cannot delete VERIFIED activity data',
    );
    const stillThere = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, verifiedId));
    expect(stillThere).toHaveLength(1);

    const foreignId = await seedActivity({ description: 'delete-isolation' });
    await expect(deleteActivityData(foreignId, otherOrgId)).rejects.toThrow('Activity data not found');
    await expect(deleteActivityData('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', orgId)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Activity data not found',
    );
  });

  it('cascades linked calculations on delete', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'delete-cascade-calc' });

    const efRows = await db
      .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
      .values({
        factorId: `test-ef-item-${RUN}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
        activityId: 'test/activity/diesel',
        name: 'Test EF item',
        unit: 'litre',
        factor: '2.680000',
        factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/litre',
      })
      .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
    const efId = efRows[0]!.id;
    efIds.push(efId);

    await db.insert(calculationsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      activityDataId: id,
      emissionFactorId: efId,
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '100.0000',
      activityUnit: 'litre',
      emissionFactor: '2.680000',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/litre',
      co2eKg: '268.0000',
    });

    await deleteActivityData(id, orgId);

    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, id));
    expect(calcRows).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('detaches linked documents by setting their activity link to null', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'delete-doc-setnull' });
    const docId = await seedDoc(id, 'detach-me.pdf');

    await deleteActivityData(id, orgId);

    const docRows = await db.select().from(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, docId));
    expect(docRows).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(docRows[0]!.activityDataId).toBeNull();
  });

  it('audits DELETE with the full old record', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ quantity: 42, description: 'delete-audit' });
    await deleteActivityData(id, orgId);

    const audit = await latestAudit(id, 'DELETE');
    expect(audit).not.toBeNull();
    expect(audit!.entity).toBe('ActivityData');
    expect(audit!.description).toBe('Activity data deleted');
    expect((audit!.oldValue as any).id).toBe(id);
    expect((audit!.oldValue as any).quantity).toBe(42);
    expect(audit!.newValue).toBeNull();
  });

  it('controller rejects missing universityId with the V1 message', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(deleteActivityDataController, {
      params: { id: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' },
      query: {},
    });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { getActivityData } from '../services/activityDataList.js';
import { getActivityDataController } from '../controllers/activityDataList.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let campusId: string;
let buildingId: string;
let floorId: string;

interface CreatedRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
}

const created: CreatedRow[] = [];

async function insertActivity(values: {
  category: typeof activityDataTable.$inferInsert.category;
  scope: typeof activityDataTable.$inferInsert.scope;
  status?: typeof activityDataTable.$inferInsert.status;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  activityDate: Date | null;
  physicalEntityId: string | null;
  description: string;
}) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      physicalEntityId: values.physicalEntityId,
      category: values.category,
      scope: values.scope,
      quantity: values.quantity.toFixed(4),
      unit: values.unit,
      activityDate: values.activityDate,
      status: values.status ?? 'DRAFT',
      description: values.description,
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  created.push({ id, label: values.description });
  return id;
}

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },

      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

describe('GET /activity-data (V1 behavior)', () => {
  it('returns defaults, envelope, ordering and reconstructed relations', async () => {

    expect(new Date(dates[dates.length - 1]!)).toEqual(new Date('2025-03-03T00:00:00.000Z'));

    expect(unlinked).toBeDefined();
    expect(unlinked!.campus).toBeNull();
    expect(unlinked!.building).toBeNull();
    expect(unlinked!.floor).toBeNull();
    expect(unlinked!.createdBy).toBeNull();
    expect(unlinked!.verifiedBy).toBeNull();

    const floorRow = result.data.find((row) => row.description === 'adl-electricity-floor');
    expect(floorRow).toBeDefined();
    expect(floorRow!.campus).toEqual({ name: 'List Test Campus' });
    expect(floorRow!.building).toEqual({ name: 'List Test Building' });
    expect(floorRow!.floor).toEqual({ name: 'List Test Floor' });
    expect(floorRow!.campusId).toBe(campusId);
    expect(floorRow!.buildingId).toBe(buildingId);
    expect(floorRow!.floorId).toBe(floorId);
    expect(floorRow!.quantity).toBe(1000);
    expect(typeof floorRow!.quantity).toBe('number');
    expect(floorRow!.universityId).toBe(orgId);
  });

  it('filters by reportingPeriodId and tenant', async () => {
    const result = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId });
    expect(result.pagination.total).toBe(6);

    const empty = await getActivityData({ universityId: otherOrgId });
    expect(empty.data).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(empty.pagination.total).toBe(0);
    expect(empty.pagination.totalPages).toBe(0);
  });

  it('filters by scope, category and status', async () => {
    const scope2 = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, scope: 'SCOPE_2' });
    expect(scope2.pagination.total).toBe(2);

    const diesel = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, category: 'DIESEL' });
    expect(diesel.pagination.total).toBe(1);
    expect(diesel.data[0]!.description).toBe('adl-diesel-floor');

    const draft = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, status: 'DRAFT' });
    expect(draft.pagination.total).toBe(2);

    const verified = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, status: 'VERIFIED' });
    expect(verified.pagination.total).toBe(1);
    expect(verified.data[0]!.status).toBe('VERIFIED');
  });

  it('filters by inclusive date range and excludes null dates', async () => {
    const result = await getActivityData({
      universityId: orgId,
      from: new Date('2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      to: new Date('2025-06-30T23:59:59.999Z'),
    });

    expect(result.pagination.total).toBe(3);
    const descriptions = result.data.map((row) => row.description).sort();
    expect(descriptions).toEqual(['adl-diesel-floor', 'adl-electricity-floor', 'adl-petrol-building']);
  });

  it('filters by hierarchy subtrees (campus, building, floor)', async () => {
    const byCampus = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, campusId });
    expect(byCampus.pagination.total).toBe(5);

    const byBuilding = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, buildingId });
    expect(byBuilding.pagination.total).toBe(4);

    const byFloor = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, floorId });
    expect(byFloor.pagination.total).toBe(3);

    expect(descriptions).toEqual(['adl-diesel-floor', 'adl-electricity-floor', 'adl-electricity-july']);

    expect(result.data).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(result.pagination.total).toBe(0);

  it('paginates with page/limit and computes totals', async () => {
    const page1 = await getActivityData({ universityId: orgId, page: 1, limit: 4 });
    expect(page1.pagination).toEqual({ page: 1, limit: 4, total: 6, totalPages: 2 });
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/activityDataList.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
const FORBIDDEN = 'Forbidden: Access restricted to your own university';

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
const ids: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgs = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values([
    { name: `Rev A ${RUN}`, code: `REV-A-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    { name: `Rev B ${RUN}`, code: `REV-B-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
  ]).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgs[0]!.id;
  otherOrgId = orgs[1]!.id;

  const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: `RP ${RUN}`, startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T00:00:00Z'), status: 'OPEN',
  }).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = period!.id;

  // page-limit window is 3 rows; statuses chosen so filtering leaves short pages.
  const rows = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values([
    { organisationId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '1.0000', unit: 'L', status: 'VERIFIED' },
    { organisationId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, category: 'PETROL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '2.0000', unit: 'L', status: 'DRAFT' },
    { organisationId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, category: 'LPG', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '3.0000', unit: 'kg', status: 'UNDER_REVIEW' },
    { organisationId: otherOrgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, category: 'CNG', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '4.0000', unit: 'm3', status: 'DRAFT' },
  ]).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  ids.push(...rows.map((r) => r.id));
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.id, ids));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('C5 GET /activity-data/review', () => {
  it('requires universityId with the exact message', async () => {

    await controller.getReviewActivitiesController({ query: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId is required');
  });

  it('is reachable and filters to DRAFT/UNDER_REVIEW after pagination (Q-10)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getReviewActivitiesController(
      { query: { universityId: orgId, limit: '3' }, user: { userId: 'u', role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,

    );

    expect(res.body.data).toHaveLength(2); // VERIFIED row consumed a pagination slot

  it('returns no pagination envelope', async () => {

      res,
    );
    expect(res.body).not.toHaveProperty('pagination');
  });

  it('normalizes cross-tenant access to 403', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getReviewActivitiesController(
      { query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId: 'u', role: 'USER', universityId: otherOrgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe(FORBIDDEN);
  });

  it('lets SUPER_ADMIN bypass isolation', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getReviewActivitiesController(
      { query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId: 'sa', role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', universityId: null } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
  });

  it('is not shadowed by GET /:id routing', async () => {
    // The route table mounts /review before /:id; a request for /review must
    // never be interpreted as an :id lookup.
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getReviewActivitiesController(
      { query: { universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import {
  rejectActivityData,
  startReviewActivityData,
  submitActivityData,
  verifyActivityData,
} from '../services/activityDataWorkflow.js';
import {
  rejectActivityDataController,
  startReviewActivityDataController,
  submitActivityDataController,
  verifyActivityDataController,
} from '../controllers/activityDataWorkflow.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let otherPeriodId: string;

const createdActivityIds: string[] = [];

async function seedActivity(values: {
  status?: string;
  rejectionReason?: string | null;
  quantity?: string;
  activityDate?: Date | null;
  reportingPeriodId?: string;
  description?: string;
}): Promise<string> {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: values.reportingPeriodId ?? periodId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: values.quantity ?? '100.0000',
      unit: 'litre',
      activityDate:
        values.activityDate === undefined ? new Date('2025-06-15T10:30:00.000Z') : values.activityDate,
      status: (values.status ?? 'DRAFT') as never,
      rejectionReason: values.rejectionReason ?? null,
      description: values.description ?? 'workflow-test-row',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(id);
  return id;
}

async function dbRow(id: string) {
  const rows = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, id));
  return rows[0]!;
}

async function latestAudit(entityId: string, action: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(auditLogsTable)
    .where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, entityId))
    .orderBy(auditLogsTable.createdAt);
  return rows.filter((r) => r.action === action).pop() ?? null;
}

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

function call(
  controller: (req: Request, res: Response) => Promise<void>,
  req: Partial<Request>,
) {
  const res = resMock();
  return { res, run: controller(req as Request, res) };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org AD Flow V1', code: 'test-adf-' + RUN, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgRows[0]!.id;

  const otherOrgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org AD Flow V1 Other', code: 'test-adf-other-' + RUN, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  otherOrgId = otherOrgRows[0]!.id;

  const periodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      name: 'Test Period ADF A ' + RUN,
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = periodRows[0]!.id;

  const otherPeriodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: otherOrgId,
      name: 'Test Period ADF B ' + RUN,
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  otherPeriodId = otherPeriodRows[0]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  if (createdActivityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entityId, createdActivityIds));
  }
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('C10 POST /activity-data/:id/submit', () => {
  it('transitions DRAFT to SUBMITTED and clears rejectionReason', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'flow-submit-draft' });

    const data = (await submitActivityData(id, orgId, null)) as Record<string, any>;
    expect(data.status).toBe('SUBMITTED');
    expect(data.rejectionReason).toBeNull();

    const row = await dbRow(id);
    expect(row.status).toBe('SUBMITTED');

    const audit = await latestAudit(id, 'UPDATE');
    expect(audit).not.toBeNull();
    expect(audit!.description).toBe('Activity status changed to SUBMITTED');
  });

  it('transitions REJECTED to SUBMITTED and clears the stale reason', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({
      status: 'REJECTED',
      rejectionReason: 'fix units',
      description: 'flow-submit-rejected',
    });

    const data = (await submitActivityData(id, orgId, null)) as Record<string, any>;
    expect(data.status).toBe('SUBMITTED');
    expect(data.rejectionReason).toBeNull();
  });

  it('rejects transitions from SUBMITTED and VERIFIED with the exact V1 message', async () => {
    const submittedId = await seedActivity({ status: 'SUBMITTED', description: 'flow-submit-bad-s' });
    await expect(submitActivityData(submittedId, orgId, null)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Only DRAFT or REJECTED records can be SUBMITTED',
    );

    const verifiedId = await seedActivity({ status: 'VERIFIED', description: 'flow-submit-bad-v' });
    await expect(submitActivityData(verifiedId, orgId, null)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Only DRAFT or REJECTED records can be SUBMITTED',
    );

    const underReviewId = await seedActivity({ status: 'UNDER_REVIEW', description: 'flow-submit-bad-u' });
    await expect(submitActivityData(underReviewId, orgId, null)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Only DRAFT or REJECTED records can be SUBMITTED',
    );
  });

  it('controller returns the V1 envelope and guards body universityId', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({ description: 'flow-submit-controller' });

    const ok = call(submitActivityDataController, {
      params: { id },
      body: { universityId: orgId },
    });
    await ok.run;
    expect(ok.res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(ok.res.body).toMatchObject({
      success: true,
      message: 'Activity data submitted successfully',
    });
    expect((ok.res.body as any).data.status).toBe('SUBMITTED');

    const missing = call(submitActivityDataController, { params: { id }, body: {} });
    await missing.run;
    expect(missing.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(missing.res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required in body' });

    const badTransition = call(submitActivityDataController, {
      params: { id },
      body: { universityId: orgId },
    });
    await badTransition.run;
    expect(badTransition.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(badTransition.res.body).toEqual({
      success: false,
      message: 'Only DRAFT or REJECTED records can be SUBMITTED',
    });
  });

  it('reports foreign and unknown records as not found', async () => {
    const foreignId = await seedActivity({ description: 'flow-submit-isolation' });
    await expect(submitActivityData(foreignId, otherOrgId, null)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Activity data not found',
    );
    await expect(submitActivityData('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010', orgId, null)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Activity data not found',
    );
  });
});

describe('C11 POST /activity-data/:id/start-review', () => {
  it('transitions SUBMITTED to UNDER_REVIEW and clears a stale rejectionReason', async () => {
    const id = await seedActivity({
      status: 'SUBMITTED',
      rejectionReason: 'stale note',
      description: 'flow-review-ok',
    });

  });
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { organisationsTable, physicalEntitiesTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/assetsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
let orgId: string;
let campusId: string;
let buildingId: string;
let floorAId: string;
let floorBId: string;
const createdIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `AstOrg ${RUN}`, code: `AST-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;

  const [campus] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: 'AC', code: `AC-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'CAMPUS',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  campusId = campus!.id;

  const [building] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, parentId: campusId, name: 'AB', code: `AB-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  buildingId = building!.id;

  const floors = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values([
    { organisationId: orgId, parentId: buildingId, name: 'FA', code: `FA-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'FLOOR' },
    { organisationId: orgId, parentId: buildingId, name: 'FB', code: `FB-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'FLOOR' },
  ]).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  floorAId = floors[0]!.id;
  floorBId = floors[1]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('POST /assets', () => {
  it('fails with the exact parent message when the floor is missing', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Ghost Meter', code: `GM-${RUN}`, type: 'ELECTRICITY_METER', floorId: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005' },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Floor not found');
  });

  it('maps ELECTRICITY_METER to the METER subtype and folds specs into metadata', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: {
        name: 'Main Meter', code: `MM-${RUN}`, type: 'ELECTRICITY_METER', floorId: floorAId,
        manufacturer: 'Schneider', modelNumber: 'PM2100', capacity: 100, capacityUnit: 'kW',
        description: 'main intake',
      },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Asset created successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({
      type: 'ELECTRICITY_METER', status: 'ACTIVE', manufacturer: 'Schneider',
      capacity: 100, capacityUnit: 'kW', floorId: floorAId,
    });
    expect(res.body.data.floor.id).toBe(floorAId);

    const rows = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'EQUIPMENT', subtype: 'METER' });
    expect((rows[0]!.metadata as any)).toMatchObject({ assetType: 'ELECTRICITY_METER', manufacturer: 'Schneider' });
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
  });

  it('maps FIRE_SUPPRESSION_SYSTEM and OTHER to OTHER subtype', async () => {
    for (const t of ['FIRE_SUPPRESSION_SYSTEM', 'OTHER']) {
      const res = resMock();
      await controller.create({
        body: { name: `${t} asset`, code: `${t}-${RUN}`, type: t, floorId: floorAId },
      } as unknown as Request, res);
      expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
      createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
      const rows = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, res.body.data.id));
      expect(rows[0]!.subtype).toBe('OTHER');
    }
  });

  it('rejects same-floor duplicates with the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Dup Meter', code: `MM-${RUN}`, type: 'ELECTRICITY_METER', floorId: floorAId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Asset with this code already exists on this floor');
  });

  it('permits the same code under a different floor (V1 scoping)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Twin Meter', code: `MM-${RUN}`, type: 'ELECTRICITY_METER', floorId: floorBId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
  });
});

describe('GET /assets', () => {
  it('filters by type and status and clamps limits', async () => {
    const byType = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { type: 'ELECTRICITY_METER' } } as unknown as Request, byType);
    expect(byType.body.data.every((a: any) => a.type === 'ELECTRICITY_METER')).toBe(true);

    const byStatus = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { status: 'DECOMMISSIONED' } } as unknown as Request, byStatus);
    expect(byStatus.body.data).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('filters by floor and searches case-insensitively', async () => {
    const byFloor = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { floorId: floorBId } } as unknown as Request, byFloor);
    expect(byFloor.body.data.every((a: any) => a.floorId === floorBId)).toBe(true);

    const searchRes = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { search: 'main met' } } as unknown as Request, searchRes);
    expect(searchRes.body.data.some((a: any) => a.code === `MM-${RUN}`)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns the fixed 500 message on query failure', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { floorId: 'bad' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(500);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Failed to fetch assets');
  });
});

describe('GET /assets/:id', () => {
  it('reconstructs the deep chain including the full university object', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: createdIds[0] } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

    expect(uni).toMatchObject({ id: orgId, country: 'India' });
    expect(Object.keys(uni)).toContain('createdAt');
  });

    await controller.getById({ params: { id: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);

});

describe('PATCH /assets/:id', () => {
  it('updates status/capacity metadata with the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { status: 'INACTIVE', capacity: 150 } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Asset updated successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ status: 'INACTIVE', capacity: 150 });
  });

      type: 'EQUIPMENT', subtype: 'METER',

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: tgt!.id }, body: { code: `MM-${RUN}` } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Asset with this code already exists on this floor');
  });

  it('ignores attempted floorId reparenting', async () => {
    const res = resMock();

});
```
