import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  auditLogsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/auditLogsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
const FORBIDDEN = 'Forbidden: Audit logs are restricted to admins';

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let userId: string;
const logIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

async function insertLog(values: Partial<typeof auditLogsTable.$inferInsert> = {}) {
  const [row] = await db.insert(auditLogsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId,
    userId,
    action: 'CREATE',
    entity: 'Report',
    entityId: `e-${logIds.length}`,
    description: 'test log',
    ...values,
  }).returning({ id: auditLogsTable.id });
  logIds.push(row!.id);
  return row!.id;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgs = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values([
    { name: `AudA ${RUN}`, code: `AUD-A-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    { name: `AudB ${RUN}`, code: `AUD-B-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
  ]).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgs[0]!.id;
  otherOrgId = orgs[1]!.id;

  const [user] = await db.insert(usersTable).values({
    authUserId: randomUUID(), username: `aud-${RUN}`, email: `aud-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: `aud-password-${RUN}`, organisationId: orgId, role: 'USER',
  }).returning({ id: usersTable.id });
  userId = user!.id;

  await insertLog({});
  await insertLog({ action: 'LOGIN', entity: 'Auth', description: 'login log' });
  await insertLog({ organisationId: otherOrgId });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.id, logIds));
  await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('GET /audit-logs (S19)', () => {
  it('401s without a user', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index({ query: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Unauthorized');
  });

  it('preserves the controller-level admin gate message for non-admin roles', async () => {
    const auditor = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: {}, user: { userId, role: 'AUDITOR', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      auditor,
    );
    // V1 quirk: AUDITOR passes the router gate but is rejected here.
    expect(auditor.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(auditor.body.message).toBe(FORBIDDEN);

    const plain = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: {}, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      plain,
    );
    expect(plain.statusCode).toBe(403);
  });

  it('returns the spread envelope with pagination and D-23 user:{id}', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['success', 'data', 'pagination']));
    expect(res.body.pagination).toMatchObject({ page: 1, limit: 50 });
    const row = res.body.data[0];
    expect(row.user).toEqual({ id: userId });
    expect(row.universityId).toBe(orgId);
  });

  it('defaults limit to 50 and orders createdAt desc', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', universityId: null } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.body.pagination.limit).toBe(50);
    const dates: number[] = res.body.data.map((d: any) => new Date(d.createdAt).getTime());
    expect([...dates].sort((a, b) => b - a)).toEqual(dates);
  });

  it('forces universityId from the JWT for non-SUPER_ADMIN callers', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      // Asking for the OTHER org but JWT says orgA -> results must be orgA only.
      { query: { universityId: otherOrgId }, user: { userId, role: 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(res.body.data.every((d: any) => d.universityId === orgId)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('lets SUPER_ADMIN query any tenant explicitly', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: otherOrgId }, user: { userId, role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', universityId: null } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.body.data.every((d: any) => d.universityId === otherOrgId)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('filters by action and entity', async () => {
    const byAction = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: orgId, action: 'LOGIN' }, user: { userId, role: 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      byAction,
    );
    expect(byAction.body.data.every((d: any) => d.action === 'LOGIN')).toBe(true);

    const byEntity = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: orgId, entity: 'Auth' }, user: { userId, role: 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      byEntity,
    );
    expect(byEntity.body.data.every((d: any) => d.entity === 'Auth')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('supports from/to datetime filters', async () => {
    const future = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString();
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: orgId, from: future }, user: { userId, role: 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects invalid enum actions through zod with joined messages', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.index(
      { query: { universityId: orgId, action: 'NOT_AN_ACTION' }, user: { userId, role: 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(typeof res.body.message).toBe('string');
  });
});

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { organisationsTable, usersTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/authV1.js';
import { registerUser, loginUser } from '../services/authV1.js';
import { signToken, verifyToken } from '../utils/jwt.js';
import { authenticate } from '../middleware/authContext.js';

// Tests load .env via db/index.ts (dotenv/config); guarantee a secret exists.
process.env.JWT_SECRET ??= 'auth-test-secret';

const RUN = Date.now();
const PASSWORD = 'Password123!';
let orgId: string;
const createdUserIds: string[] = [];
// Organisations auto-provisioned by registerUser during tests.
const createdSignupOrgIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

function reqMock(headers: Record<string, string | undefined>) {
  return { headers } as unknown as Request;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `AuthOrg ${RUN}`, code: `AUTH-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  if (createdUserIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(usersTable).where(inArray(usersTable.id, [...createdUserIds]));
  }
  // Remove signup-provisioned organisations only after users are gone.
  for (const id of createdSignupOrgIds) {
    const remaining = await db
      .select({ id: usersTable.id })
      .from(usersTable)
      .where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, id))
      .limit(1);
    if (remaining.length === 0) {
      await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, id));
    }
  }
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('POST /auth/register', () => {
  it('registers a user, provisions a PENDING placeholder organisation server-side, hashes the password, self-links authUserId, and returns sanitized user + JWT', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.register({
      body: {
        username: `demo-${RUN}`,
        email: `demo-${RUN}@example.com`,
        password: PASSWORD,
        // Client-supplied identity fields must be ignored (stripped by zod).
        organisationId: orgId,
        organisationName: 'Client Org Must Not Win',
      },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    const { user, token } = res.body.data;

    // Sanitized: plaintext/hash never returned.
    expect(user.password).toBeUndefined();

    // DEMO-ONLY self-linked identity: one UUID for both columns.
    expect(user.authUserId).toBe(user.id);
    expect(user.username).toBe(`demo-${RUN}`);
    expect(user.email).toBe(`demo-${RUN}@example.com`);

    // A NEW organisation is provisioned server-side and linked to the user;
    // the client-supplied organisationId was NOT honoured.
    expect(user.organisationId).toBeTruthy();
    expect(user.organisationId).not.toBe(orgId);
    createdUserIds.push(user.id);
    createdSignupOrgIds.push(user.organisationId);

    const orgRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(organisationsTable)
      .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, user.organisationId));
    const signupOrg = orgRows[0]!;
    // Placeholder identity until onboarding completes it.
    expect(signupOrg.name).toBe('Pending Organisation');
    expect(signupOrg.type).toBe('OTHER');
    expect(signupOrg.status).toBe('PENDING');

    // Password is actually hashed (bcrypt), not stored as plaintext.
    const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, user.id));
    const row = rows[0]!;
    expect(row.password).not.toBe(PASSWORD);
    expect(row.organisationId).toBe(user.organisationId);
    expect(await bcrypt.compare(PASSWORD, row.password)).toBe(true);
    expect(row.role).toBe('USER'); // schema default preserved
    expect(row.status).toBe('ACTIVE'); // schema default preserved

    // JWT round-trip carries exactly the demo identity.
    const decoded = verifyToken(token);
    expect(decoded.userId).toBe(user.id);
    expect(decoded.email).toBe(user.email);
  });

  it('rejects duplicate email with 400 "Email already in use" and creates no orphan organisation', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.register({
      body: {
        username: `other-${RUN}`,
        email: `demo-${RUN}@example.com`,
        password: PASSWORD,
      },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Email already in use');
  });

  it('rejects duplicate username with 400 "Username already taken" and creates no orphan organisation', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.register({
      body: {
        username: `demo-${RUN}`,
        email: `unused-${RUN}@example.com`,
        password: PASSWORD,
      },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Username already taken');
  });

  it('rejects validation failures with 400 (short password)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.register({
      body: {
        username: `shortpw-${RUN}`,
        email: `shortpw-${RUN}@example.com`,
        password: 'short',
      },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('accepts signup with no organisation fields at all (placeholder provisioned server-side)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.register({
      body: {
        username: `noorg-${RUN}`,
        email: `noorg-${RUN}@example.com`,
        password: PASSWORD,
      },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data.user.organisationId).toBeTruthy();
    createdUserIds.push(res.body.data.user.id);
    createdSignupOrgIds.push(res.body.data.user.organisationId);

    const orgRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(organisationsTable)
      .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, res.body.data.user.organisationId));
    expect(orgRows[0]!.name).toBe('Pending Organisation');
    expect(orgRows[0]!.status).toBe('PENDING');
  });
});

describe('POST /auth/login', () => {
  it('logs in with valid credentials and returns user + JWT', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.login({
      body: { email: `demo-${RUN}@example.com`, password: PASSWORD },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.user.email).toBe(`demo-${RUN}@example.com`);
    expect(res.body.data.user.password).toBeUndefined();
    const decoded = verifyToken(res.body.data.token);
    expect(decoded.userId).toBe(res.body.data.user.id);
    expect(decoded.email).toBe(res.body.data.user.email);
  });

  it('rejects a wrong password with 401 "Invalid email or password"', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.login({
      body: { email: `demo-${RUN}@example.com`, password: 'WrongPassword999!' },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid email or password');
  });

  it('rejects an unknown email with 401 (same message, no enumeration)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.login({
      body: { email: `ghost-${RUN}@example.com`, password: PASSWORD },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid email or password');
  });
});

describe('JWT utilities', () => {
  it('round-trips signToken -> verifyToken', () => {
    const token = signToken({ userId: 'u-1', email: 'u-1@x.dev' });
    expect(verifyToken(token)).toEqual({ userId: 'u-1', email: 'u-1@x.dev' });
  });

  it('JWT payload contains only userId/email plus standard iat/exp claims', () => {
    const token = signToken({ userId: 'u-2', email: 'u-2@x.dev' });
    const decoded = jwt.decode(token) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(Object.keys(decoded).sort()).toEqual(['email', 'exp', 'iat', 'userId']);
    expect(decoded.userId).toBe('u-2');
    expect(decoded.email).toBe('u-2@x.dev');
  });

  it('JWT expires in approximately 24h', () => {
    const token = signToken({ userId: 'u-3', email: 'u-3@x.dev' }, '24h');
    const decoded = jwt.decode(token) as { iat: number; exp: number };
    const ttlSeconds = decoded.exp - decoded.iat;
    expect(ttlSeconds).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(86395); // ~24h
    expect(ttlSeconds).toBeLessThanOrEqual(86405);
  });
});

describe('authenticate middleware', () => {
  const payload = { userId: 'mw-1', email: 'mw-1@x.dev' };

  it('populates req.user and calls next() for a valid Bearer token', () => {
    const req = reqMock({ authorization: `Bearer ${signToken(payload)}` }) as Request & { user?: unknown };
    const res = resMock();
    const next = vi.fn();
    authenticate(req, res, next);
    expect(next).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(req.user).toEqual(payload);
  });

  it('401s a missing Authorization header', () => {
    const res = resMock();
    const next = vi.fn();
    authenticate(reqMock({}), res, next);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('401s a malformed Bearer header', () => {
    const res = resMock();
    const next = vi.fn();
    authenticate(reqMock({ authorization: `Token ${signToken(payload)}` }), res, next);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('401s an empty bearer value', () => {
    const res = resMock();
    const next = vi.fn();
    authenticate(reqMock({ authorization: 'Bearer ' }), res, next);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('401s a token signed with an invalid signature', () => {
    const forged = jwt.sign(payload, 'totally-different-secret', { expiresIn: '24h' });
    const res = resMock();
    const next = vi.fn();
    authenticate(reqMock({ authorization: `Bearer ${forged}` }), res, next);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('401s an expired token', () => {
    const expired = jwt.sign(payload, process.env.JWT_SECRET!, { expiresIn: '-1h' });
    const res = resMock();
    const next = vi.fn();
    authenticate(reqMock({ authorization: `Bearer ${expired}` }), res, next);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(next).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('service-level guards', () => {
  it('registerUser throws exact duplicate messages', async () => {
    await expect(registerUser({
      username: `svc-${RUN}`,
      email: `demo-${RUN}@example.com`,
      password: PASSWORD,
    })).rejects.toThrow('Email already in use');

    await expect(registerUser({
      username: `demo-${RUN}`,
      email: `svc-${RUN}@example.com`,
      password: PASSWORD,
    })).rejects.toThrow('Username already taken');
  });

  it('loginUser never leaks hash presence via distinct errors', async () => {
    await expect(loginUser({ email: `ghost2-${RUN}@example.com`, password: PASSWORD }))
      .rejects.toThrow('Invalid email or password');
  });
});

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  baselinesTable,
  calculationsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/baselinesV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
let organisationId: string;
let baselinePeriodId: string;
let openPeriodId: string;
let noOpenPeriodId: string;
let factorId: string;
let baselineId: string;
const activityIds: string[] = [];

function mockRes() {
  const res: any = {
    status: (code: number) => {
      res.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json: (body: unknown) => {
      res.body = body;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

async function addCalculation(values: {
  periodId: string;
  category: 'DIESEL' | 'PETROL' | 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY';
  scope: 'SCOPE_1' | 'SCOPE_2';
  activityStatus: 'DRAFT' | 'VERIFIED' | 'CALCULATED';
  kg: string;
  calculationStatus?: 'CALCULATED' | 'FAILED';
}) {
  const [activity] = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({
    organisationId,
    reportingPeriodId: values.periodId,
    category: values.category,
    scope: values.scope,
    quantity: '1.0000',
    unit: 'kg',
    status: values.activityStatus,
  }).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  if (!activity) throw new Error('Failed to seed activity');
  activityIds.push(activity.id);
  await db.insert(calculationsTable).values({
    organisationId,
    reportingPeriodId: values.periodId,
    activityDataId: activity.id,
    emissionFactorId: factorId,
    scope: values.scope,
    quantity: '1.0000',
    activityUnit: 'kg',
    emissionFactor: '1.000000',
    factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
    co2eKg: values.kg,
    status: values.calculationStatus ?? 'CALCULATED',
  });
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [organisation] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `Baseline ${RUN}`,
    code: `BASE-${RUN}`,
    type: 'UNIVERSITY',
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning();
  if (!organisation) throw new Error('Failed to seed organisation');
  organisationId = organisation.id;

  const [factor] = await db.insert(emissionFactorsTable).values({
    factorId: `baseline-${RUN}`,
    activityId: 'DIESEL',
    name: `Baseline factor ${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    factor: '1.000000',
    unit: 'kg',
    factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  if (!factor) throw new Error('Failed to seed factor');
  factorId = factor.id;

  const periods = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values([
    { organisationId, name: 'Baseline UTC', startDate: new Date('2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'), endDate: new Date('2024-12-31T23:59:59.000Z'), status: 'LOCKED' },
    { organisationId, name: 'Open comparison', startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T23:59:59.000Z'), status: 'OPEN' },
    { organisationId, name: 'No-open source', startDate: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'), endDate: new Date('2026-12-31T23:59:59.000Z'), status: 'DRAFT' },
  ]).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  baselinePeriodId = periods[0]!.id;
  openPeriodId = periods[1]!.id;
  noOpenPeriodId = periods[2]!.id;

  await addCalculation({ periodId: baselinePeriodId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', activityStatus: 'VERIFIED', kg: '100.0000' });
  await addCalculation({ periodId: baselinePeriodId, category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', scope: 'SCOPE_2', activityStatus: 'CALCULATED', kg: '50.0000' });
  await addCalculation({ periodId: baselinePeriodId, category: 'PETROL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', activityStatus: 'DRAFT', kg: '999.0000' });
  await addCalculation({ periodId: openPeriodId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', activityStatus: 'VERIFIED', kg: '40.0000' });
  await addCalculation({ periodId: openPeriodId, category: 'PETROL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', activityStatus: 'CALCULATED', kg: '20.0000' });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(baselinesTable).where(eq(baselinesTable.organisationId, organisationId));
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.organisationId, organisationId));
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.id, activityIds));
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, factorId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, organisationId));
});

describe('Baselines V1', () => {
  it('uses the D-2 validation envelope', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.createBaseline({ body: { universityId: 'bad' } } as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
  });

  it('creates a DRAFT snapshot from VERIFIED and CALCULATED activities only', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.createBaseline({ body: { universityId: organisationId, reportingPeriodId: baselinePeriodId, methodology: 'GHG', notes: 'snapshot' } } as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ baselineYear: 2024, scope1KgCO2e: 100, scope2KgCO2e: 50, totalKgCO2e: 150, status: 'DRAFT', isLocked: false });
    expect(res.body.data.reportingPeriodId).toBe(baselinePeriodId);
    baselineId = res.body.data.id;
  });

  it('returns the reporting-period error and database duplicate behavior', async () => {
    const missing = mockRes();
    await controller.createBaseline({ body: { universityId: organisationId, reportingPeriodId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' } } as Request, missing);
    expect(missing.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Reporting period not found' });

    const duplicate = mockRes();
    await controller.createBaseline({ body: { universityId: organisationId, reportingPeriodId: baselinePeriodId } } as Request, duplicate);
    expect(duplicate.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(duplicate.body.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('lists without pagination and returns the reduced by-id view', async () => {
    const list = mockRes();
    await controller.getBaselines({ query: { universityId: organisationId } } as any, list);
    expect(list.body.data[0].reportingPeriod.name).toBe('Baseline UTC');
    expect(list.body).not.toHaveProperty('pagination');

    const byId = mockRes();
    await controller.getBaselineById({ params: { id: baselineId } } as any, byId);
    expect(byId.body.data).toEqual({
      id: baselineId,
      university: { id: organisationId, name: `Baseline ${RUN}` },
      reportingPeriod: expect.objectContaining({ id: baselinePeriodId, name: 'Baseline UTC' }),
      emissions: { scope1KgCO2e: 100, scope2KgCO2e: 50, totalKgCO2e: 150, totalTCO2e: 0.15 },
      status: 'DRAFT',
      methodology: 'GHG',
    });
    expect(byId.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('baselineYear');
  });

  it('allows arbitrary and repeated workflow transitions without audits', async () => {
    const approve = mockRes();
    await controller.approveBaseline({ params: { id: baselineId }, user: { userId: 'reviewer-1' } } as any, approve);
    expect(approve.body.data).toMatchObject({ status: 'APPROVED', approvedBy: 'reviewer-1', isLocked: false });
    const firstApproval = approve.body.data.approvedAt;

    const reapprove = mockRes();
    await controller.approveBaseline({ params: { id: baselineId }, user: { userId: 'reviewer-2' } } as any, reapprove);
    expect(reapprove.body.data.approvedBy).toBe('reviewer-2');
    expect(reapprove.body.data.approvedAt).toBeTruthy();
    expect(reapprove.body.data.approvedAt >= firstApproval).toBe(true);

    const submit = mockRes();
    await controller.submitBaseline({ params: { id: baselineId } } as any, submit);
    expect(submit.body.data.status).toBe('UNDER_REVIEW');
    const lock = mockRes();
    await controller.lockBaseline({ params: { id: baselineId } } as any, lock);
    expect(lock.body.data).toMatchObject({ status: 'LOCKED', isLocked: true, approvedBy: 'reviewer-2' });
    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.organisationId, organisationId));
    expect(audits).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('uses stored totals but live scope/category data and a synthesized SCOPE_3 row', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getBaselineComparison({ params: { id: baselineId } } as any, res);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ baseline: 0.15, current: 0.06, reduction: 0.09, reductionPercent: 60, baselineYear: 2024 });
    expect(res.body.data.scopeData).toContainEqual({ scope: 'SCOPE_3', baseline: 0, current: 0, change: 0, changePercent: 0 });
    expect(res.body.data.categoryData.map((row: any) => row.category)).toEqual(['DIESEL', 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', 'PETROL']);
    expect(res.body.data.categoryData[0].changePercent).toBe(60);
  });

  it('falls back to live totals when the stored total is zero', async () => {
    const [zero] = await db.insert(baselinesTable).values({
      organisationId,
      reportingPeriodId: noOpenPeriodId,
      baselineYear: 2026,
      scope1KgCO2e: '0',
      scope2KgCO2e: '0',
      totalKgCO2e: '0',
    }).returning({ id: baselinesTable.id });
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getBaselineComparison({ params: { id: zero!.id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.body.data.current).toBe(0.06);
    expect(res.body.data.baseline).toBe(0);
  });

  it('uses zero current emissions when the baseline organisation has no OPEN period', async () => {
    const [noOpenOrganisation] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
      name: `No Open ${RUN}`,
      code: `NO-OPEN-${RUN}`,
      type: 'UNIVERSITY',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
    const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
      organisationId: noOpenOrganisation!.id,
      name: 'Draft only',
      startDate: new Date('2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      endDate: new Date('2027-12-31T00:00:00.000Z'),
      status: 'DRAFT',
    }).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
    const [baseline] = await db.insert(baselinesTable).values({
      organisationId: noOpenOrganisation!.id,
      reportingPeriodId: period!.id,
      baselineYear: 2027,
      scope1KgCO2e: '50',
      scope2KgCO2e: '0',
      totalKgCO2e: '50',
    }).returning({ id: baselinesTable.id });
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getBaselineComparison({ params: { id: baseline!.id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ baseline: 0.05, current: 0, reduction: 0.05, reductionPercent: 100 });
    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, noOpenOrganisation!.id));
  });

  it('uses generic V1 endpoint errors for missing rows', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getBaselineById({ params: { id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' } } as any, res);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Failed to fetch baseline' });
  });
});

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';

import * as controller from '../controllers/buildingsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `BldOrg ${RUN}`, code: `BLD-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;

  const campuses = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values([
    { organisationId: orgId, name: 'Campus A', code: `CA-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'CAMPUS' },
    { organisationId: orgId, name: 'Campus B', code: `CB-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'CAMPUS' },
  ]).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  campusAId = campuses[0]!.id;
  campusBId = campuses[1]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entity, ['Building']));
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('POST /buildings', () => {
  it('fails with the exact parent message when the campus is missing', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Ghost B', code: `GB-${RUN}`, campusId: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Campus not found');
  });

  it('creates a FACILITY/BUILDING with description column and address metadata', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Science Block', code: `SB-${RUN}`, description: 'Labs', address: '2 Science Way', campusId: campusAId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body)).toEqual(['success', 'data']); // no success message on V1 building create
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ campusId: campusAId, description: 'Labs', address: '2 Science Way' });

    const rows = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING' });
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
  });

  it('rejects same-campus duplicates with the create wording', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Dup B', code: `SB-${RUN}`, campusId: campusAId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Building with this code already exists in this campus');
  });

  it('permits the same code under a different campus (V1 scoping)', async () => {

    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Twin B', code: `SB-${RUN}`, campusId: campusBId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

});

describe('GET /buildings', () => {

    expect(row.campus.university.id).toBe(orgId);
    expect(row._count.floors).toBe(1);
  });

  it('searches case-insensitively and clamps limits', async () => {

    expect(res.body.pagination.limit).toBe(100);
    expect(res.body.data.some((b: any) => b.id === createdIds[0])).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns the fixed 500 message on query failure', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { campusId: 'not-a-uuid' } } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Failed to fetch buildings');
  });

describe('GET /buildings/:id', () => {

    await controller.getById({ params: { id: createdIds[0] } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data._count.floors).toBe(2);
    expect(res.body.data.floors.map((f: any) => f.floorNumber)).toEqual([0, null]);
  });

  it('404s carrying the underlying message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Building not found');
  });
});

describe('PATCH /buildings/:id', () => {
  it('updates fields with the exact message (reparenting impossible)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { name: 'Science Renamed', campusId: campusBId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Building updated successfully');
    expect(res.body.data.name).toBe('Science Renamed');
    expect(res.body.data.campusId).toBe(campusAId); // unchanged
  });

  it('uses the update-variant duplicate wording', async () => {
    const [tgt] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId, parentId: campusAId, name: 'Rename Me', code: `RM-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING',
    }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
    createdIds.push(tgt!.id);

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: tgt!.id }, body: { code: `SB-${RUN}` } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Building with this code already exists for this campus');
  });

  it('writes no audit rows (V1 has none)', async () => {
    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'Building'));
    expect(audits).toEqual([]);
  });
});

      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

function call(
  controller: (req: Request, res: Response) => Promise<void>,

) {
  const res = resMock();
  return { res, run: controller(req as Request, res) };
}

}) {

      metadata: values.metadata ?? null,

}

});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.organisationId, [orgMainId, orgMetaId, orgBrId]));
  if (activityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(calculationsTable).where(inArray(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityIds));
  }
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.organisationId, [orgMainId, orgMetaId, orgBrId]));
  if (efIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(inArray(emissionFactorsTable.id, efIds));
  }
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgMainId, orgMetaId, orgBrId]));

  if (savedApiKey !== undefined) process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = savedApiKey;
});

describe('unitConversion engine (V1 port)', () => {
  it('returns quantity unchanged on direct match, including bare factor units', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(100, 'litre', 'kgCO2e/L', 'DIESEL')).toBe(100);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(100, 'kWh', 'kWh', 'DIESEL')).toBe(100);
  });

  it('normalizes litre/liter/L and tonne/ton/t spellings to a direct match', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(5, 'L', 'kgCO2e/litre', 'DIESEL')).toBe(5);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(5, 'liter', 'kgCO2e/l', 'DIESEL')).toBe(5);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(2, 'tonne', 'kgCO2e/t', 'DIESEL')).toBe(2);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(2, 'ton', 'kgCO2e/t', 'DIESEL')).toBe(2);
  });

  it('converts kg to t and t to kg', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(1500, 'kg', 'kgCO2e/t', 'DIESEL')).toBe(1.5);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(1.5, 't', 'kgCO2e/kg', 'DIESEL')).toBe(1500);
  });

  it('converts g to kg', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(2500, 'g', 'kgCO2e/kg', 'OTHER')).toBe(2.5);
  });

  it('converts Wh and MWh to kWh', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(2000, 'wh', 'kgCO2e/kWh', 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY')).toBe(2);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(3, 'MWh', 'kgCO2e/kWh', 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY')).toBe(3000);
  });

  it('applies the diesel/generator/boiler NCV (0.000036 TJ/L)', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(100, 'litre', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'DIESEL')).toBeCloseTo(0.0036, 10);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(100, 'l', 'tCO2/TJ', 'GENERATOR_FUEL')).toBeCloseTo(0.0036, 10);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(1000, 'L', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'BOILER_FUEL')).toBeCloseTo(0.036, 10);
  });

  it('applies the petrol NCV (0.0000342 TJ/L)', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(100, 'litre', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'PETROL')).toBeCloseTo(0.00342, 10);
  });

  it('applies the LPG NCV (0.0000473 TJ/kg)', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(10, 'kg', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'LPG')).toBeCloseTo(0.000473, 10);
  });

  it('applies the CNG/natural-gas NCVs (0.000048 TJ/kg, 0.000038 TJ/m3)', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(10, 'kg', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'CNG')).toBeCloseTo(0.00048, 10);
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(10, 'm3', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'NATURAL_GAS')).toBeCloseTo(0.00038, 10);
  });

  it('multiplies by 1000 for GJ targets', () => {
    expect(convertToEmissionFactorUnit(100, 'litre', 'kgCO2e/GJ', 'DIESEL')).toBeCloseTo(3.6, 10);
  });

  it('throws PENDING for unmapped NCV combinations and unsupported conversions', () => {
    expect(() =>
      convertToEmissionFactorUnit(10, 'bushel', 'kgCO2e/TJ', 'NATURAL_GAS'),
    ).toThrow(/^PENDING: Cannot automatically convert volume\/mass \(bushel\) to energy \(tj\) for NATURAL_GAS/);

    expect(() => convertToEmissionFactorUnit(10, 'bushel', 'kgCO2e/litre', 'DIESEL')).toThrow(
      'PENDING: Unsupported unit conversion from bushel to kgCO2e/litre',
    );
  });

  it('applies tCO2 and gCO2 multipliers with 1 as default', () => {
    expect(getCo2eMultiplier('tCO2/kg')).toBe(1000);
    expect(getCo2eMultiplier('tCO2e/TJ')).toBe(1000);
    expect(getCo2eMultiplier('gCO2/kWh')).toBe(0.001);
    expect(getCo2eMultiplier('gCO2e/kg')).toBe(0.001);
    expect(getCo2eMultiplier('kgCO2e/L')).toBe(1);
    expect(getCo2eMultiplier('kWh')).toBe(1);
  });

  it('reconstructs the compound factor unit for canonical and dataset shapes', () => {
    expect(reconstructCompoundFactorUnit({ id: 'x', factor: 1, unit: 'L', factorUnit: 'kgCO2e', source: 's', sourceVersion: null, factorName: 'n' })).toBe('kgCO2e/L');
    expect(reconstructCompoundFactorUnit({ id: 'x', factor: 1, unit: 'kg', factorUnit: 'kg CO2e / kg', source: 's', sourceVersion: null, factorName: 'n' })).toBe('kg CO2e / kg');
  });
});

describe('C20 POST /calculations/activity/:activityId (service + controller)', () => {
  let aHappyId: string;
  let aDraftPeriodActId: string;
  let aSubActId: string;
  let aVarActId: string;
  let aLockedActId: string;
  let aUnverifiedId: string;
  let aRefrigId: string;
  let aPurSteamId: string;
  let aBushelId: string;
  let aFallbackId: string;
  let aCtrlId: string;
  let aUsId: string;
  let aVehId: string;
  let aCoolId: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    aHappyId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pOpenId, category: 'DIESEL', quantity: '100.0000', unit: 'litre' });
    aDraftPeriodActId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pDraftPeriodId, category: 'PETROL', quantity: '100.0000', unit: 'litre', activityDate: new Date('2024-08-01') });
    aSubActId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pSubmittedPeriodId, category: 'LPG', quantity: '200.0000', unit: 'kg', activityDate: null });
    aVarActId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pVerifiedPeriodId, category: 'CNG', quantity: '10.0000', unit: 'm3' });
    aLockedActId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pLockedId, category: 'DIESEL', quantity: '5.0000', unit: 'litre' });
    aUnverifiedId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pOpenId, category: 'DIESEL', quantity: '5.0000', unit: 'litre', status: 'DRAFT' });
    aRefrigId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pDatelessId, category: 'REFRIGERANT', quantity: '4.0000', unit: 'kg', activityDate: null });
    aPurSteamId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pOpenId, category: 'PURCHASED_STEAM', quantity: '5.0000', unit: 'kg' });
    aBushelId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pOpenId, category: 'NATURAL_GAS', quantity: '10.0000', unit: 'bushel' });
    aFallbackId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pOpenId, category: 'DIESEL', quantity: '100.0000', unit: 'litre' });
    aCtrlId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMainId, reportingPeriodId: pOpenId, category: 'DIESEL', quantity: '50.0000', unit: 'litre' });
    aUsId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgMetaId, reportingPeriodId: pUsId, category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', quantity: '20.0000', unit: 'kWh' });
    aVehId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgBrId, reportingPeriodId: pBrId, category: 'OWNED_VEHICLE', quantity: '10.0000', unit: 'kg' });
    aCoolId = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgBrId, reportingPeriodId: pBrId, category: 'PURCHASED_COOLING', quantity: '7.0000', unit: 'kWh' });
  });

  it('calculates a VERIFIED activity in an OPEN period end-to-end', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aHappyId) as any;

    expect(result.universityId).toBe(orgMainId);
    expect(result.activityDataId).toBe(aHappyId);
    expect(result.scope).toBe('SCOPE_1');
    expect(result.quantity).toBe(100);
    expect(result.activityUnit).toBe('litre');
    expect(result.emissionFactor).toBe(2.68);
    expect(result.factorUnit).toBe('kgCO2e/L');
    expect(result.factorSource).toBe('DEFRA');
    expect(result.factorVersion).toBeNull();
    expect(result.factorName).toContain('DIESEL');
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(268);
    expect(result.status).toBe('CALCULATED');
    expect(typeof result.createdAt).toBe('string');
    expect(new Date(result.calculatedAt).toISOString()).toBe(result.calculatedAt);
  });

  it('allows DRAFT reporting periods and applies the petrol NCV', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aDraftPeriodActId) as any;
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(0.2531);
  });

  it('allows SUBMITTED periods and applies the LPG NCV', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aSubActId) as any;
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(0.473);
  });

  it('allows VERIFIED periods and applies the CNG m3 NCV', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aVarActId) as any;
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(0.0209);
  });

  it('blocks LOCKED reporting periods', async () => {
    await expect(calculateForActivity(aLockedActId)).rejects.toThrow('Reporting period is locked');

    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aLockedActId));
    expect(calcRows).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('rejects non-VERIFIED activities', async () => {
    await expect(calculateForActivity(aUnverifiedId)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Only VERIFIED activity data can be calculated',
    );
  });

  it('hits the Climatiq cache tier and derives the year from the period when the activity date is null', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aRefrigId) as any;
    expect(result.factorSource).toBe('Climatiq');
    expect(result.emissionFactor).toBe(3.2);
    expect(result.factorVersion).toBe('10.1');
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(12.8);
    expect(result.factorUnit).toBe('kgCO2e/kg');
  });

  it('reverts the activity to DRAFT when EF resolution is PENDING (no key, no rows)', async () => {
    await expect(calculateForActivity(aPurSteamId)).rejects.toThrow(
      'No emission factor available for PURCHASED_STEAM in IN. Configure CLIMATIQ_API_KEY to enable dynamic lookup.',
    );

    const rows = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, aPurSteamId));
    expect(rows[0]!.status).toBe('DRAFT');

    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aPurSteamId));
    expect(calcRows).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('reverts the activity to DRAFT when conversion is PENDING despite a resolved factor', async () => {
    await expect(calculateForActivity(aBushelId)).rejects.toThrow(
      /^PENDING: Cannot automatically convert volume\/mass \(bushel\) to energy \(tj\) for NATURAL_GAS/,
    );

    const rows = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, aBushelId));
    expect(rows[0]!.status).toBe('DRAFT');

    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aBushelId));
    expect(calcRows).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('resolves country from organisations.metadata.country', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aUsId) as any;
    expect(result.factorSource).toBe('GRID_FACTOR');
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(14.2);
  });

  it('falls back to country IN when metadata.country is absent', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aFallbackId) as any;
    expect(result.factorSource).toBe('DEFRA');
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(268);
  });

  it('applies the tCO2 multiplier through the full pipeline', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aVehId) as any;
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(5000);
    expect(result.factorUnit).toBe('tCO2/kg');
  });

  it('applies the gCO2 multiplier through the full pipeline', async () => {
    const result = await calculateForActivity(aCoolId) as any;
    expect(result.co2eKg).toBe(0.014);
    expect(result.factorUnit).toBe('gCO2/kWh');
  });

  it('writes the three expected audit records in V1 order', async () => {
    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aHappyId));
    const calcId = calcRows[0]!.id;
    const resolvedEfId = calcRows[0]!.emissionFactorId;

    const efAudits = await auditsFor(resolvedEfId);
    const efAudit = efAudits.filter((a) => a.action === 'EF_RESOLVED_FIXED')[0]!;
    expect(efAudit.entity).toBe('EmissionFactor');
    expect(efAudit.organisationId).toBe(orgMainId);
    expect(efAudit.metadata).toEqual({ factor: 2.68, source: 'DEFRA' });
    expect(efAudit.description).toBe('Emission factor selected (DEFRA)');

    const calcAudits = await auditsFor(calcId);
    expect(calcAudits).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(calcAudits[0]!.action).toBe('CALCULATION_CREATED');
    expect(calcAudits[0]!.entity).toBe('Calculation');
    expect(calcAudits[0]!.metadata).toEqual({ co2eKg: 268 });
    expect(calcAudits[0]!.description).toBe('Calculation created');

    const actAudits = await auditsFor(aHappyId);
    expect(actAudits.map((a) => a.action)).toEqual(['ACTIVITY_CALCULATED']);
    expect(actAudits[0]!.description).toBe('Activity calculation completed');
    expect(actAudits[0]!.organisationId).toBe(orgMainId);

    expect(new Date(efAudit.createdAt).getTime()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(new Date(calcAudits[0]!.createdAt).getTime());
    expect(new Date(calcAudits[0]!.createdAt).getTime()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(new Date(actAudits[0]!.createdAt).getTime());
  });

  it('transitions the activity to CALCULATED and blocks repeats until re-verified', async () => {
    const rows = await db.select().from(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, aHappyId));
    expect(rows[0]!.status).toBe('CALCULATED');

    await expect(calculateForActivity(aHappyId)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Only VERIFIED activity data can be calculated',
    );

    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aHappyId));
    expect(calcRows).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('creates a fresh snapshot after re-verification (always-insert semantics)', async () => {
    await db
      .update(activityDataTable)
      .set({ status: 'VERIFIED', updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(activityDataTable.id, aHappyId));

    const again = await calculateForActivity(aHappyId) as any;
    expect(again.co2eKg).toBe(268);

    const calcRows = await db.select().from(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aHappyId));
    expect(calcRows).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('returns 201 with the V1 envelope from the controller and normalizes domain errors', async () => {
    const ok = call(calculateActivityController, { params: { activityId: aCtrlId } });
    await ok.run;
    expect(ok.res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    const body = ok.res.body as any;
    expect(body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(body.data.scope).toBe('SCOPE_1');
    expect(body.data.co2eKg).toBe(134);
    expect(typeof body.data.quantity).toBe('number');
    expect(typeof body.data.co2eKg).toBe('number');

    const bad = call(calculateActivityController, { params: { activityId: 'not-a-uuid' } });
    await bad.run;
    expect(bad.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(bad.res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Activity data not found' });

    const missing = call(calculateActivityController, {
      params: { activityId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' },
    });
    await missing.run;
    expect(missing.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(missing.res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Activity data not found' });
  });
});

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { auditLogsTable, organisationsTable, physicalEntitiesTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/campusesV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
const createdIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgs = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values([
    { name: `CamA ${RUN}`, code: `CAM-A-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    { name: `CamB ${RUN}`, code: `CAM-B-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
  ]).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgs[0]!.id;
  otherOrgId = orgs[1]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entity, ['Campus']));
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(inArray(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('POST /campuses', () => {
  it('creates a LOCATION/CAMPUS row with folded metadata and bare 201 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'North Campus', code: `NC-${RUN}`, universityId: orgId, address: '1 North Rd', city: 'Pune', state: 'MH', postalCode: '411001' },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body)).toEqual(['success', 'data']);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ name: 'North Campus', code: `NC-${RUN}`, country: 'India', city: 'Pune', universityId: orgId });
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);

    const rows = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'CAMPUS', parentId: null });
  });

  it('rejects duplicate codes within the same university (service guard)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({ body: { name: 'Dup Campus', code: `NC-${RUN}`, universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Campus with this code already exists for this university');
  });

  it('permits the same code under a different university (V1 scoping)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({ body: { name: 'Other Uni Campus', code: `NC-${RUN}` , universityId: otherOrgId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
  });

  it('surfaces raw zod messages through error.message (V1 quirk)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({ body: { name: 'X', code: '' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(String(res.body.message)).toContain('Campus name is required');
  });
});

describe('GET /campuses', () => {
  it('applies clamped limits and university filter', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { limit: '500', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.pagination.limit).toBe(100);
    expect(res.body.data.every((c: any) => c.universityId === orgId)).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data[0]._count).toEqual({ buildings: 0 });
  });

  it('searches case-insensitively on name', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { search: 'North', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.data.some((c: any) => c.code === `NC-${RUN}`)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns the fixed 500 message when the query cannot execute', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: 'not-a-uuid' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(500);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Failed to fetch campuses');
  });
});

describe('GET /campuses/:id', () => {
  it('reconstructs the university relation and building count', async () => {
    // add a child building to exercise _count
    const [child] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId, parentId: createdIds[0], name: 'B1', code: `CAM-B1-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING',
    }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
    createdIds.push(child!.id);

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: createdIds[0] } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data._count).toEqual({ buildings: 1 });
    expect(res.body.data.university).toMatchObject({ id: orgId, code: `CAM-A-${RUN}` });
  });

  it('404s carrying the underlying message for unknown ids', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Campus not found');
  });
});

describe('PATCH /campuses/:id', () => {
  it('updates fields into metadata with the exact success message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { name: 'North Renamed', city: 'Nashik' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Campus updated successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ name: 'North Renamed', city: 'Nashik', country: 'India' });
  });

  it('blocks duplicate codes scoped to the university', async () => {
    const second = resMock();
    await controller.create({ body: { name: 'Second', code: `SEC-${RUN}`, universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, second);
    expect(second.statusCode).toBe(201);
    createdIds.push(second.body.data.id);

    const clash = resMock();
    await controller.update({ params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { code: `SEC-${RUN}` } } as unknown as Request, clash);
    expect(clash.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(clash.body.message).toBe('Campus with this code already exists for this university');
  });

  it('ignores attempted universityId reparenting (update schema omits it)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { universityId: otherOrgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.universityId).toBe(orgId);
  });

  it('writes no audit rows (V1 has none)', async () => {
    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'Campus'));
    expect(audits).toEqual([]);
  });
});
