```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray, like } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  baselinesTable,
  calculationsTable,
  documentsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  sustainabilityTargetsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/dashboardV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgAId: string;
let orgBId: string;
let orgCId: string;
let campusA1Id: string;
let campusA2Id: string;
let buildingA1Id: string;
let buildingA2Id: string;
let floorA11Id: string;
let floorA12Id: string;
let floorA21Id: string;
let pBaseId: string;
let pPrevId: string;
let pCurId: string;
let pDraftPId: string;
let pBId: string;
let efFkId: string;

const activityIds: string[] = [];
const calcIds: string[] = [];
const documentIds: string[] = [];
const targetIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

function call(
  handler: (req: Request, res: Response) => Promise<void>,
  query: Record<string, string>,
) {
  const res = resMock();
  const req = { query } as unknown as Request;
  return { res, run: handler(req, res) };
}

async function seedEntity(values: {
  organisationId: string;
  parentId?: string | null;
  name: string;
  subtype: string;
  areaSqm?: string | null;
}) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: values.organisationId,
      parentId: values.parentId ?? null,
      name: values.name,
      code: `c-dash-${RUN}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`,
      type: 'LOCATION',
      subtype: values.subtype as never,
      areaSqm: values.areaSqm ?? null,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  return rows[0]!.id;
}

async function seedActivity(values: {
  organisationId: string;
  reportingPeriodId: string;
  category: string;
  scope: string;
  quantity: string;
  unit: string;
  status: string;
  physicalEntityId?: string | null;
  activityDate?: Date | null;
  description?: string | null;
  sourceFileName?: string | null;
  createdAt?: Date;
}) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: values.organisationId,
      reportingPeriodId: values.reportingPeriodId,
      physicalEntityId: values.physicalEntityId ?? null,
      category: values.category as never,
      scope: values.scope as never,
      quantity: values.quantity,
      unit: values.unit,
      activityDate:
        values.activityDate === undefined ? new Date('2025-06-01T00:00:00.000Z') : values.activityDate,
      status: values.status as never,
      description: values.description ?? null,
      sourceFileName: values.sourceFileName ?? null,
      ...(values.createdAt ? { createdAt: values.createdAt, updatedAt: values.createdAt } : {}),
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  activityIds.push(id);
  return id;
}

async function seedCalc(values: {
  organisationId: string;
  reportingPeriodId: string;
  activityDataId: string;
  scope: string;
  co2eKg: string;
  status?: string;
}) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(calculationsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: values.organisationId,
      reportingPeriodId: values.reportingPeriodId,
      activityDataId: values.activityDataId,
      emissionFactorId: efFkId,
      scope: values.scope as never,
      quantity: '10.0000',
      activityUnit: 'kg',
      emissionFactor: '2.000000',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
      co2eKg: values.co2eKg,
      status: (values.status ?? 'CALCULATED') as never,
    })
    .returning({ id: calculationsTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  calcIds.push(id);
  return id;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  for (const pattern of ['c-dash-%', 'c-dq-%']) {
    const staleOrgs = await db
      .select({ id: organisationsTable.id })
      .from(organisationsTable)
      .where(like(organisationsTable.code, pattern));
    if (staleOrgs.length > 0) {
      const staleIds = staleOrgs.map((o) => o.id);
      await db.delete(calculationsTable).where(inArray(calculationsTable.organisationId, staleIds));
      await db.delete(documentsTable).where(inArray(documentsTable.organisationId, staleIds));
      await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.organisationId, staleIds));
      await db.delete(sustainabilityTargetsTable).where(inArray(sustainabilityTargetsTable.organisationId, staleIds));
      await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(inArray(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, staleIds));
      await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, staleIds));
    }
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, `${pattern.slice(0, 6)}%`));
  }

  const efRows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: `c-dash-fk-${RUN}`,
      activityId: 'DIESEL',
      name: `Dash FK ${RUN}`,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scopes: ['1'],
      factor: '2.000000',
      unit: 'L',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/L',
      countryCode: 'XX',
      source: 'CUSTOM',
      year: null,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  efFkId = efRows[0]!.id;

  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values([
      { name: 'Dash Org A', code: `c-dash-a-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
      { name: 'Dash Org B', code: `c-dash-b-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
      { name: 'Dash Org C', code: `c-dash-c-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    ])
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgAId = orgRows[0]!.id;
  orgBId = orgRows[1]!.id;
  orgCId = orgRows[2]!.id;

  campusA1Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, name: 'Alpha Campus', subtype: 'CAMPUS' });
  campusA2Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, name: 'Beta Campus', subtype: 'CAMPUS' });
  buildingA1Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: campusA1Id, name: 'Science Block', subtype: 'BUILDING' });
  buildingA2Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: campusA2Id, name: 'Arts Block', subtype: 'BUILDING' });
  floorA11Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: buildingA1Id, name: 'Level 1', subtype: 'FLOOR', areaSqm: '500.00' });
  floorA12Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: buildingA1Id, name: 'Level 2', subtype: 'FLOOR', areaSqm: null });
  floorA21Id = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: buildingA2Id, name: 'Ground', subtype: 'FLOOR', areaSqm: '300.00' });
  const orphanBuildingId = await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: null, name: 'Annex', subtype: 'BUILDING' });
  await seedEntity({ organisationId: orgAId, parentId: orphanBuildingId, name: 'Attic', subtype: 'FLOOR', areaSqm: '999.00' });

  const periodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values([
      { organisationId: orgAId, name: 'FY24 Base', startDate: new Date('2024-01-01'), endDate: new Date('2024-06-30'), isBaseline: true, status: 'OPEN', studentCount: 2000 },
      { organisationId: orgAId, name: 'H2 FY24', startDate: new Date('2024-07-01'), endDate: new Date('2024-12-31'), status: 'OPEN', studentCount: null },
      { organisationId: orgAId, name: 'FY25', startDate: new Date('2025-01-01'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31'), status: 'OPEN', studentCount: 2500 },
      { organisationId: orgAId, name: 'FY26 Draft', startDate: new Date('2026-01-01'), endDate: new Date('2026-12-31'), status: 'DRAFT' },
      { organisationId: orgBId, name: 'OrgB Period', startDate: new Date('2030-01-01'), endDate: new Date('2030-12-31'), status: 'OPEN' },
      { organisationId: orgCId, name: 'OrgC Draft Only', startDate: new Date('2025-01-01'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31'), status: 'DRAFT' },
    ])
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  pBaseId = periodRows[0]!.id;
  pPrevId = periodRows[1]!.id;
  pCurId = periodRows[2]!.id;
  pDraftPId = periodRows[3]!.id;
  pBId = periodRows[4]!.id;

  const actElec = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', scope: 'SCOPE_2', quantity: '120.0000', unit: 'kWh', status: 'VERIFIED', physicalEntityId: floorA11Id, activityDate: new Date('2025-02-10T00:00:00.000Z'), description: 'Electricity Feb', sourceFileName: null, createdAt: new Date('2025-06-02T10:00:00.000Z') });
  const actDiesel = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '50.0000', unit: 'litre', status: 'CALCULATED', physicalEntityId: floorA12Id, activityDate: new Date('2025-01-20T00:00:00.000Z'), description: null, sourceFileName: 'diesel-jan.csv', createdAt: new Date('2025-06-01T10:00:00.000Z') });
  const actVehicle = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, category: 'OWNED_VEHICLE', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '30.0000', unit: 'kg', status: 'CALCULATED', physicalEntityId: null, activityDate: new Date('2025-02-05T00:00:00.000Z'), description: null, sourceFileName: null, createdAt: new Date('2025-06-03T10:00:00.000Z') });
  const actRefrig = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, category: 'REFRIGERANT', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '8.0000', unit: 'kg', status: 'CALCULATED', physicalEntityId: buildingA2Id, activityDate: null, description: 'Refrig topup', sourceFileName: null, createdAt: new Date('2025-06-04T10:00:00.000Z') });
  await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, category: 'PETROL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '20.0000', unit: 'litre', status: 'DRAFT', physicalEntityId: floorA21Id, activityDate: new Date('2025-03-15T00:00:00.000Z'), description: null, sourceFileName: null, createdAt: new Date('2025-06-05T10:00:00.000Z') });

  const actBase1 = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pBaseId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '70.0000', unit: 'litre', status: 'CALCULATED', activityDate: new Date('2024-02-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
  const actBase2 = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pBaseId, category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', scope: 'SCOPE_2', quantity: '80.0000', unit: 'kWh', status: 'CALCULATED', activityDate: new Date('2024-03-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
  const actPrev = await seedActivity({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pPrevId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '90.0000', unit: 'litre', status: 'CALCULATED', activityDate: new Date('2024-08-01T00:00:00.000Z') });

  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, activityDataId: actElec, scope: 'SCOPE_2', co2eKg: '400.0000' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, activityDataId: actDiesel, scope: 'SCOPE_1', co2eKg: '300.0000' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, activityDataId: actVehicle, scope: 'SCOPE_1', co2eKg: '100.0000' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, activityDataId: actRefrig, scope: 'SCOPE_1', co2eKg: '200.0000' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId, activityDataId: actElec, scope: 'SCOPE_2', co2eKg: '99999.0000', status: 'FAILED' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pBaseId, activityDataId: actBase1, scope: 'SCOPE_1', co2eKg: '700.0000' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pBaseId, activityDataId: actBase2, scope: 'SCOPE_2', co2eKg: '500.0000' });
  await seedCalc({ organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pPrevId, activityDataId: actPrev, scope: 'SCOPE_1', co2eKg: '800.0000' });

  const targetRows = await db
    .insert(sustainabilityTargetsTable)
    .values([
      { organisationId: orgAId, targetYear: 2030, reductionPct: '50.00', targetCo2eKg: '500000.0000' },
      { organisationId: orgAId, targetYear: 2035, reductionPct: '80.00', targetCo2eKg: null },
    ])
    .returning({ id: sustainabilityTargetsTable.id });
  targetIds.push(...targetRows.map((t) => t.id));

  await db.insert(baselinesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgAId,
    reportingPeriodId: pBaseId,
    baselineYear: 2024,
    scope1KgCO2e: '700.0000',
    scope2KgCO2e: '500.0000',
    totalKgCO2e: '1200.0000',
  });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  if (calcIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(calculationsTable).where(inArray(calculationsTable.id, calcIds));
  }
  if (documentIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(documentsTable).where(inArray(documentsTable.id, documentIds));
  }
  if (activityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.id, activityIds));
  }
  if (targetIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(sustainabilityTargetsTable).where(inArray(sustainabilityTargetsTable.id, targetIds));
  }
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(inArray(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, [orgAId, orgBId, orgCId]));
  if (efFkId) {
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, efFkId));
  }
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgAId, orgBId, orgCId]));
});

describe('GET /dashboard/summary + section services (V1 contract)', () => {
  it('rejects a missing universityId with the V1 message', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, {});
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
  });

  it('returns 400 when no selectable reporting period exists', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgCId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({
      success: false,
      message: 'No active reporting period found for this university',
    });
  });

  it('selects the default period by latest endDate among selectable statuses and composes all 13 sections', async () => {
    expect(pDraftPId).toBeTruthy();
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgAId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);

    const data = res.body.data;
    expect(Object.keys(data)).toEqual([
      'overview',
      'scopeBreakdown',
      'categories',
      'topSources',
      'buildings',
      'floors',
      'trends',
      'baseline',
      'intensity',
      'recentActivity',
      'activityStats',
      'targets',
      'groups',
    ]);

    expect(data.overview.totalEmissionsTonnes).toBeCloseTo(1, 10);
    expect(data.intensity.studentCount).toBe(2500);
    expect(data.baseline.current.period).toBe('FY25');
  });

  it('computes overview totals, baseline reduction and previous-period delta from CALCULATED calcs only', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.overview, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const o = res.body.data;
    expect(o.scope1Tonnes).toBeCloseTo(0.6, 10);
    expect(o.scope2Tonnes).toBeCloseTo(0.4, 10);
    expect(o.totalEmissionsTonnes).toBeCloseTo(1, 10);
    expect(o.reductionPercentage).toBe(16.67);
    expect(o.delta).toBe(25);
  });

  it('excludes FAILED calculations from every aggregate', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.scopeBreakdown, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data.total.kgCO2e).toBe(1000);
  });

  it('computes scope breakdown percentages and applies the zero-to-positive 100% delta rule', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.scopeBreakdown, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    const s = res.body.data;
    expect(s.scope1.kgCO2e).toBe(600);
    expect(s.scope1.tonnesCO2e).toBeCloseTo(0.6, 10);
    expect(s.scope1.percentage).toBeCloseTo(60, 10);
    expect(s.scope1.delta).toBe(-25);
    expect(s.scope2.kgCO2e).toBe(400);
    expect(s.scope2.percentage).toBeCloseTo(40, 10);
    expect(s.scope2.delta).toBe(100);
    expect(s.total.kgCO2e).toBe(1000);
    expect(s.total.tonnesCO2e).toBeCloseTo(1, 10);
  });

  it('aggregates categories with per-category trend including the 100% rule', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.categoryBreakdown, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    const cats = res.body.data;
    expect(cats).toHaveLength(4);

    const elec = cats.find((c: any) => c.category === 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY');
    expect(elec).toMatchObject({ kgCO2e: 400, tonnesCO2e: 0.4, trend: 100 });
    const diesel = cats.find((c: any) => c.category === 'DIESEL');
    expect(diesel).toMatchObject({ kgCO2e: 300, trend: -62.5 });
    const vehicle = cats.find((c: any) => c.category === 'OWNED_VEHICLE');
    expect(vehicle).toMatchObject({ kgCO2e: 100, trend: 100 });
    const refrig = cats.find((c: any) => c.category === 'REFRIGERANT');
    expect(refrig).toMatchObject({ kgCO2e: 200, trend: 100 });
  });

  it('sorts top sources descending by emissions tonnes', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.topSources, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual([
      { category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', emissionsTonnes: 0.4 },
      { category: 'DIESEL', emissionsTonnes: 0.3 },
      { category: 'REFRIGERANT', emissionsTonnes: 0.2 },
      { category: 'OWNED_VEHICLE', emissionsTonnes: 0.1 },
    ]);
  });

  it('groups buildings through entity ancestry with Unassigned fallback, sorted desc', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.buildingEmissions, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual([
      { building: 'Science Block', emissionsTonnes: 0.7 },
      { building: 'Arts Block', emissionsTonnes: 0.2 },
      { building: 'Unassigned', emissionsTonnes: 0.1 },
    ]);
  });

  it('keys floors by "<building> - <floor>" with Unassigned fallbacks on either side', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.floorEmissions, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual([
      { floor: 'Science Block - Level 1', emissionsTonnes: 0.4 },
      { floor: 'Science Block - Level 2', emissionsTonnes: 0.3 },
      { floor: 'Arts Block - Unassigned', emissionsTonnes: 0.2 },
      { floor: 'Unassigned - Unassigned', emissionsTonnes: 0.1 },
    ]);
  });

  it('groups trends by YYYY-MM ascending and skips null activity dates', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.trends, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual([
      { month: '2025-01', scope1Kg: 300, scope2Kg: 0, totalKg: 300 },
      { month: '2025-02', scope1Kg: 100, scope2Kg: 400, totalKg: 500 },
    ]);
  });

  it('requires both params for baseline comparison and preserves the V1 message', async () => {
    const missingPeriod = call(controller.baselineComparison, { universityId: orgAId });
    await missingPeriod.run;
    expect(missingPeriod.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(missingPeriod.res.body).toEqual({
      success: false,
      message: 'universityId and reportingPeriodId are required',
    });

    const missingOrg = call(controller.baselineComparison, { reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await missingOrg.run;
    expect(missingOrg.res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(missingOrg.res.body.message).toBe('universityId and reportingPeriodId are required');
  });

  it('returns Current reporting period not found for an unknown period id', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.baselineComparison, {
      universityId: orgAId,
      reportingPeriodId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Current reporting period not found' });
  });

  it('compares against the isBaseline period without synthesizing snapshots', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.baselineComparison, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual({
      baseline: { period: 'FY24 Base', emissionsTonnes: 1.2 },
      current: { period: 'FY25', emissionsTonnes: 1 },
      changeTonnes: -0.2,
      reductionPercentage: 16.67,
    });
  });

  it('returns the in-data error object when no baseline period exists', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.baselineComparison, { universityId: orgBId, reportingPeriodId: pBId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({
      success: true,
      data: { error: 'No baseline period set for this university' },
    });
  });

  it('computes intensity with explicit reportingPeriodId (floor areas under campuses only)', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.intensity, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pCurId });
    await run;
    const i = res.body.data;
    expect(i.totalEmissionsTonnes).toBe(1);
    expect(i.studentCount).toBe(2500);
    expect(i.totalAreaSqm).toBe(800);
    expect(i.tonnesPerStudent).toBe(0.0004);
    expect(i.kgPerSqm).toBe(1.25);
  });

  it('resolves the default reporting period for intensity when none is supplied', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.intensity, { universityId: orgAId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data.studentCount).toBe(2500);
  });

  it('uses studentCount 0 when the selected period has no statistics', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.intensity, { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: pPrevId });
    await run;
    const i = res.body.data;
    expect(i.studentCount).toBe(0);
    expect(i.tonnesPerStudent).toBe(0);
    expect(i.totalEmissionsTonnes).toBe(0.8);
    expect(i.kgPerSqm).toBe(1);
  });

  it('maps recent activity display fields over the last 6 rows by createdAt desc', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgAId });
    await run;
    const recent = res.body.data.recentActivity;
    expect(recent).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(recent[0]).toEqual({
      source: 'Record PETROL',
      type: 'petrol',
      scope: 'S1',
      value: '20 litre',
      status: 'Synced',
    });
    expect(recent[1]).toEqual({
      source: 'Refrig topup',
      type: 'refrigerant',
      scope: 'S1',
      value: '8 kg',
      status: 'Processed',
    });
    expect(recent[2]).toEqual({
      source: 'Record OWNED_VEHICLE',
      type: 'owned vehicle',
      scope: 'S1',
      value: '30 kg',
      status: 'Processed',
    });
    expect(recent[3]).toEqual({
      source: 'Electricity Feb',
      type: 'purchased electricity',
      scope: 'S2',
      value: '120 kWh',
      status: 'Processed',
    });
    expect(recent[4].source).toBe('diesel-jan.csv');
    expect(recent[4].type).toBe('diesel');
  });

  it('derives activityStats with pending and verifiedTotal', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgAId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data.activityStats).toEqual({
      total: 5,
      draft: 1,
      submitted: 0,
      underReview: 0,
      verified: 1,
      rejected: 0,
      calculated: 3,
      pending: 1,
      verifiedTotal: 4,
    });
  });

  it('prepends the V1 baseline entry and keeps targets ascending by year (D-18)', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgAId });
    await run;
    expect(res.body.data.targets).toEqual([
      { label: '2024 baseline', value: 1, unit: 'tCO₂e', complete: false },
      { label: '2030 target (-50%)', value: 500, unit: 'tCO₂e', complete: false },
      { label: '2035 target (-80%)', value: 0, unit: 'tCO₂e', complete: false },
    ]);
  });

  it('routes categories into the five fixed groups with share/delta/spark semantics', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgAId });
    await run;
    const groups = res.body.data.groups;
    expect(groups.map((g: any) => g.key)).toEqual(['offices', 'logistics', 'travel', 'employees', 'supply-chain']);

    const offices = groups[0];
    expect(offices.value).toBe(1);
    expect(offices.share).toBe(0.6);
    expect(offices.delta).toBe(100);
    expect(offices.items.map((i: any) => i.name)).toEqual(['purchased electricity', 'refrigerant']);
    expect(offices.spark).toEqual([]);

    const logistics = groups[1];
    expect(logistics.value).toBe(0);
    expect(logistics.share).toBe(0.4);
    expect(logistics.delta).toBe(18.8);
    expect(logistics.items.map((i: any) => i.name)).toEqual(['diesel', 'owned vehicle']);

    for (const key of ['travel', 'employees', 'supply-chain']) {
      const g = groups.find((x: any) => x.key === key);
      expect(g.value).toBe(0);
      expect(g.share).toBe(0);
      expect(g.delta).toBe(0);
      expect(g.items).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  it('keeps tenants isolated across every aggregate', async () => {
    const overviewRes = call(controller.overview, { universityId: orgBId, reportingPeriodId: pBId });
    await overviewRes.run;
    expect(overviewRes.res.body.data.totalEmissionsTonnes).toBe(0);

    const defaultRes = call(controller.intensity, { universityId: orgBId });
    await defaultRes.run;
    expect(defaultRes.res.body.data.studentCount).toBe(0);
    expect(defaultRes.res.body.data.totalEmissionsTonnes).toBe(0);

    const statsRes = call(controller.getSummary, { universityId: orgBId });
    await statsRes.run;
    expect(statsRes.res.body.data.activityStats.total).toBe(0);
    expect(statsRes.res.body.data.categories).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';

import type { Request, Response } from 'express';

const RUN = Date.now();

let emptyOrgId: string;

let pDqOtherId: string;
let efFkId: string;

      this.statusCode = code;

    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

function call(query: Record<string, string>) {

  const req = { query } as unknown as Request;
  return { res, run: getMetricsController(req, res) };
}

async function seedActivity(values: {
  reportingPeriodId: string;
  category?: string;
  scope?: string;
  quantity: string;
  unit: string;
  status: string;
  activityDate?: Date | null;
  description?: string | null;
}) {

    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: dqOrgId,
      reportingPeriodId: values.reportingPeriodId,
      physicalEntityId: null,
      category: (values.category ?? 'DIESEL') as never,
      scope: (values.scope ?? 'SCOPE_1') as never,
      quantity: values.quantity,
      unit: values.unit,
      activityDate:
        values.activityDate === undefined ? new Date('2025-06-01T00:00:00.000Z') : values.activityDate,
      status: values.status as never,
      description: values.description ?? null,
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  activityIds.push(id);
  return id;
}

async function seedCalc(activityDataId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(calculationsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: dqOrgId,
      reportingPeriodId: pDqId,
      activityDataId,
      emissionFactorId: efFkId,
      scope: 'SCOPE_1' as never,
      quantity: '10.0000',
      activityUnit: 'kg',
      emissionFactor: '2.000000',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
      co2eKg: '20.0000',
      status: 'CALCULATED',
    })
    .returning({ id: calculationsTable.id });
  calcIds.push(rows[0]!.id);
}

async function seedDocument(activityDataId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(documentsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: dqOrgId,
      activityDataId,
      documentType: 'FUEL_INVOICE',
      fileName: `dq-${RUN}-${activityDataId.slice(0, 8)}.pdf`,
      originalName: 'invoice.pdf',
      fileUrl: `https://example.com/dq-${RUN}/${activityDataId.slice(0, 8)}.pdf`,
      mimeType: 'application/pdf',
      fileSize: 1024,
      status: 'UPLOADED',
    })
    .returning({ id: documentsTable.id });

beforeAll(async () => {
  const staleOrgs = await db
    .select({ id: organisationsTable.id })

    await db.delete(documentsTable).where(inArray(documentsTable.organisationId, staleIds));

    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, staleIds));

    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });

    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)

  const actVerifiedCalc = await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqId, category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', scope: 'SCOPE_2', quantity: '10.0000', unit: 'kWh', status: 'VERIFIED' });
  await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqId, quantity: '5.0000', unit: 'kg', status: 'VERIFIED' });
  await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqId, quantity: '0.0000', unit: 'L', status: 'DRAFT' });
  await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqId, quantity: '3.0000', unit: '', status: 'SUBMITTED' });
  await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqId, quantity: '2.0000', unit: 'm3', status: 'UNDER_REVIEW', activityDate: null });

  const actCalculated = await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqId, category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', scope: 'SCOPE_2', quantity: '7.0000', unit: 'kWh', status: 'CALCULATED' });

  await seedCalc(actVerifiedCalc);
  await seedCalc(actCalculated);

  await seedDocument(actVerifiedCalc);

  await seedActivity({ reportingPeriodId: pDqOtherId, quantity: '4.0000', unit: 'kg', status: 'VERIFIED' });

afterAll(async () => {
  if (calcIds.length > 0) {

  }
  if (documentIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(documentsTable).where(inArray(documentsTable.id, documentIds));
  }
  if (activityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.id, activityIds));

  if (efFkId) {

  }
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [dqOrgId, emptyOrgId]));
});

describe('GET /data-quality/metrics (V1 contract)', () => {
  it('rejects a missing universityId with the V1 message', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call({});
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
  });

  it('counts all seven V1 statuses over the tenant-scoped set', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.summary).toEqual({
      total: 8,
      verified: 3,
      draft: 1,
      submitted: 1,
      needsReview: 1,
      rejected: 1,
      calculated: 1,
    });
  });

  it('detects missing quantity (null or zero), unit (null or empty) and date', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    const byKey = Object.fromEntries(m.issues.map((i) => [i.key, i.count]));
    expect(byKey.missingQuantity).toBe(1);
    expect(byKey.missingUnit).toBe(1);
    expect(byKey.missingDate).toBe(1);
    expect(m.issues.find((i) => i.key === 'missingQuantity')?.label).toBe('Missing Quantity');
    expect(m.issues.find((i) => i.key === 'missingUnit')?.label).toBe('Missing Unit');
    expect(m.issues.find((i) => i.key === 'missingDate')?.label).toBe('Missing Activity Date');
  });

  it('flags VERIFIED activities without calculations as uncalculated and missingEF identically', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.missingEF).toBe(2);
    const uncalculatedIssue = m.issues.find((i) => i.key === 'uncalculated');
    expect(uncalculatedIssue?.count).toBe(2);
    expect(uncalculatedIssue?.label).toBe('Uncalculated Activities');
  });

  it('detects duplicates via the POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE description prefix', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.duplicates).toBe(1);
    expect(m.issues.find((i) => i.key === 'duplicates')).toEqual({
      key: 'duplicates',
      label: 'Possible Duplicates',
      count: 1,
    });
  });

  it('computes verification rate as (verified + calculated) / total at one decimal', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.coverage.verification).toEqual({ verified: 4, total: 8, rate: 50 });
  });

  it('computes calculation coverage as calculated / verified', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.coverage.calculation).toEqual({ calculated: 1, verified: 3, rate: 33.3 });
  });

  it('derives document coverage through the documents relationship (broken-query regression)', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.coverage.document).toEqual({ withDocument: 2, total: 8, rate: 25 });
  });

  it('applies the verified 40/30/20/10 weighting and rounds to an integer score', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.qualityScore).toBe(
      Math.round(50 * 0.4 + 33.3 * 0.3 + 25 * 0.2 + ((8 - 1) / 8) * 100 * 0.1),
    );
    expect(m.qualityScore).toBe(44);
  });

  it('emits issues in the exact V1 conditional order with the unverified rollup count', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    expect(m.issues.map((i) => i.key)).toEqual([
      'missingQuantity',
      'missingUnit',
      'missingDate',

      'uncalculated',
      'duplicates',

      label: 'Unverified Activities',
      count: 3,
    });

  it('filters by reporting period, scope and category; ignores campusId/buildingId like V1', async () => {
    const byPeriod = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId, { reportingPeriodId: pDqOtherId });
    expect(byPeriod.summary.total).toBe(1);
    expect(byPeriod.coverage.verification.rate).toBe(100);

    const byScope = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId, { scope: 'SCOPE_2' });
    expect(byScope.summary.total).toBe(2);

    const byCategory = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId, { category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY' });
    expect(byCategory.summary.total).toBe(2);

    const plain = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId);
    const deadFilters = await getDataQualityMetrics(dqOrgId, {
      campusId: '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
      buildingId: '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222',
    });
    expect(deadFilters).toEqual(plain);

  it('handles a zero-activity dataset with V1 fallbacks (rates 0, noDuplicateScore 100)', async () => {
    const m = await getDataQualityMetrics(emptyOrgId);

      summary: {
        total: 0,

        draft: 0,
        submitted: 0,
        needsReview: 0,

        calculated: 0,

        calculation: { calculated: 0, verified: 0, rate: 0 },
        document: { withDocument: 0, total: 0, rate: 0 },
      },
      qualityScore: 10,
      missingEF: 0,
      duplicates: 0,
    });
  });

  it('returns the exact V1 envelope with JSON-number serialization from the controller', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call({ universityId: dqOrgId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body.data)).toEqual([
      'summary',
      'issues',
      'coverage',
      'qualityScore',
      'missingEF',
      'duplicates',
    ]);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body.data.coverage)).toEqual(['verification', 'calculation', 'document']);
    expect(typeof res.body.data.qualityScore).toBe('number');
    expect(typeof res.body.data.coverage.document.rate).toBe('number');
    expect(Number.isInteger(res.body.data.qualityScore)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('normalizes the V1 broken documentId query into a working endpoint (200, not 400)', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call({ universityId: dqOrgId });
    await run;
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.coverage.document.withDocument).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  documentsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/documentsV1.js';
import { documentFileFilter } from '../routes/v1/documents.js';
import * as storage from '../services/storage.js';

vi.mock('../services/storage.js', () => ({
  uploadFile: vi.fn(async (_b: string, filePath: string) => ({ path: filePath })),
  getSignedUrl: vi.fn(async (_b: string, filePath: string) => `https://signed.test/${filePath}`),
  getPublicUrl: vi.fn((_b: string, filePath: string) => `https://public.test/${filePath}`),
}));

const RUN = Date.now();
const FORBIDDEN = 'Forbidden: Access restricted to your own university';

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let userId: string;
let activityId: string;
const docIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

function uploadReq(body: Record<string, unknown>, user?: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const buffer = Buffer.from('invoice-bytes');
  return {
    body,
    user,
    file: { originalname: `inv-${RUN}.pdf`, buffer, mimetype: 'application/pdf', size: buffer.length },
  } as unknown as Request;
}

async function insertDoc(values: Partial<typeof documentsTable.$inferInsert> = {}) {
  const [row] = await db.insert(documentsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId,
    documentType: 'OTHER',
    fileName: `f-${docIds.length}-${RUN}.pdf`,
    originalName: `o-${docIds.length}.pdf`,
    fileUrl: `u/${docIds.length}`,
    mimeType: 'application/pdf',
    fileSize: 10,
    uploadedById: userId,
    ...values,
  }).returning({ id: documentsTable.id });
  docIds.push(row!.id);
  return row!.id;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgs = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values([
    { name: `DocA ${RUN}`, code: `DOCA-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    { name: `DocB ${RUN}`, code: `DOCB-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
  ]).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgs[0]!.id;
  otherOrgId = orgs[1]!.id;

  const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: `DP ${RUN}`, startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T00:00:00Z'), status: 'OPEN',
  }).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = period!.id;

  const [user] = await db.insert(usersTable).values({
    authUserId: randomUUID(), username: `doc-${RUN}`, email: `doc-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: `doc-password-${RUN}`, organisationId: orgId, role: 'USER',
  }).returning({ id: usersTable.id });
  userId = user!.id;

  const [activity] = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, category: 'DIESEL', scope: 'SCOPE_1',
    quantity: '1.0000', unit: 'L', status: 'DRAFT',
  }).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityId = activity!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(documentsTable).where(inArray(documentsTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entity, ['Document']));
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
});

describe('D-24 multer filter (documents)', () => {
  it('rejects disallowed mimetypes with the V1 message', () => {
    const cb = vi.fn();
    documentFileFilter({}, { mimetype: 'application/zip' } as any, cb as any);
    expect((cb.mock.calls[0]![0] as Error).message).toBe('Invalid file type. Allowed: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, CSV, XLSX');
  });
});

describe('POST /documents/upload', () => {
  it('requires a file', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upload({ body: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('No file uploaded');
  });

  it('returns the Invalid input data envelope on zod failure', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upload(uploadReq({ universityId: 'bad' }) as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid input data');
    expect(res.body.errors[0].field).toBe('universityId');
  });

  it('normalizes cross-tenant uploads to 403 and lets SUPER_ADMIN pass', async () => {
    const denied = resMock();

      uploadReq({ universityId: orgId, documentType: 'OTHER' }, { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: otherOrgId }) as Request,
      denied,

    expect(denied.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(denied.body.message).toBe(FORBIDDEN);

    const admin = resMock();
    await controller.upload(
      uploadReq({ universityId: orgId, documentType: 'FUEL_INVOICE', description: 'd' }, { userId, role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', universityId: null }) as Request,

    const upCall = vi.mocked(storage.uploadFile).mock.calls.at(-1)!;
    expect(upCall[0]).toBe('documents'); // D-27
    expect(String(upCall[1])).toMatch(new RegExp(`^universities/${orgId}/invoices/[0-9a-f-]{36}\\.pdf$`));
    expect(upCall[2]).toEqual(Buffer.from('invoice-bytes'));
    expect(upCall[3]).toBe('application/pdf');
    const pubCall = vi.mocked(storage.getPublicUrl).mock.calls[callsBefore];
    expect(pubCall?.[0]).toBe('documents');

    const rows = await db.select().from(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, res.body.data.documentId));
    const doc = rows[0]!;
    docIds.push(doc.id);
    expect(doc).toMatchObject({ uploadedById: userId, fileUrl: `https://public.test/${doc.storagePath}`, publicUrl: `https://public.test/${doc.storagePath}` });

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, doc.id));
    expect(audits[0]).toMatchObject({ action: 'DOCUMENT_UPLOADED', entity: 'Document', description: 'Document uploaded' });
    expect(audits[0]!.metadata).toMatchObject({ originalName: `inv-${RUN}.pdf`, mimeType: 'application/pdf' });
  });

  it('rejects uploads pointing at nonexistent activities through the FK path', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upload(
      uploadReq({ universityId: orgId, documentType: 'OTHER', activityDataId: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' }, { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId }) as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('GET /documents', () => {
  it('requires universityId', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getAll({ query: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId is required');
  });

  it('lists newest-first for the tenant with D-23 uploadedBy and D-7 visibility', async () => {
    await insertDoc({ createdAt: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'), updatedAt: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z') });
    await insertDoc({ createdAt: new Date('2025-02-01T00:00:00Z'), updatedAt: new Date('2025-02-01T00:00:00Z') });

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getAll({ query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const dates: number[] = res.body.data.map((d: any) => new Date(d.createdAt).getTime());
    expect([...dates].sort((a, b) => b - a)).toEqual(dates);
    expect(res.body.data.every((d: any) => d.universityId === orgId)).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data[0].uploadedBy).toEqual({ id: userId });

    // D-7: an S4-uploaded row is visible in listings.
    expect(res.body.data.some((d: any) => d.originalName === `inv-${RUN}.pdf`)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('403s other tenants', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getAll({ query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: otherOrgId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
  });
});

describe('GET /documents/:id', () => {
  it('returns the serialized document', async () => {
    const id = await insertDoc({ activityDataId: activityId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById(
      { params: { id }, query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ id, universityId: orgId, uploadedBy: { id: userId }, uploadedById: userId, activityDataId: activityId });
    expect(Object.keys(res.body.data)).toContain('fileUrl');
  });

  it('normalizes missing documents to 404', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById(
      { params: { id: 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' }, query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Document not found');
  });
});

describe('GET /documents/activity/:activityId', () => {
  it('filters by activity within the tenant', async () => {
    await insertDoc({ activityDataId: activityId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getByActivity(
      { params: { activityId: activityId }, query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.every((d: any) => d.activityDataId === activityId)).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });
});

describe('DELETE /documents/:id', () => {
  it('deletes only the database row, audits, and keeps storage untouched', async () => {
    const id = await insertDoc();
    const storageCallsBefore =
      vi.mocked(storage.uploadFile).mock.calls.length + vi.mocked(storage.getPublicUrl).mock.calls.length;

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.remove(
      { params: { id }, query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: true, message: 'Document deleted successfully' });

    const rows = await db.select().from(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, id));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0);

    const after =
      vi.mocked(storage.uploadFile).mock.calls.length + vi.mocked(storage.getPublicUrl).mock.calls.length;
    expect(after).toBe(storageCallsBefore);

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, id));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'DOCUMENT_DELETED')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('normalizes missing deletes to 404', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.remove(
      { params: { id: 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' }, query: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Document not found');
  });
});

describe('POST /documents/:id/ocr (mock)', () => {
  it('runs the fixed mock payload between OCR audits', async () => {
    const id = await insertDoc();
    const started = Date.now();
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.runOcr(
      { params: { id }, body: { universityId: orgId }, user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );

    expect(Date.now() - started).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1900);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('OCR processed successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual({
      documentId: id,
      extractedData: { date: '2026-08-15', vendor: 'Utility Corp', totalAmount: 12500, unit: 'kWh', category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY' },
      confidenceScore: 0.92,
    });

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, id));
    expect(audits.map((a) => a.action)).toEqual(['OCR_STARTED', 'OCR_COMPLETED']);
    expect(audits[1]!.metadata).toMatchObject({ result: { confidenceScore: 0.92 } });
  }, 10000);

  it('requires universityId in the body', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.runOcr({ params: { id: 'x' }, body: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId is required in body');
  });
});

describe('POST /documents/:id/create-activity', () => {
  it('creates an INVOICE DRAFT activity from OCR data without isolation', async () => {
    const id = await insertDoc();
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.createFromOcr(
      {
        params: { id },
        body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, ocrData: { category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', totalAmount: 12500, unit: 'kWh', date: '2026-08-15', vendor: 'Utility Corp' } },
        user: { userId, role: 'USER', universityId: otherOrgId }, // no isolation call in V1
      } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Activity created from OCR data');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: 12500, unit: 'kWh',
      inputSource: 'INVOICE', sourceFileId: id, status: 'DRAFT', description: 'Imported via OCR: Utility Corp',
    });
  });

  it('requires universityId, reportingPeriodId and ocrData', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.createFromOcr({ params: {}, body: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Missing required fields');
  });

  it('preserves the invalid OTHER fallback crash path', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.createFromOcr(
      { params: { id: 'c' }, body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId, ocrData: { vendor: 'v' } } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll, vi } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray, like } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { emissionFactorsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { getEmissionFactor, PendingFactorError } from '../services/efResolverV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
const COUNTRY = `ResolverLand-${RUN}`;

let fixedNullYearId: string;
let fixedYearId: string;
let cachedRowId: string;

const seededIds: string[] = [];

async function seedFactor(values: {
  factorId: string;
  category: string;
  country?: string | null;
  countryCode?: string | null;
  source: string;
  status?: string;
  year?: number | null;
  unit?: string;
  factor?: string;
  scopes?: string[];
  metadata?: unknown;
}) {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: values.factorId,
      activityId: values.category,
      name: values.factorId,
      category: values.category,
      scopes: values.scopes ?? ['1'],
      factor: values.factor ?? '2.500000',
      unit: values.unit ?? 'litre',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e',
      countryCode: values.countryCode ?? null,
      countryName: values.country ?? COUNTRY,
      source: values.source,
      year: values.year ?? null,
      status: (values.status ?? 'ACTIVE') as never,
      metadata: values.metadata ?? null,
    })
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  const id = rows[0]!.id;
  seededIds.push(id);
  return id;
}

function okFetch(payload: unknown) {
  return vi.fn(async () => ({
    ok: true,
    json: async () => payload,
  })) as unknown as typeof fetch;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'efres-%'));
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.countryName, 'ResolverLand-%'));

  fixedNullYearId = await seedFactor({
    factorId: `efres-null-${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    source: 'DEFRA',
    year: null,
    factor: '9.990000',
  });
  fixedYearId = await seedFactor({
    factorId: `efres-year-${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    source: 'GOVERNMENT',
    year: 2023,
    metadata: { sourceVersion: 'v2023' },
  });
  await seedFactor({
    factorId: `efres-future-${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    source: 'EPA',
    year: 2030,
  });
  await seedFactor({
    factorId: `efres-clim-${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    source: 'CLIMATIQ',
    year: 2024,
  });
  await seedFactor({
    factorId: `efres-inactive-${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    source: 'IPCC',
    status: 'INACTIVE',
    factor: '8.880000',
  });
  cachedRowId = await seedFactor({
    factorId: `climatiq-DIESEL-${COUNTRY}-2025-litre-${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    source: 'CLIMATIQ',
    year: 2025,
    unit: 'litre',
    factor: '2.750000',
    metadata: { climatiq_version: '10.0', climatiq_id: 'test-id', fetched_at: new Date().toISOString() },
  });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  if (seededIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(inArray(emissionFactorsTable.id, seededIds));
  }
  await db
    .delete(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(like(emissionFactorsTable.countryName, 'ResolverLand-%'));
  delete process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY;
});

describe('tier 1: fixed EF', () => {
  it('prefers a year-matched fixed row over a null-year row (dated factors win)', async () => {
    const result = await getEmissionFactor({ category: 'DIESEL', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'litre' });
    expect(result.id).toBe(fixedYearId);
    expect(result.source).toBe('GOVERNMENT');
    expect(result.factorName).toBe(`efres-year-${RUN}`);
  });

  it('excludes future-year, CLIMATIQ-source and INACTIVE rows, then falls back to the undated row', async () => {
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, fixedYearId));
    const result = await getEmissionFactor({ category: 'DIESEL', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'litre' });
    expect(result.id).toBe(fixedNullYearId);
    expect(result.factor).toBe(9.99);
    expect(result.unit).toBe('litre');
    expect(result.source).toBe('DEFRA');
    expect(result.factorName).toBe(`efres-null-${RUN}`);
  });

  it('matches by countryCode as well as countryName', async () => {
    const codeId = await seedFactor({
      factorId: `efres-code-${RUN}`,
      category: 'PETROL',
      country: null,
      countryCode: 'ZZ',
      source: 'CUSTOM',
    });
    const result = await getEmissionFactor({ category: 'PETROL', country: 'ZZ', year: 2025, activityUnit: 'litre' });
    expect(result.id).toBe(codeId);
  });
});

describe('tier 2: Climatiq cache', () => {
  it('returns the cached CLIMATIQ row when the unit matches exactly', async () => {
    // Both fixed rows are gone by now: fixedYearId was deleted above and
    // fixedNullYearId here — tier 1 must come up empty for the cache to win.
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, fixedNullYearId));

    const result = await getEmissionFactor({ category: 'DIESEL', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'litre' });
    expect(result.id).toBe(cachedRowId);
    expect(result.factor).toBe(2.75);
    expect(result.unit).toBe('litre');
    expect(result.source).toBe('Climatiq');
    expect(result.sourceVersion).toBe('10.0');
  });

  it('falls through when the stored unit differs from the activity unit', async () => {
    process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = 'test-key';
    const failingFetch = vi.fn(async () => ({
      ok: false,
      status: 404,
      text: async () => 'not found',
    })) as unknown as typeof fetch;

    await expect(
      getEmissionFactor(
        { category: 'DIESEL', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'gallon' },
        failingFetch,
      ),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 'PENDING',
      message: `No emission factor found for activity "DIESEL" in country "${COUNTRY}" for year 2025. Manual entry may be required.`,
    });
  });
});

describe('tier 3: live Climatiq', () => {
  it('throws the exact missing-key PENDING error when CLIMATIQ_API_KEY is absent', async () => {
    delete process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY;
    await expect(
      getEmissionFactor({ category: 'NATURAL_GAS', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'kWh' }),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 'PENDING',
      message: `No emission factor available for NATURAL_GAS in ${COUNTRY}. Configure CLIMATIQ_API_KEY to enable dynamic lookup.`,
    });
  });

  it('throws PENDING for categories without a Climatiq activity mapping', async () => {
    process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = 'test-key';
    const fetchMock = vi.fn();

    await expect(
      getEmissionFactor(
        { category: 'BOILER_FUEL', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'kg' },
        fetchMock as unknown as typeof fetch,
      ),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(PendingFactorError);
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('fetches, builds category-specific payloads and upserts the collapsed cache row', async () => {
    process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = 'test-key';
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (_url: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
      const body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body));
      expect(body.emission_factor.activity_id).toBe('electricity-supply_grid-source_residual_mix');
      expect(body.parameters).toEqual({ energy: 1, energy_unit: 'kWh' });
      return {
        ok: true,
        json: async () => ({
          co2e: 0.71,
          co2e_unit: 'kgCO2e',
          emission_factor: {
            unit: 'kWh',
            activity_id: 'electricity-supply_grid-source_residual_mix',
            source_version: '36.0',
          },
        }),
      };
    }) as unknown as typeof fetch;

    const result = await getEmissionFactor(
      { category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'kWh' },
      fetchMock,
    );

    expect(result.factor).toBe(0.71);
    expect(result.unit).toBe('kWh');
    expect(result.source).toBe('Climatiq');
    expect(result.sourceVersion).toBe('36.0');
    expect(result.factorName).toBe(`Climatiq — PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY (${COUNTRY} 2025 - kWh)`);

    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, result.id));
    expect(rows[0]!.factorId).toBe(`climatiq-PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY-${COUNTRY}-2025-kWh`);
    expect(rows[0]!.source).toBe('CLIMATIQ');
    expect(rows[0]!.unit).toBe('kWh');
    expect(rows[0]!.factorUnit).toBe('kgCO2e');
    expect(rows[0]!.scopes).toEqual(['2']);
    expect(rows[0]!.sourceDataset).toBe('Climatiq API');
    const meta = rows[0]!.metadata as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(meta.climatiq_version).toBe('36.0');
    expect(meta.climatiq_id).toBe('electricity-supply_grid-source_residual_mix');
    expect(typeof meta.fetched_at).toBe('string');

    seededIds.push(result.id);
  });

  it('updates the existing collapsed row when the cache tier misses but the row persists', async () => {
    process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = 'test-key';

    const existingRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, `climatiq-PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY-${COUNTRY}-2025-kWh`));

    expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);

    const meta = rows[0]!.metadata as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(meta.climatiq_version).toBe('37.0');

  it('maps OWNED_VEHICLE to distance parameters and REFRIGERANT to weight parameters', async () => {

    expect(bodies[0].emission_factor.activity_id).toBe('passenger_vehicle');
    expect(bodies[0].parameters).toEqual({ distance: 1, distance_unit: 'km' });
    expect(bodies[1].emission_factor.activity_id).toBe('refrigerant');
    expect(bodies[1].parameters).toEqual({ weight: 1, weight_unit: 'kg' });

    const vehicleRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, `climatiq-OWNED_VEHICLE-${COUNTRY}-2025-km`));
    expect(vehicleRows[0]!.scopes).toEqual(['1']);

      .select()

    seededIds.push(refrigerantRows[0]!.id);
  });

  it('normalises litre spellings inside the energy payload branch', async () => {
    process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = 'test-key';
    let captured: any = null;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (_url: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
      captured = JSON.parse(String(init?.body));
      return {
        ok: true,
        json: async () => ({ co2e: 2, co2e_unit: 'kgCO2e', emission_factor: { unit: 'l' } }),
      };

    await getEmissionFactor(
      { category: 'PURCHASED_STEAM', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'LITRE' },

    expect(captured.parameters).toEqual({ energy: 1, energy_unit: 'l' });

    const steamRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, `climatiq-PURCHASED_STEAM-${COUNTRY}-2025-LITRE`));
    seededIds.push(steamRows[0]!.id);
  });

  it('throws the no-result PENDING error when Climatiq responds non-ok', async () => {
    process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY = 'test-key';
    const failingFetch = vi.fn(async () => ({
      ok: false,
      status: 500,
      text: async () => 'boom',

    await expect(
      getEmissionFactor(
        { category: 'PURCHASED_COOLING', country: COUNTRY, year: 2025, activityUnit: 'kWh' },

      ),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 'PENDING',
      message: `No emission factor found for activity "PURCHASED_COOLING" in country "${COUNTRY}" for year 2025. Manual entry may be required.`,
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
  taxonomyVersionsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  calculationsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { eq, like } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { calculateEmission } from '../services/emissionCalculation.js';
import type { CalculationResult } from '../services/emissionCalculation.js';

let orgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let taxonomyVersionId: string;
let taxonomyDieselId: string;
let taxonomyElecId: string;
let efDieselId: string;

let activityDieselId: string;
let activityElecId: string;
let activityZeroId: string;
let activityDecimalId: string;
let activityBadUnitId: string;
let activityNoTaxonomyId: string;
let activityBadQuantityId: string;

const createdActivityIds: string[] = [];

beforeAll(async () => {
  // Clean prior test data from ALL test suites (shared DB)
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'test-match-%'));
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'test-calc-%'));
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(like(activityDataTable.description, 'test-calc-%'));
  await db.delete(taxonomyVersionsTable).where(like(taxonomyVersionsTable.name, 'Test Taxonomy Calc'));

  // Create org
  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org Calc', code: 'test-calc-org-' + Date.now(), type: 'COMPANY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgRows[0]!.id;

  // Create reporting period
  const periodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      name: 'Test Period Calc',
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = periodRows[0]!.id;

  // Create taxonomy version
  const versionRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyVersionsTable)
    .values({
      name: 'Test Taxonomy Calc',
      version: '1.0.0-test-calc',
      description: 'Test taxonomy for emission calculation tests',
      isActive: true,
    })
    .returning({ id: taxonomyVersionsTable.id });
  taxonomyVersionId = versionRows[0]!.id;

  // Create taxonomy activities
  const taRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .values([
      {
        taxonomyVersionId,
        code: 'TEST.CALC.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
        name: 'Test Diesel Activity',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      },
      {
        taxonomyVersionId,
        code: 'TEST.CALC.ELECTRICITY',
        name: 'Test Electricity Activity',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      },
    ])
    .returning({ id: taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, code: taxonomyActivitiesTable.code });

  for (const row of taRows) {
    if (row.code === 'TEST.CALC.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION') taxonomyDieselId = row.id;
    if (row.code === 'TEST.CALC.ELECTRICITY') taxonomyElecId = row.id;
  }

  // Create emission factors
  // Diesel: factor = 2.68, unit = L, scope = 1
  const efDieselRows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: 'test-calc-diesel-ef-1',
      activityId: 'TEST.CALC.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
      name: 'Test Diesel Factor',
      factor: '2.680000',
      unit: 'L',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/L',
      scopes: ['1'],
      countryCode: 'IN',
      year: 2025,
      source: 'Test Source',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  efDieselId = efDieselRows[0]!.id;

  // Electricity: factor = 0.85, unit = kWh, scope = 2
  await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: 'test-calc-elec-ef-1',
      activityId: 'TEST.CALC.ELECTRICITY',
      name: 'Test Electricity Factor',
      factor: '0.850000',
      unit: 'kWh',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
      scopes: ['2'],
      countryCode: 'IN',
      year: 2025,
      source: 'Test Source Elec',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });

  // Second electricity factor (same activity, different year) — for ambiguity
  await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: 'test-calc-elec-ef-2',
      activityId: 'TEST.CALC.ELECTRICITY',
      name: 'Test Electricity Factor Alt',
      factor: '0.820000',
      unit: 'kWh',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
      scopes: ['2'],
      countryCode: 'IN',
      year: 2024,
      source: 'Test Source Elec Alt',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });

  // Create activity data records
  // Diesel: quantity=100, unit=L, scope=SCOPE_1
  const adDieselRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyDieselId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '100.0000',
      unit: 'L',
      description: 'test-calc-diesel',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityDieselId = adDieselRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityDieselId);

  // Electricity: quantity=250.50, unit=kWh, scope=SCOPE_2
  const adElecRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyElecId,
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      quantity: '250.5000',
      unit: 'kWh',
      description: 'test-calc-elec',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityElecId = adElecRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityElecId);

  // Zero quantity diesel
  const adZeroRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyDieselId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '0.0000',
      unit: 'L',
      description: 'test-calc-zero',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityZeroId = adZeroRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityZeroId);

  // Decimal quantity diesel: 150.75 L
  const adDecimalRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyDieselId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '150.7500',
      unit: 'L',
      description: 'test-calc-decimal',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityDecimalId = adDecimalRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityDecimalId);

  // Bad unit: diesel activity with unit=kg (should not match factor unit=L)
  const adBadUnitRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyDieselId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '100.0000',
      unit: 'kg',
      description: 'test-calc-bad-unit',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityBadUnitId = adBadUnitRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityBadUnitId);

  // No taxonomy activity
  const adNoTaxRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: null,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '100.0000',
      unit: 'L',
      description: 'test-calc-no-taxonomy',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityNoTaxonomyId = adNoTaxRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityNoTaxonomyId);

  // Bad quantity: negative
  const adBadQtyRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyDieselId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '-50.0000',
      unit: 'L',
      description: 'test-calc-bad-quantity',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  activityBadQuantityId = adBadQtyRows[0]!.id;
  createdActivityIds.push(activityBadQuantityId);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  for (const aid of createdActivityIds) {
    await db.delete(calculationsTable).where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, aid));
  }
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(like(activityDataTable.description, 'test-calc-%'));
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'test-calc-%'));
  await db.delete(taxonomyActivitiesTable).where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.taxonomyVersionId, taxonomyVersionId));
  await db.delete(taxonomyVersionsTable).where(eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.id, taxonomyVersionId));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, periodId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('calculateEmission service', () => {
  it('calculates correct result for matched diesel activity', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityDieselId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as CalculationResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('calculated');
    if (data.status === 'calculated') {
      // 100.0000 × 2.680000 = 268.0000
      expect(data.emissions).toBe('268.0000');
      expect(data.emissions_unit).toBe('kg CO2e');
      expect(data.quantity).toBe('100.0000');
      expect(data.activity_unit).toBe('L');
      expect(data.factor).toBe('2.680000');
      expect(data.factor_unit).toBe('kgCO2e/L');
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBe(efDieselId);
      expect(data.activity_id).toBe('TEST.CALC.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION');
      expect(data.calculation_id).toBeDefined();
    }
  });

  it('returns error for activity with no taxonomy (Phase 3 returns 400)', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityNoTaxonomyId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(400);
    expect(result.data).toHaveProperty('error');
  });

  it('returns no_match for incompatible unit (kg vs L)', async () => {
    // activityBadUnitId has unit=kg, diesel factor has unit=L
    // Phase 3 will filter out the factor → no_match
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityBadUnitId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(data.status).toBe('no_match');
  });

  it('returns ambiguous for activity with multiple factors', async () => {
    // activityElecId uses electricity taxonomy which has 2 factors (2024 + 2025)
    // Both have same unit=kWh, scope=2 → ambiguous
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityElecId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(data.status).toBe('ambiguous');
    if (data.status === 'ambiguous') {
      expect((data as { candidates: unknown[] }).candidates.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    }
  });

  it('returns 404 for nonexistent activity_data_id', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000');

    expect(result.status).toBe(404);
    expect(result.data).toHaveProperty('error');
  });

  it('calculates zero quantity correctly', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityZeroId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as CalculationResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('calculated');
    if (data.status === 'calculated') {
      // 0.0000 × 2.680000 = 0.0000
      expect(data.emissions).toBe('0.0000');
      expect(data.emissions_unit).toBe('kg CO2e');
    }
  });

  it('calculates decimal quantity with precision', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityDecimalId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as CalculationResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('calculated');
    if (data.status === 'calculated') {
      // 150.7500 × 2.680000 = 404.0100
      expect(data.emissions).toBe('404.0100');
      expect(data.emissions_unit).toBe('kg CO2e');
    }
  });

  it('calculation references correct emission_factor_id', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityDieselId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as CalculationResult;
    if (data.status === 'calculated') {
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBe(efDieselId);
    }
  });

  it('persists calculation to database', async () => {
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(calculationsTable)
      .where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityDieselId))
      .limit(1);

    expect(rows.length).toBe(1);
    const calc = rows[0]!;
    expect(calc.co2eKg).toBe('268.0000');
    expect(calc.emissionFactorId).toBe(efDieselId);
    expect(calc.activityUnit).toBe('L');
    expect(calc.emissionFactor).toBe('2.680000');
    expect(calc.status).toBe('CALCULATED');
    expect(calc.organisationId).toBe(orgId);
    expect(calc.reportingPeriodId).toBe(periodId);
    expect(calc.factorSource).toBe('Test Source');
    expect(calc.factorName).toBe('Test Diesel Factor');
  });

  it('returns same result on repeated call (idempotency)', async () => {
    const result1 = await calculateEmission(activityDieselId);
    const result2 = await calculateEmission(activityDieselId);

    expect(result1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(result2.status).toBe(200);
    const data1 = result1.data as CalculationResult;
    const data2 = result2.data as CalculationResult;

    if (data1.status === 'calculated' && data2.status === 'calculated') {
      expect(data1.calculation_id).toBe(data2.calculation_id);
      expect(data1.emissions).toBe(data2.emissions);
    }
  });

  it('does not allow frontend to override emission factor', async () => {
    // The service only takes activityDataId — no factor override parameter
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityDieselId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as CalculationResult;
    if (data.status === 'calculated') {
      // Must match the DB-matched factor, not any user-provided value
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBe(efDieselId);
      expect(data.factor).toBe('2.680000');
    }
  });

  it('calculation does not perform independent matching', async () => {
    // The service calls matchEmissionFactor — verify by checking that
    // a no_match activity does NOT produce any calculation record
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(calculationsTable)
      .where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityNoTaxonomyId))
      .limit(1);

    expect(rows.length).toBe(0);
  });

  it('result has explicit emissions_unit field', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityDieselId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as CalculationResult;
    expect(data.emissions_unit).toBe('kg CO2e');
  });

  it('negative quantity returns validation error', async () => {
    const result = await calculateEmission(activityBadQuantityId);

    expect(result.status).toBe(400);
    expect(result.data).toHaveProperty('error');
    const data = result.data as { error: string };
    expect(data.error).toContain('quantity');
  });

  it('does not calculate when units are incompatible', async () => {
    // Even if Phase 3 somehow returned a match (it won't due to unit filter),
    // the calculation service validates units independently
    // Verify no calculation record exists for bad-unit activity
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(calculationsTable)
      .where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityBadUnitId))
      .limit(1);

    expect(rows.length).toBe(0);
  });
});
```
