```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { emissionFactorsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { eq, like } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { resolveFactorUnits } from '../utils/unitNormalization.js';
import { importEmissionFactors } from '../services/emissionFactorImport.js';
import { emissionFactorsImportSchema } from '../validators/emissionFactorImport.js';

const dataset = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'emission-factors-normalized.json'), 'utf-8'),
);
const factors: Record<string, unknown>[] = dataset.emission_factors;

const CLEANUP_PREFIXES = ['india-%', 'imported-%'];

async function cleanupImportData() {
  for (const prefix of CLEANUP_PREFIXES) {
    await db
      .delete(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, prefix));
  }
}

describe('emissionFactorsImportSchema', () => {
  const validItem = {
    factor_id: 'schema-check',
    activity_id: 'electricity',
    name: 'x',
    unit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
    factor: 0.71,
  };

  it('rejects missing unit', () => {
    const itemWithoutUnit: Record<string, unknown> = { ...validItem };
    delete itemWithoutUnit.unit;
    const result = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse([itemWithoutUnit]);
    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects negative factor', () => {
    const result = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse([{ ...validItem, factor: -0.71 }]);
    expect(result.success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('resolveFactorUnits', () => {
  it('resolves kgCO2e/kWh', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/kWh')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'kWh',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
    });
  });

  it('resolves kgCO2e/km', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/km')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'km',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/km',
    });
  });

  it('resolves kgCO2e/passenger-km', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/passenger-km')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'passenger-km',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/passenger-km',
    });
  });

  it('resolves kgCO2e/kg', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/kg')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'kg',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
    });
  });

  it('resolves kgCO2e/t.km', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/t.km')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 't.km',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/t.km',
    });
  });

  it('resolves kgCO2e/room-night', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/room-night')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'room-night',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/room-night',
    });
  });

  it('derives from plain unit with explicit factor_unit', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kWh', 'kgCO2e/kWh')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'kWh',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
    });
  });

  it('accepts matching factor_unit alongside compound unit', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/kWh', 'kgCO2e/kWh')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'kWh',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
    });
  });

  it('trims surrounding whitespace from unit', () => {
    expect(resolveFactorUnits('  kgCO2e/kWh  ')).toEqual({
      activityUnit: 'kWh',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
    });
  });

  it('rejects empty unit', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('')).toThrow('Unit is required and cannot be empty');
  });

  it('rejects whitespace-only unit', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('   ')).toThrow('Unit is required and cannot be empty');
  });

  it('rejects non-compound unit without factor_unit', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('kWh')).toThrow(
      'Cannot derive factor_unit from non-compound unit "kWh"',
    );
  });

  it('rejects conflicting factor_unit with compound unit', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/kWh', 'kgCO2e/km')).toThrow('Conflicting units');
    try {
      resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/kWh', 'kgCO2e/km');
    } catch (e) {
      expect((e as Error & { field: string[] }).field).toEqual(['factor_unit']);
    }
  });

  it('rejects malformed compound unit — wrong numerator', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('CO2/kWh')).toThrow(
      'Cannot derive factor_unit from non-compound unit "CO2/kWh"',
    );
  });

  it('rejects malformed compound unit — empty denominator', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/')).toThrow(
      'Cannot derive factor_unit from non-compound unit "kgCO2e/"',
    );
  });

  it('rejects malformed unit with multiple slashes', () => {
    expect(() => resolveFactorUnits('kgCO2e/kWh/extra')).toThrow(
      'Cannot derive factor_unit from non-compound unit "kgCO2e/kWh/extra"',
    );
  });
});

describe('importEmissionFactors — full canonical dataset', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    await cleanupImportData();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await cleanupImportData();
  });

  it('validates all 12 records against the import schema', () => {
    const result = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse(factors);
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    if (result.success) {
      expect(result.data).toHaveLength(12);
    }
  });

  it('imports all 12 records on first run', async () => {
    const result = await importEmissionFactors(factors as Parameters<typeof importEmissionFactors>[0]);
    expect(result.summary.received).toBe(12);
    expect(result.summary.inserted).toBe(12);
    expect(result.summary.updated).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.skipped).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.failed).toBe(0);
    expect(result.errors).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('skips all 12 on re-import (idempotent)', async () => {
    const result = await importEmissionFactors(factors as Parameters<typeof importEmissionFactors>[0]);
    expect(result.summary.received).toBe(12);
    expect(result.summary.inserted).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.updated).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.skipped).toBe(12);
    expect(result.summary.failed).toBe(0);
    expect(result.errors).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('rejects duplicate factor_id within a single payload without partial insertion', async () => {
    const base = factors[0]!;
    const dupPayload = [
      { ...base, factor_id: 'imported-dup-payload' },
      { ...base, factor_id: 'imported-dup-payload', name: 'duplicate entry' },
    ];
    const result = await importEmissionFactors(dupPayload as Parameters<typeof importEmissionFactors>[0]);
    expect(result.summary.received).toBe(2);
    expect(result.summary.inserted).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.updated).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.skipped).toBe(0);
    expect(result.summary.failed).toBe(2);
    expect(result.errors).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.errors[0]!.index).toBe(1);
    expect(result.errors[0]!.field).toBe('factor_id');

    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'imported-dup-payload'));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('updates an existing record when a value changes, then restores it', async () => {
    const original = factors[0]!;
    const changedName = 'India fixed electricity emission factor (changed)';

    const changeResult = await importEmissionFactors([
      { ...original, name: changedName },
    ] as Parameters<typeof importEmissionFactors>[0]);
    expect(changeResult.summary.received).toBe(1);
    expect(changeResult.summary.inserted).toBe(0);
    expect(changeResult.summary.updated).toBe(1);
    expect(changeResult.summary.skipped).toBe(0);
    expect(changeResult.summary.failed).toBe(0);

    const changedRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'india-2025-electricity-grid'));
    expect(changedRows[0]!.name).toBe(changedName);

    const restoreResult = await importEmissionFactors([
      original,
    ] as Parameters<typeof importEmissionFactors>[0]);
    expect(restoreResult.summary.updated).toBe(1);

    const restoredRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'india-2025-electricity-grid'));
    expect(restoredRows[0]!.name).toBe('India fixed electricity emission factor');
  });

  it('India electricity stored correctly', async () => {
    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'india-2025-electricity-grid'));
    const row = rows[0];
    expect(row).toBeDefined();
    expect(Number(row!.factor)).toBe(0.71);
    expect(row!.unit).toBe('kWh');
    expect(row!.factorUnit).toBe('kgCO2e/kWh');
    expect(row!.countryName).toBe('India');
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
  taxonomyVersionsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { eq, like } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { matchEmissionFactor, type MatchResult } from '../services/emissionFactorMatch.js';

let orgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let taxonomyVersionId: string;
let taxonomyDieselId: string;
let taxonomyElecId: string;
let efDieselId: string;
let efElecAltId: string;

beforeAll(async () => {
  // Clean prior test data — EFs, activities, taxonomy (cascade deletes activities)
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'test-match-%'));
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(like(activityDataTable.description, 'test-match-%'));
  await db.delete(taxonomyVersionsTable).where(like(taxonomyVersionsTable.name, 'Test Taxonomy Match'));

  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org Match', code: 'test-match-org-' + Date.now(), type: 'COMPANY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgRows[0]!.id;

  const periodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      name: 'Test Period Match',
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = periodRows[0]!.id;

  const versionRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyVersionsTable)
    .values({
      name: 'Test Taxonomy Match',
      version: '1.0.0-test-match',
      description: 'Test taxonomy version for emission factor matching tests',
      isActive: true,
    })
    .returning({ id: taxonomyVersionsTable.id });
  taxonomyVersionId = versionRows[0]!.id;

  const taRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .values([
      {
        taxonomyVersionId,
        code: 'TEST.MATCH.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
        name: 'Test Diesel Activity',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      },
      {
        taxonomyVersionId,
        code: 'TEST.MATCH.ELECTRICITY',
        name: 'Test Electricity Activity',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      },
    ])
    .returning({ id: taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, code: taxonomyActivitiesTable.code });

  for (const row of taRows) {
    if (row.code === 'TEST.MATCH.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION') taxonomyDieselId = row.id;
    if (row.code === 'TEST.MATCH.ELECTRICITY') taxonomyElecId = row.id;
  }

  const efDieselRows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: 'test-match-diesel-ef-1',
      activityId: 'TEST.MATCH.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
      name: 'Test Diesel Factor',
      factor: '2.680000',
      unit: 'L',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/L',
      scopes: ['1'],
      countryCode: 'IN',
      year: 2024,
      source: 'Test',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  efDieselId = efDieselRows[0]!.id;

  const efElecRows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values([
      {
        factorId: 'test-match-elec-ef-1',
        activityId: 'TEST.MATCH.ELECTRICITY',

  await db.delete(taxonomyVersionsTable).where(eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.id, taxonomyVersionId));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, periodId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));

async function createTestActivity(overrides: {
  taxonomyActivityId?: string | null;
  scope?: string;
  unit?: string;
  activityDate?: Date | null;
  description: string;
}): Promise<string> {
  const rows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      taxonomyActivityId:
        'taxonomyActivityId' in overrides ? overrides.taxonomyActivityId : taxonomyDieselId,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: (overrides.scope as 'SCOPE_1' | 'SCOPE_2') ?? 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '100.0000',
      unit: overrides.unit ?? 'L',
      activityDate: overrides.activityDate ?? null,
      description: overrides.description,
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  return rows[0]!.id;
}

describe('matchEmissionFactor service', () => {
  it('returns matched result for single compatible factor', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({ description: 'test-match-single' });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('matched');
    if (data.status === 'matched') {
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBe(efDieselId);
      expect(data.activity_id).toBe('TEST.MATCH.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION');
      expect(data.factor.unit).toBe('L');
      expect(data.factor.factor).toBe('2.680000');
    }
  });

  it('returns ambiguous for multiple compatible factors', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyElecId,
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      unit: 'kWh',
      description: 'test-match-ambiguous',
    });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('ambiguous');
    if (data.status === 'ambiguous') {
      expect(data.activity_id).toBe('TEST.MATCH.ELECTRICITY');
      expect(data.candidates.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    }
  });

  it('returns no_match when unit is incompatible', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({
      unit: 'kg',
      description: 'test-match-no-unit',
    });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('no_match');
    if (data.status === 'no_match') {
      expect(data.activity_id).toBe('TEST.MATCH.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION');
    }
  });

  it('filters by scope — incompatible scope removes candidate', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      description: 'test-match-scope-mismatch',
    });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('no_match');
  });

  it('returns 404 for missing activity data', async () => {
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000');

    expect(result.status).toBe(404);
    expect(result.data).toHaveProperty('error');
  });

  it('returns 400 when activity has no taxonomyActivityId', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({
      taxonomyActivityId: null,
      description: 'test-match-no-taxonomy',
    });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(400);
    expect(result.data).toHaveProperty('error');
  });

  it('prefers matching year when activity has date', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({
      taxonomyActivityId: taxonomyElecId,
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      unit: 'kWh',
      activityDate: new Date('2025-06-15'),
      description: 'test-match-year-pref',
    });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('matched');
    if (data.status === 'matched') {
      expect(data.factor.year).toBe(2025);
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBe(efElecAltId);
    }
  });

  it('does not require emission_factor_id from frontend', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({ description: 'test-match-no-ef-input' });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('matched');
    if (data.status === 'matched') {
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBeDefined();
      expect(data.emission_factor_id).toBe(efDieselId);
    }
  });

  it('does not calculate emissions', async () => {
    const id = await createTestActivity({ description: 'test-match-no-calc' });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('matched');
    if (data.status === 'matched') {
      expect(data).not.toHaveProperty('co2e');
      expect(data).not.toHaveProperty('emissions');
      expect(data).not.toHaveProperty('quantity');
    }
  });

  it('does not modify emission factor records', async () => {
    const efBefore = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, efDieselId))
      .limit(1);

    const id = await createTestActivity({ description: 'test-match-no-mutate' });
    await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    const efAfter = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, efDieselId))
      .limit(1);

    expect(efAfter[0]!.updatedAt.getTime()).toBe(efBefore[0]!.updatedAt.getTime());
  });

  it('retains factor with multi-scope when scope matches', async () => {
    const multiScopeRows = await db
      .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
      .values({
        factorId: 'test-match-diesel-multi-scope',
        activityId: 'TEST.MATCH.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
        name: 'Test Diesel Multi-Scope',
        factor: '2.700000',
        unit: 'L',
        factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/L',
        scopes: ['1', '2'],
        countryCode: 'IN',
        year: 2024,
        source: 'Test',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
    const multiScopeId = multiScopeRows[0]!.id;

    const id = await createTestActivity({ description: 'test-match-multi-scope' });
    const result = await matchEmissionFactor(id);

    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    const data = result.data as MatchResult;
    expect(data.status).toBe('ambiguous');
    if (data.status === 'ambiguous') {
      const ids = data.candidates.map((c: { id: string }) => c.id);
      expect(ids).toContain(efDieselId);
      expect(ids).toContain(multiScopeId);
    }
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';

import { emissionFactorsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import {
  getEmissionFactorByIdV1,
  listEmissionFactorsV1,
} from '../services/efRegister.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

const DATASET_ROW = {
  factorId: `efread-ds-${RUN}`,
  activityId: 'test-stationary-combustion-coal',
  name: 'Dataset Coal Factor',
  sector: 'Energy',
  category: 'Coal and Coke',
  countryCode: 'IN',
  countryName: 'India',
  region: 'Asia',
  source: 'Test Source',
  sourceDataset: 'Test Dataset',
  sourceLink: 'https://example.com',
  unit: 'kg',
  factor: '0.950000',
  factorUnit: 'kg CO2e / kg',
  scopes: ['1'],
  year: 2025,
  status: 'ACTIVE' as const,
};

const NAME_ONLY_ROW = {
  factorId: `efread-name-${RUN}`,
  activityId: 'test-diesel-combustion',
  name: 'Dataset Diesel Factor',
  category: 'Diesel',
  countryName: 'Bharat',
  unit: 'litre',
  factor: '2.680000',
  factorUnit: 'kgCO2e',
  scopes: ['1'],
  year: 2024,
  status: 'ACTIVE' as const,
};

let seededIds: string[] = [];

beforeAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'efread-%'));
  const rows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values([DATASET_ROW, NAME_ONLY_ROW])
    .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  seededIds = rows.map((r) => r.id);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(like(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, 'efread-%'));
});

describe('register read adapter over dataset-shaped rows', () => {
  it('serializes compound factorUnits with the documented re-merge artifact (D-14)', async () => {
    const row = await getEmissionFactorByIdV1(seededIds[0]!);
    expect(row.id).toBe(seededIds[0]);
    expect(row.unit).toBe('kg CO2e / kg/kg');
    expect(row.factor).toBe(0.95);
    expect(row.scope).toBe('SCOPE_1');
    expect(row.country).toBe('IN');
    expect(row.sourceName).toBe('Test Dataset');
    expect(row.sourceUrl).toBe('https://example.com');
    expect(row.isFixed).toBe(true);
    expect(row.year).toBe(2025);
    expect(typeof row.createdAt).toBe('string');
  });

  it('falls back to countryName when no ISO code exists and round-trips canonical units', async () => {
    const row = await getEmissionFactorByIdV1(seededIds[1]!);
    expect(row.country).toBe('Bharat');
    expect(row.unit).toBe('litre');
  });

  it('lists with camelCase pagination under the V1 contract', async () => {
    const result = await listEmissionFactorsV1({ page: 1, limit: 50 });
    expect(result.pagination.page).toBe(1);
    expect(result.pagination.limit).toBe(50);
    expect(typeof result.pagination.totalPages).toBe('number');
    const ids = result.data.map((r) => r.id);
    expect(ids).toContain(seededIds[0]);
    expect(ids).toContain(seededIds[1]);
  });

  it('filters dataset rows by raw category tokens', async () => {
    const result = await listEmissionFactorsV1({ category: 'Coal and Coke', limit: 50 });
    expect(result.data.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(result.data.every((r) => r.category === 'Coal and Coke')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('throws not-found for unknown ids', async () => {
    await expect(getEmissionFactorByIdV1('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Emission factor not found',
    );
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  calculationsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import {
  createEmissionFactorSchema,
  updateEmissionFactorSchema,
} from '../validators/emissionFactorRegister.js';
import {
  createEmissionFactorController,
  deactivateEmissionFactorController,
  getEmissionFactorByIdController,
  getPendingEfActivitiesController,
  listEmissionFactorsController,
  updateEmissionFactorController,
} from '../controllers/emissionFactorRegister.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
const REGION = `R-${RUN}`;

let orgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let floorId: string;

const efIds: string[] = [];
const activityIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode: number; body: any };
}

function call(
  controller: (req: Request, res: Response) => Promise<void>,
  req: Partial<Request>,
) {
  const res = resMock();
  return { res, run: controller(req as Request, res) };
}

async function latestAudits(entityId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(auditLogsTable)
    .where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, entityId))
    .orderBy(auditLogsTable.createdAt);
  return rows;
}

function validCreateBody(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    name: `EF Reg Factor ${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    scope: 'SCOPE_1',
    factor: 2.68,
    unit: 'litre',
    source: 'DEFRA',
    region: REGION,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: 'Test Org EF Reg V1', code: 'test-efr-' + RUN, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' })
    .returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgRows[0]!.id;

  const periodRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      name: 'Test Period EFR ' + RUN,
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = periodRows[0]!.id;

  const campusRows = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      parentId: null,
      name: 'EFR Campus',
      code: `EFR-CAMPUS-${RUN}`,
      type: 'LOCATION' as never,
      subtype: 'CAMPUS' as never,
    })
    .returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  const campusId = campusRows[0]!.id;

  const buildingRows = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      parentId: campusId,
      name: 'EFR Building',
      code: `EFR-BUILDING-${RUN}`,
      type: 'FACILITY' as never,
      subtype: 'BUILDING' as never,
    })
    .returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  const buildingId = buildingRows[0]!.id;

  const floorRows = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      parentId: buildingId,
      name: 'EFR Floor',
      code: `EFR-FLOOR-${RUN}`,
      type: 'LOCATION' as never,
      subtype: 'FLOOR' as never,
    })
    .returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  floorId = floorRows[0]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  const allEntityIds = [...efIds, ...activityIds];
  if (allEntityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entityId, allEntityIds));
  }
  if (activityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(calculationsTable).where(inArray(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityIds));
  }
  if (efIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(inArray(emissionFactorsTable.id, efIds));
  }
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('emissionFactorRegister validators (V1 contract)', () => {
  it('accepts a valid create body and allows empty-string sourceUrl', () => {
    const ok = createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ sourceUrl: '' }));
    expect(ok.success).toBe(true);

    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse({ name: '', category: 'DIESEL' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ category: 'FLIGHT' })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ scope: 'SCOPE_3' })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ source: 'CLIMATIQ' })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ factor: 0 })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ factor: -1 })).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse(validCreateBody({ sourceUrl: 'not-a-url' })).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('update schema is partial and admits status', () => {
    expect(updateEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(updateEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse({ status: 'ACTIVE' }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(updateEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse({ status: 'ARCHIVED' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateEmissionFactorSchema.safeParse({ factor: 5 }).success).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('C14 POST /emission-factors', () => {

    expect(row.category).toBe('DIESEL');
    expect(row.scope).toBe('SCOPE_1');

    expect(row.country).toBe('IN');
    expect(row.region).toBe(REGION);
    expect(row.status).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(row.isFixed).toBe(true);

      .select()

    expect(dbRows[0]!.countryCode).toBe('IN');

    expect(audits).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(audits[0]!.action).toBe('CREATE');
    expect(audits[0]!.description).toBe('Manual emission factor created');
    expect((audits[0]!.newValue as any).id).toBe(row.id);

      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)

      body: validCreateBody({ factor: -2 }),

});

describe('C15 GET /emission-factors (list)', () => {

      return res.body as any;
    })();
    expect(byName.pagination.total).toBe(1);
    expect(byName.data[0].country).toBe('India');

  it('treats an invalid status token as match-nothing', async () => {

    });

});

describe('C18 PATCH /emission-factors/:id', () => {

describe('C16 GET /emission-factors/pending', () => {
  let verifiedNoCalcOld: string;
  let verifiedNoCalcNew: string;
  let verifiedWithCalc: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    async function seedActivity(values: { status: string; activityDate: Date; physicalEntityId?: string | null }) {
      const rows = await db
        .insert(activityDataTable)
        .values({
          organisationId: orgId,
          reportingPeriodId: periodId,
          physicalEntityId: values.physicalEntityId ?? null,
          category: 'DIESEL' as never,
          scope: 'SCOPE_1' as never,
          quantity: '100.0000',
          unit: 'litre',
          activityDate: values.activityDate,
          status: values.status as never,
          description: 'ef-pending-row',
        })
        .returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
      const id = rows[0]!.id;
      activityIds.push(id);
      return id;
    }

    verifiedNoCalcOld = await seedActivity({ status: 'VERIFIED', activityDate: new Date('2025-03-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
    verifiedWithCalc = await seedActivity({ status: 'VERIFIED', activityDate: new Date('2025-04-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
    await seedActivity({ status: 'DRAFT', activityDate: new Date('2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
    verifiedNoCalcNew = await seedActivity({
      status: 'VERIFIED',
      activityDate: new Date('2025-06-01T00:00:00.000Z'),
      physicalEntityId: floorId,
    });

    const efRows = await db
      .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
      .values({
        factorId: `efreg-calc-${RUN}`,
        activityId: 'ENERGY.FUEL.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
        name: 'EFR Calc Factor',
        category: 'DIESEL',
        scopes: ['1'],
        factor: '2.680000',
        unit: 'litre',
        factorUnit: 'kgCO2e',
        source: 'DEFRA',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      })
      .returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
    const calcEfId = efRows[0]!.id;
    efIds.push(calcEfId);

    await db.insert(calculationsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      activityDataId: verifiedWithCalc,
      emissionFactorId: calcEfId,
      scope: 'SCOPE_1' as never,
      quantity: '100.0000',
      activityUnit: 'litre',
      emissionFactor: '2.680000',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e',
      co2eKg: '268.0000',
    });
  });

  it('requires universityId with the message envelope', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(getPendingEfActivitiesController, { query: {} });
    await run;

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
  });

  it('lists VERIFIED activities without calculations, newest first, with campus/building objects only', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(getPendingEfActivitiesController, {
      query: { universityId: orgId, limit: '50' },
    });
    await run;

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const body = res.body as any;
    expect(body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(body.pagination).toEqual({ page: 1, limit: 50, total: 2, totalPages: 1 });

    const ids = body.data.map((r: any) => r.id);
    expect(ids).toContain(verifiedNoCalcOld);
    expect(ids).toContain(verifiedNoCalcNew);
    expect(ids).not.toContain(verifiedWithCalc);

    const dates = body.data.map((r: any) => r.activityDate);
    expect(dates).toEqual([...dates].sort().reverse());

    const withEntity = body.data.find((r: any) => r.id === verifiedNoCalcNew);
    expect(withEntity.campus).toEqual({ name: 'EFR Campus' });
    expect(withEntity.building).toEqual({ name: 'EFR Building' });
    expect('floor' in withEntity).toBe(false);

    const plain = body.data.find((r: any) => r.id === verifiedNoCalcOld);
    expect(plain.campus).toBeNull();
    expect(plain.building).toBeNull();
    expect('floor' in plain).toBe(false);
    expect('createdBy' in plain).toBe(false);
    expect('verifiedBy' in plain).toBe(false);
    expect('documents' in plain).toBe(false);
    expect(plain.status).toBe('VERIFIED');
    expect(plain.universityId).toBe(orgId);
  });

  it('paginates pending activities', async () => {
    const { res, run } = call(getPendingEfActivitiesController, {
      query: { universityId: orgId, page: '2', limit: '1' },
    });
    await run;

    const body = res.body as any;
    expect(body.pagination).toEqual({ page: 2, limit: 1, total: 2, totalPages: 2 });
    expect(body.data).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(body.data[0].id).toBe(verifiedNoCalcOld);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { organisationsTable, physicalEntitiesTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/floorsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
let orgId: string;
let campusId: string;
let buildingAId: string;
let buildingBId: string;
const createdIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `FlrOrg ${RUN}`, code: `FLR-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;

  const [campus] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: 'C', code: `FC-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'CAMPUS',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  campusId = campus!.id;

  const buildings = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values([
    { organisationId: orgId, parentId: campusId, name: 'BA', code: `FBA-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING' },
    { organisationId: orgId, parentId: campusId, name: 'BB', code: `FBB-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING' },
  ]).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  buildingAId = buildings[0]!.id;
  buildingBId = buildings[1]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('POST /floors', () => {
  it('fails with the exact parent message when the building is missing', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Ghost', code: `GF-${RUN}`, buildingId: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Building not found');
  });

  it('creates with success message, floorNumber metadata and areaSqm column', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Level Two', code: `L2-${RUN}`, floorNumber: 2, areaSqm: 120.5, buildingId: buildingAId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Floor created successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ floorNumber: 2, areaSqm: 120.5, buildingId: buildingAId });

    const rows = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'FLOOR', areaSqm: '120.50' });
    expect((rows[0]!.metadata as any).floorNumber).toBe(2);
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
  });

  it('rejects same-building duplicates', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Dup L2', code: `L2-${RUN}`, buildingId: buildingAId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Floor with this code already exists in this building');
  });

  it('permits the same code under a different building (V1 scoping)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Twin L2', code: `L2-${RUN}`, buildingId: buildingBId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    createdIds.push(res.body.data.id);
  });

  it('enforces the positive-area validation message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { name: 'Neg Area', code: `NA-${RUN}`, areaSqm: -5, buildingId: buildingAId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(String(res.body.message)).toContain('Area must be positive');
  });
});

describe('GET /floors', () => {
  it('orders by floorNumber asc with nulls last, then createdAt desc (cross-page correct)', async () => {
    await controller.create({ body: { name: 'L1', code: `L1-${RUN}`, floorNumber: 1, buildingId: buildingAId } } as unknown as Request, resMock());
    await insertNullFloor();

    async function insertNullFloor() {
      await controller.create({ body: { name: 'NoNum', code: `NN-${RUN}`, buildingId: buildingAId } } as unknown as Request, resMock());
    }

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { buildingId: buildingAId, limit: '10' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    const numbers = res.body.data.map((f: any) => f.floorNumber);
    expect(numbers).toEqual([1, 2, null]);
  });

  it('filters by building and searches case-insensitively', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { buildingId: buildingBId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.data.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(res.body.data.every((f: any) => f.buildingId === buildingBId)).toBe(true);

    const searchRes = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { search: 'level two' } } as unknown as Request, searchRes);
    expect(searchRes.body.data.some((f: any) => f.code === `L2-${RUN}`)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns the fixed 500 message on query failure', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { buildingId: 'nope' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(500);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Failed to fetch floors');
  });
});

describe('GET /floors/:id', () => {
  it('reconstructs the full chain building -> campus -> university', async () => {

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.building.campus.university.id).toBe(orgId);
  });

  it('404s carrying the underlying message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Floor not found');
  });
});

describe('PATCH /floors/:id', () => {
  it('updates partial fields including floorNumber reordering metadata', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { floorNumber: 9 } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Floor updated successfully');
    expect(res.body.data.floorNumber).toBe(9);
  });

  it('uses the duplicate wording on code clash within the same building', async () => {
    const [tgt] = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({

    await controller.update(

      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Floor with this code already exists in this building');
  });

  it('ignores attempted buildingId reparenting', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: createdIds[0] }, body: { buildingId: buildingBId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.buildingId).toBe(buildingAId);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  documentsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/importsV1.js';
import { excelFileFilter } from '../routes/v1/imports.js';

vi.mock('../services/storage.js', () => ({
  uploadFile: vi.fn(async (_b: string, filePath: string) => ({ path: filePath })),
  getSignedUrl: vi.fn(async (_b: string, filePath: string) => `https://signed.test/${filePath}`),
  getPublicUrl: vi.fn((_b: string, filePath: string) => `https://public.test/${filePath}`),
}));

const RUN = Date.now();
const ISOLATION = 'Access denied: University isolation mismatch';

let orgId: string;
let otherOrgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let hqOrgId: string;
let hqOtherId: string;
const activityIds: string[] = [];
const documentIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

function csvBuffer(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]): Buffer {
  const lines = [Object.keys(rows[0] ?? { a: '' }).join(',')];
  for (const r of rows) lines.push(Object.values(r).join(','));
  return Buffer.from(lines.join('\n'));
}

function uploadReq(buffer: Buffer, body: Record<string, unknown>, user?: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return {
    body,
    user,
    file: { originalname: `up-${RUN}.csv`, buffer, mimetype: 'text/csv', size: buffer.length },
  } as unknown as Request;
}

    { name: `ImpO A ${RUN}`, code: `IMPA-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    { name: `ImpO B ${RUN}`, code: `IMPB-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE' },
  ]).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = orgs[0]!.id;
  otherOrgId = orgs[1]!.id;

  const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: `P ${RUN}`, startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T00:00:00Z'), status: 'OPEN',
  }).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = period!.id;

  const b1 = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: 'HQ', code: `HQ-A-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  const b2 = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: otherOrgId, name: 'HQ', code: `HQ-B-${RUN}`, type: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'BUILDING',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  const ghost = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
    organisationId: otherOrgId, name: 'Ghost Wing', code: `GW-${RUN}`, type: 'LOCATION', subtype: 'FLOOR',
  }).returning({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id });
  hqOrgId = b1[0]!.id;
  hqOtherId = b2[0]!.id;
  void ghost;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(documentsTable).where(inArray(documentsTable.organisationId, [orgId, otherOrgId]));
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entity, ['Document']));

  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgId, otherOrgId]));

describe('D-24 multer filter (imports)', () => {
  it('rejects non-Excel mimetypes with the V1 message', () => {
    const cb = vi.fn();
    excelFileFilter({}, { mimetype: 'application/json' } as any, cb as any);
    expect(cb).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Error));
    expect((cb.mock.calls[0]![0] as Error).message).toBe('Invalid file type. Only Excel and CSV files are allowed.');
  });

  it('allows csv/xlsx/xls', () => {
    for (const mt of ['text/csv', 'application/vnd.ms-excel']) {
      const cb = vi.fn();
      excelFileFilter({}, { mimetype: mt } as any, cb as any);
      expect(cb).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null, true);
    }
  });
});

describe('POST /imports/test', () => {
  it('uploads a canned buffer to the imports bucket', async () => {

    await controller.testStorageUpload({} as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

    expect(String(res.body.data.path)).toContain('test/test-file-');

});

describe('POST /imports/upload', () => {
  it('requires universityId and reportingPeriodId', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.handleUpload(uploadReq(Buffer.from(''), {}) as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId and reportingPeriodId are required');
  });

  it('normalizes cross-tenant uploads to 403', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.handleUpload(
      uploadReq(csvBuffer([{ a: 1 }]), { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }, { universityId: otherOrgId }) as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe(ISOLATION);
  });

  it('creates an OTHER document, parses rows and audits IMPORT', async () => {
    const buf = csvBuffer([
      { 'Activity Category': 'diesel', Quantity: '5', Unit: 'L', 'Activity Date': '2025-02-01' },
      { 'Activity Category': 'nuclear', Quantity: '-1', Unit: '', 'Activity Date': 'bad' },
    ]);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.handleUpload(uploadReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('File uploaded, parsed and validated');
    expect(res.body.data.totalParsed).toBe(2);
    expect(res.body.data.validCount).toBe(1);
    expect(res.body.data.invalidCount).toBe(1);
    expect(String(res.body.data.invalidRows[0].errors)).toContain('Quantity must be a positive number');

    const docRows = await db.select().from(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, res.body.data.documentId));
    const doc = docRows[0]!;
    documentIds.push(doc.id);
    expect(doc).toMatchObject({ documentType: 'OTHER', mimeType: 'text/csv', organisationId: orgId });
    expect(doc.fileName).toMatch(/^\d+-up-\d+\.csv$/);
    expect(doc.storagePath).toBe(doc.fileUrl);

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, doc.id));
    expect(audits[0]).toMatchObject({ action: 'IMPORT', entity: 'Document', description: 'Excel/CSV import file uploaded and parsed for preview' });
  });

  it('converts Excel serial numbers into dates inside validRows', async () => {
    const serial = 45658;
    const buf = csvBuffer([{ 'Activity Category': 'LPG', Quantity: 2, Unit: 'kg', 'Activity Date': serial }]);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.handleUpload(uploadReq(buf, { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }) as Request, res);
    const parsedDate = new Date(Math.round((serial - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
    expect(new Date((res.body.data.validRows[0] as any)['Activity Date']).getTime()).toBe(parsedDate.getTime());
    documentIds.push(res.body.data.documentId);
  });
});

describe('POST /imports/:id/confirm', () => {
  it('requires path id plus body fields', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport({ params: {}, body: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('documentId (in path), validRows, universityId, reportingPeriodId are required');
  });

  it('404s unknown documents', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { params: { id: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' }, body: { validRows: [], universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Document not found');
  });

  it('403s when the document belongs to another university', async () => {
    const [doc] = await db.insert(documentsTable).values({
      organisationId: otherOrgId, documentType: 'OTHER', fileName: 'x.csv', originalName: 'x.csv',
      fileUrl: 'p', mimeType: 'text/csv', fileSize: 1,
    }).returning({ id: documentsTable.id });
    documentIds.push(doc!.id);

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { params: { id: doc!.id }, body: { validRows: [{ 'Activity Category': 'DIESEL', Quantity: 1, Unit: 'L', 'Activity Date': '2025-02-02' }], universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Access denied: Document does not belong to the specified university');
  });

  it('normalizes cross-tenant callers to 403', async () => {
    const [doc] = await db.insert(documentsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId, documentType: 'OTHER', fileName: 'y.csv', originalName: 'y.csv',
      fileUrl: 'p2', mimeType: 'text/csv', fileSize: 1,
    }).returning({ id: documentsTable.id });
    documentIds.push(doc!.id);

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      { params: { id: doc!.id }, body: { validRows: [], universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId }, user: { universityId: otherOrgId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe(ISOLATION);
  });

  it('inserts trusted rows with scoped entity matching, derives scope and completes', async () => {
    const [doc] = await db.insert(documentsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgId, documentType: 'OTHER', fileName: 'z.csv', originalName: 'orig-z.csv',
      fileUrl: 'files/z.csv', mimeType: 'text/csv', fileSize: 3, publicUrl: 'https://pub/z.csv',
    }).returning();
    documentIds.push(doc!.id);

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.confirmImport(
      {
        params: { id: doc!.id },
        body: {
          universityId: orgId,
          reportingPeriodId: periodId,
          validRows: [
            { 'Activity Category': 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', Quantity: 10, Unit: 'kWh', 'Activity Date': '2025-03-03', Building: 'hq', Floor: 'ghost wing' },
            { 'Activity Category': 'DIESEL', Quantity: '7', Unit: 'L', 'Activity Date': '2025-03-04' },
          ],
        },
      } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Import confirmed and activity data created as DRAFT');
    expect(res.body.data.insertedCount).toBe(2);

    const inserted = await db.select().from(activityDataTable)
      .where(eq(activityDataTable.sourceFileId, doc!.id));
    activityIds.push(...inserted.map((a) => a.id));

    const elec = inserted.find((a) => a.category === 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY')!;
    expect(elec.scope).toBe('SCOPE_2');
    // D-25: 'Ghost Wing' exists only under the other organisation -> must NOT match.
    // Buildings match case-insensitively within the requesting organisation instead.
    expect(elec.physicalEntityId).toBe(hqOrgId);
    expect(elec.physicalEntityId).not.toBe(hqOtherId);

    const diesel = inserted.find((a) => a.category === 'DIESEL')!;
    expect(diesel).toMatchObject({ scope: 'SCOPE_1', status: 'DRAFT', inputSource: 'EXCEL', sourceFileName: 'orig-z.csv', physicalEntityId: null });
    expect(diesel.sourceDocumentUrl).toBe('https://pub/z.csv');
    expect(diesel.quantity).toBe('7.0000');

    const after = await db.select().from(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, doc!.id));
    expect(after[0]!.status).toBe('PROCESSED');

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, doc!.id));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'IMPORT_COMPLETED' && a.description === 'Import preview confirmed, DRAFT activity data created')).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  notificationsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/notificationsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgId: string;
let userAId: string;
let userBId: string;
const notifIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

async function insertNotification(values: Partial<typeof notificationsTable.$inferInsert> = {}) {
  const [row] = await db.insert(notificationsTable).values({
    userId: userAId,
    organisationId: orgId,
    title: `t-${notifIds.length}`,
    message: 'm',
    ...values,
  }).returning({ id: notificationsTable.id });
  notifIds.push(row!.id);
  return row!.id;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `NotifOrg ${RUN}`, code: `NTF-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;

  const users = await db.insert(usersTable).values([
    { authUserId: randomUUID(), username: `ntf-a-${RUN}`, email: `ntf-a-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: `ntf-password-${RUN}`, organisationId: orgId, role: 'USER' },
    { authUserId: randomUUID(), username: `ntf-b-${RUN}`, email: `ntf-b-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: `ntf-password-${RUN}`, organisationId: orgId, role: 'USER' },
  ]).returning({ id: usersTable.id });
  userAId = users[0]!.id;
  userBId = users[1]!.id;

  await insertNotification({ title: 'old unread', createdAt: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z') });
  await insertNotification({ title: 'read one', isRead: true, createdAt: new Date('2025-02-01T00:00:00Z') });
  await insertNotification({ title: 'new unread', createdAt: new Date('2025-03-01T00:00:00Z') });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(notificationsTable).where(inArray(notificationsTable.id, notifIds));
  await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('GET /notifications', () => {
  it('401s without a JWT user', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Unauthorized');
  });

  it('lists newest-first for the caller only', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list(
      { query: {}, user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toHaveLength(3); // user B's rows (none yet) excluded implicitly
    const dates: number[] = res.body.data.map((d: any) => new Date(d.createdAt).getTime());
    expect([...dates].sort((a, b) => b - a)).toEqual(dates);
    expect(res.body.data[0].title).toBe('new unread');
  });

  it('ignores the wired page/limit/isRead params (V1 dead-param quirk)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list(
      { query: { page: '2', limit: '1', isRead: 'true' }, user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toHaveLength(3); // unfiltered / unpaginated
  });

  it('caps results at 50 rows', async () => {
    const bulk = Array.from({ length: 51 }, (_, i) => ({
      userId: userBId,
      organisationId: orgId,
      title: `bulk-${i}`,
      message: 'm',
      createdAt: new Date(2024, 0, 1, 0, 0, i),
      updatedAt: new Date(2024, 0, 1, 0, 0, i),
    }));
    const rows = await db.insert(notificationsTable).values(bulk).returning({ id: notificationsTable.id });
    notifIds.push(...rows.map((r) => r.id));

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: {}, user: { userId: userBId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.data).toHaveLength(50);
    // newest of the bulk set first
    expect(res.body.data[0].title).toBe('bulk-50');
  }, 15000);

  it('serializes V1-shaped rows including universityId alias and no updatedAt', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: {}, user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    const row = res.body.data.find((d: any) => d.title === 'new unread');
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ userId: userAId, universityId: orgId, type: null, isRead: false });
    expect(Object.keys(row)).not.toContain('updatedAt');
  });
});

describe('GET /notifications/unread-count', () => {
  it('counts only unread rows for the caller', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.unreadCount({ user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: true, data: { count: 2 } });
  });

  it('requires a user', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.unreadCount({} as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
  });
});

describe('PATCH /notifications/read-all', () => {
  it('marks only the caller\u2019s unread rows and returns the count', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.markAllRead({ user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: true, data: { count: 2 } });

    const after = resMock();
    await controller.unreadCount({ user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request, after);
    expect(after.body.data.count).toBe(0);

    // Re-seed an unread row so later tests have material.
    await insertNotification({ title: 're-unread' });
  });
});

describe('PATCH /notifications/:id/read', () => {
  it('rejects invalid uuid params through the D-12 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.markRead({ params: { id: 'bad' }, user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid input data');
    expect(res.body.errors[0].message).toBe('Invalid notification ID');
  });

  it('normalizes unknown ids to 404 with the approved message (A-2)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.markRead(
      { params: { id: 'e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' }, user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Notification not found' });
  });

  it('normalizes wrong-user access to the same 404 (compound key semantics)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.markRead(
      { params: { id: notifIds[0] }, user: { userId: userBId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Notification not found');
  });

  it('marks the caller\u2019s notification read and returns the serialized row', async () => {
    const target = await insertNotification({ title: 'mark me' });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.markRead(
      { params: { id: target }, user: { userId: userAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ id: target, userId: userAId, isRead: true, title: 'mark me' });
  });
});
```

```typescript
function clonePayload() {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(validPayload)) as typeof validPayload;
}

const RUN = Date.now();
let orgAId: string;
let orgBId: string;
let userAId: string;
let userBId: string;

function req(overrides: {
  userId?: string | null;
  body?: unknown;
} = {}): Request {
  const request: Record<string, unknown> = { body: overrides.body ?? clonePayload() };
  if (overrides.userId !== null) {
    request.user = { userId: overrides.userId ?? userAId };
  }
  return request as unknown as Request;
}

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

async function rowCountFor(organisationId: string): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ id: organisationOnboardingTable.id })
    .from(organisationOnboardingTable)
    .where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, organisationId));
  return rows.length;
}

async function loadRow(organisationId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(organisationOnboardingTable)
    .where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, organisationId));
  return rows[0];
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [orgA] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `OnbOrg A ${RUN}`, code: `ONBA-${RUN}`, type: 'OTHER', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgAId = orgA!.id;

  const [orgB] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `OnbOrg B ${RUN}`, code: `ONBB-${RUN}`, type: 'OTHER', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgBId = orgB!.id;

  const rows = await db.insert(usersTable).values([
    { username: `onb-a-${RUN}`, email: `onb-a-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: 'hash', organisationId: orgAId },
    { username: `onb-b-${RUN}`, email: `onb-b-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: 'hash', organisationId: orgBId },
  ]).returning({ id: usersTable.id });
  userAId = rows[0]!.id;
  userBId = rows[1]!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  // Onboarding rows cascade with their organisations.
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(
    inArray(auditLogsTable.entityId, [orgAId, orgBId]),
  );
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'OrganisationOnboarding'));
  await db.delete(usersTable).where(inArray(usersTable.id, [userAId, userBId]));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(inArray(organisationsTable.id, [orgAId, orgBId]));
});

describe('POST /onboarding (create)', () => {
  it('A: creates the profile for the authenticated user’s organisation (201)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(req(), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    const data = res.body.data;
    expect(data.organisationId).toBe(orgAId);
    expect(data.company.legalName).toBe('Vertex Manufacturing Pvt Ltd');
    expect(data.strategy.teammateEmails).toBe('ops@vertex.example.com, finance@vertex.example.com');
    expect(typeof data.createdAt).toBe('string');

    const row = await loadRow(orgAId);
    expect(row).toBeDefined();
    expect(row!.organisationId).toBe(orgAId);
    expect(row!.id).toBe(data.id);
    expect(row!.company).toMatchObject({ brandName: 'Vertex' });

    const audits = await db
      .select()
      .from(auditLogsTable)
      .where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'OrganisationOnboarding'));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'ONBOARDING_CREATED' && a.organisationId === orgAId)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('A: never mutates the organisations row (signup name wins over legalName)', async () => {
    const [org] = await db.select().from(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgAId));
    // The organisation keeps the name it received at fixture-creation time;
    // the onboarding legalName intentionally differs and lives only in the
    // onboarding profile.
    expect(org!.name).toBe(`OnbOrg A ${RUN}`);
    expect(org!.legalName).toBeNull();
    const meta = (org!.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(meta.onboardingNameAdopted).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('E: returns 409 and keeps a single row when the profile already exists', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(req(), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(409);
    expect(await rowCountFor(orgAId)).toBe(1);
  });

  it('F: ignores a client-supplied organisationId in the body', async () => {
    // Clean slate so POST is legal again for this scenario.
    await db.delete(organisationOnboardingTable).where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, orgAId));

    const payload = clonePayload() as Record<string, unknown>;
    payload.organisationId = orgBId; // attacker tries to write into org B

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ body: payload }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data.organisationId).toBe(orgAId);
    expect(await rowCountFor(orgBId)).toBe(0);

    // Restore the standard fixture row for later describes.
    await db.delete(organisationOnboardingTable).where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, orgAId));
    await controller.create(req(), resMock());
  });

  it('H: rejects credential-like keys anywhere in the payload (400)', async () => {
    const payload = clonePayload();
    const companyWithSecret: Record<string, unknown> = { ...payload.company, apiPassword: 'hunter2' };
    const tampered: Record<string, unknown> = { ...payload, company: companyWithSecret };

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ body: tampered }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
    expect(await rowCountFor(orgAId)).toBe(1); // nothing persisted
  });
});

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.get(req(), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

describe('PUT /onboarding (idempotent upsert)', () => {
  it('C: updates in place — same id, changed values persisted', async () => {
    const before = await loadRow(orgAId);
    // Deterministic updatedAt comparison: rewind the stored timestamp first
    // (avoids same-millisecond flakes on fast DB round-trips).
    await db.execute(sql`
      update organisation_onboarding set updated_at = now() - interval '1 hour'
      where id = ${before!.id}
    `);

    const payload = clonePayload();
    payload.company.brandName = 'Vertex Industries';
    payload.reporting.deadline = '2027-03-31';
    payload.strategy.targetYear = '2040';

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ body: payload }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const after = await loadRow(orgAId);
    expect(after!.id).toBe(before!.id);
    expect(new Date(after!.updatedAt).getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(
      new Date(before!.updatedAt).getTime(),
    );
    expect(after!.company).toMatchObject({ brandName: 'Vertex Industries' });
    expect(after!.reporting).toMatchObject({ deadline: '2027-03-31' });
    expect(after!.strategy).toMatchObject({ targetYear: '2040' });

    const response = res.body.data;
    expect(response.id).toBe(before!.id);
    expect(response.updatedAt).toBe(after!.updatedAt.toISOString());

    const audits = await db
      .select()
      .from(auditLogsTable)
      .where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'OrganisationOnboarding'));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'ONBOARDING_UPDATED' && a.organisationId === orgAId)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('C: PUT never touches the organisations row (zero org writes)', async () => {
    const [before] = await db.select().from(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgAId));

    // legalName/website deliberately differ from the organisation record.
    const payload = clonePayload();
    payload.company.legalName = 'Vertex Holdings Ltd';
    payload.company.website = 'https://holdings.vertex.example.com';

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ body: payload }), res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

    const [after] = await db.select().from(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgAId));
    expect(after).toEqual(before); // identical row: no name/legal_name/website/updatedAt writes
    expect(after!.name).toBe(`OnbOrg A ${RUN}`);
  });

  it('D: submitting the identical payload twice keeps exactly one row', async () => {
    const res1 = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req(), res1);
    const res2 = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req(), res2);

    expect(res1.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.body.data.id).toBe(res1.body.data.id);
    expect(await rowCountFor(orgAId)).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('Authorization and context errors', () => {
  it('F: a second organisation only ever sees/writes its own profile', async () => {
    // B has no profile yet -> 404, not A's data.
    const getRes = resMock();
    await controller.get(req({ userId: userBId }), getRes);
    expect(getRes.statusCode).toBe(404);

    // B creates their own; A's untouched.
    const payload = clonePayload();
    payload.company.legalName = 'Beta Corp';
    const postRes = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ userId: userBId, body: payload }), postRes);
    expect(postRes.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(postRes.body.data.organisationId).toBe(orgBId);

    const rowA = await loadRow(orgAId);
    expect(rowA!.company).toMatchObject({ legalName: 'Vertex Manufacturing Pvt Ltd' });
    expect(await rowCountFor(orgAId)).toBe(1);
    expect(await rowCountFor(orgBId)).toBe(1);
  });

  it('G: an unresolvable authenticated user gets 401 and nothing is written', async () => {
    const ghostId = randomUUID();
    const before = await db.select({ id: organisationOnboardingTable.id }).from(organisationOnboardingTable);

    const getRes = resMock();
    await controller.get(req({ userId: ghostId }), getRes);
    const postRes = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ userId: ghostId }), postRes);
    const putRes = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ userId: ghostId }), putRes);

    expect(getRes.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(postRes.statusCode).toBe(401);
    expect(putRes.statusCode).toBe(401);

    const after = await db.select({ id: organisationOnboardingTable.id }).from(organisationOnboardingTable);
    expect(after.length).toBe(before.length);
  });

  it('G: missing auth context yields 401', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.get(req({ userId: null }), res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(401);
  });
});

describe('Validation failures persist nothing', () => {
  let rowsBefore: number;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const rows = await db.select({ id: organisationOnboardingTable.id }).from(organisationOnboardingTable);
    rowsBefore = rows.length;
  });

  const cases: Array<{ name: string; mutate: (p: ReturnType<typeof clonePayload>) => void }> = [
    { name: 'invalid contactEmail', mutate: (p) => { p.strategy.contactEmail = 'not-an-email'; } },
    { name: 'invalid website URL', mutate: (p) => { p.company.website = 'notaurl'; } },
    { name: 'invalid deadline', mutate: (p) => { p.reporting.deadline = '2026-02-30'; } },
    { name: 'invalid targetYear', mutate: (p) => { p.strategy.targetYear = '20x5'; } },
    { name: 'invalid reduction', mutate: (p) => { p.strategy.reduction = '140'; } },
    { name: 'missing required section', mutate: (p) => { delete (p as Partial<typeof p>).locations; } },
    { name: 'missing company legalName', mutate: (p) => { delete (p.company as { legalName?: string }).legalName; } },
    {
      name: 'invalid teammate email token is named, none discarded silently',
      mutate: (p) => { p.strategy.teammateEmails = 'ops@vertex.example.com, broken-address'; },
    },
  ];

  for (const testCase of cases) {
    it(`H: rejects ${testCase.name} with 400`, async () => {
      const payload = clonePayload();
      testCase.mutate(payload);

      const postRes = resMock();
      await controller.create(req({ body: payload }), postRes);
      expect(postRes.statusCode).toBe(400);
      expect(postRes.body.success).toBe(false);
      expect(Array.isArray(postRes.body.details)).toBe(true);

      const putRes = resMock();
      await controller.upsert(req({ body: payload }), putRes);
      expect(putRes.statusCode).toBe(400);

      const rows = await db.select({ id: organisationOnboardingTable.id }).from(organisationOnboardingTable);
      expect(rows.length).toBe(rowsBefore); // nothing persisted by either verb
    });
  }

  it('normalises teammateEmails consistently without discarding addresses', async () => {
    const payload = clonePayload();
    payload.strategy.teammateEmails = 'OPS@Vertex.example.com , finance@vertex.example.com';

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ body: payload }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.strategy.teammateEmails)
      .toBe('ops@vertex.example.com, finance@vertex.example.com');
  });

  it('preserves numeric-string reduction within range', async () => {
    const payload = clonePayload();
    payload.strategy.reduction = '42.5';

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ body: payload }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.strategy.reduction).toBe('42.5');
  });
});

describe('Failure handling leaves no partial state', () => {
  it('I: a database failure during create surfaces 500 and persists nothing', async () => {
    await db.delete(organisationOnboardingTable).where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, orgAId));

    const errorSpy = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    const insertSpy = vi.spyOn(db, 'insert').mockImplementationOnce(() => {
      throw new Error('Simulated connection reset');
    });

    try {
      const res = resMock();
      await controller.create(req(), res);

      expect(res.statusCode).toBe(500);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe('Failed to create onboarding profile');
      // No internals leaked to the client.
      expect(JSON.stringify(res.body)).not.toContain('Simulated connection reset');
      expect(await rowCountFor(orgAId)).toBe(0);
      expect(errorSpy).toHaveBeenCalled(); // logged server-side only
    } finally {
      insertSpy.mockRestore();
      errorSpy.mockRestore();
    }

    // Service recovers immediately once the database behaves again.
    const recovery = resMock();
    await controller.create(req(), recovery);
    expect(recovery.statusCode).toBe(201);
  });
});

describe('Full lifecycle: signup -> login -> onboarding completion', () => {
  const RUN_LC = Date.now();
  let lifecycleUserId: string;
  let lifecycleOrgId: string;

  async function loadLifecycleOrg() {
    const [orgRow] = await db
      .select()
      .from(organisationsTable)
      .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, lifecycleOrgId));
    return orgRow!;
  }

  it('renames the signup placeholder once, activates it, then never renames again', async () => {
    // SIGNUP: backend provisions a PENDING placeholder organisation and links
    // the user to it atomically — no organisation name is collected.
    const credentials = {
      username: `onb-lc-${RUN_LC}`,
      email: `onb-lc-${RUN_LC}@x.dev`,
      password: 'Lifecycle!42',
    };
    const registered = await registerUser(credentials);

    lifecycleUserId = registered.user.id;
    lifecycleOrgId = registered.user.organisationId;
    expect(lifecycleOrgId).toBeTruthy(); // invariant: never NULL after signup

    // Pre-onboarding state: placeholder name, PENDING, no profile row.
    let orgRow = await loadLifecycleOrg();
    expect(orgRow.name).toBe('Pending Organisation');
    expect(orgRow.type).toBe('OTHER');
    expect(orgRow.status).toBe('PENDING');

    // LOGIN: the authenticated user carries the same non-null organisationId.
    const loggedIn = await loginUser({ email: credentials.email, password: credentials.password });
    expect(loggedIn.user.organisationId).toBe(lifecycleOrgId);

    const notFound = resMock();
    await controller.get(req({ userId: lifecycleUserId }), notFound);
    expect(notFound.statusCode).toBe(404);

    // FIRST ONBOARDING SUBMISSION completes the organisation identity:
    // placeholder -> company.legalName, PENDING -> ACTIVE.
    const payload = clonePayload();
    payload.company.legalName = 'Vertex Manufacturing Pvt Ltd';
    const created = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ userId: lifecycleUserId, body: payload }), created);
    expect(created.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(created.body.data.organisationId).toBe(lifecycleOrgId); // SAME org id

    // Exactly ONE organisation for the user and ONE onboarding row for it.
    const userRows = await db
      .select({ id: usersTable.id, organisationId: usersTable.organisationId })
      .from(usersTable)
      .where(eq(usersTable.id, lifecycleUserId));
    expect(userRows).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(userRows[0]!.organisationId).toBe(lifecycleOrgId);

    const onboardingRows = await db
      .select()
      .from(organisationOnboardingTable)
      .where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, lifecycleOrgId));
    expect(onboardingRows).toHaveLength(1);

    orgRow = await loadLifecycleOrg();
    expect(orgRow.name).toBe('Vertex Manufacturing Pvt Ltd'); // renamed from placeholder
    expect(orgRow.status).toBe('ACTIVE'); // activated by onboarding
    expect(orgRow.legalName).toBeNull(); // profile data lives in the JSONB only
    expect((orgRow.metadata as Record<string, unknown>).onboardingCompletedAt).toBeTruthy();

    // GET returns the same data.
    const fetched = resMock();
    await controller.get(req({ userId: lifecycleUserId }), fetched);
    expect(fetched.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(fetched.body.data).toEqual(created.body.data);

    // SUBSEQUENT UPDATE (point 10): legalName changes are profile-only — the
    // established organisations.name must NOT be silently overwritten.
    const updatedPayload = clonePayload();
    updatedPayload.company.legalName = 'Changed Legal Name';
    const updated = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ userId: lifecycleUserId, body: updatedPayload }), updated);
    expect(updated.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(updated.body.data.id).toBe(created.body.data.id);
    expect(updated.body.data.company.legalName).toBe('Changed Legal Name');

    orgRow = await loadLifecycleOrg();
    expect(orgRow.name).toBe('Vertex Manufacturing Pvt Ltd'); // display name stable
    expect(orgRow.status).toBe('ACTIVE');
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (!lifecycleUserId || !lifecycleOrgId) return;
    await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'OrganisationOnboarding'));
    await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, lifecycleUserId));
    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, lifecycleOrgId));
  });
});
```
