```typescript
describe('Production payload regression (bare-domain website + unanswered strategy fields)', () => {
  const RUN_P = Date.now();
  let prodUserId: string;
  let prodOrgId: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
      name: `ProdOrg ${RUN_P}`, code: `PRODP-${RUN_P}`, type: 'OTHER', status: 'PENDING',
    }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
    prodOrgId = org!.id;

    const [user] = await db.insert(usersTable).values({
      username: `onb-prod-${RUN_P}`, email: `onb-prod-${RUN_P}@x.dev`, password: 'hash', organisationId: prodOrgId,
    }).returning({ id: usersTable.id });
    prodUserId = user!.id;
  });

  it('accepts the exact production payload that previously returned 400 (201)', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ userId: prodUserId, body: cloneProductionPayload() }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data.organisationId).toBe(prodOrgId);
  });

  it('round-trips every section verbatim, preserving empty strings and bare domain', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.get(req({ userId: prodUserId }), res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const d = res.body.data;
    expect(d.company.website).toBe('test.com'); // bare domain stored as submitted
    expect(d.company.consolidationApproach).toBe('');
    expect(d.integrations.utilityBillingMethod).toBe('');
    expect(d.strategy.targetYear).toBe('');
    expect(d.strategy.reduction).toBe('');
    expect(d.strategy.teammateEmails).toBe('');
    expect(d.emissions.refrigerants).toEqual(['CO₂-based']);
    expect(d.valueChain.franchises).toBe('franchisor');
    expect(d.strategy.role).toBe('CSO / Chief Sustainability Officer');
  });

  it('PUT updates the same row and a repeat POST conflicts — never duplicates', async () => {
    const changed = cloneProductionPayload();
    changed.company.legalName = 'Test Corp Updated';

    const putRes = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ userId: prodUserId, body: changed }), putRes);
    expect(putRes.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(putRes.body.data.company.legalName).toBe('Test Corp Updated');

    const dupRes = resMock();
    await controller.create(req({ userId: prodUserId, body: cloneProductionPayload() }), dupRes);
    expect(dupRes.statusCode).toBe(409);

    const rows = await db
      .select()
      .from(organisationOnboardingTable)
      .where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, prodOrgId));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('still rejects genuinely invalid website/targetYear values', async () => {
    const badWebsite = cloneProductionPayload();
    badWebsite.company.website = 'notaurl'; // no dot, not a URL
    const websiteRes = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ userId: prodUserId, body: badWebsite }), websiteRes);
    expect(websiteRes.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(websiteRes.body.details.some((i: { field: string }) => i.field === 'company.website')).toBe(true);

    const badYear = cloneProductionPayload();
    badYear.strategy.targets = 'sbti';
    badYear.strategy.targetYear = '19000';
    const yearRes = resMock();
    await controller.upsert(req({ userId: prodUserId, body: badYear }), yearRes);
    expect(yearRes.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(yearRes.body.details.some((i: { field: string; message: string }) =>
      i.field === 'strategy.targetYear' && i.message.includes('4-digit'),
    )).toBe(true);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (!prodUserId || !prodOrgId) return;
    await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entity, 'OrganisationOnboarding'));
    await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, prodUserId));
    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, prodOrgId));
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {

  recommendationsTable,

} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/recommendationsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgId: string;
let periodId: string;
let recId: string;
const activityIds: string[] = [];

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

async function insertRec(values: Partial<typeof recommendationsTable.$inferInsert> = {}) {
  const [row] = await db.insert(recommendationsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId,
    category: 'ENERGY',
    title: `Rec ${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
    description: 'd',
    priority: 'MEDIUM',
    ...values,
  }).returning({ id: recommendationsTable.id });
  if (recId === undefined) recId = row!.id;
  return row!.id;
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `RecOrg ${RUN}`, code: `REC-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;

  const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
    organisationId: orgId, name: `RecP ${RUN}`, startDate: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'), endDate: new Date('2025-12-31T00:00:00Z'), studentCount: 1000, staffCount: 100, totalAreaSqm: '5000.00', status: 'OPEN',
  }).returning({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id });
  periodId = period!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  const recs = await db.select({ id: recommendationsTable.id }).from(recommendationsTable).where(eq(recommendationsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(recommendationsTable).where(inArray(recommendationsTable.id, recs.map((r) => r.id)));
  if (activityIds.length > 0) {
    await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(inArray(activityDataTable.id, activityIds));
  }
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('GET /recommendations', () => {
  it('requires universityId through the controller-level zod check', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: {} } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid input data');
    expect(res.body.errors[0].field).toBe('universityId');
  });

  it('hides DISMISSED by default and orders priority desc then createdAt desc', async () => {
    await insertRec({ title: 'A high', priority: 'HIGH' });
    await insertRec({ title: 'B low', priority: 'LOW' });
    await insertRec({ title: 'C dismissed', priority: 'CRITICAL', status: 'DISMISSED' });

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const titles = res.body.data.map((r: any) => r.title);
    expect(titles).toContain('A high');
    expect(titles).not.toContain('C dismissed');
    expect(res.body.data[0].priority).toBe('HIGH');
  });

  it('applies explicit filters including an explicit DISMISSED status', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgId, status: 'DISMISSED' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.data.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    const prio = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgId, priority: 'LOW' } } as unknown as Request, prio);
    expect(prio.body.data.every((r: any) => r.priority === 'LOW')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('accepts but ignores page/limit (V1 dead params)', async () => {

    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgId, page: '2', limit: '1' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    // If more than one active row exists they would have been paginated away.
    const all = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgId } } as unknown as Request, all);
    expect(res.body.data.length).toBe(all.body.data.length);
  });

  it('serializes V1-shaped rows with universityId/buildingId aliases', async () => {

    const row = res.body.data[0];
    for (const key of ['id', 'universityId', 'buildingId', 'category', 'title', 'description', 'priority', 'estimatedReductionKg', 'status', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt']) {
      expect(row).toHaveProperty(key);
    }
    expect(row.universityId).toBe(orgId);
  });

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.id).toBe(recId);
  });

  it('404s unknown ids with the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getById(
      { params: { id: 'c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Recommendation not found');
  });
});

describe('PATCH /recommendations/:id/status', () => {
  it('rejects invalid statuses with the exact V1 message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.patchStatus(
      { params: { id: recId }, body: { status: 'WIP' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid status. Must be one of: NEW, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, DISMISSED');
  });

  it('transitions to each allowed status including NEW', async () => {
    for (const status of ['IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'NEW']) {
      const res = resMock();
      await controller.patchStatus({ params: { id: recId }, body: { status } } as unknown as Request, res);
      expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.data.status).toBe(status);
    }
  });

  it('404s unknown ids', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.patchStatus(
      { params: { id: 'c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' }, body: { status: 'NEW' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Recommendation not found');
  });
});

describe('POST /recommendations/generate', () => {
  it('requires universityId and reportingPeriodId', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generate({ body: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId and reportingPeriodId are required');
  });

  it('runs the engine, persists NEW rows with dedupe, returns 201 active list', async () => {
    const before = resMock();
    await controller.generate(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId } } as unknown as Request,
      before,
    );
    expect(before.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(Array.isArray(before.body.data)).toBe(true);

    const stored = await db.select().from(recommendationsTable).where(eq(recommendationsTable.organisationId, orgId));
    const generated = stored.filter((r) => r.status === 'NEW');
    expect(generated.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Engine Rule 3 fires on a perfect-quality empty dataset? qualityScore=100 -> only
    // category rules possible; with zero emissions nothing qualifies. Accept either.
    expect(stored.every((r) => r.category && r.title && r.description)).toBe(true);

    const again = resMock();
    await controller.generate(
      { body: { universityId: orgId, reportingPeriodId: periodId } } as unknown as Request,
      again,
    );
    expect(again.statusCode).toBe(201);
    const afterStored = await db.select().from(recommendationsTable).where(eq(recommendationsTable.organisationId, orgId));
    expect(afterStored.length).toBe(stored.length); // deduped
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/reportingPeriodsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgAId: string;
let orgBId: string;
let periodA1Id: string;
let periodA2Id: string;
let periodA3Id: string;

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [orgA] = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: `rp-org-A-${RUN}`, code: `RP-A-${RUN}` })
    .returning();
  if (!orgA) throw new Error('Failed to insert orgA');
  orgAId = orgA.id;

  const [orgB] = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: `rp-org-B-${RUN}`, code: `RP-B-${RUN}` })
    .returning();
  if (!orgB) throw new Error('Failed to insert orgB');
  orgBId = orgB.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgAId));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgBId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgAId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgBId));
});

function mockRes() {
  const res: any = {
    status: (code: number) => {
      res.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json: (data: any) => {
      res.body = data;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

describe('Reporting Periods V1', () => {
  it('should reject startDate >= endDate', async () => {
    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: orgAId,
        name: 'Invalid Period',
        startDate: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        endDate: '2024-12-31T00:00:00Z',
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.create(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('startDate must be before endDate');
  });

  it('should create a valid period with default status DRAFT', async () => {
    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: orgAId,
        name: 'Period A1',
        startDate: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        endDate: '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z',
        description: 'V1 ignores this field',
        notes: 'V1 persists notes as description',
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.create(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.name).toBe('Period A1');
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('DRAFT');
    expect(res.body.data.isBaseline).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.data.description).toBe('V1 persists notes as description');
    expect(res.body.data.startDate).toBe('2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
    expect(res.body.data.endDate).toBe('2024-12-31T23:59:59.000Z');
    expect(res.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('studentCount');
    expect(res.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('staffCount');
    expect(res.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('totalAreaSqm');
    periodA1Id = res.body.data.id;
  });

  it('should reject exact duplicate periods', async () => {
    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: orgAId,
        name: 'Duplicate Period',
        startDate: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        endDate: '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z',
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.create(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Reporting period already exists');
  });

  it('should allow overlapping but non-identical periods', async () => {
    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: orgAId,
        name: 'Period A2 (Overlap)',
        startDate: '2024-06-01T00:00:00Z',
        endDate: '2025-05-31T23:59:59Z',
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.create(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    periodA2Id = res.body.data.id;
  });

  it('should create with isBaseline and reset other baselines', async () => {
    // First manually set A1 as baseline
    await controller.baseline({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, mockRes());

    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: orgAId,
        name: 'Period A3 (Baseline)',
        startDate: '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        endDate: '2023-12-31T23:59:59Z',
        isBaseline: true,
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.create(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data.isBaseline).toBe(true);
    periodA3Id = res.body.data.id;

    // Check A1 is no longer baseline
    const getRes = mockRes();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, getRes);
    expect(getRes.body.data.isBaseline).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should require universityId for list', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getAll({ query: {} } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('universityId is required');
  });

  it('should list periods sorted by startDate DESC', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getAll({ query: { universityId: orgAId } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    const data = res.body.data;
    expect(data.length).toBe(3);
    // 2024-06-01, 2024-01-01, 2023-01-01
    expect(data[0].id).toBe(periodA2Id);
    expect(data[1].id).toBe(periodA1Id);
    expect(data[2].id).toBe(periodA3Id);
  });

  it('should get by ID with organisation included', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.university).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.data.university.id).toBe(orgAId);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body.data.university).sort()).toEqual([
      'code',
      'email',
      'id',
      'metadata',
      'name',
      'phone',
      'status',
      'type',
      'website',
    ]);
    expect(res.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('studentCount');
    expect(res.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('staffCount');
    expect(res.body.data).not.toHaveProperty('totalAreaSqm');
  });

  it('should set-baseline and unset other periods', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.baseline({ params: { id: periodA2Id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.isBaseline).toBe(true);

    const getRes = mockRes();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: periodA3Id } } as any, getRes);
    expect(getRes.body.data.isBaseline).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should transition DRAFT to OPEN', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.open({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('OPEN');
  });

  it('should transition OPEN to LOCKED', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.lock({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('LOCKED');
  });

  it('should reject opening a LOCKED period', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.open({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Locked reporting period cannot be reopened');
  });

  it('should reject locking a LOCKED period', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.lock({ params: { id: periodA1Id } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Reporting period is already locked');
  });

  it('should return 404 for a missing reporting period', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getById({ params: { id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Reporting period not found' });
  });
});
```

```typescript
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('GENERATING');

    const rows = await db.select().from(reportsTable).where(eq(reportsTable.id, res.body.data.reportId));
    const created = rows[0]!;
    reportIds.push(created.id);
    expect(created.status).toBe('GENERATING');
    expect(created.name).toBe(`Carbon Report - Reports Period ${RUN}`);
  });

  it('rejects a missing field through the D-2 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generate({ body: { universityId: orgAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
    expect(res.body.details[0].field).toBe('reportingPeriodId');
  });

  it('rejects an invalid uuid through the D-2 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generate(
      { body: { universityId: 'nope', reportingPeriodId: periodAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.details[0].field).toBe('universityId');
  });

  it('returns the exact 404 message for an unknown university', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generate(
      { body: { universityId: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', reportingPeriodId: periodAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'University or Reporting Period not found' });
  });

  it('returns the exact 404 message for an unknown reporting period', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generate(
      { body: { universityId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('University or Reporting Period not found');
  });

  it('preserves the V1 cross-period quirk without an ownership check', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generate(
      { body: { universityId: orgBId, reportingPeriodId: periodAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('GENERATING');
    reportIds.push(res.body.data.reportId);
  });

  it('writes no audit rows during generation', async () => {
    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.action, 'REPORT_GENERATED'));
    expect(audits).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('S15b POST /reports/:id/generate-pdf', () => {
  it('rejects an invalid id through the D-2 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generatePdf({ params: { id: 'bad' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
  });

  it('returns 404 Report not found for an unknown id', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generatePdf(
      { params: { id: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Report not found' });
  });

  it('generates, uploads to the reports bucket, persists totals and returns the V1 envelope', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generatePdf({ params: { id } } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('PDF report generated successfully');
    expect(res.body.data.status).toBe('GENERATED');
    expect(res.body.data.fileName).toBe(`carbon-report-${id}.pdf`);
    expect(res.body.data.publicUrl).toBe(`https://signed.test/reports/${res.body.data.storagePath}`);

    const uploadCall = vi.mocked(storage.uploadFile).mock.calls[0];
    expect(uploadCall?.[0]).toBe('reports');
    expect(String(uploadCall?.[1])).toContain(`${orgAId}/`);
    expect(String(uploadCall?.[1])).toContain(`carbon-report-${id}.pdf`);
    expect(vi.mocked(storage.getSignedUrl).mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0]).toBe('reports');

    const rows = await db.select().from(reportsTable).where(eq(reportsTable.id, id));
    const updated = rows[0]!;
    expect(updated.status).toBe('GENERATED');
    expect(updated.filePath).toBe(res.body.data.storagePath);
    expect(updated.totalEmissionsKg).toBe('0.0000');
    expect(updated.generatedAt).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('writes the REPORT_GENERATED audit row with metadata', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generatePdf({ params: { id } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, id));
    expect(audits).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(audits[0]).toMatchObject({
      action: 'REPORT_GENERATED',
      entity: 'Report',
      description: 'Carbon report generated',
    });
    expect(audits[0]!.metadata).toMatchObject({ status: 'GENERATED' });
  });

  it('marks the report FAILED and surfaces the error when storage fails', async () => {
    vi.mocked(storage.uploadFile).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Storage upload failed: boom'));
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.generatePdf({ params: { id } } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(500);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Storage upload failed: boom' });

    const rows = await db.select().from(reportsTable).where(eq(reportsTable.id, id));
    expect(rows[0]!.status).toBe('FAILED');
  });
});

describe('S16 GET /reports', () => {
  it('lists rows ordered by createdAt desc with no pagination key', async () => {
    await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, createdAt: new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
    await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, createdAt: new Date('2025-02-01T00:00:00.000Z') });
    const res = resMock();

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body).not.toHaveProperty('pagination');
    const dates: number[] = res.body.data.map((r: any) => new Date(r.createdAt).getTime());
    expect([...dates].sort((a, b) => b - a)).toEqual(dates);
  });

  it('filters strictly by organisation', async () => {
    await insertReport({ organisationId: orgBId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.body.data.every((r: any) => r.universityId === orgAId)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('serializes full V1-shaped rows including null numerics and dates', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgAId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    const sample = res.body.data[0];
    for (const key of ['id', 'universityId', 'reportingPeriodId', 'name', 'status', 'filePath', 'fileName', 'totalEmissionsKg', 'scope1Kg', 'scope2Kg', 'generatedAt', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt']) {
      expect(sample).toHaveProperty(key);
    }
    expect(sample.filePath).toBeNull();
    expect(sample.generatedAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('rejects an invalid query through the D-2 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
    expect(res.body.details[0].field).toBe('universityId');
  });

  it('returns an empty array for an organisation without reports', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({ query: { universityId: orgEmptyId } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('S17 GET /reports/:id', () => {
  it('returns the full serialized row', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, status: 'GENERATED', filePath: 'a/b.pdf', fileName: 'b.pdf', totalEmissionsKg: '12.5000' });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getSingle(
      { params: { id }, user: { userId: 'u1', role: 'USER', universityId: orgAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );

    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ id, universityId: orgAId, status: 'GENERATED', totalEmissionsKg: 12.5 });
  });

  it('returns 404 Report not found for an unknown id', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getSingle(
      { params: { id: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Report not found' });
  });

  it('normalizes cross-tenant access to 403 with the exact message', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getSingle(
      { params: { id }, user: { userId: 'u1', role: 'USER', universityId: orgBId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN });
  });

  it('lets SUPER_ADMIN bypass tenant isolation', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getSingle(
      { params: { id }, user: { userId: 'sa', role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', universityId: orgBId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
  });

  it('rejects an invalid param through the D-2 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.getSingle({ params: {} } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
  });
});

describe('S18 GET /reports/:id/download', () => {
  it('returns 404 not-ready for an unknown id', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport(
      { params: { id: 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'Report not found or not ready' });
  });

  it('returns 404 while the report is still GENERATING', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, status: 'GENERATING', filePath: 'x/y.pdf' });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport({ params: { id } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Report not found or not ready');
  });

  it('returns 404 when GENERATED but filePath is missing', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, status: 'GENERATED', filePath: null });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport({ params: { id } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
  });

  it('returns the url at the top level from the normalized reports bucket and audits first', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({
      organisationId: orgAId,
      status: 'GENERATED',
      filePath: `${orgAId}/2025/carbon-report-x.pdf`,
      fileName: 'carbon-report-x.pdf',
    });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport(
      { params: { id }, user: { userId: 'u1', role: 'USER', universityId: orgAId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(Object.keys(res.body)).toEqual(['success', 'url']);
    expect(res.body.url).toBe(`https://public.test/reports/${orgAId}/2025/carbon-report-x.pdf`);
    expect(vi.mocked(storage.getPublicUrl).mock.calls.at(-1)![0]).toBe('reports');

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, id));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'REPORT_DOWNLOADED')).toBe(true);
    expect(audits.find((a) => a.action === 'REPORT_DOWNLOADED')).toMatchObject({
      entity: 'Report',
      description: 'Report downloaded',
    });
  });

  it('normalizes cross-tenant download attempts to 403', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, status: 'GENERATED', filePath: 'a/b.pdf' });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport(
      { params: { id }, user: { userId: 'u2', role: 'USER', universityId: orgBId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe(FORBIDDEN);
  });

  it('lets SUPER_ADMIN bypass isolation on download', async () => {
    const id = await insertReport({ organisationId: orgAId, status: 'GENERATED', filePath: 'a/b.pdf' });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport(
      { params: { id }, user: { userId: 'sa', role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', universityId: null } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('rejects an invalid param through the D-2 envelope', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.downloadReport({ params: { id: 'x' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  organisationsTable,
  baselinesTable,
  activityDataTable,
  calculationsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  sustainabilityTargetsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/targetsV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();

let orgAId: string;
let orgNoBaselineId: string;
let periodA1Id: string;
let targetA1Id: string;
let factorId: string;

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [orgA] = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: `tgt-org-A-${RUN}`, code: `TGT-A-${RUN}` })
    .returning();
  if (!orgA) throw new Error('Failed to insert orgA');
  orgAId = orgA.id;

  const [orgNoBaseline] = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({ name: `tgt-org-no-base-${RUN}`, code: `TGT-NB-${RUN}` })
    .returning();
  if (!orgNoBaseline) throw new Error('Failed to insert no-baseline org');
  orgNoBaselineId = orgNoBaseline.id;

  const [periodA1] = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgAId,
      name: 'TGT Period A1',
      startDate: new Date('2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'),
      endDate: new Date('2024-12-31T23:59:59Z'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning();
  if (!periodA1) throw new Error('Failed to insert periodA1');
  periodA1Id = periodA1.id;

  const [factor] = await db.insert(emissionFactorsTable).values({
    factorId: `tgt-factor-${RUN}`,
    activityId: 'DIESEL',
    name: `Target factor ${RUN}`,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    factor: '1.000000',
    unit: 'kg',
    factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
    status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id });
  if (!factor) throw new Error('Failed to insert target factor');
  factorId = factor.id;

  await db.insert(baselinesTable).values({
    organisationId: orgAId,
    reportingPeriodId: periodA1Id,
    baselineYear: 2024,
    scope1KgCO2e: '1000',
    scope2KgCO2e: '0',
    totalKgCO2e: '1000',
    status: 'APPROVED',
  });

  const [verifiedActivity] = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({
    organisationId: orgAId,
    reportingPeriodId: periodA1Id,
    category: 'DIESEL',
    scope: 'SCOPE_1',
    quantity: '1',
    unit: 'kg',
    status: 'VERIFIED',
  }).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  const [calculatedActivity] = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({
    organisationId: orgAId,
    reportingPeriodId: periodA1Id,
    category: 'PETROL',
    scope: 'SCOPE_1',
    quantity: '1',
    unit: 'kg',
    status: 'CALCULATED',
  }).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
  if (!verifiedActivity || !calculatedActivity) throw new Error('Failed to insert target activities');
  await db.insert(calculationsTable).values([
    { organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: periodA1Id, activityDataId: verifiedActivity.id, emissionFactorId: factorId, scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '1', activityUnit: 'kg', emissionFactor: '1', factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg', co2eKg: '200', status: 'FAILED' },
    { organisationId: orgAId, reportingPeriodId: periodA1Id, activityDataId: calculatedActivity.id, emissionFactorId: factorId, scope: 'SCOPE_1', quantity: '1', activityUnit: 'kg', emissionFactor: '1', factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/kg', co2eKg: '900', status: 'CALCULATED' },
  ]);

  const [targetA1] = await db
    .insert(sustainabilityTargetsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: orgAId,
      targetYear: 2030,
      reductionPct: '50.00',
      description: 'Test Target',
    })
    .returning();
  if (!targetA1) throw new Error('Failed to insert targetA1');
  targetA1Id = targetA1.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(sustainabilityTargetsTable).where(eq(sustainabilityTargetsTable.organisationId, orgAId));
  await db.delete(baselinesTable).where(eq(baselinesTable.organisationId, orgAId));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, orgAId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgAId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgNoBaselineId));
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, factorId));
});

function mockRes() {
  const res: any = {
    status: (code: number) => {
      res.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json: (data: any) => {
      res.body = data;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

describe('Targets V1', () => {
  it('should list targets sorted by targetYear ASC', async () => {
    // Insert another target for sorting check
    await db.insert(sustainabilityTargetsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgAId,
      targetYear: 2025,
      reductionPct: '20.00',
    });

    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getTargets({ query: { universityId: orgAId } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.data.length).toBe(2);
    expect(res.body.data[0].targetYear).toBe(2025);
    expect(res.body.data[1].targetYear).toBe(2030);
    expect(res.body.data[0].reductionPct).toBe(20);
    expect(res.body.data[0].targetCo2eKg).toBeNull();
    expect(typeof res.body.data[1].reductionPct).toBe('number');
    expect(res.body.data[1].targetCo2eKg).toBeNull();
    expect(res.body.data[0]).not.toHaveProperty('organisationId');
  });

  it('should use D-2 envelope for POST validation failure', async () => {
    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: 'not-a-uuid',
        targetYear: 1990, // invalid year
        reductionPct: 150, // invalid pct
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.createTarget(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
    expect(res.body.details).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.details.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('should create a target using the latest approved baseline', async () => {
    const req = {
      body: {
        universityId: orgAId,
        targetYear: 2030,
        reductionPct: 50,
      },
    } as Request;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.createTarget(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ universityId: orgAId, targetCo2eKg: 500, status: 'ACTIVE' });
  });

  it('should return exact 400 missing-baseline message for POST', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.createTarget({ body: { universityId: orgNoBaselineId, targetYear: 2030, reductionPct: 50 } } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('No approved baseline found for this university. Target requires a baseline.');
  });

  it('should calculate progress from VERIFIED activities without calculation-status filtering', async () => {
    const req = {
      params: { id: targetA1Id },
      query: { reportingPeriodId: periodA1Id },
    } as any;
    const res = mockRes();

    await controller.getTargetProgress(req, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual({
      baselineTCO2e: 1,
      targetTCO2e: 0,
      currentTCO2e: 0.2,
      achievedReductionTCO2e: 0.8,
      requiredReductionTCO2e: 1,
      progressPercent: 80,
    });
  });

  it('should require universityId for list', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getTargets({ query: {} } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body).toEqual({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
  });

  it('should reject an invalid progress reporting period id', async () => {
    const res = mockRes();
    await controller.getTargetProgress({
      params: { id: targetA1Id },
      query: { reportingPeriodId: 'not-a-uuid' },
    } as any, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.error).toBe('Invalid request body');
    expect(res.body.details[0].field).toBe('reportingPeriodId');
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/universitiesV1.js';

const RUN = Date.now();
let orgId: string;

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return res;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      res.body = payload;
      return res;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `Uni Base ${RUN}`,
    code: `UNI-BASE-${RUN}`,
    type: 'UNIVERSITY',
    status: 'PENDING',
    metadata: { country: 'India', address: '1 Old Road' },
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, orgId));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
});

describe('POST /universities', () => {
  it('creates with metadata flattening and the exact success message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(
      {
        body: {
          name: `New Uni ${RUN}`,
          code: `NEW-${RUN}`,
          email: 'a@b.in',
          address: '2 New St',
          city: 'Mumbai',
          state: 'MH',
          postalCode: '400001',
        },
      } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('University created successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({
      code: `NEW-${RUN}`,
      country: 'India', // V1 default
      address: '2 New St',
      city: 'Mumbai',
      status: 'PENDING',
    });

    const rows = await db.select().from(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    // The created org is outside the afterAll cleanup target; delete explicitly.
    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    void rows;
  }, 10000);

  it('rejects duplicate codes with the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create(
      { body: { name: 'Dup Uni', code: `UNI-BASE-${RUN}` } } as unknown as Request,

    expect(res.body.message).toBe('University with this code already exists');
  });

    await controller.create({ body: { name: 'X', code: '' } } as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Invalid input data');

  });
});

describe('GET /universities', () => {

describe('PATCH /universities/:id', () => {
  it('updates fields, stores into metadata, and reports the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: orgId }, body: { name: 'Uni Renamed', city: 'Pune', status: 'ACTIVE' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('University updated successfully');
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ name: 'Uni Renamed', city: 'Pune', status: 'ACTIVE' });

    const rows = await db.select().from(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
    expect(rows[0]!.metadata).toMatchObject({ city: 'Pune', country: 'India' });
  });

  it('blocks duplicate-code updates', async () => {
    const [other] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
      name: 'Other Uni', code: `OTHER-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
    }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: orgId }, body: { code: `OTHER-${RUN}` } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('University with this code already exists');

    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, other!.id));
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

afterAll(async () => {
```

```typescript
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { eq, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { auditLogsTable, organisationsTable, usersTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import * as controller from '../controllers/usersV1.js';

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  createUser: vi.fn(),
  updateUserName: vi.fn(),
  removeUser: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../services/neonAuthAdmin.js', () => ({
  getIdentityPort: () => mocks,
  NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError: class NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError extends Error {
    name = 'NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError';
    constructor() {
      super('Neon Auth admin operations are unavailable');
    }
  },
}));

const RUN = Date.now();
let orgId: string;
let targetId: string;
let superId: string;
const authT = randomUUID();
const authS = randomUUID();

function resMock() {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: null as unknown,
    status(code: number) { this.statusCode = code; return res; },
    json(payload: unknown) { res.body = payload; return res; },
  };
  return res as unknown as Response & { statusCode?: number; body?: any };
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
    name: `UsrOrg ${RUN}`, code: `USR-${RUN}`, type: 'UNIVERSITY', status: 'ACTIVE',
  }).returning({ id: organisationsTable.id });
  orgId = org!.id;

  // Test-only fixture mirroring Neon Auth's synced directory (no repo migration).
  await db.execute(sql`create schema if not exists neon_auth`);
  await db.execute(sql`
    create table if not exists neon_auth.users_sync (
      id uuid primary key,
      email text,
      raw_user_meta_data jsonb
    );
  `);

  const rows = await db.insert(usersTable).values([
    // Fixture-only values for the NOT NULL username/email/password columns.
    { authUserId: authT, username: `tess-${RUN}`, email: `tess-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: `tess-password-${RUN}`, organisationId: orgId, role: 'USER', status: 'ACTIVE' },
    { authUserId: authS, username: `super-${RUN}`, email: `super-${RUN}@x.dev`, password: `super-password-${RUN}`, organisationId: orgId, role: 'SUPER_ADMIN', status: 'ACTIVE' },
  ]).returning({ id: usersTable.id });
  targetId = rows[0]!.id;
  superId = rows[1]!.id;

  await db.execute(sql`
    insert into neon_auth.users_sync (id, email, raw_user_meta_data) values
      (${authT}::uuid, 't@x.dev', jsonb_build_object('name','Tess Ting')),
      (${authS}::uuid, 's@x.dev', jsonb_build_object('name','Super Visor'));
  `);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await db.delete(auditLogsTable).where(inArray(auditLogsTable.entity, ['User']));
  await db.delete(usersTable).where(inArray(usersTable.id, [targetId, superId]));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, orgId));
  await db.execute(sql`drop schema if exists neon_auth cascade`);
});

describe('GET /users', () => {
  it('joins the synced directory, orders createdAt desc, and applies D-31', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({} as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    // Shared dev DB: restrict assertions to this test's own fixtures.
    const orgUsers = (res.body.data as any[]).filter((u) => u.universityId === orgId);
    expect(orgUsers).toHaveLength(2);

    const target = orgUsers.find((u: any) => u.id === targetId);
    expect(target).toMatchObject({
      email: 't@x.dev',
      firstName: 'Tess',
      lastName: 'Ting',
      universityId: orgId,
      lastLoginAt: null,
    });
    const dates: number[] = orgUsers.map((u: any) => new Date(u.createdAt).getTime());
    expect([...dates].sort((a, b) => b - a)).toEqual(dates);
  });

  it('degrades to local columns when the Neon Auth directory table is missing', async () => {
    await db.execute(sql`drop table neon_auth.users_sync`);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.list({} as unknown as Request, res);
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(Array.isArray(res.body.data)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('POST /users', () => {
  it('creates the identity, links auth_user_id, audits, and returns the V1 subset', async () => {
    // auth_user_id is uuid-typed: the mocked identity must use a valid UUID.
    const newAuthId = randomUUID();
    mocks.createUser.mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: newAuthId });
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { firstName: 'New', lastName: 'User', email: `new-${RUN}@x.dev`, role: 'REVIEWER', universityId: orgId },
      user: { userId: superId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.data).toMatchObject({ firstName: 'New', email: `new-${RUN}@x.dev`, role: 'REVIEWER' });
    expect(res.body.data.password).toBeUndefined(); // no credential leak in response

    const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.authUserId, newAuthId));
    // Schema compatibility: NOT NULL username/email/password satisfied.
    expect(rows[0]!).toMatchObject({
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      organisationId: orgId,
      username: `new-${RUN}@x.dev`, // email used as default username
      email: `new-${RUN}@x.dev`,
    });
    const issuedCredential = String(mocks.createUser.mock.calls[0]![0].password);
    expect(rows[0]!.password).not.toBe(issuedCredential); // stored hashed, not plaintext
    expect(await bcrypt.compare(issuedCredential, rows[0]!.password)).toBe(true);

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, rows[0]!.id));
    expect(audits[0]).toMatchObject({ action: 'CREATE', entity: 'User', description: 'Added new user' });

    expect(mocks.createUser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const arg = mocks.createUser.mock.calls[0]![0];
    expect(arg.email).toBe(`new-${RUN}@x.dev`);
    expect(String(arg.password).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12); // D-30 random credential

    // cleanup created row via its id
    await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, rows[0]!.id));
  });

  it('maps duplicate-email failures from the provider to the exact V1 message', async () => {
    mocks.createUser.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('User with this email already exists'));
    const before = await db.select({ id: usersTable.id }).from(usersTable);

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { firstName: 'Dup', email: `dup-${RUN}@x.dev`, role: 'USER', universityId: orgId },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Email already in use');

    const after = await db.select({ id: usersTable.id }).from(usersTable);
    expect(after.length).toBe(before.length); // no partial insert
  });

  it('creates a local-only user when admin operations are unavailable', async () => {
    const { NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError } = await import('../services/neonAuthAdmin.js');
    mocks.createUser.mockRejectedValueOnce(new NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError());

    const res = resMock();
    await controller.create({
      body: { firstName: 'LocalOnly', email: `localonly-${RUN}@x.dev`, role: 'USER' },
    } as unknown as Request, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(typeof res.body.data.id).toBe('string');

    // Self-linked identity keeps the endpoint functional without the admin API.
    const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, res.body.data.id));
    expect(rows[0]?.authUserId).toBeTruthy();

    await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, res.body.data.id));
  });
});

describe('PATCH /users/:id', () => {
  it('updates application-owned fields and writes old/new audit', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: targetId }, body: { role: 'REVIEWER', status: 'SUSPENDED' }, user: { userId: superId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data.id).toBe(targetId);

    const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, targetId));
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ role: 'REVIEWER', status: 'SUSPENDED' });

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, targetId));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'UPDATE' && a.description === 'Updated user details')).toBe(true);

    // restore for later tests
    await db.update(usersTable).set({ role: 'USER', status: 'ACTIVE' }).where(eq(usersTable.id, targetId));
  });

  it('swallows best-effort name-sync failures (D-32)', async () => {
    mocks.updateUserName.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('sync down'));
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: targetId }, body: { firstName: 'Renamed' }, user: { userId: superId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    if (res.statusCode !== 200) console.log('D32 BODY', JSON.stringify(res.body));
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200); // app contract preserved
  });

  it('404s unknown ids with the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.update(
      { params: { id: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' }, body: { role: 'USER' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('User not found');
  });
});

describe('DELETE /users/:id', () => {
  it('blocks SUPER_ADMIN targets with the exact message', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.remove(
      { params: { id: superId }, user: { userId: superId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('Cannot delete a SUPER_ADMIN account');

    const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, superId));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(mocks.removeUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('audits first, deletes the app row, and returns the message as data', async () => {
    mocks.removeUser.mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined);
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.remove(
      { params: { id: targetId }, user: { userId: superId } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.data).toEqual({ message: 'User deleted successfully' });

    const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, targetId));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(mocks.removeUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(targetId);

    const audits = await db.select().from(auditLogsTable).where(eq(auditLogsTable.entityId, targetId));
    expect(audits.some((a) => a.action === 'DELETE' && a.description === 'Deleted user')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('404s unknown ids', async () => {
    const res = resMock();
    await controller.remove(
      { params: { id: 'f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' } } as unknown as Request,
      res,
    );
    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.message).toBe('User not found');
  });
```

```typescript
import express from "express";
import type { Request, Response } from "express";
import dotenv from "dotenv";
import morgan from "morgan";
import helmet from "helmet";
import slowDown from "express-slow-down";
import cors from 'cors';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from './db/index.js';
import v1Router from './routes/index.js';

dotenv.config();

const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

const limiter = slowDown({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  delayAfter: 10,
  delayMs: (hits) => hits * 200,
  maxDelayMs: 5000,
});

const port = process.env.PORT || 5000;

const app = express();

if (isProduction) {
  app.set('trust proxy', 1);
}

app.use(helmet());

const frontendOrigin = process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN;
app.use(
  cors(
    frontendOrigin
      ? { origin: frontendOrigin.split(',').map((o) => o.trim()) }
      : {},
  ),
);

app.use(morgan(isProduction ? 'combined' : 'dev'));
app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }));

app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.status(200).json({ status: 'ok' });
});

app.get('/health/db', async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    await db.execute(sql`SELECT 1`);
    res.status(200).json({ status: 'ok', database: 'connected' });
  } catch {
    res.status(503).json({ status: 'degraded', database: 'disconnected' });
  }
});

app.use('/api/v1', limiter, v1Router);

app.use((_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: 'Route not found' });
});

// NOTE: the 4th `_next` parameter is required - Express only registers a
// middleware as an error handler when its arity is exactly 4. Without it this
// handler is skipped and errors fall through to the default HTML responder
// (leaking stack traces in production).
app.use((err: unknown, _req: Request, res: Response, _next: unknown) => {
  if (res.headersSent) return;
  console.error('Unhandled error:', err);

  let status = 500;
  let message = 'Internal server error';
  const pgCode =
    (err as { code?: string } | null)?.code ??
    (err as { cause?: { code?: string } } | null)?.cause?.code;
  if (pgCode === '23503') {
    // foreign_key_violation: never leak the underlying SQL to clients
    status = 400;
    message = 'Referenced record does not exist';
  } else if (pgCode === '23505') {
    // unique_violation
    status = 409;
    message = 'Resource already exists';
  } else if (err instanceof SyntaxError && 'body' in (err as object)) {
    // body-parser malformed JSON
    status = 400;
    message = 'Malformed JSON body';
  } else if ((err as { type?: string } | null)?.type === 'entity.too.large') {
    status = 413;
    message = 'Request payload too large';
  } else if (!isProduction && err instanceof Error) {
    message = err.message;
  }

  res.status(status).json({ success: false, message });
});

const server = app
  .listen(port, () => {
    console.log(`SERVER AT ${port}`);
  });

function shutdown() {
  console.log('\nShutting down...');
  server.close(() => {
    console.log('Server closed.');
    process.exit(0);
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.error('Forced shutdown after timeout.');
    process.exit(1);
  }, 5000);
}

process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);
process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);

process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
  console.error('Unhandled promise rejection:', reason);
});

process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
  console.error('Uncaught exception:', err);
  shutdown();
});
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { previewImportBuffer, confirmImportJob } from '../services/activityDataImportV1.js';

const TEMPLATE_CSV = `activityDate,category,quantity,unit,building,floor,description
2026-08-01,PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY,10000,kWh,Main Building,Ground Floor,Monthly electricity
2026-08-02,DIESEL,500,L,Generator,,Generator fuel`;

export function downloadTemplate(_req: Request, res: Response): void {
  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/csv');
  res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename=activity_data_template.csv');
  res.status(200).send(TEMPLATE_CSV);
}

export async function previewImport(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const universityId = req.body.universityId as string;
    const reportingPeriodId = req.body.reportingPeriodId as string;

    if (!universityId || !reportingPeriodId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId and reportingPeriodId are required' });
      return;
    }
    if (!req.file) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'No file uploaded' });
      return;
    }

    const data = await previewImportBuffer(universityId, reportingPeriodId, req.file);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to preview import';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function confirmImport(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const universityId = req.body.universityId as string;
    const reportingPeriodId = req.body.reportingPeriodId as string;
    const jobId = req.body.jobId as string;

    if (!universityId || !reportingPeriodId || !jobId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'Missing required fields' });
      return;
    }

    const user = (req as unknown as { user?: { userId?: string | null } }).user;
    const importedRows = await confirmImportJob({
      universityId,
      reportingPeriodId,
      jobId,
      userId: user?.userId ?? null,
      sourceFileId: typeof req.body.sourceFileId === 'string' ? req.body.sourceFileId : undefined,
      skippedRows: Array.isArray(req.body.skippedRows) ? (req.body.skippedRows as number[]) : undefined,
    });

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'Import confirmed successfully', importedRows });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to confirm import';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { activityDataListQuerySchema } from '../validators/activityDataList.js';
import { getActivityData } from '../services/activityDataList.js';

export async function getActivityDataController(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
): Promise<void> {

  if (!universityId || typeof universityId !== 'string') {
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'universityId is required' });
    return;
  }

  const result = activityDataListQuerySchema.safeParse(req.query);

  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid query parameters',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const list = await getActivityData(result.data);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, ...list });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to fetch activity data',
    });
  }
}

const FORBIDDEN = 'Forbidden: Access restricted to your own university';

export async function getReviewActivitiesController(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const universityId = req.query.universityId as string;
    if (!universityId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
      return;
    }

    const user = (req as unknown as { user?: { role?: string; universityId?: string | null } }).user;
    if (user && user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && user.universityId !== universityId) {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN });
      return;
    }

    const page = req.query.page ? parseInt(req.query.page as string, 10) : 1;
    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : 20;

    const result = await getActivityData({ universityId, page, limit });

    // Preserved V1 quirk (Q-10): the review-status filter runs AFTER pagination,
    // so pages can come back short.
    const reviewData = result.data.filter(
      (a) => a.status === 'DRAFT' || a.status === 'UNDER_REVIEW',
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: reviewData });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to fetch review activities',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import {
  createAsset,
  getAssetById,
  listAssets,
  updateAsset,
} from '../services/hierarchyV1.js';
import { createAssetSchema, updateAssetSchema } from '../validators/assetsV1.js';

export async function create(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const validatedData = createAssetSchema.parse(req.body);
    const asset = await createAsset(validatedData);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, message: 'Asset created successfully', data: asset });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to create asset',
    });
  }
}

export async function list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const page = Math.max(Number(req.query.page) || 1, 1);
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(req.query.limit) || 20, 1), 100);
    const search = typeof req.query.search === 'string' ? req.query.search.trim() : undefined;
    const floorId = typeof req.query.floorId === 'string' ? req.query.floorId : undefined;
    const type = typeof req.query.type === 'string' ? req.query.type : undefined;
    const status = typeof req.query.status === 'string' ? req.query.status : undefined;

    const result = await listAssets({ page, limit, search, floorId, type, status });
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: result.assets, pagination: result.pagination });
  } catch {
    // Preserved V1 quirk: fixed server error on list failures.
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, message: 'Failed to fetch assets' });
  }
}

export async function getById(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const asset = await getAssetById(String(req.params.id));
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: asset });
  } catch (error) {
    // Preserved V1 quirk: any failure becomes a 404 carrying the message.
    res.status(404).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Asset not found',
    });
  }
}

export async function update(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const validatedData = updateAssetSchema.parse(req.body);
    const asset = await updateAsset(id, validatedData);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'Asset updated successfully', data: asset });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update asset',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { auditActionEnum } from '../db/schema/enums.js';
import { getAuditLogs } from '../services/auditLogQuery.js';

const FORBIDDEN = 'Forbidden: Audit logs are restricted to admins';

interface AuthUser {
  role?: string;
  universityId?: string | null;
}

const filtersSchema = z.object({
  universityId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  userId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  action: z.enum(auditActionEnum.enumValues).optional(),
  entity: z.string().optional(),
  entityId: z.string().optional(),
  from: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  to: z.string().datetime().optional(),
});

export async function index(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const user = (req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user;
    if (!user) {
      res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
      return;
    }

    // Preserved V1 quirk: the router-level RBAC admits AUDITOR, but this
    // controller check rejects everyone except SUPER_ADMIN/ORGANISATION_ADMIN
    // (UNIVERSITY_ADMIN is not a valid user_role enum value).
    if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && user.role !== 'ORGANISATION_ADMIN') {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN });
      return;
    }

    const filters = filtersSchema.parse(req.query);

    if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
      // Org admins must be scoped to their own university; without a
      // universityId claim in the token we cannot scope safely -> deny.
      if (!user.universityId) {
        res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN });
        return;
      }
      filters.universityId = user.universityId;
    }

    const result = await getAuditLogs(filters);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join(', ') });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to fetch audit logs',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { loginUser, registerUser, getMe as getMeService } from '../services/authV1.js';
import { loginSchema, registerSchema } from '../validators/authV1.js';

// DEMO-ONLY auth controllers (public routes; no RBAC per D-33).

export async function register(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const data = registerSchema.parse(req.body);
    const result = await registerUser(data);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to register user';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function login(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const data = loginSchema.parse(req.body);
    const result = await loginUser(data);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to login';
    if (message === 'Invalid email or password') {
      res.status(401).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

// Authenticated endpoint — returns the current user profile + organisation
// status so the frontend can determine whether to show onboarding or dashboard.
export async function me(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const userId = (req as unknown as { user?: { userId?: string } }).user?.userId;
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
    return;
  }
  try {
    const data = await getMeService(userId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to fetch user';
    if (message === 'User not found') {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { createBaselineSchema } from '../validators/baselinesV1.js';
import * as baselinesService from '../services/baselinesV1.js';

function validationError(res: Response, details: { field: string; message: string }[]) {
  res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Invalid request body', details });
}

export async function createBaseline(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = createBaselineSchema.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!result.success) {
    validationError(res, result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({ field: issue.path.join('.'), message: issue.message })));
    return;

  try {
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { calculateForActivity } from '../services/calculationV1.js';

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

export async function calculateActivityController(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
): Promise<void> {
  const activityId = req.params.activityId as string;
  if (!UUID_RE.test(activityId)) {
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'Activity data not found' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const data = await calculateForActivity(activityId);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to calculate activity',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
  getRecentActivity,
  getActivityStats,
  getTargets,
  getGroupBreakdown,
} from '../services/dashboardV1.js';

function errorResponse(res: Response, e: unknown): void {
  res.status(400).json({
    success: false,
    message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Request failed',
  });
}

export const getSummary = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const universityId = req.query.universityId ? String(req.query.universityId) : '';
    if (!universityId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
      return;
    }

    let reportingPeriodId = req.query.reportingPeriodId ? String(req.query.reportingPeriodId) : '';
    const campusId = req.query.campusId ? String(req.query.campusId) : undefined;
    const buildingId = req.query.buildingId ? String(req.query.buildingId) : undefined;
    const floorId = req.query.floorId ? String(req.query.floorId) : undefined;
    if (!reportingPeriodId) {
      const defaultPeriod = await getDefaultReportingPeriod(universityId);
      if (defaultPeriod) reportingPeriodId = defaultPeriod;
      else {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          message: 'No active reporting period found for this university',
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    const [
      overview,

      floors,
      trends,
      baseline,
      intensity,
      recentActivity,
      activityStats,
      targets,
      groups,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      getOverview(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),
      getScopeBreakdown(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),
      getCategoryBreakdown(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),
      getTopSources(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),

      getBaselineComparison(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),
      getIntensityMetrics(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),
      getRecentActivity(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      getActivityStats(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      getTargets(universityId),
      getGroupBreakdown(universityId, reportingPeriodId, campusId, buildingId, floorId),
    ]);

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        overview,
        scopeBreakdown,
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { getDataQualityMetrics } from '../services/dataQualityV1.js';
import type { DataQualityFilters } from '../services/dataQualityV1.js';

export const getMetricsController = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const universityId = req.query.universityId as string;
    if (!universityId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
      return;
    }

    // V1 quirk preserved: campusId/buildingId are accepted but never applied
    // to the query (dataQuality.controller.ts:24-25 feeds them into filters,
    // dataQuality.service.ts never reads them).
    const filters: DataQualityFilters = {};
    if (req.query.reportingPeriodId) filters.reportingPeriodId = req.query.reportingPeriodId as string;
    if (req.query.scope) filters.scope = req.query.scope as string;
    if (req.query.category) filters.category = req.query.category as string;
    if (req.query.campusId) filters.campusId = req.query.campusId as string;
    if (req.query.buildingId) filters.buildingId = req.query.buildingId as string;

    const metrics = await getDataQualityMetrics(universityId, filters);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: metrics });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to fetch metrics',
    });
  }
};
```
