SHA-256: `df00b6699bdda7a64352d3d64f9bb55b17d853e0b697e54a46fd76eeafc94471`

```typescript
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { uploadDocumentBodySchema } from '../validators/documentsV1.js';
import {
  createActivityFromOcr,
  deleteDocument,
  getDocumentById,
  getDocuments,
  getDocumentsByActivityId,
  runMockOcr,
} from '../services/documentsV1.js';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { documentsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import { getPublicUrl, uploadFile } from '../services/storage.js';

const FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE = 'Forbidden: Access restricted to your own university';

interface AuthUser {
  role?: string;
  universityId?: string | null;
  userId?: string | null;
}

function checkIsolation(req: Request, organisationId: string): void {
  const user = (req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user;
  if (!user) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: User not authenticated');
  }
  if (user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return;
  }
  if (user.universityId !== organisationId) {
    throw new Error(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
  }
}

function isForbidden(e: unknown): boolean {
  return e instanceof Error && e.message === FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE;
}

export async function upload(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    if (!req.file) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'No file uploaded' });
      return;
    }

    const parsed = uploadDocumentBodySchema.safeParse(req.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid input data',
        errors: parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
          field: issue.path.join('.'),
          message: issue.message,
        })),
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      checkIsolation(req, parsed.data.universityId);
    } catch (e) {
      if (isForbidden(e)) {
        res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE });
        return;
      }
      throw e;
    }

    const userId =
      ((req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user?.userId ?? null) as string | null;

    // D-27: V1 uploaded to bucket "carbonsynq-documents"; normalized to the V2 "documents" bucket.
    const uniqueFileName = buildUniqueFileName(req.file.originalname);
    const storagePath = `universities/${parsed.data.universityId}/invoices/${uniqueFileName}`;

    await uploadFile('documents', storagePath, req.file.buffer, req.file.mimetype);
    const publicUrl = getPublicUrl('documents', storagePath);

    const [document] = await db
      .insert(documentsTable)
      .values({
        organisationId: parsed.data.universityId,
        activityDataId: parsed.data.activityDataId ?? null,
        documentType: parsed.data.documentType,
        fileName: uniqueFileName,
        originalName: req.file.originalname,
        fileUrl: publicUrl,
        mimeType: req.file.mimetype,
        fileSize: req.file.size,
        storagePath,
        publicUrl,
        status: 'UPLOADED',
        description: parsed.data.description ?? null,
        uploadedById: userId,
      })
      .returning();
    if (!document) throw new Error('Failed to create document');

    await createAuditLog({
      action: 'DOCUMENT_UPLOADED',
      entity: 'Document',
      entityId: document.id,
      userId,
      organisationId: parsed.data.universityId,
      metadata: { originalName: req.file.originalname, mimeType: req.file.mimetype },
      description: 'Document uploaded',
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,

        documentId: document.id,

      },
    });

    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });

function buildUniqueFileName(originalname: string): string {
  const fileExt = originalname.split('.').pop();

  try {
    const universityId = req.body.universityId as string;
    if (!universityId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required in body' });
      return;
    }

    try {
      checkIsolation(req, universityId);

        res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE });
        return;
      }

    }

    const documentId = String(req.params.id);

      userId: (req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user?.userId ?? null,
      organisationId: universityId,

      action: 'OCR_COMPLETED',
      entity: 'Document',

      userId: (req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user?.userId ?? null,
      organisationId: universityId,
      metadata: { result },

    });

  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to process OCR';

      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { emissionCalculationSchema } from '../validators/emissionCalculation.js';
import { calculateEmission } from '../services/emissionCalculation.js';

export async function calculateEmissionController(
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
): Promise<void> {
  const result = emissionCalculationSchema.safeParse(req.body);

  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const calcResult = await calculateEmission(result.data.activity_data_id);

    if (calcResult.status === 404) {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: (calcResult.data as { error: string }).error });
      return;
    }

    if (calcResult.status === 400) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, ...(calcResult.data as { error: string; details?: unknown }) });
      return;
    }

    // 200 — may be 'calculated', 'no_match', or 'ambiguous'
    const data = calcResult.data as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (data.status === 'calculated') {
      res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
    } else {
      res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Internal server error',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { emissionFactorsImportSchema } from '../validators/emissionFactorImport.js';
import { importEmissionFactors } from '../services/emissionFactorImport.js';

export async function importEmissionFactorsController(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse(req.body);

  if (!result.success) {
    const errors = result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
      index: typeof issue.path[0] === 'number' ? issue.path[0] : -1,
      field: issue.path.slice(1).join('.'),
      message: issue.message,
    }));
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      summary: { received: 0, inserted: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 },
      errors,
    });
    return;
  }

  const importResult = await importEmissionFactors(result.data);

  if (importResult.errors.length > 0) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      summary: importResult.summary,
      errors: importResult.errors,
    });
    return;
  }

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    summary: importResult.summary,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  documentsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import { uploadFile } from '../services/storage.js';
import { processImportBuffer } from '../services/importsV1.js';

const ISOLATION_MESSAGE = 'Access denied: University isolation mismatch';

function assertModuleIsolation(req: Request, targetUniversityId: string): void {
  const jwtUniversityId = (req as unknown as { user?: { universityId?: string | null } }).user?.universityId;
  if (jwtUniversityId && jwtUniversityId !== targetUniversityId) {
    throw new Error(ISOLATION_MESSAGE);
  }
}

export async function testStorageUpload(_req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const testContent = Buffer.from('CarbonSynq Storage Test OK');
    const result = await uploadFile('imports', `test/test-file-${Date.now()}.txt`, testContent, 'text/plain');
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'Storage test successful', data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Storage test failed',
    });
  }
}

export async function handleUpload(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    if (!req.file) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'No file uploaded' });
      return;
    }

    const universityId = req.body.universityId;
    const reportingPeriodId = req.body.reportingPeriodId;

    if (!universityId || !reportingPeriodId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId and reportingPeriodId are required' });
      return;
    }

    try {
      assertModuleIsolation(req, universityId);
    } catch {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: ISOLATION_MESSAGE });
      return;
    }

    const { originalname, buffer, mimetype, size } = req.file;
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const filePath = `${universityId}/${year}/${timestamp}-${originalname}`;

    const uploadResult = await uploadFile('imports', filePath, buffer, mimetype);

    const [document] = await db
      .insert(documentsTable)
      .values({
        organisationId: universityId,
        documentType: 'OTHER',
        fileName: `${timestamp}-${originalname}`,
        originalName: originalname,
        fileUrl: uploadResult.path,
        storagePath: uploadResult.path,
        mimeType: mimetype,
        fileSize: size,
      })
      .returning();
    if (!document) throw new Error('Failed to create document');

    const parsedData = processImportBuffer(buffer);

    await createAuditLog({
      action: 'IMPORT',
      entity: 'Document',
      entityId: document.id,
      organisationId: universityId,
      metadata: { fileName: originalname, fileSize: size, validRows: parsedData.validCount },
      description: 'Excel/CSV import file uploaded and parsed for preview',
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'File uploaded, parsed and validated',
      data: {
        documentId: document.id,
        ...parsedData,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to upload import';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

const SCOPE_2_CATEGORIES = ['PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', 'PURCHASED_STEAM', 'PURCHASED_HEATING', 'PURCHASED_COOLING'];

function determineScope(category: string): 'SCOPE_1' | 'SCOPE_2' {
  return SCOPE_2_CATEGORIES.includes(category) ? 'SCOPE_2' : 'SCOPE_1';
}

export async function confirmImport(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const documentId = String(req.params.id);
    const validRows = req.body.validRows;
    const universityId = req.body.universityId;
    const reportingPeriodId = req.body.reportingPeriodId;

    if (!documentId || !validRows || !universityId || !reportingPeriodId) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'documentId (in path), validRows, universityId, reportingPeriodId are required',
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      assertModuleIsolation(req, universityId);
    } catch {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: ISOLATION_MESSAGE });
      return;
    }

    const documentRows = await db.select().from(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, documentId)).limit(1);
    const document = documentRows[0];
    if (!document) {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: 'Document not found' });
      return;
    }

    if (document.organisationId !== universityId) {
      res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Access denied: Document does not belong to the specified university',
      });
      return;
    }

    // D-25: floors are scoped to the requested organisation (V1 leaked across universities).
    const buildings = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id, name: physicalEntitiesTable.name })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, universityId));
    const buildingByName = new Map(buildings.map((b) => [b.name.toLowerCase(), b.id]));

    const floors = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id, name: physicalEntitiesTable.name })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, universityId));
    const floorByName = new Map(floors.map((f) => [f.name.toLowerCase(), f.id]));

    const activityDataToInsert = (validRows as Record<string, unknown>[]).map((row) => {
      const category = row['Activity Category'] as string;
      const scope = determineScope(category);
      const buildingName = row.Building != null ? String(row.Building).toLowerCase() : '';
      const floorName = row.Floor != null ? String(row.Floor).toLowerCase() : '';
      const matchedBuildingId = buildingName ? buildingByName.get(buildingName) : undefined;
      const matchedFloorId = floorName ? floorByName.get(floorName) : undefined;

      return {
        organisationId: universityId,
        reportingPeriodId,
        category: category as never,
        scope: scope as never,
        quantity: String(row.Quantity),
        unit: String(row.Unit),
        activityDate: new Date(row['Activity Date'] as string),
        description: (row.Description as string) ?? null,
        status: 'DRAFT' as never,
        inputSource: 'EXCEL' as never,
        sourceFileId: document.id,
        sourceFileName: document.originalName,
        sourceDocumentUrl: document.publicUrl || document.fileUrl,
        physicalEntityId: matchedFloorId ?? matchedBuildingId ?? null,
      };
    });

    const inserted = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values(activityDataToInsert).returning({ id: activityDataTable.id });
    const insertedCount = inserted.length;

    await db.update(documentsTable).set({ status: 'PROCESSED' }).where(eq(documentsTable.id, document.id));

    await createAuditLog({
      action: 'IMPORT_COMPLETED',
      entity: 'Document',
      entityId: document.id,
      organisationId: universityId,
      metadata: { insertedCount },
      description: 'Import preview confirmed, DRAFT activity data created',
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Import confirmed and activity data created as DRAFT',
      data: { insertedCount },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to confirm import';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}
```

```typescript
        errors: paramResult.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
          field: issue.path.join('.'),
          message: issue.message,
        })),
      });
      return;

    const userId = requireUserId(req);
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import {
  findSecretLikeKeys,
  onboardingPayloadSchema,
} from '../validators/onboardingV1.js';
import type { OnboardingPayload } from '../validators/onboardingV1.js';
import {
  ONBOARDING_ALREADY_EXISTS,
  ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND,
  createOnboarding,
  getOnboarding,
  getPhysicalHierarchy,
  upsertOnboarding,
} from '../services/onboardingV1.js';

interface AuthUser {
  userId?: string | null;
}

function requireUserId(req: Request): string | null {
  return (req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user?.userId ?? null;
}

// Reject credential-like keys anywhere in the payload, then run the zod
// schema. On failure responds 400 with per-field details and returns null.
function parsePayload(req: Request, res: Response): OnboardingPayload | null {
  const secretKeys = findSecretLikeKeys(req.body);
  if (secretKeys.length > 0) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: [
        {
          field: secretKeys.join(', '),
          message: 'Credential-like fields are not allowed in onboarding data',
        },
      ],
    });
    return null;
  }

  const result = onboardingPayloadSchema.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return null;
  }
  return result.data;
}

// Shared mapping from service errors to the API's status conventions.
function sendServiceError(res: Response, error: unknown, fallback: string): void {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : fallback;
  if (message === 'Unauthorized') {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message });
    return;
  }
  if (message === ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND) {
    res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
    return;
  }
  if (message === ONBOARDING_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
    res.status(409).json({ success: false, message });
    return;
  }
  // Unexpected failure: log server-side without leaking database internals.
  console.error('Onboarding request failed:', error);
  res.status(500).json({ success: false, message: fallback });
}

export async function get(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const userId = requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
    return;
  }
  try {
    const data = await getOnboarding(userId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    sendServiceError(res, error, 'Failed to fetch onboarding profile');
  }
}

export async function create(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const userId = requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
    return;
  }
  const payload = parsePayload(req, res);
  if (!payload) return;
  try {
    const data = await createOnboarding(userId, payload);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    sendServiceError(res, error, 'Failed to create onboarding profile');
  }
}

export async function upsert(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const userId = requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
    return;
  }
  const payload = parsePayload(req, res);
  if (!payload) return;
  try {
    const data = await upsertOnboarding(userId, payload);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    sendServiceError(res, error, 'Failed to update onboarding profile');
  }
}

// GET /onboarding/hierarchy
// Returns the full Campus → Building → Floor hierarchy for the authenticated
// user's organisation. Used by the Activity Data form's cascading dropdowns.
export async function getHierarchy(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const userId = requireUserId(req);
  if (!userId) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Unauthorized' });
    return;
  }
  try {
    const data = await getPhysicalHierarchy(userId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    sendServiceError(res, error, 'Failed to fetch physical hierarchy');
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  generateRecommendations,
  getRecommendationById,
  listRecommendations,
  updateRecommendationStatus,
} from '../services/recommendationsV1.js';

const FORBIDDEN = 'Forbidden: Access restricted to your own university';

const querySchema = z.object({
  universityId: z.string().uuid('Invalid university ID'),
});

export async function list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const query = querySchema.parse(req.query);
    const priority = typeof req.query.priority === 'string' ? req.query.priority : undefined;
    const category = typeof req.query.category === 'string' ? req.query.category : undefined;
    const status = typeof req.query.status === 'string' ? req.query.status : undefined;

    const data = await listRecommendations({ ...query, priority, category, status });
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid input data',
        errors: error.issues.map((issue) => ({
          field: issue.path.join('.'),
          message: issue.message,
        })),
      });
      return;
    }
    if ((error as Error).message === FORBIDDEN) {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to fetch recommendations',
    });
  }
}

export async function getById(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const data = await getRecommendationById(String(req.params.id));
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to fetch recommendation';
    if (message === 'Recommendation not found') {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function patchStatus(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const { status } = req.body as { status?: string };
    const data = await updateRecommendationStatus(id, String(status));
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update recommendation';
    if (message === 'Recommendation not found') {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    // V1 surfaced the invalid-status domain error through the raw global handler.
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function generate(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const universityId = req.body.universityId;
    const reportingPeriodId = req.body.reportingPeriodId;

    if (!universityId || !reportingPeriodId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId and reportingPeriodId are required' });
      return;
    }

    const data = await generateRecommendations(universityId, reportingPeriodId);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to generate recommendations',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import {
  generateReportSchema,
  getReportsSchema,
  reportIdParamSchema,
} from '../validators/reportsV1.js';
import * as reportsService from '../services/reportsV1.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import { getPublicUrl } from '../services/storage.js';

const FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE = 'Forbidden: Access restricted to your own university';

interface AuthUser {
  role?: string;
  universityId?: string | null;
}

function checkIsolation(req: Request, organisationId: string): void {
  const user = (req as unknown as { user?: AuthUser }).user;
  if (!user) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized: User not authenticated');
  }
  if (user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
    return;
  }
  if (user.universityId !== organisationId) {
    throw new Error(FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
  }
}

function isForbidden(e: unknown): boolean {
  return e instanceof Error && e.message === FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE;
}

export async function generate(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = generateReportSchema.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const data = await reportsService.generateReport(result.data.universityId, result.data.reportingPeriodId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to create report';
    const status = message === 'University or Reporting Period not found' ? 404 : 400;
    res.status(status).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function generatePdf(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = reportIdParamSchema.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const data = await reportsService.generateReportPdf(result.data.id);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data, message: 'PDF report generated successfully' });
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to generate PDF report';
    if (message === 'Report not found') {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = getReportsSchema.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const data = await reportsService.getReports(result.data.universityId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to fetch reports',
    });
  }
}

export async function getSingle(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = reportIdParamSchema.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const data = await reportsService.getReportById(result.data.id);
    checkIsolation(req, data.universityId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to fetch report';
    if (message === 'Report not found' || isForbidden(e)) {
      const status = message === 'Report not found' ? 404 : 403;
      res.status(status).json({ success: false, message: isForbidden(e) ? FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE : message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function downloadReport(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = reportIdParamSchema.safeParse(req.params);
  if (!result.success) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid request body',
      details: result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
        field: issue.path.join('.'),
        message: issue.message,
      })),
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const report = await reportsService.findReportById(result.data.id);

    if (!report || report.status !== 'GENERATED' || !report.filePath) {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: 'Report not found or not ready' });
      return;
    }

    checkIsolation(req, report.universityId);

    await createAuditLog({
      action: 'REPORT_DOWNLOADED',
      entity: 'Report',
      entityId: report.id,
      organisationId: report.universityId,
      metadata: { fileName: report.fileName },
      description: 'Report downloaded',
    });

    const url = getPublicUrl('reports', report.filePath);

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, url });
  } catch (e) {
    if (isForbidden(e)) {
      res.status(403).json({ success: false, message: FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE });
      return;
    }
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to download report';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}
```

```typescript
  try {
    const data = await targetsService.getTargetProgress({
      targetId,
      reportingPeriodId: result.data.reportingPeriodId,
    });
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (e) {
    const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to get target progress';
    const status = message === 'Target not found' || message === 'Approved baseline not found' || message === 'Reporting period not found' ? 404 : 400;
    res.status(status).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function getTargets(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const universityId = String(req.query.universityId);
    if (!req.query.universityId) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'universityId is required' });
      return;
    }

    const data = await targetsService.getTargets(universityId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to fetch targets',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { taxonomyImportSchema } from '../validators/taxonomyImport.js';
import { importTaxonomy } from '../services/taxonomyImport.js';

export async function importTaxonomyController(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  const result = taxonomyImportSchema.safeParse(req.body);

  if (!result.success) {
    const errors = result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
      index: -1,
      field: issue.path.join('.'),
      message: issue.message,
    }));
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      summary: { received: 0, inserted: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0 },
      errors,
    });
    return;
  }

  const importResult = await importTaxonomy(result.data);

  if (importResult.errors.length > 0) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      summary: importResult.summary,
      errors: importResult.errors,
    });
    return;
  }

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    summary: importResult.summary,
  });
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  createUniversity,
  getUniversities,
  getUniversityById,
  updateUniversity,
} from '../services/universitiesV1.js';

const createSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2, 'University name is required'),
  code: z.string().min(2, 'University code is required').max(50),
  email: z.string().email().optional(),
  phone: z.string().optional(),
  website: z.string().url().optional(),
  address: z.string().optional(),
  city: z.string().optional(),
  state: z.string().optional(),
  country: z.string().default('India'),
  postalCode: z.string().optional(),
});

const updateSchema = createSchema.partial().extend({
  status: z.enum(['ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'PENDING']).optional(),
});

function validationIssues(error: z.ZodError) {
  return error.issues.map((issue) => ({
    field: issue.path.join('.'),
    message: issue.message,
  }));
}

export async function create(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const data = createSchema.parse(req.body);
    const university = await createUniversity(data);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, message: 'University created successfully', data: university });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid input data',
        errors: validationIssues(error),
      });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to create university',
    });
  }
}

export async function list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const page = Math.max(Number(req.query.page) || 1, 1);
    const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(req.query.limit) || 20, 1), 100);
    const search = typeof req.query.search === 'string' ? req.query.search.trim() : undefined;
    const status =
      typeof req.query.status === 'string'
        ? (req.query.status as 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'PENDING')
        : undefined;

    const result = await getUniversities({ page, limit, search, status });
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: result.universities, pagination: result.pagination });
  } catch {
    // Preserved V1 quirk: list failures surfaced a bare 500-style message.
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, message: 'Failed to fetch universities' });
  }
}

export async function getById(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const university = await getUniversityById(String(req.params.id));
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: university });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(404).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to fetch university',
    });
  }
}

export async function update(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const data = updateSchema.parse(req.body);
    const university = await updateUniversity(String(req.params.id), data);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'University updated successfully', data: university });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Invalid input data',
        errors: validationIssues(error),
      });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update university',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  createStatistic,
  deleteStatistic,
  getStatistics,
  updateStatistic,
} from '../services/universityStatisticsV1.js';

const createSchema = z.object({
  universityId: z.string().uuid('Invalid university ID'),
  reportingPeriodId: z.string().uuid('Invalid reporting period ID'),
  studentCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
  staffCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
  totalAreaSqm: z.number().nonnegative().optional(),
});
const updateSchema = z.object({
  studentCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
  staffCount: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional(),
  totalAreaSqm: z.number().nonnegative().optional(),
});
const idParamSchema = z.object({ id: z.string().uuid('Invalid statistic ID') });

export async function list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const universityId = req.query.universityId as string;
    if (!universityId) throw new Error('universityId is required');
    const data = await getStatistics(universityId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch {
    // Preserved V1 quirk: the missing-universityId message is swallowed here.
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'Failed to fetch statistics' });
  }
}

export async function create(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const parsed = createSchema.safeParse(req.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'Failed to create statistic' });
      return;
    }
    const data = await createStatistic(req.body as Record<string, unknown>);
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to create statistic';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: message.startsWith('Failed to') ? message : 'Failed to create statistic' });
  }
}

export async function update(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const parsed = idParamSchema.safeParse(req.params);
    if (!parsed.success || updateSchema.safeParse(req.body).success === false) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'Failed to update statistic' });
      return;
    }
    const data = await updateStatistic(String(req.params.id), req.body as Record<string, unknown>);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update statistic';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: message.startsWith('Failed to') ? message : 'Failed to update statistic' });
  }
}

export async function remove(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const parsed = idParamSchema.safeParse(req.params);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: 'Failed to delete statistic' });
      return;
    }
    await deleteStatistic(String(req.params.id));
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'Deleted successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to delete statistic';
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: message.startsWith('Failed to') ? message : 'Failed to delete statistic' });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { usersTable } from '../db/schema/users.js';
import {
  createUser,
  deleteUser,
  listUsers,
  updateUser,
} from '../services/usersV1.js';
import { createUserSchema, updateUserSchema } from '../validators/usersV1.js';

// D-33: RBAC/session enforcement is intentionally DEFERRED for the demo phase.

export async function list(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // Resolve the caller's organisationId so we only return same-org users.
    const authUser = (req as unknown as { user?: { userId?: string } }).user;
    let organisationId: string | null = null;
    if (authUser?.userId) {
      const rows = await db
        .select({ organisationId: usersTable.organisationId })
        .from(usersTable)
        .where(eq(usersTable.id, authUser.userId))
        .limit(1);
      organisationId = rows[0]?.organisationId ?? null;
    }
    const data = await listUsers(organisationId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to fetch users',
    });
  }
}

export async function create(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const data = createUserSchema.parse(req.body);
    const adminId =
      (req as unknown as { user?: { userId?: string | null } }).user?.userId ?? null;
    const result = await createUser({ ...data, adminId });
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to create user';
    if (message === 'Email already in use' || message.startsWith('Neon Auth')) {
      res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function update(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const data = updateUserSchema.parse(req.body);
    const adminId =
      (req as unknown as { user?: { userId?: string | null } }).user?.userId ?? null;
    const result = await updateUser(id, data, adminId);
    void result;
    // Preserved V1 shape: controller returns only the envelope (service already
    // audited old/new); V1 responded with the updated subset.
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: { id },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to update user';
    if (message === 'User not found') {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}

export async function remove(req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const id = String(req.params.id);
    const adminId =
      (req as unknown as { user?: { userId?: string | null } }).user?.userId ?? null;
    const data = await deleteUser(id, adminId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to delete user';
    if (message === 'User not found') {
      res.status(404).json({ success: false, message });
      return;
    }
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, message });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import postgres from 'postgres';

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL!;
const client = postgres(connectionString, { prepare: false });

async function main() {
  const snakeCaseTables = [
    'organisations', 'users', 'physical_entities',
    'reporting_periods', 'activity_data', 'emission_factors', 'calculations',
    'sustainability_targets', 'documents', 'import_jobs', 'audit_logs',
    'recommendations', 'reports',
    'taxonomy_versions', 'taxonomy_activities',
  ];

  console.log('Verifying Drizzle tables exist...');
  const tables = await client`
    SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
    ORDER BY tablename
  `;
  const existing = tables.map((r) => r.tablename);
  for (const t of snakeCaseTables) {
    const found = existing.includes(t);
    console.log(`  ${found ? 'OK' : 'MISSING'}: ${t}`);
  }

  console.log('\nChecking FK constraints on key tables...');
  const fks = await client`
    SELECT
      tc.table_name,
      kcu.column_name,
      ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name,
      rc.delete_rule
    FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
    JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
      ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
      AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
    JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu
      ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
      AND ccu.table_schema = tc.table_schema
    JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints rc
      ON rc.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
      AND rc.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema
    WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
      AND tc.table_schema = 'public'
      AND tc.table_name IN ('users', 'physical_entities', 'activity_data', 'calculations')
    ORDER BY tc.table_name, kcu.column_name
  `;
  for (const fk of fks) {
    console.log(`  ${fk.table_name}.${fk.column_name} -> ${fk.foreign_table_name} (${fk.delete_rule})`);
  }

  await client.end();
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('Error:', e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

### 95. `original-neon-backend/src/db/index.ts`

SHA-256: `19b7a14c439761c8da2f72309c02003732bb91427a12764d0c8d3b5be19eca4a`

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import dns from 'node:dns';
import { drizzle } from 'drizzle-orm/neon-http';
import { neonConfig } from '@neondatabase/serverless';

// Neon endpoints resolve to both IPv6 and IPv4; on hosts with broken/slow IPv6
// routing (common on Windows), undici hangs until connect-timeout. Prefer A records.
dns.setDefaultResultOrder('ipv4first');

const databaseUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;

if (!databaseUrl) {
  throw new Error('DATABASE_URL environment variable is required');
}

const MAX_FETCH_ATTEMPTS = 3;

/**
 * Retrying fetch for the Neon HTTP driver. A rejected fetch means the request
 * never reached the server (DNS/connect/TLS failure), so retrying is safe even
 * for writes. Server-side errors arrive as normal responses and are not retried.
 */
async function retryingFetch(input: Parameters<typeof fetch>[0], init?: Parameters<typeof fetch>[1]): Promise<Response> {
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await fetch(input, init);
    } catch (error) {
      if (attempt >= MAX_FETCH_ATTEMPTS) throw error;
      const cause = (error as { cause?: { message?: string; code?: string } })?.cause;
      const text = [error instanceof Error ? error.message : '', cause?.message ?? '', cause?.code ?? '']
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase();
      const retriable =
        /fetch failed|connect timeout|connecterror|econnreset|econnrefused|etimedout|eai_again|enotfound|socket|network/.test(
          text,
        );
      if (!retriable) throw error;
      console.warn(`Neon HTTP request failed (attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_FETCH_ATTEMPTS}), retrying: ${text.trim()}`);
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150 * 2 ** (attempt - 1)));
    }
  }
}

// Applied globally: drizzle(string) builds its own neon client, which reads
// neonConfig (including fetchFunction) at request time.
neonConfig.fetchFunction = retryingFetch;

export const db = drizzle(databaseUrl);
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import postgres from 'postgres';

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL!;
const sql = postgres(connectionString, { prepare: false });

async function inspect() {
  try {
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. ALL tables in public schema with row counts
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('1. ALL TABLES IN PUBLIC SCHEMA WITH ROW COUNTS');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    try {
      const tables = await sql.unsafe(`
        SELECT tablename,
               (xpath('/rowcount/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) FROM %I', tablename), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS row_count
        FROM pg_tables
        WHERE schemaname = 'public'
        ORDER BY tablename
      `);
      console.table(tables);
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('query_to_xml method failed, falling back to simple counts...');
      console.error(String(e));
      const tableNames = await sql.unsafe(`
        SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename
      `);
      for (const row of tableNames) {
        const count = await sql.unsafe(`SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM "${row.tablename}"`);
        console.log(`  ${row.tablename}: ${count[0]?.row_count}`);
      }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Column names and types for each table
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('2. COLUMN NAMES AND TYPES FOR EACH TABLE');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    const targetTables = [
      'organisations', 'users', 'physical_entities',
      'reporting_periods', 'activity_data', 'emission_factors', 'calculations',
      'sustainability_targets', 'documents', 'import_jobs', 'audit_logs',
      'recommendations', 'reports',
      'taxonomy_versions', 'taxonomy_activities',
    ];

    for (const tableName of targetTables) {
      console.log(`\n--- Table: ${tableName} ---`);
      try {
        const cols = await sql.unsafe(`
          SELECT column_name, data_type, udt_name, is_nullable, column_default
          FROM information_schema.columns
          WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = $1
          ORDER BY ordinal_position
        `, [tableName]);
        if (cols.length === 0) {
          console.log('  TABLE DOES NOT EXIST');
        } else {
          console.table(cols);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`  ERROR: ${String(e)}`);
      }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. ALL foreign key constraints
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('3. ALL FOREIGN KEY CONSTRAINTS');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    const fkeys = await sql.unsafe(`
      SELECT tc.table_name, kcu.column_name, ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name, ccu.column_name AS foreign_column_name, rc.delete_rule
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
      JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name AND ccu.table_schema = tc.table_schema
      JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints rc ON rc.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name AND rc.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema
      WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY' AND tc.table_schema = 'public'
      ORDER BY tc.table_name, kcu.column_name
    `);
    if (fkeys.length === 0) {
      console.log('  NO FOREIGN KEY CONSTRAINTS FOUND');
    } else {
      console.table(fkeys);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. ALL unique constraints
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('4. ALL UNIQUE CONSTRAINTS');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    const uniques = await sql.unsafe(`
      SELECT tc.constraint_name, tc.table_name, kcu.column_name
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
      WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'UNIQUE' AND tc.table_schema = 'public'
      ORDER BY tc.table_name, kcu.column_name
    `);
    if (uniques.length === 0) {
      console.log('  NO UNIQUE CONSTRAINTS FOUND');
    } else {
      console.table(uniques);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. ALL enum types
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('5. ALL ENUM TYPES');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    const enums = await sql.unsafe(`
      SELECT t.typname, array_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) AS values
      FROM pg_type t
      JOIN pg_enum e ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
      GROUP BY t.typname
      ORDER BY t.typname
    `);
    if (enums.length === 0) {
      console.log('  NO ENUM TYPES FOUND');
    } else {
      console.table(enums);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Sample rows (first 3) from tables with data
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('6. SAMPLE ROWS (FIRST 3) FROM TABLES WITH DATA');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    const allTables = await sql.unsafe(`
      SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename
    `);
    for (const row of allTables) {
      const tableName = row.tablename as string;
      try {
        const countResult = await sql.unsafe(`SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM "${tableName}"`);
        const cnt = Number(countResult[0]?.cnt ?? 0);
        if (cnt > 0) {
          console.log(`\n--- ${tableName} (${cnt} rows total) ---`);
          const sample = await sql.unsafe(`SELECT * FROM "${tableName}" LIMIT 3`);
          console.table(sample);
        } else {
          console.log(`\n--- ${tableName} (0 rows) ---`);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`\n--- ${tableName}: ERROR: ${String(e)} ---`);
      }
    }

  } catch (e) {
    console.error('FATAL ERROR:', e);
  } finally {
    await sql.end();
  }
}

inspect();
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import postgres from 'postgres';

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL!;
const client = postgres(connectionString, { prepare: false });

const EXPECTED_TABLES = [
  'organisations', 'users', 'physical_entities',
  'reporting_periods', 'activity_data', 'emission_factors', 'calculations',
  'sustainability_targets', 'documents', 'import_jobs', 'audit_logs',
  'recommendations', 'reports',
  'taxonomy_versions', 'taxonomy_activities',
];

const NEW_ENUMS = [
  'organisation_type', 'organisation_status',
  'physical_entity_type', 'physical_entity_subtype', 'physical_entity_status',
  'recommendation_status', 'sustainability_target_status',
  'taxonomy_activity_status',
];

const OLD_ENUMS = [
  'university_status', 'asset_status', 'asset_type', 'baseline_status',
];

async function main() {
  // ── 1. List all tables in public schema ──
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  1. ALL TABLES IN PUBLIC SCHEMA');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  const allTables = await client`
    SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
    ORDER BY tablename
  `;
  if (allTables.length === 0) {
    console.log('  (no tables found)');
  } else {
    for (const row of allTables) {
      console.log(`  - ${row.tablename}`);
    }
  }
  console.log(`  Total: ${allTables.length} table(s)\n`);

  // ── 2. Row counts for expected tables ──
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  2. ROW COUNTS FOR EXPECTED TABLES');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  for (const table of EXPECTED_TABLES) {
    try {
      // Validate table name to prevent SQL injection (only allow alphanumeric + underscore)
      if (!/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/.test(table)) {
        console.log(`  ${table}: SKIPPED (invalid table name)`);
        continue;
      }
      const result = await client.unsafe(`SELECT count(*) AS c FROM ${table}`);
      const count = result[0]?.c ?? 'unknown';
      console.log(`  ${table}: EXISTS — ${count} row(s)`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.log(`  ${table}: ERROR — ${err.message}`);
    }
  }
  console.log();

  // ── 3. New enum types ──
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  3. NEW ENUM TYPES');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  const newEnums = await client`
    SELECT typname FROM pg_type
    WHERE typname IN ('organisation_type', 'organisation_status',
                      'physical_entity_type', 'physical_entity_subtype',
                      'physical_entity_status')
    ORDER BY typname
  `;
  if (newEnums.length === 0) {
    console.log('  (none found)');
  } else {
    for (const row of newEnums) {
      console.log(`  ✓ ${row.typname}`);
    }
  }
  // Also show which are missing
  const foundNewEnums = new Set(newEnums.map((r) => r.typname));
  const missingNew = NEW_ENUMS.filter((e) => !foundNewEnums.has(e));
  if (missingNew.length > 0) {
    for (const m of missingNew) {
      console.log(`  ✗ ${m}  (MISSING)`);
    }
  }
  console.log();

  // ── 4. Old enum types ──
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  4. OLD ENUM TYPES');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  const oldEnums = await client`
    SELECT typname FROM pg_type
    WHERE typname IN ('university_status', 'asset_status', 'asset_type', 'baseline_status')
    ORDER BY typname
  `;
  if (oldEnums.length === 0) {
    console.log('  (none found)');
  } else {
    for (const row of oldEnums) {
      console.log(`  ! ${row.typname}`);
    }
  }
  const foundOldEnums = new Set(oldEnums.map((r) => r.typname));
  const missingOld = OLD_ENUMS.filter((e) => !foundOldEnums.has(e));
  if (missingOld.length > 0) {
    for (const m of missingOld) {
      console.log(`    ${m}  (already removed)`);
    }
  }
  console.log();

  // ── 5. Users table columns ──
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  5. USERS TABLE COLUMNS');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  try {
    const cols = await client`
      SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_name = 'users' AND table_schema = 'public'
      ORDER BY ordinal_position
    `;
    if (cols.length === 0) {
      console.log('  (users table does not exist or has no columns)');
    } else {
      for (const col of cols) {
        console.log(`  ${col.column_name} | ${col.data_type} | nullable=${col.is_nullable}`);
      }
      console.log(`  Total: ${cols.length} column(s)`);
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.log(`  ERROR: ${err.message}`);
  }
  console.log();

  // ── 6. Users data ──
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  6. ALL USERS DATA');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  try {
    const users = await client`SELECT * FROM users`;
    if (users.length === 0) {
      console.log('  (no rows)');
    } else {
      for (const user of users) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(user, null, 2));
        console.log('  ---');
      }
    }
    console.log(`  Total: ${users.length} row(s)`);
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.log(`  ERROR: ${err.message}`);
  }
  console.log();

  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');
  console.log('  CHECK COMPLETE');
  console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════════════');

  await client.end();
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('FATAL:', e.message);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

SHA-256: `b2a501c5fc0573aa6901781bcc88c5a213f362fff25d53cec26ccb54f15e4b28`

```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, varchar, text, numeric, timestamp, index } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import {
  activityCategoryEnum,
  activityInputSourceEnum,
  activityScopeEnum,
  activityStatusEnum,
} from './enums.js';
import { organisationsTable } from './organisation.js';
import { reportingPeriodsTable } from './reporting.js';
import { physicalEntitiesTable } from './physical_entities.js';
import { usersTable } from './users.js';
import { taxonomyActivitiesTable } from './taxonomy.js';

export const activityDataTable = pgTable('activity_data', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id').notNull().references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  reportingPeriodId: uuid('reporting_period_id').notNull().references(() => reportingPeriodsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  physicalEntityId: uuid('physical_entity_id').references(() => physicalEntitiesTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  taxonomyActivityId: uuid('taxonomy_activity_id').references(() => taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  category: activityCategoryEnum('category').notNull(),
  scope: activityScopeEnum('scope').notNull(),
  quantity: numeric('quantity', { precision: 14, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
  unit: varchar('unit', { length: 50 }).notNull(),
  activityDate: timestamp('activity_date', { withTimezone: true }),
  description: text('description'),
  status: activityStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('DRAFT'),
  enteredById: uuid('entered_by_id').references(() => usersTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  verifiedById: uuid('verified_by_id').references(() => usersTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  verifiedAt: timestamp('verified_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  rejectionReason: text('rejection_reason'),
  inputSource: activityInputSourceEnum('input_source').notNull().default('MANUAL'),
  sourceFileId: varchar('source_file_id', { length: 255 }),
  sourceFileName: varchar('source_file_name', { length: 255 }),
  sourceDocumentUrl: text('source_document_url'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  index('activity_data_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
  index('activity_data_reporting_period_id_idx').on(t.reportingPeriodId),
  index('activity_data_physical_entity_id_idx').on(t.physicalEntityId),
  index('activity_data_taxonomy_activity_id_idx').on(t.taxonomyActivityId),
  index('activity_data_category_idx').on(t.category),
  index('activity_data_scope_idx').on(t.scope),
  index('activity_data_status_idx').on(t.status),
  index('activity_data_activity_date_idx').on(t.activityDate),
]);
```

```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, varchar, text, integer, timestamp, index } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
```

### 101. `original-neon-backend/src/db/schema/emissions.ts`

SHA-256: `5bc4a20533a61e5198d4c0e8c253f6a7af187ebde7de08c894f1522bd744fc7f`

```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, varchar, text, integer, numeric, date, timestamp, jsonb, index, uniqueIndex } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import {
  activityScopeEnum,
  emissionFactorStatusEnum,
  calculationStatusEnum,
} from './enums.js';
import { organisationsTable } from './organisation.js';
import { reportingPeriodsTable } from './reporting.js';
import { activityDataTable } from './activities.js';

export const emissionFactorsTable = pgTable('emission_factors', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),

  // Identity
  factorId: varchar('factor_id', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  activityId: text('activity_id').notNull(),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),

  // Classification
  useCase: text('use_case'),
  sector: text('sector'),
  category: text('category'),

  // Geography
  countryCode: varchar('country_code', { length: 2 }),
  countryName: varchar('country_name', { length: 255 }),
  region: varchar('region', { length: 100 }),

  // Provenance
  source: varchar('source', { length: 255 }),
  sourceDataset: text('source_dataset'),
  sourceLink: text('source_link'),
  sourceFactorId: varchar('source_factor_id', { length: 255 }),

  // LCA / Methodology
  sourceLcaActivity: text('source_lca_activity'),
  factorCalculationMethod: text('factor_calculation_method'),
  factorCalculationOrigin: text('factor_calculation_origin'),
  supportedCalculationMethods: text('supported_calculation_methods').array(),

  // Temporal
  year: integer('year'),
  yearReleased: integer('year_released'),
  validFrom: date('valid_from'),
  validTo: date('valid_to'),

  // Measurement
  unitType: varchar('unit_type', { length: 100 }),
  unit: varchar('unit', { length: 100 }).notNull(),
  factor: numeric('factor', { precision: 12, scale: 6 }).notNull(),
  factorUnit: varchar('factor_unit', { length: 100 }).notNull(),

  // Accounting
  scopes: text('scopes').array(),

  // GHG Composition
  constituentGases: jsonb('constituent_gases'),

  // Extension
  metadata: jsonb('metadata'),

  // Lifecycle
  status: emissionFactorStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('ACTIVE'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  uniqueIndex('emission_factors_factor_id_idx').on(t.factorId),
  index('emission_factors_activity_id_idx').on(t.activityId),
  index('emission_factors_status_idx').on(t.status),
  index('emission_factors_sector_idx').on(t.sector),
  index('emission_factors_category_idx').on(t.category),
  index('emission_factors_country_code_idx').on(t.countryCode),
  index('emission_factors_region_idx').on(t.region),
  index('emission_factors_unit_idx').on(t.unit),
  index('emission_factors_year_idx').on(t.year),
  index('emission_factors_activity_country_year_idx').on(t.activityId, t.countryCode, t.year),
]);

export const calculationsTable = pgTable('calculations', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id').notNull().references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  reportingPeriodId: uuid('reporting_period_id').notNull().references(() => reportingPeriodsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  activityDataId: uuid('activity_data_id').notNull().references(() => activityDataTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  emissionFactorId: uuid('emission_factor_id').notNull().references(() => emissionFactorsTable.id, { onDelete: 'restrict' }),
  scope: activityScopeEnum('scope').notNull(),
  quantity: numeric('quantity', { precision: 14, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
  activityUnit: varchar('activity_unit', { length: 50 }).notNull(),
  emissionFactor: numeric('emission_factor', { precision: 12, scale: 6 }).notNull(),
  factorUnit: varchar('factor_unit', { length: 100 }).notNull(),
  factorSource: varchar('factor_source', { length: 255 }),
  factorVersion: varchar('factor_version', { length: 100 }),
  factorName: varchar('factor_name', { length: 255 }),
  co2eKg: numeric('co2e_kg', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
  status: calculationStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('CALCULATED'),
  calculatedAt: timestamp('calculated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  index('calculations_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
  index('calculations_reporting_period_id_idx').on(t.reportingPeriodId),
  index('calculations_activity_data_id_idx').on(t.activityDataId),
  index('calculations_emission_factor_id_idx').on(t.emissionFactorId),
  index('calculations_scope_idx').on(t.scope),
  index('calculations_status_idx').on(t.status),
]);
```

```typescript
  'COMPLETED',
  'PARTIAL',
  'FAILED',
]);

// ── Taxonomy ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  'ACTIVE',
  'INACTIVE',

]);
```

### 106. `original-neon-backend/src/db/schema/onboarding.ts`

SHA-256: `549c4fa977b8a401989cf10fb11df0da3502a63eab014922030fd1ea0c1edfd2`

```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, jsonb, timestamp } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import { organisationsTable } from './organisation.js';

// One onboarding profile per organisation (1:1). The sections mirror the
// frontend's onboarding wizard and are profile/configuration data rather than
// transactional data, so JSONB is intentional — do not normalise into child
// tables. The UNIQUE organisation_id both enforces the 1:1 invariant and
// provides the lookup index.
export const organisationOnboardingTable = pgTable('organisation_onboarding', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id')
    .notNull()
    .unique()
    .references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  company: jsonb('company').notNull(),
  locations: jsonb('locations').notNull(),
  reporting: jsonb('reporting').notNull(),
  integrations: jsonb('integrations').notNull(),
  emissions: jsonb('emissions').notNull(),
  valueChain: jsonb('value_chain').notNull(),
  strategy: jsonb('strategy').notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});
```

### 110. `original-neon-backend/src/db/schema/relations.ts`

SHA-256: `e27cbef18918df704e94d4948ac712fedb0a3007f076bf7094ba179527851572`

```typescript
import { defineRelations } from 'drizzle-orm/relations';
import { organisationsTable } from './organisation.js';
import { usersTable } from './users.js';
import { physicalEntitiesTable } from './physical_entities.js';
import { activityDataTable } from './activities.js';
import { emissionFactorsTable, calculationsTable } from './emissions.js';
import { baselinesTable, reportingPeriodsTable, sustainabilityTargetsTable } from './reporting.js';
import { documentsTable } from './documents.js';
import { importJobsTable } from './imports.js';
import { auditLogsTable } from './audit.js';
import { recommendationsTable } from './recommendations.js';
import { reportsTable } from './reports.js';
import { taxonomyVersionsTable, taxonomyActivitiesTable } from './taxonomy.js';
import { organisationOnboardingTable } from './onboarding.js';

const schema = {
  organisationsTable,
  usersTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  activityDataTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  calculationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  baselinesTable,
  sustainabilityTargetsTable,
  documentsTable,
  importJobsTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  recommendationsTable,
  reportsTable,
  taxonomyVersionsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
  organisationOnboardingTable,
};

export const relations = defineRelations(schema, (h) => ({
  organisationsTable: {
    users: h.many.usersTable(),
    physicalEntities: h.many.physicalEntitiesTable(),
    activityData: h.many.activityDataTable(),
    reportingPeriods: h.many.reportingPeriodsTable(),
    baselines: h.many.baselinesTable(),
    sustainabilityTargets: h.many.sustainabilityTargetsTable(),
    calculations: h.many.calculationsTable(),
    reports: h.many.reportsTable(),
    importJobs: h.many.importJobsTable(),
    auditLogs: h.many.auditLogsTable(),
    documents: h.many.documentsTable(),
    recommendations: h.many.recommendationsTable(),
    onboarding: h.one.organisationOnboardingTable({
      from: h.organisationsTable.id,
      to: h.organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId,
    }),
  },

  usersTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.usersTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    createdActivities: h.many.activityDataTable({ alias: 'createdActivities' }),
    verifiedActivities: h.many.activityDataTable({ alias: 'verifiedActivities' }),
    uploadedDocuments: h.many.documentsTable(),
    auditLogs: h.many.auditLogsTable(),
  },

  physicalEntitiesTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    parent: h.one.physicalEntitiesTable({
      from: h.physicalEntitiesTable.parentId,
      to: h.physicalEntitiesTable.id,
      alias: 'parentEntity',
    }),
    children: h.many.physicalEntitiesTable({
      alias: 'childEntities',
      from: h.physicalEntitiesTable.id,
      to: h.physicalEntitiesTable.parentId,
    }),
    activityData: h.many.activityDataTable(),
    recommendations: h.many.recommendationsTable(),
  },

  activityDataTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.activityDataTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    reportingPeriod: h.one.reportingPeriodsTable({
      from: h.activityDataTable.reportingPeriodId,
      to: h.reportingPeriodsTable.id,
    }),
    physicalEntity: h.one.physicalEntitiesTable({
      from: h.activityDataTable.physicalEntityId,
      to: h.physicalEntitiesTable.id,
    }),
    taxonomyActivity: h.one.taxonomyActivitiesTable({
      from: h.activityDataTable.taxonomyActivityId,
      to: h.taxonomyActivitiesTable.id,
    }),
    createdBy: h.one.usersTable({
      from: h.activityDataTable.enteredById,
      to: h.usersTable.id,
      alias: 'createdActivities',
    }),
    verifiedBy: h.one.usersTable({
      from: h.activityDataTable.verifiedById,
      to: h.usersTable.id,
      alias: 'verifiedActivities',
    }),
    calculations: h.many.calculationsTable(),
    documents: h.many.documentsTable(),
  },

  emissionFactorsTable: {
    calculations: h.many.calculationsTable(),
  },

  calculationsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.calculationsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    reportingPeriod: h.one.reportingPeriodsTable({
      from: h.calculationsTable.reportingPeriodId,
      to: h.reportingPeriodsTable.id,
    }),
    activityData: h.one.activityDataTable({
      from: h.calculationsTable.activityDataId,
      to: h.activityDataTable.id,
    }),
    emissionFactorRel: h.one.emissionFactorsTable({
      from: h.calculationsTable.emissionFactorId,
      to: h.emissionFactorsTable.id,
    }),
  },

  reportingPeriodsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    activityData: h.many.activityDataTable(),
    calculations: h.many.calculationsTable(),
    reports: h.many.reportsTable(),
    baselines: h.many.baselinesTable(),
  },

  sustainabilityTargetsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.sustainabilityTargetsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
  },

  baselinesTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.baselinesTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    reportingPeriod: h.one.reportingPeriodsTable({
      from: h.baselinesTable.reportingPeriodId,
      to: h.reportingPeriodsTable.id,
    }),
  },

  documentsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.documentsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    activityData: h.one.activityDataTable({
      from: h.documentsTable.activityDataId,
      to: h.activityDataTable.id,
    }),
    uploadedBy: h.one.usersTable({
      from: h.documentsTable.uploadedById,
      to: h.usersTable.id,
    }),
  },

  importJobsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.importJobsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
  },

  auditLogsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.auditLogsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    user: h.one.usersTable({
      from: h.auditLogsTable.userId,
      to: h.usersTable.id,
    }),
  },

  recommendationsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.recommendationsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    physicalEntity: h.one.physicalEntitiesTable({
      from: h.recommendationsTable.physicalEntityId,
      to: h.physicalEntitiesTable.id,
    }),
  },

  reportsTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.reportsTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
    reportingPeriod: h.one.reportingPeriodsTable({
      from: h.reportsTable.reportingPeriodId,
      to: h.reportingPeriodsTable.id,
    }),
  },

  taxonomyVersionsTable: {
    taxonomyActivities: h.many.taxonomyActivitiesTable(),
  },

  taxonomyActivitiesTable: {
    taxonomyVersion: h.one.taxonomyVersionsTable({
      from: h.taxonomyActivitiesTable.taxonomyVersionId,
      to: h.taxonomyVersionsTable.id,
    }),
    parent: h.one.taxonomyActivitiesTable({
      from: h.taxonomyActivitiesTable.parentId,
      to: h.taxonomyActivitiesTable.id,
      alias: 'parentActivity',
    }),
    children: h.many.taxonomyActivitiesTable({
      alias: 'childActivities',
      from: h.taxonomyActivitiesTable.id,
      to: h.taxonomyActivitiesTable.parentId,
    }),
    activityData: h.many.activityDataTable(),
  },

  organisationOnboardingTable: {
    organisation: h.one.organisationsTable({
      from: h.organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId,
      to: h.organisationsTable.id,
    }),
  },
}));
```

```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, varchar, text, integer, boolean, numeric, timestamp, uniqueIndex, index } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import { baselineStatusEnum, reportingPeriodStatusEnum, sustainabilityTargetStatusEnum } from './enums.js';
import { organisationsTable } from './organisation.js';

export const reportingPeriodsTable = pgTable('reporting_periods', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id').notNull().references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  startDate: timestamp('start_date', { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
  endDate: timestamp('end_date', { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
  isBaseline: boolean('is_baseline').notNull().default(false),
  status: reportingPeriodStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('DRAFT'),
  description: text('description'),
  studentCount: integer('student_count'),
  staffCount: integer('staff_count'),
  totalAreaSqm: numeric('total_area_sqm', { precision: 10, scale: 2 }),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  uniqueIndex('reporting_periods_organisation_id_name_idx').on(t.organisationId, t.name),
  uniqueIndex('reporting_periods_organisation_id_start_end_idx').on(t.organisationId, t.startDate, t.endDate),
  index('reporting_periods_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
  index('reporting_periods_is_baseline_idx').on(t.isBaseline),
  index('reporting_periods_status_idx').on(t.status),
  index('reporting_periods_start_date_idx').on(t.startDate),
]);

export const baselinesTable = pgTable('baselines', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id').notNull().references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  reportingPeriodId: uuid('reporting_period_id').references(() => reportingPeriodsTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  baselineYear: integer('baseline_year').notNull(),
  scope1KgCO2e: numeric('scope1_kg_co2e', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
  scope2KgCO2e: numeric('scope2_kg_co2e', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
  totalKgCO2e: numeric('total_kg_co2e', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
  methodology: text('methodology'),
  notes: text('notes'),
  isLocked: boolean('is_locked').notNull().default(false),
  status: baselineStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('DRAFT'),
  approvedBy: text('approved_by'),
  approvedAt: timestamp('approved_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  lockedAt: timestamp('locked_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  uniqueIndex('baselines_organisation_id_baseline_year_idx').on(t.organisationId, t.baselineYear),
  index('baselines_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
]);

export const sustainabilityTargetsTable = pgTable('sustainability_targets', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id').notNull().references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  targetYear: integer('target_year').notNull(),
  reductionPct: numeric('reduction_pct', { precision: 5, scale: 2 }).notNull(),
  targetCo2eKg: numeric('target_co2e_kg', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }),
  description: text('description'),
  status: sustainabilityTargetStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('ACTIVE'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  index('sustainability_targets_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
  index('sustainability_targets_target_year_idx').on(t.targetYear),
]);
```

```typescript
export const reportsTable = pgTable('reports', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),

  reportingPeriodId: uuid('reporting_period_id').notNull().references(() => reportingPeriodsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  status: reportStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('GENERATING'),
  filePath: text('file_path'),
  fileName: varchar('file_name', { length: 255 }),
  totalEmissionsKg: numeric('total_emissions_kg', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }),
  scope1Kg: numeric('scope1_kg', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }),
  scope2Kg: numeric('scope2_kg', { precision: 16, scale: 4 }),
  generatedAt: timestamp('generated_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  index('reports_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
  index('reports_reporting_period_id_idx').on(t.reportingPeriodId),
  index('reports_status_idx').on(t.status),
]);
```
