```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, varchar, text, boolean, timestamp, index, uniqueIndex } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import { taxonomyActivityStatusEnum } from './enums.js';

export const taxonomyVersionsTable = pgTable('taxonomy_versions', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  version: varchar('version', { length: 50 }).notNull(),
  description: text('description'),
  isActive: boolean('is_active').notNull().default(true),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  uniqueIndex('taxonomy_versions_name_version_idx').on(t.name, t.version),
]);

export const taxonomyActivitiesTable = pgTable('taxonomy_activities', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  taxonomyVersionId: uuid('taxonomy_version_id').notNull().references(() => taxonomyVersionsTable.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  parentId: uuid('parent_id').references((): any => taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  code: varchar('code', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  slug: varchar('slug', { length: 255 }),
  description: text('description'),
  semanticValues: text('semantic_values').array(),
  status: taxonomyActivityStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('ACTIVE'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  index('taxonomy_activities_version_id_idx').on(t.taxonomyVersionId),
  index('taxonomy_activities_parent_id_idx').on(t.parentId),
  uniqueIndex('taxonomy_activities_version_code_idx').on(t.taxonomyVersionId, t.code),
  uniqueIndex('taxonomy_activities_version_slug_idx').on(t.taxonomyVersionId, t.slug),
]);
```

### 114. `original-neon-backend/src/db/schema/users.ts`

SHA-256: `6545cd08683e84f53a9ac44231f2b6a3db2a1c5b74a22f696931248783e60b8f`

```typescript
import { pgTable, uuid, text, timestamp, index } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import { userRoleEnum, userStatusEnum } from './enums.js';
import { organisationsTable } from './organisation.js';

export const usersTable = pgTable('users', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  authUserId: uuid('auth_user_id'),
  username: text('username').notNull().unique(),
  email: text('email').notNull().unique(),
  password: text('password').notNull(),
  // Invariant: every user belongs to an organisation (provisioned at signup,
  // or linked deliberately). RESTRICT prevents deleting an organisation that
  // still has members instead of silently orphaning them.
  organisationId: uuid('organisation_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => organisationsTable.id, { onDelete: 'restrict' }),
  role: userRoleEnum('role').notNull().default('USER'),
  status: userStatusEnum('status').notNull().default('ACTIVE'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
}, (t) => [
  index('users_organisation_id_idx').on(t.organisationId),
  index('users_role_idx').on(t.role),
  index('users_status_idx').on(t.status),
]);
```

```typescript
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)

      name: 'AC-101',
      code: 'AC101',

      subtype: 'AIR_CONDITIONER',

  console.log('Taxonomy activities resolved.');

  // 8. Emission Factors (use taxonomy codes as activity_id)
  // Idempotent: reuse the existing row for a factorId instead of inserting duplicates.
  async function upsertSeedEf(values: typeof emissionFactorsTable.$inferInsert) {
    const existing = await db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, values.factorId!))

    console.log(`Emission Factor (${values.factorId}) created:`, created.id);
    return created;

  const _efDiesel = await upsertSeedEf({

  // 9. Activity Data
  const actRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)

      organisationId: org.id,

  // 10. Calculation

  console.log('\nSeeding complete!');

main().catch((e) => {
```

SHA-256: `4bcccb63ca4ef24a45820664ca9dd6bbf9f3ac53bf2ad2823edaccb1c187df13`

```typescript
/**
 * CarbonSync V2 — deterministic demo data seeder.
 *
 * Usage: npm run db:seed:demo   (requires the dev server running on :5000)
 *
 * DEMO EMISSION FACTOR NOTICE:
 * The seeded emission factors include both USER-PROVIDED values
 * (India electricity grid 0.71 kgCO2e/kWh; France grid mix 0.912 kgCO2e/kWh)
 * and SYNTHETIC values invented solely to make the demo dataset calculable
 * (diesel/petrol/LPG/natural-gas/heating). Synthetic factors are NOT
 * authoritative and must not be used for real carbon accounting.
 */
import 'dotenv/config';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from './index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  auditLogsTable,
  baselinesTable,
  calculationsTable,
  documentsTable,
  importJobsTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  recommendationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  reportsTable,
  sustainabilityTargetsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  usersTable,
} from './schema/index.js';

const API = process.env.DEMO_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000/api/v1';

async function api(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown) {
  const init: RequestInit = {
    method,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000),
  };
  if (body !== undefined) init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  const res = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, init);
  const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as any;
  if (!res.ok || json?.success === false) {
    throw new Error(
      `API ${method} ${path} -> ${res.status}: ${JSON.stringify(json).slice(0, 400)}`,
    );
  }
  return json;
}

async function main() {
  console.log('=== CarbonSync V2 demo seeder ===');
  console.log(`API base: ${API}`);

  // ── Preflight ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let healthy = false;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 5 && !healthy; attempt++) {
    try {
      const health = await fetch(new URL('/health', API), {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
      });
      if (!health.ok) throw new Error(`health ${health.status}`);
      healthy = true;
      console.log('Preflight: dev server is up.');
    } catch {
      console.log(`Preflight attempt ${attempt}: dev server not ready, retrying in 3s...`);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000));
    }
  }
  if (!healthy) {
    throw new Error('Dev server is not reachable on :5000. Start it with `npm run dev` first.');
  }

  // ── Phase A: cleanup (application data only) ─────────────────
  // Preserves: users (real accounts), taxonomy_versions, taxonomy_activities.
  // Order respects FKs; calculations.emission_factor_id is ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  // so calculations MUST be deleted before emission_factors.
  console.log('\n--- Phase A: cleaning application data ---');
  const cleanupOrder: { label: string; table: any }[] = [
    { label: 'sustainability_targets', table: sustainabilityTargetsTable },
    { label: 'recommendations', table: recommendationsTable },
    { label: 'documents', table: documentsTable },
    { label: 'reports', table: reportsTable },
    { label: 'import_jobs', table: importJobsTable },
    { label: 'baselines', table: baselinesTable },
    { label: 'calculations', table: calculationsTable },
    { label: 'audit_logs', table: auditLogsTable },
    { label: 'activity_data', table: activityDataTable },
    { label: 'physical_entities', table: physicalEntitiesTable },
    { label: 'reporting_periods', table: reportingPeriodsTable },
    { label: 'emission_factors', table: emissionFactorsTable },
    { label: 'organisations', table: organisationsTable },
  ];
  for (const { label, table } of cleanupOrder) {
    const deleted = await db.delete(table).returning({ id: table.id });
    console.log(`deleted ${deleted.length} rows from ${label}`);
  }
  console.log('Cleanup done (users and taxonomy preserved).\n');

  // ── Phase B: organisation + demo user ────────────────────────
  console.log('--- Phase B: organisation & demo user ---');
  const uni = await api('POST', '/universities', {
    name: 'Greenfield University',
    code: 'GU-DEMO',
    email: 'admin@greendemo.edu',
    city: 'Pune',
    state: 'Maharashtra',
    country: 'India',
    address: 'Greenfield Campus Road 1',
  });
  const universityId = uni.data.id as string;
  await api('PATCH', `/universities/${universityId}`, { status: 'ACTIVE' });
  console.log('University:', universityId);

  // Re-run safe: if the demo user already exists (users survive cleanup),
  // log in instead of registering. Registration provisions a PENDING
  // "Pending Organisation" placeholder server-side; the direct relink below
  // re-attaches the demo user to Greenfield University so the demo dataset
  // stays authoritative.
  const demoEmail = 'demo@carbonsync.test';
  let signupOrgId: string | undefined;
  try {
    await api('POST', '/auth/login', { email: demoEmail, password: 'DemoPass123!' });
    console.log('Demo user already exists; logged in.');
  } catch {
    const reg = await api('POST', '/auth/register', {
      username: 'demo.user',
      email: demoEmail,
      password: 'DemoPass123!',
    });
    console.log('Demo user registered:', reg.data.user.email);
    // Registration provisions its own placeholder org; remember it so the
    // relink below can remove it and leave zero orphans.
    signupOrgId = reg.data.user.organisationId ?? undefined;
  }
  // No V2 endpoint sets organisation_id on an existing user; keep the link
  // correct across re-runs with a direct update (documented exception).
  await db
    .update(usersTable)
    .set({ organisationId: universityId })
    .where(eq(usersTable.email, demoEmail));
  if (signupOrgId) {
    await db
      .delete(organisationsTable)
      .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, signupOrgId));
  }

  // ── Phase C: physical hierarchy ──────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n--- Phase C: campus / building / floor / asset hierarchy ---');
  const campusDefs = [
    { name: 'North Campus', code: 'GU-NC', city: 'Pune' },
    { name: 'South Campus', code: 'GU-SC', city: 'Pune' },
  ];
  const buildingDefs: Record<string, { name: string; code: string }[]> = {
    'GU-NC': [
      { name: 'Academic Block', code: 'GU-NC-ACD' },
      { name: 'Library', code: 'GU-NC-LIB' },
      { name: 'Admin Block', code: 'GU-NC-ADM' },
    ],
    'GU-SC': [
      { name: 'Engineering Block', code: 'GU-SC-ENG' },
      { name: 'Hostel A', code: 'GU-SC-HST' },
    ],
  };
  const floorNames = ['Ground Floor', 'First Floor'];
  const assetTypes = ['ELECTRICITY_METER', 'CHILLER', 'BOILER', 'DIESEL_GENERATOR'] as const;

  const campusIds: Record<string, string> = {};
  const floors: { id: string; campusCode: string; buildingCode: string }[] = [];

  for (const c of campusDefs) {
    const res = await api('POST', '/campuses', {
      name: c.name,
      code: c.code,
      universityId,
      city: c.city,
      state: 'Maharashtra',
      country: 'India',
    });
    campusIds[c.code] = res.data.id;
    console.log(`Campus ${c.code}:`, res.data.id);
  }

  let assetSeq = 0;
  for (const [campusCode, buildings] of Object.entries(buildingDefs)) {
    for (const b of buildings) {
      const bRes = await api('POST', '/buildings', {
        name: b.name,
        code: b.code,
        campusId: campusIds[campusCode],
        address: `${b.name}, ${campusDefs.find((c) => c.code === campusCode)!.name}`,
      });
      const buildingId = bRes.data.id;
      console.log(`Building ${b.code}:`, buildingId);

      for (let f = 0; f < floorNames.length; f++) {
        const fName = floorNames[f]!;
        const fRes = await api('POST', '/floors', {
          name: fName,
          code: `${b.code}-F${f}`,
          floorNumber: f,
          areaSqm: 800 + f * 120,
          buildingId,
        });
        floors.push({ id: fRes.data.id, campusCode, buildingCode: b.code });
        console.log(`Floor ${b.code}-F${f}:`, fRes.data.id);

        for (let a = 0; a < 2; a++) {
          const type = assetTypes[(assetSeq + a) % assetTypes.length]!;
          await api('POST', '/assets', {
            name: `${type.replace(/_/g, ' ').toLowerCase()} ${b.code}-F${f}-${a}`,
            code: `AS-${b.code}-F${f}-${a}`,
            type,
            manufacturer: 'DemoCorp',
            modelNumber: `DM-${1000 + assetSeq}`,
            floorId: fRes.data.id,
          });
          assetSeq++;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  console.log(`Assets created: ${assetSeq}`);

  // ── Phase D: emission factors ────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n--- Phase D: emission factors ---');
  const efPayloads = [
    {
      // USER-PROVIDED (data/emission-factors-normalized.json #1) — value exact
      name: 'India fixed electricity emission factor',
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      factor: 0.71,

    {

      category: 'OWNED_VEHICLE',

      sourceName: 'CarbonSync demo dataset (synthetic)',
      country: 'India',
      notes: 'Synthetic demo factor — not an authoritative emission factor.',

    {
      name: 'Purchased steam (demo)',
      category: 'PURCHASED_STEAM',
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',

      notes: 'Synthetic demo factor — not an authoritative emission factor.',

    {
      name: 'Purchased cooling (demo)',
      category: 'PURCHASED_COOLING',
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      factor: 0.15,
      unit: 'kgCO2e/kWh',
      source: 'CUSTOM',
      sourceName: 'CarbonSync demo dataset (synthetic)',
      country: 'India',
      notes: 'Synthetic demo factor — not an authoritative emission factor.',
    },
  ];
  for (const p of efPayloads) {
    const r = await api('POST', '/emission-factors', p);
    console.log(`EF ${p.category} (${p.factor}):`, r.data.id);
  }

  // ── Phase E: reporting periods ───────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n--- Phase E: reporting periods ---');
  const baseP = await api('POST', '/reporting-periods', {
    universityId,
    name: 'FY 2023-24 (Baseline)',
    startDate: '2023-04-01',
    endDate: '2024-03-31',
  });
  const baselinePeriodId = baseP.data.id as string;
  await api('POST', `/reporting-periods/${baselinePeriodId}/open`);
  console.log('Baseline period:', baselinePeriodId);

  const curP = await api('POST', '/reporting-periods', {
    universityId,
    name: 'FY 2025-26',
    startDate: '2025-04-01',
    endDate: '2026-03-31',
  });
  const currentPeriodId = curP.data.id as string;
  await api('POST', `/reporting-periods/${currentPeriodId}/open`);
  console.log('Current period:', currentPeriodId);

  // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const demoDates = (startYear: number, startMonth: number, n: number) =>
    Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
      const m = startMonth + Math.min(i, 11);
      const day = i < 12 ? 12 : 20;
      return new Date(Date.UTC(startYear, m, day)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    });

  async function createActivity(periodId: string, dateISO: string, quantity: number, locIdx: number) {
    const loc = floors[locIdx % floors.length]!;
    const res = await api('POST', '/activity-data', {
      universityId,
      reportingPeriodId: periodId,
      campusId: campusIds[loc.campusCode],
      floorId: loc.id,
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
      scope: 'SCOPE_2',
      quantity,
      unit: 'kWh',
      activityDate: dateISO,
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
      description: `Monthly electricity consumption — ${loc.buildingCode} (${loc.campusCode})`,
    });
    return res.data.id as string;
  }

  async function driveToCalculated(id: string) {
    await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/submit`, { universityId });
    await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/start-review`, { universityId });
    await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/verify`, { universityId });
    // /calculations/activity/:id is used because /emissions/calculate requires
    // a taxonomy_activity_id, which the current seed taxonomy cannot provide
    // for these categories. Side effect: activity ends CALCULATED (not
    // VERIFIED); see docs/demo-data-seeding.md known-nuances section.
    await api('POST', `/calculations/activity/${id}`);
  }

  // ── Phase F: baseline-period activities + baseline ───────────
  console.log('\n--- Phase F: baseline period activities & baseline ---');
  const baseDates = demoDates(2023, 3, 8); // Apr 2023 .. Nov 2023 (inside FY23-24)
  const baseQtys = [48000, 51000, 49500, 53000, 50500, 47000, 52000, 54000];
  for (let i = 0; i < baseDates.length; i++) {
    const id = await createActivity(baselinePeriodId, baseDates[i]!, baseQtys[i]!, i);
    await driveToCalculated(id);
    console.log(`Baseline activity ${i + 1}/${baseDates.length} calculated:`, id);
  }

  const bl = await api('POST', '/baselines', { universityId, reportingPeriodId: baselinePeriodId });
  const baselineId = bl.data.id as string;
  await api('POST', `/baselines/${baselineId}/submit`);
  await api('POST', `/baselines/${baselineId}/approve`);
  // NOTE: baseline stays APPROVED for now — the /targets service requires an
  // APPROVED baseline. It gets locked in Phase H after target creation.
  await api('POST', `/reporting-periods/${baselinePeriodId}/set-baseline`);
  await api('POST', `/reporting-periods/${baselinePeriodId}/lock`);
  console.log('Baseline submitted & approved:', baselineId);

  // ── Phase G: current-period activities (varied statuses) ─────
  console.log('\n--- Phase G: current period activities ---');
  const curDates = demoDates(2025, 3, 15); // Apr 2025 .. within FY25-26
  const curQtys = [
    42000, 43500, 41000, 45000, 42500, 46000, 44500, 43000, 47000,
    41500, 44000, 45500, 46500, 42800, 47200,
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < curDates.length; i++) {
    const id = await createActivity(currentPeriodId, curDates[i]!, curQtys[i]!, i + 3);
    if (i < 9) {
      await driveToCalculated(id);
      console.log(`Current activity ${i + 1}: CALCULATED`, id);
    } else if (i === 9) {
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/submit`, { universityId });
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/start-review`, { universityId });
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/verify`, { universityId });
      console.log('Current activity 10: VERIFIED', id);
    } else if (i === 10) {
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/submit`, { universityId });
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/start-review`, { universityId });
      console.log('Current activity 11: UNDER_REVIEW', id);
    } else if (i === 11) {
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/submit`, { universityId });
      console.log('Current activity 12: SUBMITTED', id);
    } else if (i === 12) {
      console.log('Current activity 13: DRAFT', id);
    } else {
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/submit`, { universityId });
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/start-review`, { universityId });
      await api('POST', `/activity-data/${id}/reject`, {
        universityId,
        reason: 'Meter reading inconsistent with invoice (demo rejection).',
      });
      console.log(`Current activity ${i + 1}: REJECTED`, id);
    }
  }

  // ── Phase H: statistics, target, recommendations ─────────────
  console.log('\n--- Phase H: statistics / target / recommendations ---');
  for (const pid of [baselinePeriodId, currentPeriodId]) {
    await api('POST', '/university-statistics', {
      universityId,
      reportingPeriodId: pid,
      studentCount: 12000,
      staffCount: 1500,
      totalAreaSqm: 95000,
    });
  }
  console.log('University statistics set on both periods.');

  const tgt = await api('POST', '/targets', {
    universityId,
    targetYear: 2030,
    reductionPct: 42,
    description: 'Cut emissions 42% by 2030 against the FY2023-24 baseline.',
  });
  console.log('Target created:', tgt.data?.id ?? '(created)');

  // Baseline intentionally left APPROVED (not locked): /targets/:id/progress
  // only recognises APPROVED baselines, and the frontend target-progress UI
  // depends on that endpoint.

  const recs = await api('POST', '/recommendations/generate', {
    universityId,
    reportingPeriodId: currentPeriodId,
  });
  console.log(`Recommendations generated: ${(recs.data ?? []).length}`);

  // ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== DEMO SEED COMPLETE ===');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    universityId,
    baselinePeriodId,
    currentPeriodId,
    baselineId,
    demoUser: 'demo@carbonsync.test / DemoPass123!',
    campuses: 2,
    buildings: 5,
    floors: floors.length,
    assets: assetSeq,
    emissionFactors: efPayloads.length,
    activities: { baselinePeriod: 8, currentPeriod: 15 },
  }, null, 2));
}

main()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch((err) => {
    console.error('\nDEMO SEED FAILED:', err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    process.exit(1);
  });
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import { db } from './index.js';
import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  taxonomyVersionsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
} from './schema/index.js';

interface TaxonomyNode {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  slug?: string;
  description?: string;
  children?: TaxonomyNode[];
}

const TAXONOMY_TREE: TaxonomyNode[] = [
  {
    code: 'ENERGY',
    name: 'Energy',
    slug: 'energy',
    children: [
      {
        code: 'ENERGY.ELECTRICITY',
        name: 'Electricity',
        slug: 'electricity',
      },
      {
        code: 'ENERGY.FUEL',
        name: 'Fuel',
        slug: 'fuel',
        children: [
          {
            code: 'ENERGY.FUEL.DIESEL',
            name: 'Diesel',
            slug: 'diesel',
            children: [
              {
                code: 'ENERGY.FUEL.DIESEL.STATIONARY_COMBUSTION',
                name: 'Stationary Combustion',
                slug: 'diesel-stationary-combustion',
                description: 'Diesel consumed by stationary equipment (generators, boilers)',
              },
            ],
          },
          {
            code: 'ENERGY.FUEL.PETROL',
            name: 'Petrol',
            slug: 'petrol',
          },
          {
            code: 'ENERGY.FUEL.NATURAL_GAS',
            name: 'Natural Gas',
            slug: 'natural-gas',
          },
          {
            code: 'ENERGY.FUEL.LPG',
            name: 'LPG',
            slug: 'lpg',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    code: 'TRANSPORT',
    name: 'Transport',
    slug: 'transport',
    children: [
      {
        code: 'TRANSPORT.ROAD',
        name: 'Road Travel',
        slug: 'road-travel',
        children: [
          {
            code: 'TRANSPORT.ROAD.PASSENGER_VEHICLE',
            name: 'Passenger Vehicle',
            slug: 'passenger-vehicle',
          },
          {
            code: 'TRANSPORT.ROAD.FREIGHT',
            name: 'Road Freight',
            slug: 'road-freight',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        code: 'TRANSPORT.RAIL',
        name: 'Rail Travel',
        slug: 'rail-travel',
      },
      {
        code: 'TRANSPORT.AIR',
        name: 'Air Travel',
        slug: 'air-travel',
      },
      {
        code: 'TRANSPORT.SEA',
        name: 'Sea Travel',
        slug: 'sea-travel',
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    code: 'REFRIGERANTS_AND_FUGITIVE_GASES',
    name: 'Refrigerants and Fugitive Gases',
    slug: 'refrigerants-and-fugitive-gases',
    children: [
      {
        code: 'REFRIGERANTS_AND_FUGITIVE_GASES.REFRIGERANT',
        name: 'Refrigerants',
        slug: 'refrigerants',
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    code: 'WASTE',
    name: 'Waste',
    slug: 'waste',
    children: [
      {
        code: 'WASTE.GENERAL',
        name: 'General Waste',
        slug: 'general-waste',
      },
      {
        code: 'WASTE.FOOD_ORGANIC',
        name: 'Food and Organic Waste',
        slug: 'food-organic-waste',
      },
      {
        code: 'WASTE.PAPER_CARDBOARD',
        name: 'Paper and Cardboard',
        slug: 'paper-cardboard',
      },
      {
        code: 'WASTE.PLASTIC',
        name: 'Plastic',
        slug: 'plastic',
      },
      {
        code: 'WASTE.GLASS',
        name: 'Glass',
        slug: 'glass',
      },
      {
        code: 'WASTE.METAL',
        name: 'Metal',
        slug: 'metal',
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    code: 'WATER',
    name: 'Water',
    slug: 'water',
    children: [
      {
        code: 'WATER.SUPPLY',
        name: 'Water Supply',
        slug: 'water-supply',
      },
      {
        code: 'WATER.TREATMENT',
        name: 'Water Treatment',
        slug: 'water-treatment',
      },
    ],
  },
];

async function main() {
  console.log('Seeding taxonomy...');

  // 1. Check if taxonomy version already exists
  const existingVersions = await db
    .select()
    .from(taxonomyVersionsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.name, 'CarbonSync Taxonomy'),
        eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.version, '1.0'),
      ),
    );

  let versionId: string;

  if (existingVersions.length > 0) {
    versionId = existingVersions[0]!.id;
    console.log(`Taxonomy version already exists: ${versionId}`);
  } else {
    const versionRows = await db
      .insert(taxonomyVersionsTable)
      .values({
        name: 'CarbonSync Taxonomy',
        version: '1.0',
        description: 'Canonical activity taxonomy for CarbonSync emissions tracking',
        isActive: true,
      })
      .returning();
    versionId = versionRows[0]!.id;
    console.log(`Taxonomy version created: ${versionId}`);
  }

  // 2. Insert taxonomy activities level by level (roots first, then children)
  async function insertNodes(
    nodes: TaxonomyNode[],
    parentId: string | null,
  ): Promise<void> {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      // Check if this code already exists in this version
      const existing = await db
        .select({ id: taxonomyActivitiesTable.id })
        .from(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.taxonomyVersionId, versionId),
            eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.code, node.code),
          ),
        );

      let nodeId: string;

      if (existing.length > 0) {
        nodeId = existing[0]!.id;
        console.log(`  Already exists: ${node.code}`);
      } else {
        const rows = await db
          .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
          .values({
            taxonomyVersionId: versionId,
            parentId,
            code: node.code,
            name: node.name,
            slug: node.slug ?? null,
            description: node.description ?? null,
            status: 'ACTIVE',
          })
          .returning();
        nodeId = rows[0]!.id;
        console.log(`  Created: ${node.code} (${node.name})`);
      }

      // Recursively insert children
      if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
        await insertNodes(node.children, nodeId);
      }
    }
  }

  await insertNodes(TAXONOMY_TREE, null);

  console.log('\nTaxonomy seeding complete!');
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('Taxonomy seeding failed:', e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

SHA-256: `3c526f2a23c4b0fcd9654abbb6520ab13b68386d038265c9cf6e50e4b32cccf8`

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { resolve } from 'path';
import { taxonomyImportSchema } from '../validators/taxonomyImport.js';
import { emissionFactorsImportSchema } from '../validators/emissionFactorImport.js';
import { importTaxonomy } from '../services/taxonomyImport.js';
import { importEmissionFactors } from '../services/emissionFactorImport.js';
import { db } from './index.js';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';

const taxonomyJsonPath = resolve(process.cwd(), 'data/taxonomy-activities.json');
const efJsonPath = resolve(process.cwd(), 'data/emission-factors-normalized.json');

async function main() {
  let passed = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  function assert(label: string, condition: boolean, detail?: string) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`  PASS: ${label}`);
      passed++;
    } else {
      console.log(`  FAIL: ${label}${detail ? ` — ${detail}` : ''}`);
      failed++;
    }
  }

  // ── TEST 1: Taxonomy JSON parses and validates ────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 1: Taxonomy JSON validation ===');
  const taxonomyRaw = readFileSync(taxonomyJsonPath, 'utf-8');
  const taxonomyParsed = JSON.parse(taxonomyRaw);
  const taxonomyResult = taxonomyImportSchema.safeParse(taxonomyParsed);
  assert('Taxonomy JSON parses', taxonomyResult.success, taxonomyResult.success ? undefined : taxonomyResult.error.issues.map(i => i.message).join(', '));

  // ── TEST 2: Taxonomy import succeeds ──────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 2: Taxonomy import ===');
  const taxonomyImport = await importTaxonomy(taxonomyResult.data!);
  console.log('  Summary:', JSON.stringify(taxonomyImport.summary));
  assert('Taxonomy import success', taxonomyImport.errors.length === 0, JSON.stringify(taxonomyImport.errors));
  assert('Taxonomy received > 0', taxonomyImport.summary.received > 0);
  assert('Taxonomy inserted > 0', taxonomyImport.summary.inserted > 0);
  assert('Taxonomy failed = 0', taxonomyImport.summary.failed === 0);

  // ── TEST 3: Taxonomy re-import is idempotent ──────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 3: Taxonomy re-import (idempotency) ===');
  const taxonomyReimport = await importTaxonomy(taxonomyResult.data!);
  console.log('  Summary:', JSON.stringify(taxonomyReimport.summary));
  assert('Taxonomy re-import success', taxonomyReimport.errors.length === 0);
  assert('Taxonomy re-import inserted = 0', taxonomyReimport.summary.inserted === 0);
  assert('Taxonomy re-import skipped > 0', taxonomyReimport.summary.skipped > 0);

  // ── TEST 4: EF JSON parses and validates ──────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 4: Emission factor JSON validation ===');
  const efRaw = readFileSync(efJsonPath, 'utf-8');
  const efParsed = JSON.parse(efRaw);
  const efArray = efParsed.emission_factors as Record<string, unknown>[];
  const efResult = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse(efArray);
  assert('EF JSON parses', efResult.success, efResult.success ? undefined : efResult.error.issues.map(i => i.message).join(', '));

  // ── TEST 5: EF import succeeds ────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 5: Emission factor import ===');
  const efImport = await importEmissionFactors(efResult.data!);
  console.log('  Summary:', JSON.stringify(efImport.summary));
  assert('EF import success', efImport.errors.length === 0, JSON.stringify(efImport.errors));
  assert('EF received > 0', efImport.summary.received > 0);
  assert('EF inserted > 0', efImport.summary.inserted > 0);
  assert('EF failed = 0', efImport.summary.failed === 0);

  // ── TEST 6: EF re-import is idempotent ────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 6: Emission factor re-import (idempotency) ===');
  const efReimport = await importEmissionFactors(efResult.data!);
  console.log('  Summary:', JSON.stringify(efReimport.summary));
  assert('EF re-import success', efReimport.errors.length === 0);
  assert('EF re-import inserted = 0', efReimport.summary.inserted === 0);
  assert('EF re-import skipped > 0', efReimport.summary.skipped > 0);

  // ── TEST 7: Invalid root object rejected ──────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 7: Invalid root rejected ===');
  const invalidTaxonomy = taxonomyImportSchema.safeParse({ not: 'an array' });
  assert('Object rejected', !invalidTaxonomy.success);
  const invalidNull = taxonomyImportSchema.safeParse(null);
  assert('Null rejected', !invalidNull.success);
  const invalidString = taxonomyImportSchema.safeParse('string');
  assert('String rejected', !invalidString.success);
  const invalidWrapper = taxonomyImportSchema.safeParse({ items: [] });
  assert('Wrapper object rejected', !invalidWrapper.success);

  // ── TEST 8: Invalid EF root rejected ──────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 8: Invalid EF root rejected ===');
  const invalidEf = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse({ not: 'an array' });
  assert('EF object rejected', !invalidEf.success);

  // ── TEST 9: Invalid EF factor rejected ────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 9: Invalid EF fields rejected ===');
  const invalidFactor = emissionFactorsImportSchema.safeParse([
    { factor_id: 'x', activity_id: 'a.b', name: 'x', unit: 'kg', factor: -1, factor_unit: 'kgCO2e/kg' },
  ]);
  assert('Negative factor rejected', !invalidFactor.success);

  // ── TEST 10: Missing required fields rejected ─────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 10: Missing required fields rejected ===');
  const missingFields = await importEmissionFactors([
    {
      factor_id: '',
      activity_id: 'some.activity',
      name: 'Test',
      unit: 'kg',
      factor: 1.0,
      factor_unit: 'kgCO2e/kg',
    },
  ]);
  assert('Empty factor_id rejected', missingFields.errors.length > 0);
  assert('No partial insert (failed = received)', missingFields.summary.failed === missingFields.summary.received);
  assert('Inserted = 0', missingFields.summary.inserted === 0);

  // ── TEST 11: DB row counts match ──────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n=== TEST 11: DB verification ===');
  const taCount = await db.execute(sql`SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM taxonomy_activities`);
  const efCount = await db.execute(sql`SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM emission_factors`);
  const taRows = Number(taCount.rows[0]?.cnt ?? 0);
  const efRows = Number(efCount.rows[0]?.cnt ?? 0);
  console.log(`  Taxonomy activities in DB: ${taRows}`);
  console.log(`  Emission factors in DB: ${efRows}`);
  assert('Taxonomy rows exist in DB', taRows > 0);
  assert('EF rows exist in DB', efRows > 0);

  // ── SUMMARY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log(`\n${'='.repeat(50)}`);
  console.log(`RESULTS: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed`);
  console.log(`${'='.repeat(50)}`);

  process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('Test failed:', e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import { db } from './index.js';
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  activityDataTable,
  calculationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from './schema/index.js';

let passed = 0;
let failed = 0;
let sectionCount = 1;
const T = '__INTTEST__';

function ok(label: string) { passed++; console.log(`  OK  ${label}`); }
function fail(label: string, detail?: string) { failed++; console.log(`  FAIL ${label}${detail ? ` -- ${detail}` : ''}`); }
function section(title: string) { console.log(`\n[${String(sectionCount++).padStart(2, '0')}] ${title}`); }

async function cleanup() {
  await db.delete(calculationsTable).where(sql`${calculationsTable.factorSource} LIKE ${T + '%'}`);
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(sql`${activityDataTable.description} LIKE ${T + '%'}`);
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(sql`${reportingPeriodsTable.name} LIKE ${T + '%'}`);
  await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(sql`${physicalEntitiesTable.code} LIKE ${T + '%'}`);
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(sql`${organisationsTable.code} LIKE ${T + '%'}`);
}

async function main() {
  console.log('CarbonSync Backend v2 -- Database Verification (Post-Refactor)');
  console.log('============================================================');

  // ── 1. DATABASE IDENTITY ───────────────────────────────────────
  section('Database Identity');
  try {
    const dbRes = await db.execute(sql`SELECT current_database() AS db, current_schema() AS schema_name, current_user AS usr`);
    const rows = dbRes as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[];
    const row = rows[0];
    if (row) {
      console.log(`  database: ${String(row['db'])}`);
      console.log(`  schema: ${String(row['schema_name'])}`);
      console.log(`  user: ${String(row['usr'])}`);
      ok('Database identity retrieved');
    } else {
      fail('Could not retrieve database identity');
    }
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Database identity query failed', msg);
  }

  // ── 2. SELECT 1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  section('SELECT 1 via Drizzle');
  try {
    const result = await db.execute(sql`SELECT 1 AS result`);
    const rows = result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[];
    const row = rows[0];
    if (row && row['result'] === 1) {
      ok('Connection successful');
    } else {
      fail('SELECT 1 returned unexpected result', JSON.stringify(row));
    }
    await cleanup();
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('SELECT 1 failed', msg);
    console.log('\nFATAL: Cannot proceed without database connectivity');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // ── 3. TABLE VERIFICATION ────────────────────────────────────
  section('Table Verification (15 expected)');
  const expectedTables = [
    'organisations', 'users', 'physical_entities',
    'reporting_periods', 'activity_data', 'emission_factors', 'calculations',
    'sustainability_targets', 'documents', 'import_jobs', 'audit_logs',
    'recommendations', 'reports',
    'taxonomy_versions', 'taxonomy_activities',
  ];
  try {
    const tablesResult = await db.execute(
      sql`SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename`
    );
    const existing = new Set(
      (tablesResult as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]).map((r) => String(r['tablename']))
    );
    let found = 0;
    for (const t of expectedTables) {
      if (existing.has(t)) {
        found++;
      } else {
        fail(`Table missing: ${t}`);
      }
    }
    if (found === expectedTables.length) {
      ok(`${found}/${expectedTables.length} tables found`);
    } else {
      fail(`${found}/${expectedTables.length} tables found`);
    }

    // Check that old tables are gone
    const oldTables = ['universities', 'campuses', 'buildings', 'floors', 'assets', 'baselines', 'university_statistics', 'climatiq_cache', 'uploaded_documents', 'notifications'];
    let oldGone = 0;
    for (const t of oldTables) {
      if (!existing.has(t)) {
        oldGone++;
      } else {
        fail(`Old table still exists: ${t}`);
      }
    }
    if (oldGone === oldTables.length) {
      ok(`${oldGone}/${oldTables.length} old tables removed`);
    }
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Table verification failed', msg);

    );
    const existingEnums = new Set(
      (enumResult as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[]).map((r) => String(r['typname']))
    );

  section('Physical Entity: Generator (Root Level)');
  const gPrefix = `${T}_GEN`;
  try {

  try {

    const genRows = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({

      subtype: 'GENERATOR',

    }).returning();
    const gen = genRows[0]!;

    // Case 1: Electricity associated with a building
    const act1 = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({

    // Case 2: LPG associated with a kitchen
    const act2 = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({

    // Case 3: Refrigerant associated with an air conditioner
    const act3 = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({

    const act4 = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({

    // Case 5: Organisation-wide activity (physicalEntityId = NULL)
    const act5 = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({

    ok(`Case 5: Org-wide electricity (no entity) -- ${act5[0]!.id}`);

    // Verify all 5 can be queried
    const allActs = await db.select().from(activityDataTable)
      .where(sql`${activityDataTable.description} LIKE ${aPrefix + '%'}`);
    if (allActs.length === 5) {
      ok(`All 5 activity records queryable`);
    } else {
      fail(`Expected 5 activities, got ${allActs.length}`);
    }
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Activity data test failed', msg);
  }

  // ── 10. TENANT ISOLATION ─────────────────────────────────────
  section('Tenant Isolation');
  const tPrefix = `${T}_TEN`;
  try {
    const orgARows = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
      name: 'Organisation A',
      code: `${tPrefix}_A`,
      type: 'COMPANY',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    }).returning();
    const orgA = orgARows[0]!;

    const orgBRows = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({
      name: 'Organisation B',
      code: `${tPrefix}_B`,
      type: 'COMPANY',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    }).returning();
    const orgB = orgBRows[0]!;

    // Create PhysicalEntity belonging to Org B
    const peRows = await db.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
      organisationId: orgB.id,
      name: 'Org B Building',
      code: `${tPrefix}_B_BLD`,
      type: 'LOCATION',
      subtype: 'BUILDING',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    }).returning();
    const peB = peRows[0]!;
    ok(`PhysicalEntity created under Org B: ${peB.id}`);

    // Create ReportingPeriod under Org A
    const rpRows = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
      organisationId: orgA.id,
      name: `${tPrefix}_A_RP`,
      startDate: new Date('2025-04-01'),
      endDate: new Date('2026-03-31'),
      status: 'OPEN',
    }).returning();
    const rpA = rpRows[0]!;

    // Attempt cross-org: ActivityData under Org A referencing Org B's PhysicalEntity
    // This is rejected at application level; DB FK allows it since physicalEntity exists.
    // We verify the cross-org reference is POTENTIALLY possible at DB level (FK exists),
    // but the application must enforce tenant boundary.
    // For this test, we INSERT and verify it succeeded (DB allows it),
    // then document that APPLICATION must reject it.
    const actRows = await db.insert(activityDataTable).values({
      organisationId: orgA.id,
      reportingPeriodId: rpA.id,
      physicalEntityId: peB.id,
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',

      status: 'DRAFT',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    }).returning();
    if (actRows.length === 1) {
      ok(`Cross-org insert succeeded at DB level (application must enforce boundary)`);
      // Clean up the cross-org record
      await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(sql`${activityDataTable.description} = ${tPrefix + '_CROSS_ORG_ATTEMPT'}`);
    } else {
      fail('Cross-org insert failed unexpectedly');
    }
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Tenant isolation test failed', msg);
  }

  // ── 11. TRANSACTION ROLLBACK ────────────────────────────────
  section('Transaction Rollback');
  const rbPrefix = `${T}_RB`;
  try {
    let threw = false;
    try {
      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.insert(organisationsTable).values({
          name: 'Rollback Test Org',
          code: `${rbPrefix}_ORG`,
          type: 'OTHER',
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        });
        await tx.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
          organisationId: (await tx.select({ id: organisationsTable.id })
            .from(organisationsTable)
            .where(sql`${organisationsTable.code} = ${rbPrefix + '_ORG'}`))[0]!.id,
          name: 'Rollback Test Entity',
          code: `${rbPrefix}_PE`,
          type: 'LOCATION',
          subtype: 'SITE',
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        });
        throw new Error('Forced rollback');
      });
    } catch {
      threw = true;
    }

    if (!threw) {
      fail('Transaction did not throw');
    } else {
      const orgCheck = await db.select().from(organisationsTable)
        .where(sql`${organisationsTable.code} = ${rbPrefix + '_ORG'}`);
      const peCheck = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable)
        .where(sql`${physicalEntitiesTable.code} = ${rbPrefix + '_PE'}`);

      if (orgCheck.length === 0 && peCheck.length === 0) {
        ok('Rollback verified: neither org nor entity exists');
      } else {
        fail('Rollback failed: records still exist',
          `org:${orgCheck.length} entity:${peCheck.length}`);
      }
    }
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Transaction rollback test failed', msg);
  }

  // ── 12. TRANSACTION COMMIT ──────────────────────────────────
  section('Transaction Commit');
  const coPrefix = `${T}_CO`;
  try {
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const orgRows = await tx.insert(organisationsTable).values({
        name: 'Commit Test Org',
        code: `${coPrefix}_ORG`,
        type: 'GOVERNMENT',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      }).returning();
      const org = orgRows[0]!;
      await tx.insert(physicalEntitiesTable).values({
        organisationId: org.id,
        name: 'Commit Test Entity',
        code: `${coPrefix}_PE`,
        type: 'LOCATION',
        subtype: 'SITE',
        status: 'ACTIVE',
      });
    });

    const orgCheck = await db.select().from(organisationsTable)
      .where(sql`${organisationsTable.code} = ${coPrefix + '_ORG'}`);
    const peCheck = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(sql`${physicalEntitiesTable.code} = ${coPrefix + '_PE'}`);

    if (orgCheck.length === 1 && peCheck.length === 1) {
      ok('Commit verified: both org and entity exist');
    } else {
      fail('Commit verification failed',
        `org:${orgCheck.length} entity:${peCheck.length}`);
    }

    // Clean up
    await db.delete(physicalEntitiesTable).where(sql`${physicalEntitiesTable.code} = ${coPrefix + '_PE'}`);
    await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(sql`${organisationsTable.code} = ${coPrefix + '_ORG'}`);
    ok('Cleanup of committed test records successful');
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Transaction commit test failed', msg);
  }

  // ── 13. HEALTH ENDPOINTS ────────────────────────────────────
  section('Health Endpoints');
  try {
    const { default: express } = await import('express');
    const app = express();
    const { sql: drizzleSql } = await import('drizzle-orm');

    app.get('/health', (_req, res) => { res.status(200).json({ status: 'ok' }); });
    app.get('/health/db', async (_req, res) => {
      try {
        await db.execute(drizzleSql`SELECT 1`);
        res.status(200).json({ status: 'ok', database: 'connected' });
      } catch {
        res.status(503).json({ status: 'degraded', database: 'disconnected' });
      }
    });

    const server = app.listen(0);
    const addr = server.address();
    const port = typeof addr === 'object' && addr ? addr.port : 0;

    const healthRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${port}/health`);
    const healthBody = await healthRes.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (healthRes.status === 200 && healthBody['status'] === 'ok') {
      ok('/health returns 200 with status ok');
    } else {
      fail('/health returned unexpected response', JSON.stringify(healthBody));
    }

    const dbRes = await fetch(`http://localhost:${port}/health/db`);
    const dbBody = await dbRes.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (dbRes.status === 200 && dbBody['status'] === 'ok' && dbBody['database'] === 'connected') {
      ok('/health/db returns 200 with database connected');
    } else {
      fail('/health/db returned unexpected response', JSON.stringify(dbBody));
    }

    server.close();
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Health endpoint test failed', msg);
  }

  // ── 14. FINAL CLEANUP ───────────────────────────────────────
  section('Final Cleanup');
  try {
    await cleanup();
    const remaining = await db.select().from(organisationsTable)
      .where(sql`${organisationsTable.code} LIKE ${T + '%'}`);
    if (remaining.length === 0) {
      ok('All test records cleaned up');
    } else {
      fail(`${remaining.length} test records remain`);
    }
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    fail('Cleanup failed', msg);
  }

  // ── SUMMARY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n============================================================');
  console.log(`RESULTS: ${passed} PASSED, ${failed} FAILED`);
  console.log('============================================================');

  process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch(async (e: unknown) => {
  const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
  console.error(`\nFATAL ERROR: ${msg}`);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import { db } from './index.js';
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  taxonomyVersionsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
  activityDataTable,
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from './schema/index.js';

const PREFIX = '__VERIFY_TAX__';

let passed = 0;
let failed = 0;

function ok(msg: string) {
  passed++;
  console.log(`  ✓ ${msg}`);
}
function fail(msg: string, detail?: string) {
  failed++;
  console.log(`  ✗ ${msg}${detail ? ` — ${detail}` : ''}`);
}

async function main() {
  console.log('=== Taxonomy Schema Verification ===\n');

  // ── 1. Create taxonomy version ──
  console.log('1. Taxonomy version insert');
  const versionRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyVersionsTable)
    .values({
      name: `${PREFIX} Test Taxonomy`,
      version: '0.0.1',
      description: 'Verification test taxonomy',
      isActive: true,
    })
    .returning();
  const version = versionRows[0]!;
  ok(`Version created: ${version.id}`);

  // ── 2. Create root taxonomy activity (parent = null) ──
  console.log('\n2. Root taxonomy activity insert');
  const rootRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .values({
      taxonomyVersionId: version.id,
      parentId: null,
      code: `${PREFIX}.ENERGY`,
      name: 'Energy',
      slug: `${PREFIX.toLowerCase()}-energy`,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  const root = rootRows[0]!;
  ok(`Root activity created: ${root.code} (parent_id = null)`);

  // ── 3. Create child taxonomy activity referencing parent ──
  console.log('\n3. Child taxonomy activity insert');
  const childRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .values({
      taxonomyVersionId: version.id,
      parentId: root.id,
      code: `${PREFIX}.ENERGY.FUEL`,
      name: 'Fuel',
      slug: `${PREFIX.toLowerCase()}-fuel`,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  const child = childRows[0]!;
  ok(`Child activity created: ${child.code} (parent_id = ${root.id})`);

  // Create leaf
  const leafRows = await db
    .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .values({
      taxonomyVersionId: version.id,
      parentId: child.id,
      code: `${PREFIX}.ENERGY.FUEL.DIESEL`,
      name: 'Diesel',
      slug: `${PREFIX.toLowerCase()}-diesel`,
      description: 'Diesel fuel for stationary combustion',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  const leaf = leafRows[0]!;
  ok(`Leaf activity created: ${leaf.code} (parent_id = ${child.id})`);

  // ── 4. Create emission factors referencing the same taxonomy activity ──
  console.log('\n4. Emission factors for same taxonomy activity (different country/year)');

  const ef1Rows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: `${PREFIX}-ef-india-2024`,
      activityId: leaf.code,
      name: 'Diesel - India 2024',
      factor: '2.680000',
      unit: 'L',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/L',
      scopes: ['1'],
      countryCode: 'IN',
      countryName: 'India',
      year: 2024,
      source: 'CEA',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  ok(`EF1 created: ${ef1Rows[0]!.name} (IN, 2024)`);

  const ef2Rows = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId: `${PREFIX}-ef-uk-2024`,
      activityId: leaf.code,
      name: 'Diesel - UK 2024',
      factor: '2.510000',
      unit: 'L',
      factorUnit: 'kgCO2e/L',
      scopes: ['1'],
      countryCode: 'GB',
      countryName: 'United Kingdom',
      year: 2024,
      source: 'DEFRA',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  ok(`EF2 created: ${ef2Rows[0]!.name} (GB, 2024)`);

  // ── 5. Create activity data referencing the same taxonomy activity ──
  console.log('\n5. Activity data referencing taxonomy activity');

  // Need a temp org + reporting period for FK
  const orgRows = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({
      name: `${PREFIX} Test Org`,
      code: `${PREFIX}_ORG`,
      type: 'COMPANY',
      email: 'verify@test.com',
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  const org = orgRows[0]!;

  const rpRows = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: org.id,
      name: `${PREFIX} RP`,
      startDate: new Date('2025-01-01'),
      endDate: new Date('2025-12-31'),
      isBaseline: false,
      status: 'OPEN',
    })
    .returning();
  const rp = rpRows[0]!;

  const actRows = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: org.id,
      reportingPeriodId: rp.id,
      taxonomyActivityId: leaf.id,
      category: 'DIESEL',
      scope: 'SCOPE_1',
      quantity: '500.0000',
      unit: 'L',
      description: '500 L diesel consumed by generator',
      status: 'DRAFT',
      inputSource: 'MANUAL',
    })
    .returning();
  ok(`Activity data created: ${actRows[0]!.id} (taxonomy_activity_id = ${leaf.id})`);

  // ── 6. Verify multiple EFs reference same taxonomy activity ──
  console.log('\n6. Verify multiple EFs for same taxonomy activity');
  const efsForLeaf = await db
    .select({ id: emissionFactorsTable.id, name: emissionFactorsTable.name, countryCode: emissionFactorsTable.countryCode })
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.activityId, leaf.code));
  if (efsForLeaf.length >= 2) {
    ok(`Found ${efsForLeaf.length} emission factors for ${leaf.code}`);
  } else {
    fail(`Expected >= 2 EFs, found ${efsForLeaf.length}`);
  }

  // ── 7. Verify different countries/years for same taxonomy ──
  console.log('\n7. Verify different country codes for same taxonomy activity');
  const countries = efsForLeaf.map((r) => r.countryCode).sort();
  if (countries.length === 2 && countries[0] === 'GB' && countries[1] === 'IN') {
    ok(`Country codes: ${countries.join(', ')}`);
  } else {
    fail(`Unexpected country codes: ${JSON.stringify(countries)}`);
  }

  // ── 8. Verify self-referencing parent/child ──
  console.log('\n8. Verify parent/child relationship');
  const childWithParent = await db
    .select({ parentId: taxonomyActivitiesTable.parentId })
    .from(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, child.id));
  if (childWithParent[0]?.parentId === root.id) {
    ok(`Child parent_id correctly points to root`);
  } else {
    fail(`Child parent_id mismatch`, `expected ${root.id}, got ${childWithParent[0]?.parentId}`);
  }

  // ── Cleanup ──
  console.log('\n9. Cleanup');
  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.organisationId, org.id));
  await db.delete(emissionFactorsTable).where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.activityId, leaf.code));
  await db.delete(taxonomyActivitiesTable).where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.taxonomyVersionId, version.id));
  await db.delete(taxonomyVersionsTable).where(eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.id, version.id));
  await db.delete(reportingPeriodsTable).where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, org.id));
  await db.delete(organisationsTable).where(eq(organisationsTable.id, org.id));
  ok('Test data cleaned up');

  // ── Summary ──
  console.log(`\n=== Results: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed ===`);
  process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('Verification failed:', e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```typescript
import { db } from './db/index.js';
```

```typescript
async function runE2E() {
  console.log('--- STARTING E2E JOURNEY ---');

  // 1. Create University & Admin
  console.log('1. Creating University & Admin User...');
  const [org] = await db.insert(organisationsTable).values({ name: 'Demo University', type: 'UNIVERSITY' }).returning();
  const [user] = await db.insert(usersTable).values({ 
    organisationId: org.id,

    firstName: 'Demo', 
    lastName: 'Admin',
    role: 'ADMIN',
    clerkId: 'test_clerk_id_' + Date.now()
  }).returning();

  // 2. Setup Hierarchy
  console.log('2. Setting up University Hierarchy...');
  await onboardingService.completeOnboarding(org.id, {
    structure: [{
      name: 'Main Campus',
      type: 'CAMPUS',
      buildings: [{
        name: 'Academic Block',
        floors: [{ name: 'Ground Floor' }]
      }]
    }]
  });
  const hierarchy = await onboardingService.getPhysicalHierarchy(org.id);
  const mainCampus = hierarchy.find(h => h.name === 'Main Campus');
  const academicBlock = mainCampus.children.find(c => c.name === 'Academic Block');
  const groundFloor = academicBlock.children.find(c => c.name === 'Ground Floor');
  console.log(`   -> Created: ${mainCampus.name} > ${academicBlock.name} > ${groundFloor.name}`);

  // 3. Create Reporting Period
  console.log('3. Creating Reporting Period...');
  const [period] = await db.insert(reportingPeriodsTable).values({
    organisationId: org.id,
    name: 'FY 2025-26',
    startDate: new Date('2025-04-01'),
    endDate: new Date('2026-03-31'),
    status: 'OPEN'
  }).returning();

  // 4. Add Activity Data
  console.log('4. Adding Activity Data (Electricity 1000 kWh)...');
  const [elecActivity] = await db.select().from(taxonomyActivitiesTable).where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.name, 'Electricity')).limit(1);
  
  const activity = await activityDataService.createActivityData({
    universityId: org.id,
    reportingPeriodId: period.id,
    physicalEntityId: groundFloor.id,
    taxonomyActivityId: elecActivity.id,
    quantity: 1000,
    unit: 'kWh',
    category: 'Electricity',
    startDate: '2025-04-01',
    endDate: '2025-04-30',
    description: 'April Electricity Bill'
  });
  console.log(`   -> Draft Activity created: ${activity.id}`);

  // 5. Verify Activity (triggers calculations)
  console.log('5. Verifying Activity (Triggers Calculation)...');
  const verifiedActivity = await activityDataService.changeActivityStatus(activity.id, 'VERIFIED', user.id);
  
  // 6. Check Dashboard
  console.log('6. Checking Dashboard Aggregation...');
  const dashboardOverview = await dashboardService.getOverview(org.id, period.id);
  console.log(`   -> Dashboard Total Emissions: ${dashboardOverview.totalEmissionsTonnes * 1000} kgCO2e`);

  // 7. Create Baseline
  console.log('7. Creating Baseline...');
  const baseline = await baselinesService.createBaseline({
    universityId: org.id,
    reportingPeriodId: period.id,
    methodology: 'GHG Protocol',
  });
  await baselinesService.changeBaselineStatus(baseline.id, 'APPROVED', user.id);
  console.log(`   -> Approved Baseline created for ${baseline.baselineYear}: ${baseline.totalKgCO2e} kgCO2e`);

  // 8. Create Target
  console.log('8. Creating Target (30% reduction)...');
  const target = await targetsService.createTarget({
    universityId: org.id,
    targetYear: 2030,
    reductionPct: 30,
    description: 'Campus 2030 Goal'
  });
  console.log(`   -> Target 2030 created: ${target.targetCo2eKg} kgCO2e`);

  // 9. Generate Recommendations
  console.log('9. Generating Recommendations...');
  const recommendations = await recommendationsService.generateRecommendations(org.id, period.id);
  console.log(`   -> Generated ${recommendations.length} recommendations`);
  if (recommendations.length > 0) {
    console.log(`      Example: ${recommendations[0].title}`);
  }

  // 10. Generate Report
  console.log('10. Generating PDF Report...');
  // Note: generateReportPdf requires actual AWS S3 to be mocked or connected, so we'll just initiate the report.
  const report = await reportsService.generateReport(org.id, period.id);
  console.log(`   -> Report initiated with ID: ${report.reportId} and Status: ${report.status}`);

  console.log('--- E2E JOURNEY COMPLETE! ---');
  process.exit(0);
}

runE2E().catch(console.error);
```

SHA-256: `9db4f2fcadff13ff6054d9cd2e77e16763a493774e7a2dfdcd5970cbe1812e10`

```typescript
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { verifyToken } from '../utils/jwt.js';

// DEMO-ONLY reusable Bearer JWT middleware. Intentionally NOT attached to any
// existing route yet; future modules can opt in per-router/per-route.
//
//   Authorization: Bearer <token>
//
// On success populates req.user = { userId, email } (matching the shape the
// existing controllers already read defensively).

export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
}

type AuthenticatedRequest = Request & { user?: AuthenticatedUser };

export function authenticate(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  const header = req.headers.authorization;

  if (!header) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Missing Authorization header' });
    return;
  }

  if (!header.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Malformed Authorization header' });
    return;
  }

  const token = header.slice('Bearer '.length).trim();
  if (!token) {
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Malformed Authorization header' });
    return;
  }

  let payload;
  try {
    payload = verifyToken(token);
  } catch {
    // Covers invalid signature, malformed token and expired token alike.
    res.status(401).json({ success: false, message: 'Invalid or expired token' });
    return;
  }

  (req as AuthenticatedRequest).user = payload;
  next();
}
```

### 126. `original-neon-backend/src/routes/v1/activityData.ts`

SHA-256: `f586e64b4d5c02b18220f5089ae4659bd1b48d7a9e9525c28864a5df52cf2e2a`

```typescript
import { Router, type RequestHandler } from 'express';
import multer from 'multer';
import { createActivityDataController } from '../../controllers/activityDataCreate.js';
import { getActivityDataController } from '../../controllers/activityDataList.js';
import { getActivityDataByIdController } from '../../controllers/activityDataGetById.js';
import { updateActivityDataController } from '../../controllers/activityDataUpdate.js';
import { deleteActivityDataController } from '../../controllers/activityDataDelete.js';
import {
  rejectActivityDataController,
  startReviewActivityDataController,
  submitActivityDataController,
  verifyActivityDataController,
} from '../../controllers/activityDataWorkflow.js';
import {
  confirmImport,
  downloadTemplate,
  previewImport,
} from '../../controllers/activityDataImportV1.js';
import { getReviewActivitiesController } from '../../controllers/activityDataList.js';
import { authenticate } from '../../middleware/authContext.js';

function wrapMulter(multerMiddleware: RequestHandler): RequestHandler {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    void Promise.resolve(
      multerMiddleware(req, res, (err?: unknown) => {
        if (err instanceof Error) {
          res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: err.message });
          return;
        }
        next();
      }),
    ).catch(next);
  };
}

export function csvFileFilter(_req: unknown, file: { mimetype: string }, cb: (e: Error | null, ok?: boolean) => void): void {
  const allowedTypes = [
    'text/csv',
    'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
    'application/vnd.ms-excel',
  ];
  if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
    cb(null, true);
  } else {
    cb(new Error('Invalid file type. Allowed: CSV, XLSX, XLS'));
  }
}

const upload = multer({
  storage: multer.memoryStorage(),
  limits: { fileSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 },
  fileFilter: csvFileFilter,
});

const router = Router();

router.post('/', createActivityDataController);

// Import and review routes must be registered before parameterized /:id routes.
router.get('/import/template', downloadTemplate);
router.post('/import/preview', wrapMulter(upload.single('file')), previewImport);
router.post('/import/confirm', confirmImport);
// Auth required here: the review list enforces university isolation from the
// JWT (403 for cross-tenant access), which only works with an authenticated user.
router.get('/review', authenticate, getReviewActivitiesController);

router.get('/', getActivityDataController);

router.get('/:id', getActivityDataByIdController);
router.patch('/:id', updateActivityDataController);
router.delete('/:id', deleteActivityDataController);

router.post('/:id/submit', submitActivityDataController);
router.post('/:id/start-review', startReviewActivityDataController);
router.post('/:id/verify', verifyActivityDataController);
router.post('/:id/reject', rejectActivityDataController);

export default router;
```

```typescript
import { Router, type RequestHandler } from 'express';
import multer from 'multer';
import {
  upload,
  getAll,
  getById,
  getByActivity,
  remove,
  runOcr,
  createFromOcr,
} from '../../controllers/documentsV1.js';
import { authenticate } from '../../middleware/authContext.js';

function wrapMulter(multerMiddleware: RequestHandler): RequestHandler {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    void Promise.resolve(
      multerMiddleware(req, res, (err?: unknown) => {
        if (err instanceof Error) {
          res.status(400).json({ success: false, message: err.message });
          return;
        }
        next();
      }),
    ).catch(next);
  };
}

export function documentFileFilter(_req: unknown, file: { mimetype: string }, cb: (e: Error | null, ok?: boolean) => void): void {
  const allowedTypes = [
    'application/pdf',
    'image/png',
    'image/jpeg',
    'image/jpg',
    'text/csv',
    'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
  ];
  if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
    cb(null, true);
  } else {
    cb(new Error('Invalid file type. Allowed: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, CSV, XLSX'));
  }
}

const uploadMiddleware = multer({
  storage: multer.memoryStorage(),
  limits: { fileSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 },
  fileFilter: documentFileFilter,
});

const documentsRouter = Router();
documentsRouter.use(authenticate);

documentsRouter.post('/upload', wrapMulter(uploadMiddleware.single('file')), upload);
documentsRouter.get('/', getAll);
documentsRouter.get('/activity/:activityId', getByActivity);
documentsRouter.get('/:id', getById);
documentsRouter.delete('/:id', remove);
documentsRouter.post('/:id/ocr', runOcr);
documentsRouter.post('/:id/create-activity', createFromOcr);

export default documentsRouter;
```

### 151. `original-neon-backend/src/services/activityDataContract.ts`

SHA-256: `bf676914d7b57006c32c653ca05c77adaf288ae50d279c9bac0c188f1a552243`

```typescript
import type { activityDataTable, documentsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { calculationsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import type { EntityAncestry } from '../utils/physicalEntityTree.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';
import { desc, inArray } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';

export type ActivityDataRow = typeof activityDataTable.$inferSelect;
export type CalculationRow = typeof calculationsTable.$inferSelect;
export type DocumentRow = typeof documentsTable.$inferSelect;

/**
 * Latest calculation snapshot per activity (by calculatedAt), keyed by
 * activity_data_id. Used to embed `calculations: [snapshot]` into activity
 * responses so consumers (frontend) can read item.calculations[0].co2eKg.
 */
export async function fetchLatestCalculationsMap(
  activityIds: string[],
): Promise<Map<string, CalculationRow>> {
  const map = new Map<string, CalculationRow>();
  if (activityIds.length === 0) return map;
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(calculationsTable)
    .where(inArray(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityIds))
    .orderBy(calculationsTable.activityDataId, desc(calculationsTable.calculatedAt));
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!map.has(row.activityDataId)) {
      map.set(row.activityDataId, row);
    }
  }
  return map;
}

export function serializeCalculationSnapshot(row: CalculationRow): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    activityDataId: row.activityDataId,
    emissionFactorId: row.emissionFactorId,
    scope: row.scope,
    quantity: numericToNumber(row.quantity),
    activityUnit: row.activityUnit,
    emissionFactor: numericToNumber(row.emissionFactor),
    factorUnit: row.factorUnit,
    factorSource: row.factorSource,
    factorVersion: row.factorVersion,
    factorName: row.factorName,
    co2eKg: numericToNumber(row.co2eKg),
    status: row.status,
    calculatedAt: row.calculatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export function serializeActivityDataRow(
  row: ActivityDataRow,
  ancestry: EntityAncestry | null,
  calculations?: Record<string, unknown>[],
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    universityId: row.organisationId,
    reportingPeriodId: row.reportingPeriodId,
    campusId: ancestry?.campusId ?? null,
    buildingId: ancestry?.buildingId ?? null,
    floorId: ancestry?.floorId ?? null,
    assetId: null,
    category: row.category,
    scope: row.scope,
    quantity: numericToNumber(row.quantity),
    unit: row.unit,
    activityDate: row.activityDate ? row.activityDate.toISOString() : null,
    description: row.description,
    status: row.status,
    enteredById: row.enteredById,
    verifiedById: row.verifiedById,
    verifiedAt: row.verifiedAt ? row.verifiedAt.toISOString() : null,
    rejectionReason: row.rejectionReason,
    inputSource: row.inputSource,
    sourceFileId: row.sourceFileId,
    sourceFileName: row.sourceFileName,
    sourceDocumentUrl: row.sourceDocumentUrl,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    calculations: calculations ?? [],
  };
}

export interface ActivityRelationObjects {
  campus: { name: string } | null;
  building: { name: string } | null;
  floor: { name: string } | null;
  createdBy: { firstName: string | null; lastName: string | null } | null;
  verifiedBy: { firstName: string | null; lastName: string | null } | null;
}

export function buildActivityRelationObjects(
  row: ActivityDataRow,
  ancestry: EntityAncestry | null,
): ActivityRelationObjects {
  return {
    campus: ancestry?.campusName != null ? { name: ancestry.campusName } : null,
    building: ancestry?.buildingName != null ? { name: ancestry.buildingName } : null,
    floor: ancestry?.floorName != null ? { name: ancestry.floorName } : null,
    createdBy:
      row.enteredById !== null ? { firstName: null, lastName: null } : null,
    verifiedBy:
      row.verifiedById !== null ? { firstName: null, lastName: null } : null,
  };
}

export function serializeDocumentRow(row: DocumentRow): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    universityId: row.organisationId,
    activityDataId: row.activityDataId,
    documentType: row.documentType,
    fileName: row.fileName,
    originalName: row.originalName,
    fileUrl: row.fileUrl,
    mimeType: row.mimeType,
    fileSize: row.fileSize,
    storagePath: row.storagePath,
    publicUrl: row.publicUrl,
    status: row.status,
    description: row.description,
    uploadedById: row.uploadedById,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}
```

SHA-256: `ef28970e65f51ded393f05eb739e9aadb2e722e83702036dd921fd7fefdd52d6`

```typescript
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import type { CreateActivityDataInput } from '../validators/activityDataCreate.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import { resolveTaxonomyActivityId } from '../utils/taxonomyBridge.js';
import {
  fetchAncestry,
  resolveMostGranularEntityId,
} from '../utils/physicalEntityTree.js';
import { serializeActivityDataRow } from './activityDataContract.js';

export async function createActivityData(
  userId: string | null,
  data: CreateActivityDataInput,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const periodRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, data.reportingPeriodId))
    .limit(1);

  const period = periodRows[0];
  if (!period) throw new Error('Reporting period not found');

  const activityDate = new Date(data.activityDate);
  if (activityDate < period.startDate || activityDate > period.endDate) {
    throw new Error(
      `Activity date must be within reporting period (${period.startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0]} to ${period.endDate.toISOString().split('T')[0]})`,
    );
  }

  if (period.organisationId !== data.universityId) {
    throw new Error('Reporting period does not belong to the specified university');
  }

  const physicalEntityId = resolveMostGranularEntityId({
    campusId: data.campusId ?? null,
    buildingId: data.buildingId ?? null,
    floorId: data.floorId ?? null,
  });

  if (physicalEntityId !== null) {
    const entityRows = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, physicalEntityId))
      .limit(1);
    if (entityRows.length === 0) throw new Error('Physical entity not found');
  }

  const taxonomyActivityId = await resolveTaxonomyActivityId(data.category);

  const quantityString = data.quantity.toFixed(4);

  const duplicateRows = await db
    .select({ id: activityDataTable.id })
    .from(activityDataTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(activityDataTable.organisationId, data.universityId),
        eq(activityDataTable.reportingPeriodId, data.reportingPeriodId),
        eq(activityDataTable.activityDate, activityDate),
        eq(activityDataTable.category, data.category),
        eq(activityDataTable.quantity, quantityString),
        eq(activityDataTable.unit, data.unit),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  const isDuplicate = duplicateRows.length > 0;

  const description = isDuplicate
    ? `POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: ${data.description || ''}`
    : (data.description ?? null);

  const inserted = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: data.universityId,
      reportingPeriodId: data.reportingPeriodId,
      physicalEntityId,
      taxonomyActivityId,
      category: data.category,
      scope: data.scope,
      quantity: quantityString,
      unit: data.unit,
      activityDate,
      description,
      status: 'DRAFT',
      enteredById: userId,
      inputSource: data.inputSource ?? 'MANUAL',
      sourceFileId: data.sourceFileId ?? null,
      sourceFileName: data.sourceFileName ?? null,
      sourceDocumentUrl: data.sourceDocumentUrl ?? null,
    })
    .returning();

  const row = inserted[0];
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create activity data');

  const ancestry = physicalEntityId !== null ? await fetchAncestry(physicalEntityId) : null;
  const serialized = serializeActivityDataRow(row, ancestry);

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'ACTIVITY_CREATED',
    entity: 'ActivityData',
    entityId: row.id,
    organisationId: data.universityId,
    userId,
    newValue: serialized,
    description: 'Activity data created',
  });

  return serialized;
}
```

### 153. `original-neon-backend/src/services/activityDataDelete.ts`

SHA-256: `57ea608c145ca7faa15037440cd0df421a2dd823682893da9f6fea67c5c505ec`

```typescript
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { activityDataTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { serializeActivityDataRow } from './activityDataContract.js';
import { findScopedActivityRow } from './activityDataScopedFetch.js';
import { fetchAncestry } from '../utils/physicalEntityTree.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';

export async function deleteActivityData(
  id: string,
  universityId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const record = await findScopedActivityRow(id, universityId);
  if (!record) {
    throw new Error('Activity data not found');
  }

  if (record.status === 'VERIFIED') {
    throw new Error('Cannot delete VERIFIED activity data');
  }

  const ancestry = record.physicalEntityId
    ? await fetchAncestry(record.physicalEntityId)
    : null;

  await db.delete(activityDataTable).where(eq(activityDataTable.id, id));

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'DELETE',
    entity: 'ActivityData',
    entityId: id,
    organisationId: universityId,
    oldValue: serializeActivityDataRow(record, ancestry),
    description: 'Activity data deleted',
  });
}
```

SHA-256: `d911b890f9f5a9b6e79c8e7c0e81ec3364a81c068238238c32b3ef9165d247ec`

```typescript
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { documentsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import {
  buildActivityRelationObjects,
  serializeActivityDataRow,
  serializeCalculationSnapshot,
  serializeDocumentRow,
  fetchLatestCalculationsMap,
} from './activityDataContract.js';
import { findScopedActivityRow } from './activityDataScopedFetch.js';
import { fetchAncestry } from '../utils/physicalEntityTree.js';

export async function getActivityDataById(
  id: string,
  universityId: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const record = await findScopedActivityRow(id, universityId);
  if (!record) {
    throw new Error('Activity data not found');
  }

  const ancestry = record.physicalEntityId
    ? await fetchAncestry(record.physicalEntityId)
    : null;

  const docRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(documentsTable)
    .where(eq(documentsTable.activityDataId, id))
    .orderBy(documentsTable.createdAt);

  const calculationsMap = await fetchLatestCalculationsMap([id]);
  const latestCalculation = calculationsMap.get(id);

  return {
    ...serializeActivityDataRow(
      record,
      ancestry,
      latestCalculation ? [serializeCalculationSnapshot(latestCalculation)] : [],
    ),
    ...buildActivityRelationObjects(record, ancestry),
    documents: docRows.map(serializeDocumentRow),
  };
}
```
