```typescript
import { and, desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  documentsTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';

type DocumentRow = typeof documentsTable.$inferSelect;

function serializeDocument(document: DocumentRow, uploadedById: string | null) {
  return {
    id: document.id,
    universityId: document.organisationId,
    activityDataId: document.activityDataId,
    documentType: document.documentType,
    fileName: document.fileName,
    originalName: document.originalName,
    fileUrl: document.fileUrl,
    mimeType: document.mimeType,
    fileSize: document.fileSize,
    storagePath: document.storagePath,
    publicUrl: document.publicUrl,
    status: document.status,
    description: document.description,
    uploadedById: document.uploadedById,
    createdAt: document.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: document.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    uploadedBy: uploadedById ? { id: uploadedById } : null,
  };
}

async function serializeRows(rows: { document: DocumentRow; uploadedById: string | null }[]) {
  return rows.map(({ document, uploadedById }) => serializeDocument(document, uploadedById));
}

const baseSelect = {
  document: documentsTable,
  uploadedById: usersTable.id,
};

export async function getDocuments(universityId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select(baseSelect)
    .from(documentsTable)
    .leftJoin(usersTable, eq(documentsTable.uploadedById, usersTable.id))
    .where(eq(documentsTable.organisationId, universityId))
    .orderBy(desc(documentsTable.createdAt));
  return serializeRows(rows);
}

export async function findDocumentById(id: string, universityId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select(baseSelect)
    .from(documentsTable)
    .leftJoin(usersTable, eq(documentsTable.uploadedById, usersTable.id))
    .where(and(eq(documentsTable.id, id), eq(documentsTable.organisationId, universityId)))
    .limit(1);
  const row = rows[0];
  return row ? serializeDocument(row.document, row.uploadedById) : null;
}

export async function getDocumentById(id: string, universityId: string) {
  const document = await findDocumentById(id, universityId);
  if (!document) throw new Error('Document not found');
  return document;
}

export async function getDocumentsByActivityId(activityDataId: string, universityId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select(baseSelect)
    .from(documentsTable)
    .leftJoin(usersTable, eq(documentsTable.uploadedById, usersTable.id))
    .where(and(eq(documentsTable.activityDataId, activityDataId), eq(documentsTable.organisationId, universityId)))
    .orderBy(desc(documentsTable.createdAt));
  return serializeRows(rows);
}

export async function deleteDocument(id: string, universityId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ id: documentsTable.id })
    .from(documentsTable)
    .where(and(eq(documentsTable.id, id), eq(documentsTable.organisationId, universityId)))
    .limit(1);
  if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error('Document not found');
  await db.delete(documentsTable).where(eq(documentsTable.id, id));
}

export async function runMockOcr(id: string, universityId: string) {
  const document = await getDocumentById(id, universityId);

  // Placeholder OCR processing delay
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));

  return {
    documentId: document.id,
    extractedData: {
      date: '2026-08-15',
      vendor: 'Utility Corp',
      totalAmount: 12500,
      unit: 'kWh',
      category: 'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
    },
    confidenceScore: 0.92,
  };
}

export async function createActivityFromOcr(data: {
  universityId: string;
  reportingPeriodId: string;
  ocrData: Record<string, unknown>;
  sourceFileId: string | null;
}) {
  const ocrData = data.ocrData as {
    category?: string;
    totalAmount?: number;
    unit?: string;
    date?: string;
    vendor?: string;
  };

  const [activity] = await db
    .insert(activityDataTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: data.universityId,
      reportingPeriodId: data.reportingPeriodId,
      category: (ocrData.category || 'OTHER') as never,
      scope: 'SCOPE_1' as never,
      quantity: String(ocrData.totalAmount || 1),
      unit: ocrData.unit || 'unit',
      activityDate: ocrData.date ? new Date(ocrData.date) : new Date(),
      description: `Imported via OCR: ${ocrData.vendor}`,
      inputSource: 'INVOICE' as never,
      sourceFileId: data.sourceFileId,
      status: 'DRAFT' as never,
    })
    .returning();

  if (!activity) throw new Error('Failed to create activity');
  return {
    ...activity,
    quantity: Number(activity.quantity),
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { and, arrayContains, count, eq, notExists, or, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';

  activityDataTable,

const UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

function readMetadata(row: EmissionFactorRow): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (row.metadata !== null && typeof row.metadata === 'object' && !Array.isArray(row.metadata)) {
    return row.metadata as Record<string, unknown>;
  }
  return {};
}

function metadataString(metadata: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): string | null {
  const value = metadata[key];
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
}

function scopeToken(scope: string): string {
  return scope.replace('SCOPE_', '');
}

export function serializeEmissionFactorRow(row: EmissionFactorRow): Record<string, unknown> {
  const metadata = readMetadata(row);
  const sourceVersion =
    metadataString(metadata, 'sourceVersion') ?? metadataString(metadata, 'climatiq_version');
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    category: row.category,
    scope:
      row.scopes && row.scopes.length > 0
        ? `SCOPE_${row.scopes[0]}`
        : null,
    factor: numericToNumber(row.factor) ?? 0,
    unit: row.factorUnit === 'kgCO2e' ? row.unit : `${row.factorUnit}/${row.unit}`,
    source: row.source,
    sourceName: row.sourceDataset,
    sourceVersion,
    sourceUrl: row.sourceLink,
    region: row.region,
    country: row.countryCode ?? row.countryName,
    validFrom: row.validFrom ?? null,
    validTo: row.validTo ?? null,
    status: row.status,
    isFixed: row.source !== 'CLIMATIQ',
    year: row.year ?? null,
    notes: metadataString(metadata, 'notes'),
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

function normalizeCountry(input: string): { countryCode: string | null; countryName: string | null } {
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return { countryCode: null, countryName: null };
  if (/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(trimmed)) {
    return { countryCode: trimmed.toUpperCase(), countryName: null };
  }
  return { countryCode: null, countryName: trimmed };
}

export async function getEmissionFactorByIdV1(id: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  if (!UUID_RE.test(id)) {
    throw new Error('Emission factor not found');
  }
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new Error('Emission factor not found');
  }
  return serializeEmissionFactorRow(row);
}

async function findRawById(id: string): Promise<EmissionFactorRow> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new Error('Emission factor not found');
  }
  return row;
}

export async function createEmissionFactorV1(
  data: CreateEmissionFactorInput,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const compound = splitCompoundUnit(data.unit);
  const activityUnit = compound ? compound.activityUnit : data.unit.trim();
  const factorUnit = compound ? compound.factorUnit : 'kgCO2e';
  const country = normalizeCountry(data.country ?? '');

  const taxonomyCode = CATEGORY_TAXONOMY_CODES[data.category] ?? `MANUAL.${data.category}`;
  const factorId = `manual-${data.category}-${country.countryCode ?? 'na'}-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;

  const metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (data.sourceVersion !== undefined) metadata.sourceVersion = data.sourceVersion;
  if (data.notes !== undefined) metadata.notes = data.notes;

  const inserted = await db
    .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
    .values({
      factorId,
      activityId: taxonomyCode,
      name: data.name,
      category: data.category,
      scopes: [scopeToken(data.scope)],
      factor: String(data.factor),
      unit: activityUnit,
      factorUnit,
      region: data.region ?? null,
      countryCode: country.countryCode,
      countryName: country.countryName,
      source: data.source,
      sourceDataset: data.sourceName ?? null,
      sourceLink: data.sourceUrl ?? null,
      validFrom: data.validFrom ? data.validFrom : null,
      validTo: data.validTo ? data.validTo : null,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
      year: null,
      metadata,
    })
    .returning();
  const created = inserted[0]!;

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'CREATE',
    entity: 'EmissionFactor',
    entityId: created.id,
    newValue: serializeEmissionFactorRow(created),
    description: 'Manual emission factor created',
  });

  return serializeEmissionFactorRow(created);
}

export interface EmissionFactorListFilters {
  category?: string;
  scope?: string;
  country?: string;
  region?: string;
  status?: string;
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
}

export async function listEmissionFactorsV1(filters: EmissionFactorListFilters): Promise<{
  data: Record<string, unknown>[];
  pagination: { page: number; limit: number; total: number; totalPages: number };
}> {
  const page = filters.page || 1;
  const limit = filters.limit || 20;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  const conditions = [];
  if (filters.category) conditions.push(eq(emissionFactorsTable.category, filters.category));
  if (filters.scope) conditions.push(arrayContains(emissionFactorsTable.scopes, [filters.scope.replace('SCOPE_', '')]));
  if (filters.country) {
    conditions.push(
      or(
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.countryCode, filters.country),
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.countryName, filters.country),
      )!,
    );
  }
  if (filters.region) conditions.push(eq(emissionFactorsTable.region, filters.region));
  if (filters.status) {
    if ((EMISSION_FACTOR_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(filters.status)) {
      conditions.push(sql`${emissionFactorsTable.status} = ${filters.status}`);
    } else {
      conditions.push(sql`false`);
    }
  }

  const where = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;

  const [rows, countResult] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select()
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(where)
      .orderBy(sql`${emissionFactorsTable.createdAt} DESC`)
      .limit(limit)
      .offset(offset),
    db.select({ value: count() }).from(emissionFactorsTable).where(where),
  ]);

  const total = Number(countResult[0]!.value);
  return {
    data: rows.map(serializeEmissionFactorRow),
    pagination: {
      page: Number(page),
      limit: Number(limit),
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / Number(limit)),
    },
  };
}

export async function updateEmissionFactorV1(
  id: string,
  data: UpdateEmissionFactorInput,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const existing = await findRawById(id);

  const values: Partial<typeof emissionFactorsTable.$inferInsert> = {};
  if (data.name !== undefined) values.name = data.name;
  if (data.category !== undefined) values.category = data.category;
  if (data.scope !== undefined) values.scopes = [scopeToken(data.scope)];
  if (data.factor !== undefined) values.factor = String(data.factor);
  if (data.unit !== undefined) {
    const compound = splitCompoundUnit(data.unit);
    values.unit = compound ? compound.activityUnit : data.unit.trim();
    values.factorUnit = compound ? compound.factorUnit : 'kgCO2e';
  }
  if (data.source !== undefined) values.source = data.source;
  if (data.sourceName !== undefined) values.sourceDataset = data.sourceName;
  if (data.sourceUrl !== undefined) values.sourceLink = data.sourceUrl;
  if (data.country !== undefined) {
    const country = normalizeCountry(data.country);
    values.countryCode = country.countryCode;
    values.countryName = country.countryName;
  }
  if (data.region !== undefined) values.region = data.region;
  if (data.validFrom) values.validFrom = data.validFrom;
  if (data.validTo) values.validTo = data.validTo;
  if (data.status !== undefined) values.status = data.status;
  if (data.sourceVersion !== undefined || data.notes !== undefined) {
    const metadata = readMetadata(existing);
    const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...metadata };
    if (data.sourceVersion !== undefined) next.sourceVersion = data.sourceVersion;
    if (data.notes !== undefined) next.notes = data.notes;
    values.metadata = next;
  }
  values.updatedAt = new Date();

  const updatedRows = await db
    .update(emissionFactorsTable)
    .set(values)
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  const updated = updatedRows[0]!;

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'UPDATE',
    entity: 'EmissionFactor',
    entityId: id,
    oldValue: { factor: numericToNumber(existing.factor) },
    newValue: { factor: numericToNumber(updated.factor) },
    description: 'Emission factor updated',
  });

  return serializeEmissionFactorRow(updated);
}

export async function deactivateEmissionFactorV1(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await findRawById(id);
  await db
    .update(emissionFactorsTable)
    .set({ status: 'INACTIVE', updatedAt: sql`now()` })
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, id));
}

function serializePendingRow(
  row: ActivityDataRow,
  ancestry: EntityAncestry | null,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    ...serializeActivityDataRow(row, ancestry),
    campus: ancestry?.campusName != null ? { name: ancestry.campusName } : null,
    building: ancestry?.buildingName != null ? { name: ancestry.buildingName } : null,
  };
}

export async function getPendingEfActivities(
  universityId: string,
  page = 1,
  limit = 20,
): Promise<{ data: Record<string, unknown>[]; pagination: Record<string, number> }> {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const where = and(
    eq(activityDataTable.organisationId, universityId),
    sql`${activityDataTable.status} = 'VERIFIED'`,
    notExists(
      db
        .select({ one: sql`1` })
        .from(calculationsTable)
        .where(eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityDataTable.id)),
    ),
  );

  const [rows, countResult] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select()
      .from(activityDataTable)
      .where(where)
      .orderBy(sql`${activityDataTable.activityDate} DESC`)
      .limit(limit)
      .offset(skip),
    db.select({ value: count() }).from(activityDataTable).where(where),
  ]);

  const entityIds = rows
    .map((r) => r.physicalEntityId)
    .filter((id): id is string => id !== null);
  const ancestryMap = await fetchAncestryMap(entityIds);

  const total = Number(countResult[0]!.value);
  return {
    data: rows.map((row) =>
      serializePendingRow(
        row,
        row.physicalEntityId ? ancestryMap.get(row.physicalEntityId) ?? null : null,
      ),
    ),
    pagination: {
      page: Number(page),
      limit: Number(limit),
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / Number(limit)),
    },
  };
}
```

SHA-256: `b098659b6a4320e5d9113345a9eaf0373821b1bbaf010d0b574cef3bc1e14b2d`

```typescript
import { and, desc, eq, lte, or, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { emissionFactorsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';
import { splitCompoundUnit } from '../utils/unitNormalization.js';
import type { ActivityCategory } from '../utils/taxonomyBridge.js';

export interface ResolvedFactor {
  id: string;
  factor: number;
  unit: string;
  factorUnit: string;
  source: string;
  sourceVersion: string | null;
  factorName: string;
}

export class PendingFactorError extends Error {
  status: 'PENDING';

  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'PendingFactorError';
    this.status = 'PENDING';
  }
}

const defaultFetch: typeof fetch = globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis);

function readMetadata(row: typeof emissionFactorsTable.$inferSelect): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (row.metadata !== null && typeof row.metadata === 'object' && !Array.isArray(row.metadata)) {
    return row.metadata as Record<string, unknown>;
  }
  return {};
}

function metadataString(metadata: Record<string, unknown>, key: string): string | null {
  const value = metadata[key];
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
}

function countryCondition(country: string) {
  return or(
    eq(emissionFactorsTable.countryCode, country),
    eq(emissionFactorsTable.countryName, country),
  )!;
}

/**
 * PRIORITY ORDER:
 * 1. Fixed EF (non-Climatiq source, country + category match)
 * 2. Climatiq Cache (locally stored from a previous API call, matching unit)
 * 3. Climatiq API (fetch dynamically based on activity category/unit, save to cache)
 * 4. No factor → throw structured error
 */
export async function getEmissionFactor(
  params: {
    category: ActivityCategory;
    country: string;
    year: number;
    activityUnit: string;
  },
  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = defaultFetch,
): Promise<ResolvedFactor> {
  const { category, country, year, activityUnit } = params;

  // ── Priority 1: Fixed EF ──────────────────────────────────────
  const fixedRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.category, category),
        countryCondition(country),
        sql`${emissionFactorsTable.source} <> 'CLIMATIQ'`,
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.status, 'ACTIVE'),
        or(lte(emissionFactorsTable.year, year), sql`${emissionFactorsTable.year} IS NULL`)!,
      ),
    )
    // Deterministic ranking: dated factors win over undated ones (Postgres puts
    // NULLS first on a plain DESC, hence the explicit NULLS LAST), then the most
    // recently registered factor wins among ties.
    .orderBy(
      sql`${emissionFactorsTable.year} DESC NULLS LAST`,
      desc(emissionFactorsTable.createdAt),
    )
    .limit(1);
  const fixedEF = fixedRows[0];

  if (fixedEF) {
    const metadata = readMetadata(fixedEF);
    return {
      id: fixedEF.id,
      factor: numericToNumber(fixedEF.factor) ?? 0,
      unit: fixedEF.unit,
      factorUnit: fixedEF.factorUnit,
      source: fixedEF.sourceDataset ?? fixedEF.source ?? 'UNKNOWN',
      sourceVersion: metadataString(metadata, 'sourceVersion'),
      factorName: fixedEF.name,
    };
  }

  // ── Priority 2: Climatiq Cache ────────────────────────────────
  const cachedRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.category, category),
        countryCondition(country),
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.year, year),
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.source, 'CLIMATIQ'),
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.status, 'ACTIVE'),
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.unit, activityUnit),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  const cached = cachedRows[0];

  if (cached) {
    const metadata = readMetadata(cached);
    return {
      id: cached.id,
      factor: numericToNumber(cached.factor) ?? 0,
      unit: cached.unit,
      factorUnit: cached.factorUnit,
      source: 'Climatiq',
      sourceVersion: metadataString(metadata, 'climatiq_version'),
      factorName: cached.name,
    };
  }

  // ── Priority 3: Climatiq API ──────────────────────────────────
  const climatiqKey = process.env.CLIMATIQ_API_KEY;
  if (!climatiqKey) {
    throw new PendingFactorError(
      `No emission factor available for ${category} in ${country}. Configure CLIMATIQ_API_KEY to enable dynamic lookup.`,
    );
  }

  const climatiqResult = await fetchFromClimatiq(
    {
      category,
      country,
      year,
      activityUnit,
      apiKey: climatiqKey,
    },
    fetchImpl,
  );

  if (!climatiqResult) {
    throw new PendingFactorError(
      `No emission factor found for activity "${category}" in country "${country}" for year ${year}. Manual entry may be required.`,
    );
  }

  // Save to ClimatiqCache (collapsed into emission_factors per blueprint §15.3)
  const fetchedAt = new Date();
  const factorId = `climatiq-${category}-${country}-${year}-${activityUnit}`;
  const efName = `Climatiq — ${category} (${country} ${year} - ${activityUnit})`;
  const compound = splitCompoundUnit(climatiqResult.unit);

  const existingRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, factorId))
    .limit(1);
  const existingDynamic = existingRows[0];

  let dynamicEF: typeof emissionFactorsTable.$inferSelect;
  if (existingDynamic) {
    const updatedRows = await db
      .update(emissionFactorsTable)
      .set({
        factor: String(climatiqResult.factor),
        factorUnit: compound ? compound.factorUnit : climatiqResult.unit,
        metadata: {
          ...(readMetadata(existingDynamic)),
          climatiq_id: climatiqResult.climatiqId,
          climatiq_version: climatiqResult.version ?? null,
          fetched_at: fetchedAt.toISOString(),
        },
        updatedAt: fetchedAt,
      })
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, existingDynamic.id))
      .returning();
    dynamicEF = updatedRows[0]!;
  } else {
    const insertedRows = await db
      .insert(emissionFactorsTable)
      .values({
        factorId,
        activityId: category,
        name: efName,
        category,
        scopes: resolveScopeForCategory(category) === 'SCOPE_2' ? ['2'] : ['1'],
        factor: String(climatiqResult.factor),
        unit: activityUnit,
        factorUnit: compound ? compound.factorUnit : climatiqResult.unit,
        countryCode: /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(country) ? country.toUpperCase() : null,
        countryName: /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(country) ? null : country,
        source: 'CLIMATIQ',
        sourceDataset: 'Climatiq API',
        year,
        status: 'ACTIVE',
        metadata: {
          climatiq_id: climatiqResult.climatiqId,
          climatiq_version: climatiqResult.version ?? null,
          fetched_at: fetchedAt.toISOString(),
        },
      })
      .returning();
    dynamicEF = insertedRows[0]!;
  }

  return {
    id: dynamicEF.id,
    factor: climatiqResult.factor,
    unit: activityUnit,
    factorUnit: compound ? compound.factorUnit : climatiqResult.unit,
    source: 'Climatiq',
    sourceVersion: climatiqResult.version ?? null,
    factorName: efName,
  };
}

// ── Climatiq API call ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interface ClimatiqResult {
  factor: number;
  unit: string;
  climatiqId: string;
  version?: string | undefined;
}

const CATEGORY_TO_CLIMATIQ_ACTIVITY: Partial<Record<ActivityCategory, string>> = {
  REFRIGERANT: 'refrigerant',
  OWNED_VEHICLE: 'passenger_vehicle',
  PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY: 'electricity-supply_grid-source_residual_mix',
  PURCHASED_STEAM: 'heat-networks-steam',
  PURCHASED_HEATING: 'heat-networks-hot_water',
  PURCHASED_COOLING: 'cooling',
};

async function fetchFromClimatiq(
  params: {
    category: ActivityCategory;
    country: string;
    year: number;
    activityUnit: string;
    apiKey: string;
  },
  fetchImpl: typeof fetch,
): Promise<ClimatiqResult | null> {
  const activityId = CATEGORY_TO_CLIMATIQ_ACTIVITY[params.category];
  if (!activityId) return null;

  const reqBody: {
    emission_factor: Record<string, unknown>;
    parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
  } = {
    emission_factor: {
      activity_id: activityId,
      region: params.country,
      year: params.year,
      data_version: '^36',
    },
    parameters: {},
  };

  let aUnit = params.activityUnit.toLowerCase();
  if (aUnit === 'kwh') aUnit = 'kWh';
  if (aUnit === 'mwh') aUnit = 'MWh';
  if (aUnit === 'l' || aUnit === 'litre' || aUnit === 'liter') aUnit = 'l';

  // Dynamic payload based on category (Issue #1)
  if (
    ['PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY', 'PURCHASED_HEATING', 'PURCHASED_COOLING', 'PURCHASED_STEAM'].includes(
      params.category,
    )
  ) {
    reqBody.parameters = { energy: 1, energy_unit: aUnit };
  } else if (params.category === 'OWNED_VEHICLE') {
    reqBody.parameters = { distance: 1, distance_unit: aUnit };
  } else if (params.category === 'REFRIGERANT') {
    reqBody.parameters = { weight: 1, weight_unit: aUnit };
  } else if (['kg', 't', 'tonne', 'ton', 'g'].includes(aUnit)) {
    reqBody.parameters = { weight: 1, weight_unit: aUnit };
  } else {
    reqBody.parameters = { volume: 1, volume_unit: aUnit };
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetchImpl('https://api.climatiq.io/data/v1/estimate', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${params.apiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(reqBody),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errBody = await response.text();
      console.warn(`[EF Resolver] Climatiq API error ${response.status}:`, errBody);
      return null;
    }

    const data = (await response.json()) as {
      co2e: number;
      co2e_unit: string;
      emission_factor?: { unit?: string; activity_id?: string; source_version?: string };
    };
    return {
      factor: data.co2e,
      unit: `${data.co2e_unit}/${data.emission_factor?.unit ?? 'unit'}`,
      climatiqId: data.emission_factor?.activity_id ?? activityId,
      version: data.emission_factor?.source_version ?? undefined,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.warn(
      `[EF Resolver] Climatiq API failed for ${params.category}/${params.country}:`,
      message,
    );
    return null;
  }
}

// ── Scope helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function resolveScopeForCategory(category: ActivityCategory): 'SCOPE_1' | 'SCOPE_2' {
  const scope2: ActivityCategory[] = [
    'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
    'PURCHASED_STEAM',
    'PURCHASED_HEATING',
    'PURCHASED_COOLING',
  ];

  return scope2.includes(category) ? 'SCOPE_2' : 'SCOPE_1';
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  calculationsTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import {
  matchEmissionFactor,
  type MatchResultMatched,
} from './emissionFactorMatch.js';

interface ActivityDataRecord {
  id: string;
  organisationId: string;
  reportingPeriodId: string;
  scope: string;
  unit: string;
  quantity: string;
  taxonomyActivityId: string | null;
}

interface CalculationRecord {
  id: string;
  activity_data_id: string;
  emission_factor_id: string;
  organisation_id: string;
  reporting_period_id: string;
  scope: string;
  quantity: string;
  activity_unit: string;
  emission_factor: string;
  factor_unit: string;
  factor_source: string | null;
  factor_version: string | null;
  factor_name: string | null;
  co2e_kg: string;
  status: string;
  calculated_at: Date;
}

interface CalculationSuccess {
  status: 'calculated';
  calculation_id: string;
  activity_data_id: string;
  emission_factor_id: string;
  activity_id: string;
  quantity: string;
  activity_unit: string;
  factor: string;
  factor_unit: string;
  emissions: string;
  emissions_unit: string;
  factor_metadata: {
    factor_id: string;
    name: string;
    source: string | null;
    year: number | null;
  };
}

export type CalculationResult = CalculationSuccess;

function parseNumericString(value: string): { integerStr: string; scale: number } {
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  const dotIndex = trimmed.indexOf('.');
  if (dotIndex === -1) {
    return { integerStr: trimmed, scale: 0 };
  }
  const intPart = trimmed.slice(0, dotIndex);
  const decPart = trimmed.slice(dotIndex + 1);
  return { integerStr: intPart + decPart, scale: decPart.length };
}

function multiplyNumeric(a: string, b: string, resultScale: number): string {
  const parsedA = parseNumericString(a);
  const parsedB = parseNumericString(b);
  const productScale = parsedA.scale + parsedB.scale;

  const product = BigInt(parsedA.integerStr) * BigInt(parsedB.integerStr);

  const scaleDiff = productScale - resultScale;
  if (scaleDiff === 0) {
    return formatNumeric(product, resultScale);
  }

  const divisor = BigInt(10) ** BigInt(scaleDiff);
  const quotient = product / divisor;
  return formatNumeric(quotient, resultScale);
}

function formatNumeric(value: bigint, scale: number): string {
  if (scale === 0) {
    return value.toString();
  }
  const negative = value < 0n;
  const abs = negative ? -value : value;
  const str = abs.toString().padStart(scale + 1, '0');
  const intPart = str.slice(0, str.length - scale);
  const decPart = str.slice(str.length - scale);
  const result = `${intPart}.${decPart}`;
  return negative ? `-${result}` : result;
}

async function loadActivityData(activityDataId: string): Promise<ActivityDataRecord | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: activityDataTable.id,
      organisationId: activityDataTable.organisationId,
      reportingPeriodId: activityDataTable.reportingPeriodId,
      scope: activityDataTable.scope,
      unit: activityDataTable.unit,
      quantity: activityDataTable.quantity,
      taxonomyActivityId: activityDataTable.taxonomyActivityId,
    })
    .from(activityDataTable)
    .where(eq(activityDataTable.id, activityDataId))
    .limit(1);

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const row = rows[0]!;
  return {
    id: row.id,
    organisationId: row.organisationId,
    reportingPeriodId: row.reportingPeriodId,
    scope: row.scope,
    unit: row.unit,
    quantity: row.quantity,
    taxonomyActivityId: row.taxonomyActivityId,
  };
}

async function findExistingCalculation(
  activityDataId: string,
): Promise<CalculationRecord | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(calculationsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityDataId),
        eq(calculationsTable.status, 'CALCULATED'),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const row = rows[0]!;
  return {
    id: row.id,
    activity_data_id: row.activityDataId,
    emission_factor_id: row.emissionFactorId,
    organisation_id: row.organisationId,
    reporting_period_id: row.reportingPeriodId,
    scope: row.scope,
    quantity: row.quantity,
    activity_unit: row.activityUnit,
    emission_factor: row.emissionFactor,
    factor_unit: row.factorUnit,
    factor_source: row.factorSource,
    factor_version: row.factorVersion,
    factor_name: row.factorName,
    co2e_kg: row.co2eKg,
    status: row.status,
    calculated_at: row.calculatedAt,
  };
}

function toCalculationSuccess(
  calc: CalculationRecord,
  activityId: string,
): CalculationSuccess {
  return {
    status: 'calculated',
    calculation_id: calc.id,
    activity_data_id: calc.activity_data_id,
    emission_factor_id: calc.emission_factor_id,
    activity_id: activityId,
    quantity: calc.quantity,
    activity_unit: calc.activity_unit,
    factor: calc.emission_factor,
    factor_unit: calc.factor_unit,
    emissions: calc.co2e_kg,
    emissions_unit: 'kg CO2e',
    factor_metadata: {
      factor_id: calc.emission_factor_id,
      name: calc.factor_name ?? 'Unknown',
      source: calc.factor_source,
      year: null,
    },
  };
}

export async function calculateEmission(
  activityDataId: string,
): Promise<{ status: number; data: CalculationResult | { success: false; error: string; details?: unknown } }> {
  // 1. Load activity data
  const activity = await loadActivityData(activityDataId);
  if (!activity) {
    return {
      status: 404,
      data: { success: false, error: 'Activity data not found' },
    };
  }

  // 2. Check for existing calculation (idempotent reuse)
  const existing = await findExistingCalculation(activityDataId);
  if (existing) {
    // Need to resolve activity_id from the emission factor
    const efRow = await db
      .select({ activityId: emissionFactorsTable.activityId })
      .from(emissionFactorsTable)
      .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, existing.emission_factor_id))
      .limit(1);

    const activityId = efRow[0]?.activityId ?? 'unknown';
    return { status: 200, data: toCalculationSuccess(existing, activityId) };
  }

  // 3. Invoke Phase 3 mapping
  const matchResult = await matchEmissionFactor(activityDataId);
  if (matchResult.status !== 200) {
    return { status: matchResult.status, data: matchResult.data as { success: false; error: string } };
  }

  const matchData = matchResult.data;
  if (!('status' in matchData) || matchData.status !== 'matched') {
    return {
      status: 200,
      data: matchData as unknown as { success: false; error: string },
    };
  }

  const matched = matchData as MatchResultMatched;

  // 4. Validate unit compatibility
  if (activity.unit !== matched.factor.unit) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      data: {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unit mismatch',
        details: {
          activity_unit: activity.unit,
          factor_unit: matched.factor.unit,
          message: `Activity unit "${activity.unit}" is not compatible with factor unit "${matched.factor.unit}"`,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  // 5. Validate quantity is non-negative
  const quantityNum = parseFloat(activity.quantity);
  if (isNaN(quantityNum) || quantityNum < 0) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      data: {
        success: false,
        error: 'Invalid quantity',
        details: { quantity: activity.quantity, message: 'Quantity must be a non-negative number' },
      },
    };
  }

  // 6. Calculate co2eKg with integer-scale precision
  const co2eKg = multiplyNumeric(activity.quantity, matched.factor.factor, 4);

  // 7. Load full emission factor for snapshot metadata
  const efRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, matched.emission_factor_id))
    .limit(1);

  const ef = efRows[0];

  // 8. Persist calculation
  const calcRows = await db
    .insert(calculationsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: activity.organisationId,
      reportingPeriodId: activity.reportingPeriodId,
      activityDataId: activity.id,
      emissionFactorId: matched.emission_factor_id,
      scope: activity.scope as 'SCOPE_1' | 'SCOPE_2',
      quantity: activity.quantity,
      activityUnit: activity.unit,
      emissionFactor: matched.factor.factor,
      factorUnit: matched.factor.factor_unit,
      factorSource: ef?.source ?? null,
      factorVersion: ef?.year != null ? String(ef.year) : null,
      factorName: matched.factor.name,
      co2eKg,
      status: 'CALCULATED',
    })
    .returning({ id: calculationsTable.id });

  const calcId = calcRows[0]!.id;

  // 9. Return result
  return {
    status: 200,
    data: {
      status: 'calculated',
      calculation_id: calcId,
      activity_data_id: activity.id,
      emission_factor_id: matched.emission_factor_id,
      activity_id: matched.activity_id,
      quantity: activity.quantity,
      activity_unit: activity.unit,
      factor: matched.factor.factor,
      factor_unit: matched.factor.factor_unit,
      emissions: co2eKg,
      emissions_unit: 'kg CO2e',
      factor_metadata: {
        factor_id: matched.emission_factor_id,
        name: matched.factor.name,
        source: ef?.source ?? null,
        year: matched.factor.year,
      },
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { emissionFactorsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import type { EmissionFactorImportItem } from '../validators/emissionFactorImport.js';
import type { ImportSummary, ImportErrorDetail } from '../types/api.js';
import { resolveFactorUnits } from '../utils/unitNormalization.js';

function stableStringify(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value !== 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return '[' + value.map(stableStringify).join(',') + ']';
  const sorted = Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort();
  return '{' + sorted.map((k) => JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + stableStringify((value as Record<string, unknown>)[k])).join(',') + '}';
}

export async function importEmissionFactors(
  items: EmissionFactorImportItem[],
): Promise<{ summary: ImportSummary; errors: ImportErrorDetail[] }> {
  const received = items.length;
  const errors: ImportErrorDetail[] = [];

  const factorIds = new Set<string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const item = items[i]!;
    if (factorIds.has(item.factor_id)) {
      errors.push({
        index: i,
        field: 'factor_id',
        message: `Duplicate factor_id "${item.factor_id}" in payload`,
      });
    }
    factorIds.add(item.factor_id);
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return {
      summary: { received, inserted: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, failed: received },
      errors,
    };
  }

  try {
    let inserted = 0;
    let updated = 0;
    let skipped = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      const item = items[i]!;
      let activityUnit: string;
      let factorUnit: string;
      try {
        const resolved = resolveFactorUnits(item.unit, item.factor_unit);
        activityUnit = resolved.activityUnit;
        factorUnit = resolved.factorUnit;
      } catch (e) {
        errors.push({
          index: i,
          field: 'unit',
          message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown unit resolution error',
        });
        continue;
      }

      const existing = await db
        .select()
        .from(emissionFactorsTable)
        .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.factorId, item.factor_id));

      if (existing.length > 0) {
        const ex = existing[0]!;
        const needsUpdate =
          ex.name !== item.name ||
          Number(ex.factor) !== item.factor ||
          ex.unit !== activityUnit ||
          ex.factorUnit !== factorUnit ||
          ex.activityId !== item.activity_id ||
          ex.useCase !== (item.use_case ?? null) ||
          ex.sector !== (item.sector ?? null) ||
          ex.category !== (item.category ?? null) ||
          ex.countryCode !== (item.country_code ?? null) ||
          ex.countryName !== (item.country_name ?? null) ||
          ex.region !== (item.region ?? null) ||
          ex.source !== (item.source ?? null) ||
          ex.sourceDataset !== (item.source_dataset ?? null) ||
          ex.sourceLink !== (item.source_link ?? null) ||
          ex.sourceFactorId !== (item.source_factor_id ?? null) ||
          ex.sourceLcaActivity !== (item.source_lca_activity ?? null) ||
          ex.factorCalculationMethod !== (item.factor_calculation_method ?? null) ||
          ex.factorCalculationOrigin !== (item.factor_calculation_origin ?? null) ||
          ex.year !== (item.year ?? null) ||
          ex.yearReleased !== (item.year_released ?? null) ||
          ex.unitType !== (item.unit_type ?? null) ||
          stableStringify(ex.scopes) !== stableStringify(item.scopes ?? null) ||
          stableStringify(ex.supportedCalculationMethods) !== stableStringify(item.supported_calculation_methods ?? null) ||
          stableStringify(ex.constituentGases) !== stableStringify(item.constituent_gases ?? null) ||
          stableStringify(ex.metadata) !== stableStringify(item.metadata ?? null);

        if (needsUpdate) {
          await db
            .update(emissionFactorsTable)
            .set({
              activityId: item.activity_id,
              name: item.name,
              factor: String(item.factor),
              unit: activityUnit,
              factorUnit: factorUnit,
              useCase: item.use_case ?? null,
              sector: item.sector ?? null,
              category: item.category ?? null,
              countryCode: item.country_code ?? null,
              countryName: item.country_name ?? null,
              region: item.region ?? null,
              source: item.source ?? null,
              sourceDataset: item.source_dataset ?? null,
              sourceLink: item.source_link ?? null,
              sourceFactorId: item.source_factor_id ?? null,
              sourceLcaActivity: item.source_lca_activity ?? null,
              factorCalculationMethod: item.factor_calculation_method ?? null,
              factorCalculationOrigin: item.factor_calculation_origin ?? null,
              supportedCalculationMethods: item.supported_calculation_methods ?? null,
              year: item.year ?? null,
              yearReleased: item.year_released ?? null,
              unitType: item.unit_type ?? null,
              scopes: item.scopes ?? null,
              constituentGases: item.constituent_gases ?? null,
              metadata: item.metadata ?? null,
              updatedAt: sql`now()`,
            })
            .where(eq(emissionFactorsTable.id, ex.id));
          updated++;
        } else {
          skipped++;
        }
      } else {
        await db.insert(emissionFactorsTable).values({
          factorId: item.factor_id,
          activityId: item.activity_id,
          name: item.name,
          factor: String(item.factor),
          unit: activityUnit,
          factorUnit: factorUnit,
          useCase: item.use_case ?? null,
          sector: item.sector ?? null,
          category: item.category ?? null,
          countryCode: item.country_code ?? null,
          countryName: item.country_name ?? null,
          region: item.region ?? null,
          source: item.source ?? null,
          sourceDataset: item.source_dataset ?? null,
          sourceLink: item.source_link ?? null,
          sourceFactorId: item.source_factor_id ?? null,
          sourceLcaActivity: item.source_lca_activity ?? null,
          factorCalculationMethod: item.factor_calculation_method ?? null,
          factorCalculationOrigin: item.factor_calculation_origin ?? null,
          supportedCalculationMethods: item.supported_calculation_methods ?? null,
          year: item.year ?? null,
          yearReleased: item.year_released ?? null,
          unitType: item.unit_type ?? null,
          scopes: item.scopes ?? null,
          constituentGases: item.constituent_gases ?? null,
          metadata: item.metadata ?? null,
          status: 'ACTIVE',
        });
        inserted++;
      }
    }

    return {
      summary: {
        received,
        inserted,
        updated,
        skipped,
        failed: errors.length,
      },
      errors,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      summary: {
        received,
        inserted: 0,
        updated: 0,
        skipped: 0,
        failed: received,
      },
      errors: [
        {
          index: -1,
          message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error',
        },
      ],
    };
  }
}
```

### 171. `original-neon-backend/src/services/emissionFactorMatch.ts`

SHA-256: `835e8c6cbc9939527146a6d1035c7fdca3a657c7937fce3f3ab5da9c07be7eb0`

```typescript
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  activityDataTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
  emissionFactorsTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';

interface ActivityDataRecord {
  id: string;
  taxonomyActivityId: string | null;
  scope: string;
  unit: string;
  activityDate: Date | null;
  reportingPeriodId: string;
}

interface TaxonomyActivityRecord {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
}

interface EmissionFactorRecord {
  id: string;
  factorId: string;
  activityId: string;
  name: string;
  unit: string;
  factor: string;
  factorUnit: string;
  scopes: string[] | null;
  year: number | null;
  countryCode: string | null;
  countryName: string | null;
  region: string | null;
  source: string | null;
  status: string;
}

export interface MatchResultMatched {
  status: 'matched';
  emission_factor_id: string;
  activity_id: string;
  factor: {
    id: string;
    factor_id: string;
    name: string;
    unit: string;
    factor: string;
    factor_unit: string;
    year: number | null;
    country_code: string | null;
  };
}

export interface MatchResultAmbiguous {
  status: 'ambiguous';
  activity_id: string;
  candidates: Array<{
    id: string;
    factor_id: string;
    name: string;
    unit: string;
    year: number | null;
    country_code: string | null;
  }>;
}

export interface MatchResultNoMatch {
  status: 'no_match';
  activity_id: string;
  reason: string;
}

export type MatchResult = MatchResultMatched | MatchResultAmbiguous | MatchResultNoMatch;

async function resolveActivityData(activityDataId: string): Promise<ActivityDataRecord | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: activityDataTable.id,
      taxonomyActivityId: activityDataTable.taxonomyActivityId,
      scope: activityDataTable.scope,
      unit: activityDataTable.unit,
      activityDate: activityDataTable.activityDate,
      reportingPeriodId: activityDataTable.reportingPeriodId,
    })
    .from(activityDataTable)
    .where(eq(activityDataTable.id, activityDataId))
    .limit(1);

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const row = rows[0]!;
  return {
    id: row.id,
    taxonomyActivityId: row.taxonomyActivityId,
    scope: row.scope,
    unit: row.unit,
    activityDate: row.activityDate,
    reportingPeriodId: row.reportingPeriodId,
  };
}

async function resolveTaxonomyActivity(
  taxonomyActivityId: string,
): Promise<TaxonomyActivityRecord | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: taxonomyActivitiesTable.id,
      code: taxonomyActivitiesTable.code,
      name: taxonomyActivitiesTable.name,
    })
    .from(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, taxonomyActivityId))
    .limit(1);

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  const row = rows[0]!;
  return { id: row.id, code: row.code, name: row.name };
}

async function findCandidates(activityCode: string): Promise<EmissionFactorRecord[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(emissionFactorsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.activityId, activityCode),
        eq(emissionFactorsTable.status, 'ACTIVE'),
      ),
    );

  return rows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    factorId: r.factorId,
    activityId: r.activityId,
    name: r.name,
    unit: r.unit,
    factor: r.factor,
    factorUnit: r.factorUnit,
    scopes: r.scopes,
    year: r.year,
    countryCode: r.countryCode,
    countryName: r.countryName,
    region: r.region,
    source: r.source,
    status: r.status,
  }));
}

function filterByUnit(
  candidates: EmissionFactorRecord[],
  activityUnit: string,
): EmissionFactorRecord[] {
  return candidates.filter((c) => c.unit === activityUnit);
}

function filterByScope(
  candidates: EmissionFactorRecord[],
  activityScope: string,
): EmissionFactorRecord[] {
  const scopeValue = activityScope.replace('SCOPE_', '');
  return candidates.filter((c) => {
    if (!c.scopes || c.scopes.length === 0) return true;
    return c.scopes.includes(scopeValue);
  });
}

function filterByYear(
  candidates: EmissionFactorRecord[],
  activityDate: Date | null,
): EmissionFactorRecord[] {
  if (!activityDate || candidates.length === 0) return candidates;

  const activityYear = activityDate.getFullYear();
  const withMatchingYear = candidates.filter((c) => c.year === activityYear);

  if (withMatchingYear.length > 0) return withMatchingYear;
  return candidates;
}

function decideMatch(
  candidates: EmissionFactorRecord[],
  activityId: string,
): MatchResult {
  if (candidates.length === 0) {
    return {
      status: 'no_match',
      activity_id: activityId,
      reason: 'No emission factors found for this activity',
    };
  }

  if (candidates.length === 1) {
    const c = candidates[0]!;
    return {
      status: 'matched',
      emission_factor_id: c.id,
      activity_id: activityId,
      factor: {
        id: c.id,
        factor_id: c.factorId,
        name: c.name,
        unit: c.unit,
        factor: c.factor,
        factor_unit: c.factorUnit,
        year: c.year,
        country_code: c.countryCode,
      },
    };
  }

  return {
    status: 'ambiguous',
    activity_id: activityId,
    candidates: candidates.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      factor_id: c.factorId,
      name: c.name,
      unit: c.unit,
      year: c.year,
      country_code: c.countryCode,
    })),
  };
}

export async function matchEmissionFactor(
  activityDataId: string,
): Promise<{ status: number; data: MatchResult | { success: false; error: string } }> {
  const activity = await resolveActivityData(activityDataId);
  if (!activity) {
    return {
      status: 404,
      data: { success: false, error: 'Activity data not found' },
    };
  }

  if (!activity.taxonomyActivityId) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      data: {
        success: false,
        error: 'Activity data has no taxonomy activity assigned',
      },
    };
  }

  const taxonomy = await resolveTaxonomyActivity(activity.taxonomyActivityId);
  if (!taxonomy) {
    return {
      status: 404,
      data: { success: false, error: 'Taxonomy activity not found' },
    };
  }

  let candidates = await findCandidates(taxonomy.code);
  candidates = filterByUnit(candidates, activity.unit);
  candidates = filterByScope(candidates, activity.scope);
  candidates = filterByYear(candidates, activity.activityDate);

  const result = decideMatch(candidates, taxonomy.code);
  return { status: 200, data: result };
}
```

```typescript
import { and, desc, eq, ilike, inArray, or, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { organisationsTable } from '../db/schema/organisation.js';
import { physicalEntitiesTable } from '../db/schema/physical_entities.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';
import { serializeUniversity } from './universitiesV1.js';

type PERow = typeof physicalEntitiesTable.$inferSelect;

const ASSET_SUBTYPES = [
  'METER',
  'GENERATOR',
  'BOILER',
  'CHILLER',
  'AIR_CONDITIONER',
  'REFRIGERATION',
  'OTHER',
];

const ASSET_TYPE_TO_SUBTYPE: Record<string, string> = {
  ELECTRICITY_METER: 'METER',
  SUB_METER: 'METER',
  DIESEL_GENERATOR: 'GENERATOR',
  LPG_EQUIPMENT: 'OTHER',
  NATURAL_GAS_EQUIPMENT: 'OTHER',
  BOILER: 'BOILER',
  CHILLER: 'CHILLER',
  AIR_CONDITIONER: 'AIR_CONDITIONER',
  REFRIGERATION_SYSTEM: 'REFRIGERATION',
  FIRE_SUPPRESSION_SYSTEM: 'OTHER',
  OTHER: 'OTHER',
};

function meta(row: PERow): Record<string, unknown> {
  return (row.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
}

async function loadRow(id: string): Promise<PERow | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

async function loadOrganisation(id: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(organisationsTable)
    .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

async function countChildren(parentId: string, subtype: string): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, parentId), eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, subtype as never)),
    );
  return Number(rows[0]?.total ?? 0);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------- CAMPUS ----

export interface CampusCreateInput {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  universityId: string;
  address?: string | undefined;
  city?: string | undefined;
  state?: string | undefined;
  country: string;
  postalCode?: string | undefined;
}

function serializeCampus(row: PERow, organisation: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof loadOrganisation>>, buildingsCount: number) {
  const m = meta(row);
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    code: row.code,
    address: (m.address as string) ?? null,
    city: (m.city as string) ?? null,
    state: (m.state as string) ?? null,
    country: (m.country as string) ?? 'India',
    postalCode: (m.postalCode as string) ?? null,
    universityId: row.organisationId,
    university: organisation ? { id: organisation.id, name: organisation.name, code: organisation.code } : null,
    _count: { buildings: buildingsCount },
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function createCampus(data: CampusCreateInput) {
  const duplicate = await db
    .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, data.universityId),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'CAMPUS' as never),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  if (duplicate.length > 0) {
    // V1 enforced this at the database level (unique (universityId, code)); the
    // org-wide index was dropped per decision E-1(b), so the guard lives here.
    throw new Error('Campus with this code already exists for this university');
  }

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: data.universityId,
      parentId: null,
      name: data.name,
      code: data.code,
      type: 'LOCATION',
      subtype: 'CAMPUS',
      metadata: {
        address: data.address ?? null,
        city: data.city ?? null,
        state: data.state ?? null,
        country: data.country,
        postalCode: data.postalCode ?? null,
      },
    })
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create campus');

  const organisation = await loadOrganisation(data.universityId);
  return serializeCampus(row, organisation, 0);
}

export async function listCampuses(params: {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  search?: string | undefined;
  universityId?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const skip = Math.max(0, (params.page - 1) * params.limit);
  const conditions = [eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'CAMPUS' as never)];
  if (params.universityId) conditions.push(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, params.universityId));
  if (params.search) {
    conditions.push(or(ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.name, `%${params.search}%`), ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.code, `%${params.search}%`))!);
  }
  const where = and(...conditions);

  const [rows, countRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where).orderBy(desc(physicalEntitiesTable.createdAt)).limit(params.limit).offset(skip),
    db.select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` }).from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where),
  ]);

  const total = Number(countRows[0]?.total ?? 0);
  const campuses = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    campuses.push(serializeCampus(row, await loadOrganisation(row.organisationId), await countChildren(row.id, 'BUILDING')));
  }
  return { campuses, pagination: { page: params.page, limit: params.limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / params.limit) } };
}

export async function getCampusById(id: string) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || row.subtype !== 'CAMPUS') throw new Error('Campus not found');
  const [organisation, buildingsCount] = await Promise.all([
    loadOrganisation(row.organisationId),
    countChildren(row.id, 'BUILDING'),
  ]);
  return serializeCampus(row, organisation, buildingsCount);
}

export async function updateCampus(
  id: string,
  data: {
    name?: string | undefined;
    code?: string | undefined;
    address?: string | undefined;
    city?: string | undefined;
    state?: string | undefined;
    country?: string | undefined;
    postalCode?: string | undefined;
  },
) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || row.subtype !== 'CAMPUS') throw new Error('Campus not found');

  if (data.code && data.code !== row.code) {
    const duplicate = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, row.organisationId),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'CAMPUS' as never),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1);
    if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Campus with this code already exists for this university');
  }

  const mergedMeta = { ...meta(row) };
  for (const key of ['address', 'city', 'state', 'country', 'postalCode'] as const) {
    if (data[key] !== undefined) mergedMeta[key] = data[key];
  }

  await db
    .update(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .set({
      ...(data.name !== undefined ? { name: data.name } : {}),
      ...(data.code !== undefined ? { code: data.code } : {}),
      metadata: mergedMeta,
    })
    .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, id));

  return getCampusById(id);
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------- BUILDING ----

export interface BuildingCreateInput {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  description?: string | undefined;
  address?: string | undefined;
  campusId: string;
}


async function campusLite(campusId: string | null) {
  if (!campusId) return null;
  const campus = await loadRow(campusId);
  if (!campus || campus.subtype !== 'CAMPUS') return null;
  const organisation = await loadOrganisation(campus.organisationId);
  return {
    ...{ id: campus.id, name: campus.name, code: campus.code },
    university: organisation
      ? { id: organisation.id, name: organisation.name, code: organisation.code }
      : null,
  };
}

function serializeBuilding(row: PERow, campus: unknown, floorsCount: number | undefined, floors?: unknown[]) {
  const base = {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    code: row.code,
    description: row.description,
    address: (meta(row).address as string) ?? null,
    campusId: row.parentId,
    campus,
    ...(floorsCount === undefined ? {} : { _count: { floors: floorsCount } }),
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
  return floors ? { ...base, floors } : base;
}

export async function createBuilding(data: BuildingCreateInput) {
  const campus = await loadRow(data.campusId);
  if (!campus || campus.subtype !== 'CAMPUS') throw new Error('Campus not found');

  const duplicate = await db
    .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, data.campusId),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'BUILDING' as never),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Building with this code already exists in this campus');

  const metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (data.address !== undefined) metadata.address = data.address;

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: campus.organisationId,
      parentId: campus.id,
      name: data.name,
      code: data.code,
      description: data.description ?? null,
      type: 'FACILITY',
      subtype: 'BUILDING',
      metadata,
    })
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create building');

  return serializeBuilding(row, await campusLite(campus.id), 0);
}

export async function listBuildings(params: {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  search?: string | undefined;
  campusId?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const skip = Math.max(0, (params.page - 1) * params.limit);
  const conditions = [eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'BUILDING' as never)];
  if (params.campusId) conditions.push(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, params.campusId));
  if (params.search) {
    conditions.push(or(ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.name, `%${params.search}%`), ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.code, `%${params.search}%`))!);
  }
  const where = and(...conditions);

  const [rows, countRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where).orderBy(desc(physicalEntitiesTable.createdAt)).limit(params.limit).offset(skip),
    db.select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` }).from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where),
  ]);
  const total = Number(countRows[0]?.total ?? 0);

  const buildings = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const campus = row.parentId ? await campusLite(row.parentId) : null;
    const floorsCount = await countChildren(row.id, 'FLOOR');
    buildings.push(serializeBuilding(row, campus, floorsCount));
  }
  return { buildings, pagination: { page: params.page, limit: params.limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / params.limit) } };
}

export async function getBuildingById(id: string) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || row.subtype !== 'BUILDING') throw new Error('Building not found');

  const childFloors = await db
    .select()
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(and(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, row.id), eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'FLOOR' as never)));
  const sortedFloors = childFloors.sort((a, b) => {
    const fa = Number(meta(a).floorNumber ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    const fb = Number(meta(b).floorNumber ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    if (fa !== fb) return fa - fb;
    return b.createdAt.getTime() - a.createdAt.getTime();
  });

  const campus = row.parentId ? await campusLite(row.parentId) : null;
  const serializedFloors = sortedFloors.map((f) =>
    serializeFloor(f, campus, undefined),
  );

  return serializeBuilding(row, campus, childFloors.length, serializedFloors);
}

export async function updateBuilding(
  id: string,
  data: { name?: string | undefined; code?: string | undefined; description?: string | undefined; address?: string | undefined },
) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || row.subtype !== 'BUILDING') throw new Error('Building not found');

  if (data.code && data.code !== row.code) {
    const duplicate = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, row.parentId!),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'BUILDING' as never),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1);
    if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Building with this code already exists for this campus');
  }

  const mergedMeta = { ...meta(row) };
  if (data.address !== undefined) mergedMeta.address = data.address;

  await db
    .update(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .set({
      ...(data.name !== undefined ? { name: data.name } : {}),
      ...(data.code !== undefined ? { code: data.code } : {}),
      ...(data.description !== undefined ? { description: data.description } : {}),
      metadata: mergedMeta,
    })
    .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, id));

  return getBuildingById(id);
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------- FLOOR ----

export interface FloorCreateInput {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  floorNumber?: number | undefined;
  areaSqm?: number | undefined;
  buildingId: string;
}

function serializeFloor(row: PERow, building: unknown, _campusChain?: unknown) {
  void _campusChain;
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    code: row.code,
    floorNumber: (meta(row).floorNumber as number) ?? null,
    areaSqm: numericToNumber(row.areaSqm),
    buildingId: row.parentId,
    building,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

async function buildingIncludeForFloor(buildingRow: PERow) {
  const campus = buildingRow.parentId ? await loadRow(buildingRow.parentId) : null;
  const organisation = campus ? await loadOrganisation(campus.organisationId) : null;
  return {
    ...{ id: buildingRow.id, name: buildingRow.name, code: buildingRow.code },
    campus: campus
      ? {
          ...{ id: campus.id, name: campus.name, code: campus.code },
          university: organisation ? { id: organisation.id, name: organisation.name, code: organisation.code } : null,
        }
      : null,
  };
}

export async function createFloor(data: FloorCreateInput) {
  const building = await loadRow(data.buildingId);
  if (!building || building.subtype !== 'BUILDING') throw new Error('Building not found');

  const duplicate = await db
    .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, data.buildingId),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'FLOOR' as never),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Floor with this code already exists in this building');

  const metadata: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (data.floorNumber !== undefined) metadata.floorNumber = data.floorNumber;

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: building.organisationId,
      parentId: building.id,
      name: data.name,
      code: data.code,
      areaSqm: data.areaSqm === undefined ? null : String(data.areaSqm),
      type: 'LOCATION',
      subtype: 'FLOOR',
      metadata,
    })
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create floor');

  return serializeFloor(row, await buildingIncludeForFloor(building));
}

export async function listFloors(params: {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  search?: string | undefined;
  buildingId?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const conditions = [eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'FLOOR' as never)];
  if (params.buildingId) conditions.push(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, params.buildingId));
  if (params.search) {
    conditions.push(or(ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.name, `%${params.search}%`), ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.code, `%${params.search}%`))!);
  }
  const where = and(...conditions);

  // V1 orders by [floorNumber asc, createdAt desc]; floorNumber lives in jsonb
  // metadata in V2, so ordering happens in-process before pagination is applied.
  const allRows = await db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where);
  const sorted = [...allRows].sort((a, b) => {
    const fa = Number(meta(a).floorNumber ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    const fb = Number(meta(b).floorNumber ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    if (fa !== fb) return fa - fb;
    return b.createdAt.getTime() - a.createdAt.getTime();
  });
  const total = sorted.length;
  const pageRows = sorted.slice(Math.max(0, (params.page - 1) * params.limit), Math.max(0, (params.page - 1) * params.limit) + params.limit);

  const floors = [];
  for (const row of pageRows) {
    const building = row.parentId ? await loadRow(row.parentId) : null;
    floors.push(serializeFloor(row, building ? await buildingIncludeForFloor(building) : null));
  }
  return { floors, pagination: { page: params.page, limit: params.limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / params.limit) } };
}

export async function getFloorById(id: string) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || row.subtype !== 'FLOOR') throw new Error('Floor not found');
  const building = row.parentId ? await loadRow(row.parentId) : null;
  return serializeFloor(row, building ? await buildingIncludeForFloor(building) : null);
}

export async function updateFloor(
  id: string,
  data: { name?: string | undefined; code?: string | undefined; floorNumber?: number | undefined; areaSqm?: number | undefined },
) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || row.subtype !== 'FLOOR') throw new Error('Floor not found');

  if (data.code && data.code !== row.code) {
    const duplicate = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, row.parentId!),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'FLOOR' as never),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1);
    if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Floor with this code already exists in this building');
  }

  const mergedMeta = { ...meta(row) };
  if (data.floorNumber !== undefined) mergedMeta.floorNumber = data.floorNumber;

  await db
    .update(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .set({
      ...(data.name !== undefined ? { name: data.name } : {}),
      ...(data.code !== undefined ? { code: data.code } : {}),
      ...(data.areaSqm !== undefined ? { areaSqm: String(data.areaSqm) } : {}),
      metadata: mergedMeta,
    })
    .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, id));

  return getFloorById(id);
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------- ASSET ----

export interface AssetCreateInput {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  type: string;
  status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'DECOMMISSIONED' | undefined;
  manufacturer?: string | undefined;
  modelNumber?: string | undefined;
  capacity?: number | undefined;
  capacityUnit?: string | undefined;
  description?: string | undefined;
  floorId: string;
}

function serializeAssetShallow(row: PERow, floorLite: unknown) {
  const m = meta(row);
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    code: row.code,
    type: (m.assetType as string) ?? 'OTHER',
    status: row.status,
    manufacturer: (m.manufacturer as string) ?? null,
    modelNumber: (m.modelNumber as string) ?? null,
    capacity: m.capacity === undefined || m.capacity === null ? null : Number(m.capacity),
    capacityUnit: (m.capacityUnit as string) ?? null,
    description: row.description,
    floorId: row.parentId,
    floor: floorLite,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function createAsset(data: AssetCreateInput) {
  const floor = await loadRow(data.floorId);
  if (!floor || floor.subtype !== 'FLOOR') throw new Error('Floor not found');

  const duplicate = await db
    .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, data.floorId),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Asset with this code already exists on this floor');

  const metadata: Record<string, unknown> = { assetType: data.type };
  if (data.manufacturer !== undefined) metadata.manufacturer = data.manufacturer;
  if (data.modelNumber !== undefined) metadata.modelNumber = data.modelNumber;
  if (data.capacity !== undefined) metadata.capacity = data.capacity;
  if (data.capacityUnit !== undefined) metadata.capacityUnit = data.capacityUnit;

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: floor.organisationId,
      parentId: floor.id,
      name: data.name,
      code: data.code,
      description: data.description ?? null,
      type: 'EQUIPMENT',
      subtype: ASSET_TYPE_TO_SUBTYPE[data.type]! as never,
      status: (data.status ?? 'ACTIVE') as never,
      metadata,
    })
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create asset');

  const building = floor.parentId ? await loadRow(floor.parentId) : null;
  const floorLite = {
    id: floor.id,
    name: floor.name,
    code: floor.code,
    building: building
      ? { id: building.id, name: building.name, code: building.code }
      : null,
  };
  return serializeAssetShallow(row, floorLite);
}

export async function listAssets(params: {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  search?: string | undefined;
  floorId?: string | undefined;
  type?: string | undefined;
  status?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const skip = Math.max(0, (params.page - 1) * params.limit);
  const conditions = [inArray(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, ASSET_SUBTYPES as never[])];
  if (params.floorId) conditions.push(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, params.floorId));
  if (params.type && ASSET_TYPE_TO_SUBTYPE[params.type]) {
    conditions.push(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, ASSET_TYPE_TO_SUBTYPE[params.type]! as never));
  }
  if (params.status) conditions.push(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.status, params.status as never));
  if (params.search) {
    conditions.push(or(ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.name, `%${params.search}%`), ilike(physicalEntitiesTable.code, `%${params.search}%`))!);
  }
  const where = and(...conditions);

  const [rows, countRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where).orderBy(desc(physicalEntitiesTable.createdAt)).limit(params.limit).offset(skip),
    db.select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` }).from(physicalEntitiesTable).where(where),
  ]);
  const total = Number(countRows[0]?.total ?? 0);

  const assets = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const floor = row.parentId ? await loadRow(row.parentId) : null;
    const building = floor?.parentId ? await loadRow(floor.parentId) : null;
    const floorLite = floor
      ? {
          id: floor.id,
          name: floor.name,
          code: floor.code,
          building: building
            ? { id: building.id, name: building.name, code: building.code }
            : null,
        }
      : null;
    assets.push(serializeAssetShallow(row, floorLite));
  }
  return { assets, pagination: { page: params.page, limit: params.limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / params.limit) } };
}

export async function getAssetById(id: string) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || !ASSET_SUBTYPES.includes(row.subtype as never)) throw new Error('Asset not found');

  // Deep chain reconstruction: asset -> floor -> building -> campus -> university(full).
  const floor = row.parentId ? await loadRow(row.parentId) : null;
  const building = floor?.parentId ? await loadRow(floor.parentId) : null;
  const campus = building?.parentId ? await loadRow(building.parentId) : null;
  const organisation = campus ? await loadOrganisation(campus.organisationId) : null;

  const deep = {
    ...serializeAssetShallow(row, null),
    floor: floor
      ? {
          ...serializeFloor(floor, null),
          building: building
            ? {
                ...(await (async () => {
                  const campusLite = campus
                    ? {
                        ...{ id: campus.id, name: campus.name, code: campus.code },
                        university: organisation ? serializeUniversity(organisation) : null,
                      }
                    : null;
                  return { ...(buildingIncludeForFloorShallow(building)), campus: campusLite };
                })()),
              }
            : null,
        }
      : null,
  };
  return deep;
}

function buildingIncludeForFloorShallow(building: PERow) {
  return { id: building.id, name: building.name, code: building.code };
}

export async function updateAsset(
  id: string,
  data: {
    name?: string | undefined;
    code?: string | undefined;
    status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'DECOMMISSIONED' | undefined;
    manufacturer?: string | undefined;
    modelNumber?: string | undefined;
    capacity?: number | undefined;
    capacityUnit?: string | undefined;
    description?: string | undefined;
  },
) {
  const row = await loadRow(id);
  if (!row || !ASSET_SUBTYPES.includes(row.subtype as never)) throw new Error('Asset not found');

  if (data.code && data.code !== row.code) {
    const duplicate = await db
      .select({ id: physicalEntitiesTable.id })
      .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.parentId, row.parentId!),
          eq(physicalEntitiesTable.code, data.code),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1);
    if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('Asset with this code already exists on this floor');
  }

  const mergedMeta = { ...meta(row) };
  for (const key of ['manufacturer', 'modelNumber', 'capacity', 'capacityUnit'] as const) {
    if (data[key] !== undefined) mergedMeta[key] = data[key];
  }

  await db
    .update(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .set({
      ...(data.name !== undefined ? { name: data.name } : {}),
      ...(data.code !== undefined ? { code: data.code } : {}),
      ...(data.status !== undefined ? { status: data.status } : {}),
      ...(data.description !== undefined ? { description: data.description } : {}),
      metadata: mergedMeta,
    })
    .where(eq(physicalEntitiesTable.id, id));

  return getAssetById(id);
}
```

### 173. `original-neon-backend/src/services/importRowSchema.ts`

SHA-256: `8a7806b9212984da32f70aca70367898f0feddbbb41e1e0253a1ef9af493f89a`

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';
import { activityCategoryEnum } from '../db/schema/enums.js';

const categoryValues = activityCategoryEnum.enumValues;

export const importRowSchema = z.object({
  'Activity Category': z
    .string()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, '_'))
    .pipe(z.enum(categoryValues)),
  Quantity: z
    .union([z.string(), z.number()])
    .transform((val) => Number(val))
    .refine((val) => !isNaN(val) && val > 0, {
      message: 'Quantity must be a positive number',
    }),
  Unit: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Unit cannot be empty'),
  'Activity Date': z
    .union([z.string(), z.number(), z.date()])
    .transform((val) => {
      if (typeof val === 'number') {
        const jsDate = new Date(Math.round((val - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
        return jsDate;
      }
      return new Date(val);
    })
    .refine((val) => !isNaN(val.getTime()), {
      message: 'Invalid Date format',
    }),
  Building: z.string().trim().optional(),
  Floor: z.string().trim().optional(),
  Description: z.string().trim().optional(),
});

export type ImportRow = z.infer<typeof importRowSchema>;

export function validateImportRow(
  row: unknown,
  rowIndex: number,
): { isValid: false; rowIndex: number; errors: string } | { isValid: true; rowIndex: number; data: ImportRow } {
  const result = importRowSchema.safeParse(row);
  if (!result.success) {
    const errors = result.error.issues.map((err) => err.message).join(', ');
    return { isValid: false, rowIndex, errors };
  }
  return { isValid: true, rowIndex, data: result.data };
}
```

```typescript
import * as xlsx from 'xlsx';
import { validateImportRow } from './importRowSchema.js';

export function processImportBuffer(buffer: Buffer) {
  const workbook = xlsx.read(buffer, { type: 'buffer', cellDates: true });
  const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0]!;
  const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName]!;
  const rawRows = xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json<Record<string, unknown>>(worksheet);

  const validRows: unknown[] = [];
  const invalidRows: { row: number; errors: string }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < rawRows.length; i++) {
    const validation = validateImportRow(rawRows[i], i + 2);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      invalidRows.push({ row: validation.rowIndex, errors: validation.errors });
    } else {
      validRows.push(validation.data);
    }
  }

  return {
    totalParsed: rawRows.length,
    validCount: validRows.length,
    invalidCount: invalidRows.length,
    validRows,
    invalidRows,
  };
}
```
