```typescript
/**
 * Injectable identity-admin port for Neon Auth.
 *
 * VERIFIED LIMITATION (v0.5.0-beta): `@neondatabase/auth/server` exposes only
 * proxy/session/middleware tooling (`createAuthServer`). It does NOT ship an
 * admin/user-management API, so the default port implementation fails loudly
 * rather than pretending to mutate identities. Tests (and a future adapter)
 * may inject a working implementation.
 */

export class NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super(
      'Neon Auth admin operations are unavailable: @neondatabase/auth v0.5.0-beta provides no user-management API. Identity mutations require the upstream admin capability (see blueprint TODO/Users section).',
    );
    this.name = 'NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError';
  }
}

export interface IdentityCreateInput {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  name: string;
}

export interface IdentityRecord {
  id: string;
  email?: string;
  name?: string;
}

export interface IdentityPort {
  createUser(input: IdentityCreateInput): Promise<IdentityRecord>;
  updateUserName(id: string, name: string): Promise<void>;
  removeUser(id: string): Promise<void>;
}

const unavailablePort: IdentityPort = {
  async createUser() {
    throw new NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError();
  },
  async updateUserName() {
    throw new NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError();
  },
  async removeUser() {
    throw new NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError();
  },
};

let activePort: IdentityPort = unavailablePort;

/** Test/adapter seam: supply a working identity implementation. */
export function setIdentityPort(port: IdentityPort | null): void {
  activePort = port ?? unavailablePort;
}

export function getIdentityPort(): IdentityPort {
  return activePort;
}
```

```typescript
import { and, desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { notificationsTable } from '../db/schema/notifications.js';

type NotificationRow = typeof notificationsTable.$inferSelect;

function serializeNotification(row: NotificationRow) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    userId: row.userId,
    universityId: row.organisationId,
    title: row.title,
    message: row.message,
    type: row.type,
    isRead: row.isRead,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function getNotifications(userId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(notificationsTable)
    .where(eq(notificationsTable.userId, userId))
    .orderBy(desc(notificationsTable.createdAt))
    .limit(50);
  return rows.map(serializeNotification);
}

export async function getUnreadCount(userId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ id: notificationsTable.id })
    .from(notificationsTable)
    .where(and(eq(notificationsTable.userId, userId), eq(notificationsTable.isRead, false)));
  return rows.length;
}

export async function markAllAsRead(userId: string) {
  const updated = await db
    .update(notificationsTable)
    .set({ isRead: true })
    .where(and(eq(notificationsTable.userId, userId), eq(notificationsTable.isRead, false)))
    .returning({ id: notificationsTable.id });
  return { count: updated.length };
}

class NotFoundTag extends Error {}

export async function markAsRead(id: string, userId: string) {
  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .update(notificationsTable)
      .set({ isRead: true })
      .where(and(eq(notificationsTable.id, id), eq(notificationsTable.userId, userId)))
      .returning();
    if (!row) throw new NotFoundTag();
    return serializeNotification(row);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof NotFoundTag) throw new Error('Notification not found');
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function createNotification(
  userId: string,
  organisationId: string | null,
  title: string,
  message: string,
  type: string = 'INFO',
) {
  const [row] = await db
    .insert(notificationsTable)
    .values({
      userId,
      organisationId,
      title,
      message,
      type,
    })
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create notification');
  return serializeNotification(row);
}
```

### 177. `original-neon-backend/src/services/onboardingV1.ts`

SHA-256: `7ae3936988d1329d7f1bac82bfbc6dd496dc6991f9c0e09c76692c9ab66c30e3`

```typescript
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  organisationOnboardingTable,
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { PENDING_ORGANISATION_NAME } from './authV1.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import type { OnboardingPayload, OnboardingCampus } from '../validators/onboardingV1.js';

// Organisation onboarding profiles (1:1 with the authenticated user's
// organisation).
//
// SECURITY MODEL: callers never pass an organisationId. The organisation is
// resolved from the authenticated user row (users.organisation_id), so an org
// can only ever read/write its own onboarding profile.
//
// ORGANISATION IDENTITY LIFECYCLE: signup provisions a placeholder
// organisation ("Pending Organisation", status PENDING) server-side; users
// never name or id it. Onboarding OWNS the one-time transition to the real
// organisation identity: the FIRST successful profile creation replaces the
// placeholder name with company.legalName and activates the organisation.
// Subsequent onboarding updates perform ZERO writes to the organisations row
// — the display name is then owned by the admin organisation-profile API
// (updateUniversity). Organisations that were never placeholders (pre-existing
// or admin-created) are never renamed by this flow; their PENDING→ACTIVE
// transition still fires on first completion.

type OnboardingRow = typeof organisationOnboardingTable.$inferSelect;
type OrganisationRow = typeof organisationsTable.$inferSelect;

export const ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND = 'Onboarding profile not found';
export const ONBOARDING_ALREADY_EXISTS = 'Onboarding profile already exists';

interface ResolvedContext {
  organisation: OrganisationRow;
  existing: OnboardingRow | null;
}

async function resolveOrganisationContext(userId: string): Promise<ResolvedContext | null> {
  // The JWT only carries { userId, email }; organisationId always comes from
  // the users table (source of truth), never from the client.
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      userOrganisationId: usersTable.organisationId,
      organisation: organisationsTable,
      existing: organisationOnboardingTable,
    })
    .from(usersTable)
    .innerJoin(organisationsTable, eq(usersTable.organisationId, organisationsTable.id))
    .leftJoin(
      organisationOnboardingTable,
      eq(organisationOnboardingTable.organisationId, organisationsTable.id),
    )
    .where(eq(usersTable.id, userId))
    .limit(1);

  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) return null;
  return { organisation: row.organisation, existing: row.existing ?? null };
}

function serializeOnboarding(row: OnboardingRow) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    organisationId: row.organisationId,
    company: row.company,
    locations: row.locations,
    reporting: row.reporting,
    integrations: row.integrations,
    emissions: row.emissions,
    valueChain: row.valueChain,
    strategy: row.strategy,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

function sectionsFrom(payload: OnboardingPayload) {
  return {
    company: payload.company,
    locations: payload.locations,
    reporting: payload.reporting,
    integrations: payload.integrations,
    emissions: payload.emissions,
    valueChain: payload.valueChain,
    strategy: payload.strategy,
  };
}

// The ONE sanctioned organisation write in this service: completing the
// signup placeholder identity. Called only on the FIRST successful profile
// creation — never on subsequent updates.
async function completeOrganisationSetup(
  organisation: OrganisationRow,
  payload: OnboardingPayload,
): Promise<void> {
  const metadata = { ...((organisation.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>) };
  metadata.onboardingCompletedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  // Store available infrastructure flags in org metadata.
  if (payload.physicalStructure?.availableInfrastructure) {
    metadata.availableInfrastructure = payload.physicalStructure.availableInfrastructure;
  }

  const update: Partial<typeof organisationsTable.$inferInsert> = { metadata };
  // Replace the placeholder name exactly once; never touch real names.
  if (organisation.name === PENDING_ORGANISATION_NAME) {
    update.name = payload.company.legalName;
    update.legalName = payload.company.legalName;
    // Also replace the ugly temp code (PENDING-xxxx) with a clean slug
    // derived from the company name, e.g. "Vertex Mfg" → "VERTEX-MFG".
    const slug = payload.company.legalName
      .toUpperCase()
      .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
      .slice(0, 50);
    // Append a short random suffix to guarantee uniqueness.
    const suffix = organisation.id.slice(0, 6).toUpperCase();
    update.code = `${slug}-${suffix}`;
  }
  // Onboarding completion activates the account's organisation.
  if (organisation.status === 'PENDING') {
    update.status = 'ACTIVE';
  }

  await db
    .update(organisationsTable)
    .set(update)
    .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, organisation.id));
}

// ── Physical Hierarchy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Generates a DB-safe code from a display name.
// e.g. "Main Campus" → "MAIN-CAMPUS", "Academic Block" → "ACADEMIC-BLOCK"
function toCode(name: string): string {
  return name
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
    .slice(0, 40);
}

// Returns a unique code by appending a short random suffix when needed.
function uniqueCode(name: string, suffix: string): string {
  const base = toCode(name);
  return `${base}-${suffix}`;
}

interface CreatedFloor {
  id: string;
  name: string;
}

interface CreatedBuilding {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  floors: CreatedFloor[];
}

interface CreatedCampus {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  buildings: CreatedBuilding[];
}

// Atomically creates the full Campus → Building → Floor hierarchy in
// physical_entities. Called exactly ONCE on the first onboarding submission.
// Returns the created IDs so the frontend can use them immediately.
async function createPhysicalHierarchy(
  organisationId: string,
  campuses: OnboardingCampus[],
): Promise<CreatedCampus[]> {
  // Use a short org suffix to ensure code uniqueness across orgs.
  const orgSuffix = organisationId.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase();

  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const result: CreatedCampus[] = [];

    for (const campus of campuses) {
      const campusCode = uniqueCode(campus.name, orgSuffix);

      const [campusRow] = await tx
        .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
        .values({
          organisationId,
          parentId: null,
          name: campus.name,
          code: campusCode,
          type: 'LOCATION',
          subtype: 'CAMPUS',
          metadata: {
            city: campus.city ?? null,
            state: campus.state ?? null,
            country: campus.country,
          },
        })
        .returning();

      if (!campusRow) throw new Error(`Failed to create campus: ${campus.name}`);

      const createdBuildings: CreatedBuilding[] = [];

      for (const building of campus.buildings) {
        const buildingCode = uniqueCode(building.name, campusRow.id.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase());

        const [buildingRow] = await tx
          .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
          .values({
            organisationId,
            parentId: campusRow.id,
            name: building.name,
            code: buildingCode,
            type: 'FACILITY',
            subtype: 'BUILDING',
            metadata: {},
          })
          .returning();

        if (!buildingRow) throw new Error(`Failed to create building: ${building.name}`);

        const createdFloors: CreatedFloor[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < building.floors.length; i++) {
          const floor = building.floors[i];
          if (!floor) continue;
          const floorCode = uniqueCode(floor.name, `${buildingRow.id.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()}-${i}`);

          const [floorRow] = await tx
            .insert(physicalEntitiesTable)
            .values({
              organisationId,
              parentId: buildingRow.id,
              name: floor.name,
              code: floorCode,
              type: 'FACILITY',
              subtype: 'FLOOR',
              metadata: { floorNumber: i },
            })
            .returning();

          if (!floorRow) throw new Error(`Failed to create floor: ${floor.name}`);
          createdFloors.push({ id: floorRow.id, name: floorRow.name });
        }

        createdBuildings.push({
          id: buildingRow.id,
          name: buildingRow.name,
          floors: createdFloors,
        });
      }

      result.push({
        id: campusRow.id,
        name: campusRow.name,
        buildings: createdBuildings,
      });
    }

    return result;
  });
}

// Fetches the full Campus → Building → Floor hierarchy for a user's
// organisation. Used by GET /onboarding/hierarchy for Activity Data dropdowns.
export async function getPhysicalHierarchy(userId: string) {
  const context = await resolveOrganisationContext(userId);
  if (!context) throw new Error('Unauthorized');

  // Load all physical entities for this org in one query.
  const allEntities = await db
    .select()
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, context.organisation.id),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.status, 'ACTIVE'),
      ),
    );

  // Build nested structure in memory (avoids N+1 queries).
  const campusRows = allEntities.filter((e) => e.subtype === 'CAMPUS');
  const buildingRows = allEntities.filter((e) => e.subtype === 'BUILDING');
  const floorRows = allEntities.filter((e) => e.subtype === 'FLOOR');

  const campuses = campusRows.map((campus) => {
    const buildings = buildingRows
      .filter((b) => b.parentId === campus.id)
      .map((building) => {
        const floors = floorRows
          .filter((f) => f.parentId === building.id)
          .map((floor) => ({ id: floor.id, name: floor.name }))
          .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
        return { id: building.id, name: building.name, floors };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    return { id: campus.id, name: campus.name, buildings };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  return {
    universityId: context.organisation.id,
    universityName: context.organisation.name,
    campuses,
  };
}

export async function getOnboarding(userId: string) {
  const context = await resolveOrganisationContext(userId);
  if (!context) throw new Error('Unauthorized');
  if (!context.existing) throw new Error(ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND);
  return {
    ...serializeOnboarding(context.existing),
    organisationStatus: context.organisation.status as string,
    onboardingCompleted: true,
  };
}

export async function createOnboarding(userId: string, payload: OnboardingPayload) {
  const context = await resolveOrganisationContext(userId);
  if (!context) throw new Error('Unauthorized');
  if (context.existing) throw new Error(ONBOARDING_ALREADY_EXISTS);

  let row: OnboardingRow | undefined;
  try {
    [row] = await db
      .insert(organisationOnboardingTable)
      .values({
        organisationId: context.organisation.id,
        ...sectionsFrom(payload),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .returning();
  } catch (error) {
    // Concurrent create lost against the UNIQUE(organisation_id) constraint —
    // never silently overwrite; surface the conflict instead.
    if ((error as { code?: string }).code === '23505') {
      throw new Error(ONBOARDING_ALREADY_EXISTS);
    }
    throw error;
  }
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create onboarding profile');

  await completeOrganisationSetup(context.organisation, payload);
  await auditOnboarding('ONBOARDING_CREATED', row, userId, null);

  // If physicalStructure was provided, atomically create the Campus → Building
  // → Floor hierarchy in physical_entities. This only happens ONCE on the
  // first submission — PUT /onboarding updates never re-create hierarchy.
  let createdHierarchy: CreatedCampus[] | null = null;
  if (payload.physicalStructure?.campuses?.length) {
    createdHierarchy = await createPhysicalHierarchy(
      context.organisation.id,
      payload.physicalStructure.campuses,
    );
  }

  return {
    ...serializeOnboarding(row),
    organisationStatus: 'ACTIVE',
    onboardingCompleted: true,
    ...(createdHierarchy !== null ? { createdHierarchy: { campuses: createdHierarchy } } : {}),
  };
}

export async function upsertOnboarding(userId: string, payload: OnboardingPayload) {
  return upsertWithRetry(userId, payload, 2);
}

async function upsertWithRetry(
  userId: string,
  payload: OnboardingPayload,
  retriesLeft: number,
): Promise<ReturnType<typeof serializeOnboarding> & { organisationStatus: string; onboardingCompleted: boolean }> {
  const context = await resolveOrganisationContext(userId);
  if (!context) throw new Error('Unauthorized');

  if (context.existing) {
    const [row] = await db
      .update(organisationOnboardingTable)
      .set({ ...sectionsFrom(payload), updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(organisationOnboardingTable.id, context.existing.id))
      .returning();
    if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to update onboarding profile');

    await auditOnboarding('ONBOARDING_UPDATED', row, userId, serializeOnboarding(context.existing));
    return {
      ...serializeOnboarding(row),
      organisationStatus: 'ACTIVE',
      onboardingCompleted: true,
    };
  }

  let row: OnboardingRow | undefined;
  try {
    [row] = await db
      .insert(organisationOnboardingTable)
      .values({
        organisationId: context.organisation.id,
        ...sectionsFrom(payload),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .returning();
  } catch (error) {
    // Raced another PUT that created the row first — fall back to updating it
    // so PUT stays idempotent under concurrency (bounded retries).
    if ((error as { code?: string }).code === '23505' && retriesLeft > 0) {
      return upsertWithRetry(userId, payload, retriesLeft - 1);
    }
    throw error;
  }
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create onboarding profile');

  await completeOrganisationSetup(context.organisation, payload);
  await auditOnboarding('ONBOARDING_CREATED', row, userId, null);
  return {
    ...serializeOnboarding(row),
    organisationStatus: 'ACTIVE',
    onboardingCompleted: true,
  };
}

async function auditOnboarding(
  action: 'ONBOARDING_CREATED' | 'ONBOARDING_UPDATED',
  row: OnboardingRow,
  userId: string,
  oldValue: unknown,
): Promise<void> {
  await createAuditLog({
    action,
    entity: 'OrganisationOnboarding',
    entityId: row.id,
    organisationId: row.organisationId,
    userId,
    oldValue,
    newValue: serializeOnboarding(row),
    description: action === 'ONBOARDING_CREATED'
      ? 'Organisation onboarding profile created'
      : 'Organisation onboarding profile updated',
  });
}
```

### 178. `original-neon-backend/src/services/recommendationEngine.ts`

SHA-256: `d17fb7d1fe8cbd096f9865920971aeca07e6102cea1ba62d4bff98bbef278b3d`

```typescript
interface CategoryStats {
  tCO2e: number;
  pct: number;
}

export interface RecommendationPayload {
  organisationId: string;
  category: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  priority: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH';
  estimatedReductionKg?: number;
}

// Impact thresholds
const HIGH_PCT_THRESHOLD = 30; // Category responsible for >30% of total = HIGH
const MED_PCT_THRESHOLD = 15; // >15% = MEDIUM

const CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY: 'Electricity Consumption',
  DIESEL: 'Diesel Consumption',
  PETROL: 'Petrol Consumption',
  NATURAL_GAS: 'Natural Gas Consumption',
  LPG: 'LPG Consumption',
  CNG: 'CNG Consumption',
  GENERATOR_FUEL: 'Generator Fuel Usage',
  BOILER_FUEL: 'Boiler Fuel Usage',
  REFRIGERANT: 'Refrigerant Leakage',
  OWNED_VEHICLE: 'Owned Vehicle Emissions',
  PURCHASED_STEAM: 'Purchased Steam',
  PURCHASED_HEATING: 'Purchased Heating',
  PURCHASED_COOLING: 'Purchased Cooling',
};

const CATEGORY_GROUP: Record<string, string> = {
  PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY: 'ENERGY',
  PURCHASED_STEAM: 'ENERGY',
  PURCHASED_HEATING: 'ENERGY',
  PURCHASED_COOLING: 'ENERGY',
  DIESEL: 'FUEL',
  PETROL: 'FUEL',
  LPG: 'FUEL',
  NATURAL_GAS: 'FUEL',
  CNG: 'FUEL',
  GENERATOR_FUEL: 'FUEL',
  BOILER_FUEL: 'FUEL',
  REFRIGERANT: 'REFRIGERANTS',
  OWNED_VEHICLE: 'TRANSPORT',
};

const CATEGORY_ACTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY:
    'Identify high-consumption buildings and implement energy-efficiency measures such as LED lighting, smart HVAC controls, and solar panels.',
  DIESEL:
    'Review diesel generator usage frequency and explore switching to grid power or renewable energy alternatives.',
  PETROL: 'Encourage carpooling, explore EV fleet transition, and optimize vehicle usage policies.',
  NATURAL_GAS: 'Audit heating systems, improve insulation, and explore electrification of heating processes.',
  LPG: 'Review LPG usage and explore natural gas or electric alternatives where feasible.',
  CNG: 'Optimize fleet routing and explore EV alternatives for short-range vehicles.',
  GENERATOR_FUEL:
    'Assess backup power needs, implement UPS systems, and reduce reliance on diesel generators.',
  BOILER_FUEL: 'Upgrade to high-efficiency boilers and explore heat recovery systems.',
  REFRIGERANT:
    'Conduct regular leak detection checks, upgrade to low-GWP refrigerants, and train maintenance staff.',
  OWNED_VEHICLE:
    'Implement a fleet electrification roadmap and encourage sustainable commuting alternatives.',
  PURCHASED_STEAM: 'Optimize steam distribution networks and reduce distribution losses.',
  PURCHASED_HEATING: 'Improve building insulation and explore district heating alternatives.',
  PURCHASED_COOLING:
    'Upgrade to energy-efficient cooling systems and optimize thermostat setpoints.',
};

export function evaluateRules(data: {
  universityId: string;
  categoryMap: Record<string, CategoryStats>;
  totalEmissions: number;
  intensity: Record<string, unknown>;
  dataQuality: Record<string, unknown>;
}): RecommendationPayload[] {
  const recommendations: RecommendationPayload[] = [];
  const { universityId, categoryMap = {}, intensity, dataQuality } = data;

  // Rule 1: Category-based emission dominance
  for (const [category, stats] of Object.entries(categoryMap) as [string, CategoryStats][]) {
    const label = CATEGORY_LABELS[category] || category.replace(/_/g, ' ');
    const group = CATEGORY_GROUP[category] || 'OTHER';
    const action =
      CATEGORY_ACTIONS[category] ||
      `Review ${label.toLowerCase()} and implement reduction measures.`;

    if (stats.pct >= HIGH_PCT_THRESHOLD && stats.tCO2e > 0) {
      recommendations.push({
        organisationId: universityId,
        category: group,
        title: `Reduce ${label}`,
        description: `${label} accounts for ${stats.pct.toFixed(1)}% of total emissions (${stats.tCO2e.toFixed(1)} tCO₂e). This is your single largest emission source. ${action}`,
        priority: 'HIGH',
        estimatedReductionKg: stats.tCO2e * 1000 * 0.2,
      });
    } else if (stats.pct >= MED_PCT_THRESHOLD && stats.pct < HIGH_PCT_THRESHOLD && stats.tCO2e > 0) {
      recommendations.push({
        organisationId: universityId,
        category: group,
        title: `Optimize ${label}`,
        description: `${label} contributes ${stats.pct.toFixed(1)}% of total emissions (${stats.tCO2e.toFixed(1)} tCO₂e). ${action}`,
        priority: 'MEDIUM',
        estimatedReductionKg: stats.tCO2e * 1000 * 0.15,
      });
    }
  }

  // Rule 2: High electricity intensity (kWh per sqm)
  // Preserved verbatim from V1: the intensity payload never carried
  // electricityKwhPerSqm, so this rule was already dead code there.
  if ((intensity as any)?.electricityKwhPerSqm > 150) {
    const existing = recommendations.find((r) => r.title.toLowerCase().includes('electricity'));
    if (!existing) {
      recommendations.push({
        organisationId: universityId,
        category: 'ENERGY',
        title: 'HVAC and Lighting Audit Required',
        description: `Electricity intensity is ${(intensity as any).electricityKwhPerSqm.toFixed(0)} kWh/m², which exceeds the recommended 150 kWh/m² benchmark. Conduct an energy audit of HVAC systems and lighting infrastructure.`,
        priority: 'HIGH',
        estimatedReductionKg: 8000,
      });
    }
  }

  // Rule 3: Low data quality score
  const qualityScore = (dataQuality as any)?.qualityScore as number | undefined;
  if (qualityScore !== undefined && qualityScore < 70) {
    recommendations.push({
      organisationId: universityId,
      category: 'DATA_QUALITY',
      title: 'Improve Data Completeness',
      description: `Data quality score is ${qualityScore}% (below 70% threshold). Incomplete data leads to inaccurate carbon accounting. Verify all activities and upload supporting documents.`,
      priority: 'MEDIUM',
    });
  } else if (qualityScore !== undefined && qualityScore < 85) {
    recommendations.push({
      organisationId: universityId,
      category: 'DATA_QUALITY',
      title: 'Data Completion Reminder',
      description: `Data quality score is ${qualityScore}%. Complete the remaining unverified activities and calculation gaps to achieve an Excellent rating.`,
      priority: 'LOW',
    });
  }

  // Rule 4: Refrigerant emissions (any amount is concerning)
  const refrigerant = categoryMap['REFRIGERANT'];
  if (refrigerant && refrigerant.tCO2e > 0) {
    const existing = recommendations.find((r) => r.category === 'REFRIGERANTS');
    if (!existing) {
      recommendations.push({
        organisationId: universityId,
        category: 'REFRIGERANTS',
        title: 'Refrigerant Leak Management',
        description: `Refrigerant leakage detected (${refrigerant.tCO2e.toFixed(2)} tCO₂e). Refrigerants have very high global warming potential. Implement quarterly leak detection audits and consider upgrading to low-GWP alternatives.`,
        priority: 'HIGH',
        estimatedReductionKg: refrigerant.tCO2e * 1000 * 0.5,
      });
    }
  }

  return recommendations;
}
```

### 179. `original-neon-backend/src/services/recommendationsV1.ts`

SHA-256: `91ffa9add64ebd6df80e56406b3d8f00b729104608a78fd95e07bffdd62dd532`

```typescript
import { and, desc, eq, inArray, not } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { recommendationsTable } from '../db/schema/recommendations.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';
import {
  getCategoryBreakdown,
  getIntensityMetrics,
} from './dashboardV1.js';
import { getDataQualityMetrics } from './dataQualityV1.js';
import { evaluateRules } from './recommendationEngine.js';

type RecommendationRow = typeof recommendationsTable.$inferSelect;

function serializeRecommendation(row: RecommendationRow) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    universityId: row.organisationId,
    buildingId: row.physicalEntityId,
    category: row.category,
    title: row.title,
    description: row.description,
    priority: row.priority,
    estimatedReductionKg:
      row.estimatedReductionKg === null ? null : numericToNumber(row.estimatedReductionKg),
    status: row.status,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function listRecommendations(filters: {
  universityId: string;
  priority?: string | undefined;
  category?: string | undefined;
  status?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const conditions = [eq(recommendationsTable.organisationId, filters.universityId)];
  if (filters.priority) conditions.push(eq(recommendationsTable.priority, filters.priority as never));
  if (filters.category) conditions.push(eq(recommendationsTable.category, filters.category));
  if (filters.status) conditions.push(eq(recommendationsTable.status, filters.status as never));
  else conditions.push(not(eq(recommendationsTable.status, 'DISMISSED')));

  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(recommendationsTable)
    .where(and(...conditions))
    .orderBy(desc(recommendationsTable.priority), desc(recommendationsTable.createdAt));
  return rows.map(serializeRecommendation);
}

export async function findRecommendationById(id: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(recommendationsTable)
    .where(eq(recommendationsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  const row = rows[0];
  return row ? serializeRecommendation(row) : null;
}

export async function getRecommendationById(id: string) {
  const recommendation = await findRecommendationById(id);
  if (!recommendation) throw new Error('Recommendation not found');
  return recommendation;
}

const VALID_STATUSES = ['NEW', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'DISMISSED'];

class NotFoundTag extends Error {}

export async function updateRecommendationStatus(id: string, status: string) {
  if (!VALID_STATUSES.includes(status)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid status. Must be one of: ${VALID_STATUSES.join(', ')}`);
  }
  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .update(recommendationsTable)
      .set({ status: status as never })
      .where(eq(recommendationsTable.id, id))
      .returning();
    if (!row) throw new NotFoundTag();
    return serializeRecommendation(row);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof NotFoundTag) throw new Error('Recommendation not found');
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function generateRecommendations(universityId: string, reportingPeriodId: string) {
  const intensity = await getIntensityMetrics(universityId, reportingPeriodId);
  const categories = await getCategoryBreakdown(universityId, reportingPeriodId);
  const dataQuality = await getDataQualityMetrics(
    universityId,
    reportingPeriodId ? { reportingPeriodId } : undefined,
  );

  const totalEmissions = categories.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.tonnesCO2e, 0);
  const categoryMap: Record<string, { tCO2e: number; pct: number }> = {};
  for (const c of categories) {
    categoryMap[c.category] = {
      tCO2e: c.tonnesCO2e,
      pct: totalEmissions > 0 ? (c.tonnesCO2e / totalEmissions) * 100 : 0,
    };
  }

  const candidates = evaluateRules({
    universityId,
    categoryMap,
    totalEmissions,
    intensity: intensity as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
    dataQuality: dataQuality as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
  });

  for (const rec of candidates) {
    const existing = await db
      .select({ id: recommendationsTable.id })
      .from(recommendationsTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(recommendationsTable.organisationId, rec.organisationId),
          eq(recommendationsTable.title, rec.title),
          inArray(recommendationsTable.status, ['NEW', 'OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS']),
        ),
      )
      .limit(1);

    if (existing.length === 0) {
      await db.insert(recommendationsTable).values({
        organisationId: rec.organisationId,
        category: rec.category,
        title: rec.title,
        description: rec.description,
        priority: rec.priority,
        estimatedReductionKg:
          rec.estimatedReductionKg === undefined ? null : String(rec.estimatedReductionKg),
        status: 'NEW',
      });
    }
  }

  return listActive(universityId);
}

async function listActive(universityId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(recommendationsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(recommendationsTable.organisationId, universityId),
        not(eq(recommendationsTable.status, 'DISMISSED')),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(desc(recommendationsTable.priority), desc(recommendationsTable.createdAt));
  return rows.map(serializeRecommendation);
}
```

```typescript
import PDFDocument from 'pdfkit';

export interface ReportPdfBaseline {
  error?: string;
  baseline?: {
    reportingPeriodName?: unknown;
    emissionsTonnes?: number;
  };
  current?: {
    emissionsTonnes?: number;
  };
  changeTonnes?: number;
  reductionPercentage?: number;
}

export interface ReportPdfIntensity {
  error?: string;
  studentCount?: number;
  totalAreaSqm?: number;
  tonnesPerStudent?: number;
  kgPerSqm?: number;
}

export interface ReportPdfData {
  universityName: string;
  reportingPeriodName: string;
  totalEmissionsTonnes: number;
  scope1Tonnes: number;
  scope2Tonnes: number;
  scope1Percentage: string;
  scope2Percentage: string;
  reductionPercentage: number;
  categories?: { category: string; tonnesCO2e: number; scope: string }[] | null;
  topSources?: { category: string; emissionsTonnes: number }[] | null;
  buildings?: { building: string; emissionsTonnes: number }[] | null;
  floors?: { floor: string; emissionsTonnes: number }[] | null;
  trends?: { month: string; totalKg: number }[] | null;
  baseline?: ReportPdfBaseline | null;
  intensity?: ReportPdfIntensity | null;
}

export const generatePdf = (reportData: ReportPdfData): Promise<Buffer> => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const doc = new PDFDocument({ margin: 50, size: 'A4' });
    const buffers: Buffer[] = [];
    doc.on('data', buffers.push.bind(buffers));
    doc.on('end', () => {
      resolve(Buffer.concat(buffers));
    });
    doc.on('error', reject);

    const addTitle = (title: string) => {
      doc.fontSize(18).fillColor('#2c3e50').text(title);
      doc.moveDown();
      doc.fillColor('black');
    };

    const addLine = (label: string, value: unknown) => {
      doc.fontSize(11).text(`${label}: ${value}`);
    };

    // =====================================================
    // 1. COVER PAGE
    // =====================================================
    doc.fontSize(28).fillColor('#2980b9').text('CarbonSynq', { align: 'center' });
    doc.moveDown();
    doc.fontSize(22).fillColor('#34495e').text('University Carbon Emissions Report', { align: 'center' });
    doc.moveDown(4);

    doc.fontSize(14).fillColor('black');
    addLine('University', reportData.universityName);
    addLine('Reporting Period', reportData.reportingPeriodName);
    addLine('Generated At', new Date().toLocaleDateString());
    doc.addPage();

    // =====================================================
    // 2. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & EMISSIONS
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('1. Executive Summary');
    addLine('Total Emissions', `${reportData.totalEmissionsTonnes} tCO2e`);
    addLine('Scope 1', `${reportData.scope1Tonnes} tCO2e (${reportData.scope1Percentage}%)`);
    addLine('Scope 2', `${reportData.scope2Tonnes} tCO2e (${reportData.scope2Percentage}%)`);

    if (reportData.reductionPercentage) {
      addLine('Reduction vs Baseline', `${reportData.reductionPercentage}%`);
    }
    doc.moveDown(2);

    // =====================================================
    // 3. CATEGORY ANALYSIS
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('2. Category-wise Emissions');
    if (reportData.categories && reportData.categories.length) {
      reportData.categories.forEach((cat) => {
        addLine(cat.category, `${cat.tonnesCO2e.toFixed(2)} tCO2e (Scope: ${cat.scope})`);
      });
    } else {
      doc.text('No category data available.');
    }
    doc.moveDown(2);

    // =====================================================
    // 4. TOP SOURCES
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('3. Top Emission Sources');
    if (reportData.topSources && reportData.topSources.length) {
      reportData.topSources.slice(0, 5).forEach((source, i) => {
        addLine(`${i + 1}. ${source.category}`, `${source.emissionsTonnes.toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      });
    } else {
      doc.text('No source data available.');
    }
    doc.addPage();

    // =====================================================
    // 5. BUILDING & FLOOR ANALYSIS
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('4. Building & Floor Emissions');
    doc.fontSize(14).text('By Building:');
    doc.moveDown(0.5);
    if (reportData.buildings && reportData.buildings.length) {
      reportData.buildings.forEach((b) => {
        addLine(b.building, `${b.emissionsTonnes.toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      });
    } else {
      doc.text('No building data available.');
    }
    doc.moveDown();

    doc.fontSize(14).text('By Floor:');
    doc.moveDown(0.5);
    if (reportData.floors && reportData.floors.length) {
      reportData.floors.slice(0, 10).forEach((f) => {
        addLine(f.floor, `${f.emissionsTonnes.toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      });
    } else {
      doc.text('No floor data available.');
    }
    doc.addPage();

    // =====================================================
    // 6. MONTHLY TRENDS
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('5. Monthly Trends');
    if (reportData.trends && reportData.trends.length) {
      reportData.trends.forEach((t) => {
        addLine(t.month, `${(t.totalKg / 1000).toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      });
    } else {
      doc.text('No monthly trend data available.');
    }
    doc.moveDown(2);

    // =====================================================
    // 7. BASELINE COMPARISON
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('6. Baseline Comparison');
    if (reportData.baseline && !reportData.baseline.error) {
      addLine('Baseline Period', reportData.baseline.baseline?.reportingPeriodName);
      addLine('Baseline Emissions', `${reportData.baseline.baseline?.emissionsTonnes?.toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      addLine('Current Emissions', `${reportData.baseline.current?.emissionsTonnes?.toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      addLine('Absolute Change', `${reportData.baseline.changeTonnes?.toFixed(2)} tCO2e`);
      addLine('Percentage Change', `${reportData.baseline.reductionPercentage}%`);
    } else {
      doc.text('Baseline comparison not available.');
    }
    doc.addPage();

    // =====================================================
    // 8. EMISSION INTENSITY
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('7. Emission Intensity');
    if (reportData.intensity && !reportData.intensity.error) {
      addLine('Student Count', reportData.intensity.studentCount);
      addLine('Total Area', `${reportData.intensity.totalAreaSqm ?? 0} m²`);
      addLine('Tonnes CO2e / Student', reportData.intensity.tonnesPerStudent?.toFixed(4));
      addLine('kg CO2e / m²', reportData.intensity.kgPerSqm?.toFixed(4));
    } else {
      doc.text('Intensity metrics not available.');
    }
    doc.moveDown(2);

    // =====================================================
    // 9. METHODOLOGY
    // =====================================================
    addTitle('8. Methodology');
    doc.fontSize(11).text('Emission calculations were performed using the following methodology:');
    doc.moveDown();
    doc.text('Activity Data × Applicable Emission Factor = CO2e Emissions');
    doc.moveDown();
    doc.text('Scope 1:');
    doc.text('Fuel Consumption × Fuel Emission Factor = Scope 1 Emissions');
    doc.moveDown();
    doc.text('Scope 2:');
    doc.text('Electricity Consumption × Applicable Grid Emission Factor = Scope 2 Emissions');
    doc.moveDown();
    doc.text('Emission results are presented in kilograms CO2 equivalent (kgCO2e) and tonnes CO2 equivalent (tCO2e).');

    doc.end();
  });
};
```

SHA-256: `ece12de8699e61ca5d469bd09f78477ef8dd78390c2755ae647a5fa4918175a2`

```typescript
import { eq, and, desc, not } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { reportingPeriodsTable } from '../db/schema/reporting.js';
import { organisationsTable } from '../db/schema/organisation.js';

function serializeReportingPeriod(period: typeof reportingPeriodsTable.$inferSelect) {
  return {
    id: period.id,
    universityId: period.organisationId,
    name: period.name,
    startDate: period.startDate.toISOString(),
    endDate: period.endDate.toISOString(),
    isBaseline: period.isBaseline,
    status: period.status,
    description: period.description,
    createdAt: period.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: period.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

function serializeUniversity(organisation: typeof organisationsTable.$inferSelect) {
  return {
    id: organisation.id,
    name: organisation.name,
    code: organisation.code,
    email: organisation.email,
    phone: organisation.phone,
    website: organisation.website,
    status: organisation.status,
    type: organisation.type,
    metadata: organisation.metadata,
  };
}

export async function createReportingPeriod(data: {
  universityId: string;
  name: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  isBaseline?: boolean | undefined;
  notes?: string | undefined;
}) {
  if (data.startDate >= data.endDate) {
    throw new Error('startDate must be before endDate');
  }

  const existingRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, data.universityId),
        eq(reportingPeriodsTable.startDate, data.startDate),
        eq(reportingPeriodsTable.endDate, data.endDate)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  const existing = existingRows[0];

  if (existing) {
    throw new Error('Reporting period already exists');
  }

  if (data.isBaseline) {
    await db
      .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
      .set({ isBaseline: false })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, data.universityId),
          eq(reportingPeriodsTable.isBaseline, true)
        )
      );
  }

  const [period] = await db
    .insert(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: data.universityId,
      name: data.name,
      startDate: data.startDate,
      endDate: data.endDate,
      isBaseline: data.isBaseline ?? false,
      description: data.notes,
      status: 'DRAFT',
    })
    .returning();

  if (!period) {
    throw new Error('Failed to create reporting period');
  }

  return serializeReportingPeriod(period);
}

export async function getReportingPeriods(universityId: string) {
  const periods = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, universityId))
    .orderBy(desc(reportingPeriodsTable.startDate));

  return periods.map(serializeReportingPeriod);
}

export async function getReportingPeriodById(id: string) {
  const periodRows = await db
    .select({
      period: reportingPeriodsTable,
      organisation: organisationsTable,
    })
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .leftJoin(
      organisationsTable,
      eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, organisationsTable.id)
    )
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id));

  const row = periodRows[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new Error('Reporting period not found');
  }

  const { period, organisation } = row;

  return {
    ...serializeReportingPeriod(period),
    university: organisation ? serializeUniversity(organisation) : null,
  };
}

export async function setBaseline(id: string) {
  const periodRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  const period = periodRows[0];

  if (!period) {
    throw new Error('Reporting period not found');
  }

  await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({ isBaseline: false })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, period.organisationId),
        eq(reportingPeriodsTable.isBaseline, true),
        not(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
      )
    );

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({ isBaseline: true })
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    throw new Error('Failed to update reporting period');
  }

  return serializeReportingPeriod(updated);
}

export async function openReportingPeriod(id: string) {
  const periodRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  const period = periodRows[0];

  if (!period) {
    throw new Error('Reporting period not found');
  }

  if (period.status === 'LOCKED') {
    throw new Error('Locked reporting period cannot be reopened');
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({ status: 'OPEN' })
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    throw new Error('Failed to update reporting period');
  }

  return serializeReportingPeriod(updated);
}

export async function lockReportingPeriod(id: string) {
  const periodRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  const period = periodRows[0];

  if (!period) {
    throw new Error('Reporting period not found');
  }

  if (period.status === 'LOCKED') {
    throw new Error('Reporting period is already locked');
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({ status: 'LOCKED' })
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    throw new Error('Failed to update reporting period');
  }

  return serializeReportingPeriod(updated);
}
```

SHA-256: `9610077c55558cf55df431e8886aaa6b011bfe35320c825be03627a9e4a8b30a`

```typescript
import { desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  organisationsTable,
  reportingPeriodsTable,
  reportsTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';
import * as dashboard from './dashboardV1.js';
import { generatePdf, type ReportPdfBaseline, type ReportPdfIntensity } from './reportPdf.js';
import { getSignedUrl, uploadFile } from './storage.js';
import { createNotification } from './notificationsV1.js';

type ReportRow = typeof reportsTable.$inferSelect;

function serializeReport(report: ReportRow) {
  return {
    id: report.id,
    universityId: report.organisationId,
    reportingPeriodId: report.reportingPeriodId,
    name: report.name,
    status: report.status,
    filePath: report.filePath,
    fileName: report.fileName,
    totalEmissionsKg: numericToNumber(report.totalEmissionsKg),
    scope1Kg: numericToNumber(report.scope1Kg),
    scope2Kg: numericToNumber(report.scope2Kg),
    generatedAt: report.generatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    createdAt: report.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: report.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function generateReport(universityId: string, reportingPeriodId: string) {
  const [university] = await db
    .select({ id: organisationsTable.id })
    .from(organisationsTable)
    .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, universityId))
    .limit(1);
  const [period] = await db
    .select({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id, name: reportingPeriodsTable.name })
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, reportingPeriodId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!university || !period) {
    throw new Error('University or Reporting Period not found');
  }

  const [report] = await db
    .insert(reportsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: university.id,
      reportingPeriodId: period.id,
      name: `Carbon Report - ${period.name}`,
      status: 'GENERATING',
    })
    .returning();

  if (!report) throw new Error('Failed to create report');
  return { reportId: report.id, status: report.status };
}

interface OverviewShape {
  totalEmissionsTonnes: number;
  reductionPercentage: number;
}

interface ScopeShape {
  scope1: { tonnesCO2e: number; kgCO2e: number; percentage: number };
  scope2: { tonnesCO2e: number; kgCO2e: number; percentage: number };
}

export async function generateReportPdf(reportId: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      report: reportsTable,
      organisationName: organisationsTable.name,
      periodName: reportingPeriodsTable.name,
    })
    .from(reportsTable)
    .innerJoin(organisationsTable, eq(reportsTable.organisationId, organisationsTable.id))
    .innerJoin(reportingPeriodsTable, eq(reportsTable.reportingPeriodId, reportingPeriodsTable.id))
    .where(eq(reportsTable.id, reportId))
    .limit(1);

  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) throw new Error('Report not found');

  const { report, organisationName, periodName } = row;

  try {
    const universityId = report.organisationId;
    const reportingPeriodId = report.reportingPeriodId;

    const [
      overviewResult,
      scopeResult,
      categories,
      buildings,
      floors,
      trends,
      baseline,
      intensity,
      topSources,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      dashboard.getOverview(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getScopeBreakdown(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getCategoryBreakdown(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getBuildingEmissions(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getFloorEmissions(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getMonthlyTrends(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getBaselineComparison(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getIntensityMetrics(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
      dashboard.getTopSources(universityId, reportingPeriodId),
    ]);

    const overview = overviewResult as unknown as OverviewShape;
    const scope = scopeResult as unknown as ScopeShape;

    const pdfBuffer = await generatePdf({
      universityName: organisationName,
      reportingPeriodName: periodName,
      totalEmissionsTonnes: overview.totalEmissionsTonnes,
      scope1Tonnes: scope.scope1.tonnesCO2e,
      scope2Tonnes: scope.scope2.tonnesCO2e,
      scope1Percentage: scope.scope1.percentage.toFixed(2),
      scope2Percentage: scope.scope2.percentage.toFixed(2),
      reductionPercentage: overview.reductionPercentage,
      categories,
      buildings,
      floors,
      trends,
      baseline: baseline as unknown as ReportPdfBaseline,
      intensity: intensity as unknown as ReportPdfIntensity,
      topSources,
    });

    const fileName = `carbon-report-${report.id}.pdf`;
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const filePath = `${universityId}/${year}/${fileName}`;

    const uploadResult = await uploadFile('reports', filePath, pdfBuffer, 'application/pdf');
    const storagePath = uploadResult.path;

    const publicUrl = await getSignedUrl('reports', storagePath);

    const [updated] = await db
      .update(reportsTable)
      .set({
        status: 'GENERATED',
        filePath: storagePath,
        fileName,
        totalEmissionsKg: String(overview.totalEmissionsTonnes * 1000),
        scope1Kg: String(scope.scope1.kgCO2e),
        scope2Kg: String(scope.scope2.kgCO2e),
        generatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(reportsTable.id, report.id))
      .returning();

    if (!updated) throw new Error('Failed to update report');

    await createAuditLog({
      action: 'REPORT_GENERATED',
      entity: 'Report',
      entityId: report.id,
      organisationId: report.organisationId,
      metadata: { fileName, status: 'GENERATED', storagePath, publicUrl },
      description: 'Carbon report generated',
    });

    // D-21 retired: V1's per-user notification fan-out is restored now that the
    // notifications table exists. A failure here still routes to the FAILED path.
    const universityUsers = await db
      .select({ id: usersTable.id })
      .from(usersTable)
      .where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, report.organisationId));
    for (const user of universityUsers) {
      await createNotification(
        user.id,
        report.organisationId,
        'Carbon Report Generated',
        `Your carbon emissions report for ${periodName} has been generated successfully.`,
        'REPORT_GENERATED',
      );
    }

    return { status: 'GENERATED', storagePath, fileName, publicUrl };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to generate report:', error);

    await db
      .update(reportsTable)
      .set({ status: 'FAILED' })
      .where(eq(reportsTable.id, report.id));

    throw error;
  }
}

export async function getReports(universityId: string) {
  const reports = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportsTable)
    .where(eq(reportsTable.organisationId, universityId))
    .orderBy(desc(reportsTable.createdAt));
  return reports.map(serializeReport);
}

export async function findReportById(id: string) {
  const reportRows = await db.select().from(reportsTable).where(eq(reportsTable.id, id)).limit(1);
  const report = reportRows[0];
  return report ? serializeReport(report) : null;
}

export async function getReportById(id: string) {
  const report = await findReportById(id);
  if (!report) throw new Error('Report not found');
  return report;
}
```

SHA-256: `ef42f753d5eb45a14a24902cef53394042161ec2e6433f646e108665d5aa8648`

```typescript
import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

// Local filesystem object-storage driver.
//
// Provider-agnostic surface (uploadFile / getSignedUrl / getPublicUrl) so the
// storage backend can be swapped without touching call sites. Files live under
// STORAGE_DIR (default ./uploads) inside per-bucket directories and are served
// publicly via GET /files/<bucket>/<path> mounted in app.ts — mirroring the
// previous public-read behaviour without any external provider.

const ALLOWED_BUCKETS = ['imports', 'documents', 'reports'] as const;

export type StorageBucket = (typeof ALLOWED_BUCKETS)[number];

const STORAGE_ROOT = process.env.STORAGE_DIR
  ? path.resolve(process.env.STORAGE_DIR)
  : path.resolve('uploads');

function validateBucket(bucket: string): StorageBucket {
  if (!ALLOWED_BUCKETS.includes(bucket as StorageBucket)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid storage bucket: ${bucket}`);
  }
  return bucket as StorageBucket;
}

/** Resolve and safety-check a bucket-relative key against the storage root. */
function resolveStoragePath(bucket: string, filePath: string): string {
  const validBucket = validateBucket(bucket);
  const bucketRoot = path.join(STORAGE_ROOT, validBucket);
  const target = path.resolve(bucketRoot, filePath);
  if (!target.startsWith(bucketRoot + path.sep)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid storage path: ${filePath}`);
  }
  return target;
}

function encodeKey(filePath: string): string {
  return filePath.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
}

function buildFileUrl(bucket: StorageBucket, filePath: string): string {
  // PUBLIC_BASE_URL (OPTIONAL) is the externally reachable base of this API.
  // Unset → relative URLs, usable when the frontend is served same-origin or
  // behind a reverse proxy that forwards /files to this service.
  const base = (process.env.PUBLIC_BASE_URL ?? '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return `${base}/files/${bucket}/${encodeKey(filePath)}`;
}

export async function uploadFile(
  bucket: StorageBucket,
  filePath: string,
  file: Buffer,
  _contentType: string,
) {
  const target = resolveStoragePath(bucket, filePath);
  await mkdir(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(target, file);
  return { path: filePath };
}

/**
 * Local files are static — there is nothing to sign. Returns the public file
 * URL directly; expiresIn is accepted for interface parity with expiring
 * object-store drivers and ignored by this implementation.
 */
export async function getSignedUrl(
  bucket: StorageBucket,
  filePath: string,
  _expiresIn = 3600,
): Promise<string> {
  resolveStoragePath(bucket, filePath);
  return buildFileUrl(validateBucket(bucket), filePath);
}

export function getPublicUrl(bucket: StorageBucket, filePath: string): string {
  resolveStoragePath(bucket, filePath);
  return buildFileUrl(validateBucket(bucket), filePath);
}
```

SHA-256: `625fa27cf7cde5221a08b5b98e3522de2841753a421603ea72012dd0e414dc9e`

```typescript
import { and, asc, desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { activityDataTable, baselinesTable, calculationsTable, reportingPeriodsTable, sustainabilityTargetsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';

export async function getTargets(universityId: string) {
  const targets = await db
    .select()
    .from(sustainabilityTargetsTable)
    .where(eq(sustainabilityTargetsTable.organisationId, universityId))
    .orderBy(asc(sustainabilityTargetsTable.targetYear));

  return targets.map((target) => ({
    id: target.id,
    universityId: target.organisationId,
    targetYear: target.targetYear,
    reductionPct: Number(target.reductionPct),
    targetCo2eKg: target.targetCo2eKg ? Number(target.targetCo2eKg) : null,
    description: target.description,
    status: target.status,
    createdAt: target.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: target.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  }));
}

export async function createTarget(data: {
  universityId: string;
  targetYear: number;
  reductionPct: number;
  description?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const baselineRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(baselinesTable)
    .where(and(eq(baselinesTable.organisationId, data.universityId), eq(baselinesTable.status, 'APPROVED')))
    .orderBy(desc(baselinesTable.baselineYear))
    .limit(1);
  const baseline = baselineRows[0];
  if (!baseline) throw new Error('No approved baseline found for this university. Target requires a baseline.');

  const baselineTCO2e = (numericToNumber(baseline.totalKgCO2e) ?? 0) / 1000;
  const targetCo2eKg = (baselineTCO2e - baselineTCO2e * (data.reductionPct / 100)) * 1000;
  const [target] = await db
    .insert(sustainabilityTargetsTable)
    .values({
      organisationId: data.universityId,
      targetYear: data.targetYear,
      reductionPct: String(data.reductionPct),
      targetCo2eKg: String(targetCo2eKg),
      description: data.description,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  if (!target) throw new Error('Failed to create target');
  return {
    id: target.id,
    universityId: target.organisationId,
    targetYear: target.targetYear,
    reductionPct: numericToNumber(target.reductionPct) ?? 0,
    targetCo2eKg: target.targetCo2eKg === null ? null : numericToNumber(target.targetCo2eKg),
    description: target.description,
    status: target.status,
    createdAt: target.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: target.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function getTargetProgress(data: { targetId: string; reportingPeriodId: string }) {
  const targetRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(sustainabilityTargetsTable)
    .where(eq(sustainabilityTargetsTable.id, data.targetId))
    .limit(1);

  const target = targetRows[0];

  if (!target) {
    throw new Error('Target not found');
  }

  const baselineRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(baselinesTable)
    .where(and(eq(baselinesTable.organisationId, target.organisationId), eq(baselinesTable.status, 'APPROVED')))
    .orderBy(desc(baselinesTable.baselineYear))
    .limit(1);
  const baseline = baselineRows[0];
  if (!baseline) throw new Error('Approved baseline not found');

  const periodRows = await db
    .select({ id: reportingPeriodsTable.id })
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, data.reportingPeriodId))
    .limit(1);
  const period = periodRows[0];
  if (!period) throw new Error('Reporting period not found');

  const calculations = await db
    .select({ co2eKg: calculationsTable.co2eKg })
    .from(calculationsTable)
    .innerJoin(activityDataTable, eq(calculationsTable.activityDataId, activityDataTable.id))
    .where(and(eq(activityDataTable.reportingPeriodId, period.id), eq(activityDataTable.status, 'VERIFIED')));
  const currentKg = calculations.reduce((total, calculation) => total + (numericToNumber(calculation.co2eKg) ?? 0), 0);
  const baselineTCO2e = (numericToNumber(baseline.totalKgCO2e) ?? 0) / 1000;
  const targetTCO2e = (numericToNumber(target.targetCo2eKg) ?? 0) / 1000;
  const currentTCO2e = currentKg / 1000;
  const achievedReductionTCO2e = baselineTCO2e - currentTCO2e;
  const requiredReductionTCO2e = baselineTCO2e - targetTCO2e;
  const progressPercent = requiredReductionTCO2e > 0
    ? (achievedReductionTCO2e / requiredReductionTCO2e) * 100
    : 0;

  return {
    baselineTCO2e: Number(baselineTCO2e.toFixed(2)),
    targetTCO2e: Number(targetTCO2e.toFixed(2)),
    currentTCO2e: Number(currentTCO2e.toFixed(2)),
    achievedReductionTCO2e: Number(achievedReductionTCO2e.toFixed(2)),
    requiredReductionTCO2e: Number(requiredReductionTCO2e.toFixed(2)),
    progressPercent: Number(progressPercent.toFixed(2)),
  };
}
```

SHA-256: `ece6b418314e9ece7a81b1fbf3480bf127ce9df127d05c5d4bdf8b098e2f3fb7`

```typescript
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { eq, and, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import {
  taxonomyVersionsTable,
  taxonomyActivitiesTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';
import type { TaxonomyImportNode } from '../validators/taxonomyImport.js';
import type { ImportSummary, ImportErrorDetail } from '../types/api.js';

const IMPORT_VERSION_NAME = 'CarbonSync Import';
const IMPORT_VERSION_NUMBER = '1.0';

function countNodes(nodes: TaxonomyImportNode[]): number {
  let count = 0;
  for (const node of nodes) {
    count++;
    if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
      count += countNodes(node.children);
    }
  }
  return count;
}

export async function importTaxonomy(
  nodes: TaxonomyImportNode[],
): Promise<{ summary: ImportSummary; errors: ImportErrorDetail[] }> {
  const received = countNodes(nodes);

  try {
    const existingVersions = await db
      .select()
      .from(taxonomyVersionsTable)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.name, IMPORT_VERSION_NAME),
          eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.version, IMPORT_VERSION_NUMBER),
        ),
      );

    let versionId: string;

    if (existingVersions.length > 0) {
      versionId = existingVersions[0]!.id;
    } else {
      const versionRows = await db
        .insert(taxonomyVersionsTable)
        .values({
          name: IMPORT_VERSION_NAME,
          version: IMPORT_VERSION_NUMBER,
          description: 'Canonical taxonomy imported via reference-data import endpoint',
          isActive: true,
        })
        .returning();
      versionId = versionRows[0]!.id;
    }

    let inserted = 0;
    let updated = 0;
    let skipped = 0;

    const codeToId = new Map<string, string>();

    const queue: { nodes: TaxonomyImportNode[]; parentId: string | null }[] = [
      { nodes, parentId: null },
    ];

    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const batch = queue.shift()!;

      for (const node of batch.nodes) {
        const existing = await db
          .select()
          .from(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.taxonomyVersionId, versionId),
              eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.code, node.code),
            ),
          );

        if (existing.length > 0) {
          const ex = existing[0]!;
          codeToId.set(node.code, ex.id);

          const newSemantic = node.semantic_values ?? null;
          const nameChanged = ex.name !== node.name;
          const semanticChanged =
            JSON.stringify(ex.semanticValues) !== JSON.stringify(newSemantic);

          if (nameChanged || semanticChanged) {
            await db
              .update(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
              .set({
                name: node.name,
                semanticValues: newSemantic,
                updatedAt: sql`now()`,
              })
              .where(eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.id, ex.id));
            updated++;
          } else {
            skipped++;
          }

          if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
            queue.push({ nodes: node.children, parentId: ex.id });
          }
        } else {
          const [row] = await db
            .insert(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
            .values({
              taxonomyVersionId: versionId,
              parentId: batch.parentId,
              code: node.code,
              name: node.name,
              slug: node.slug ?? null,
              description: node.description ?? null,
              semanticValues: node.semantic_values ?? null,
              status: 'ACTIVE',
            })
            .returning();

          codeToId.set(node.code, row!.id);
          inserted++;

          if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
            queue.push({ nodes: node.children, parentId: row!.id });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      summary: {
        received,
        inserted,
        updated,
        skipped,
        failed: 0,
      },
      errors: [],
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      summary: {
        received,
        inserted: 0,
        updated: 0,
        skipped: 0,
        failed: received,
      },
      errors: [
        {
          index: -1,
          message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error',
        },
      ],
    };
  }
}
```

SHA-256: `06daa757f2dae7c1560fc12bfd4814f40baacc6959996a4429546a6b8275e94b`

```typescript
import { and, desc, eq, ilike, or, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import {
  organisationsTable,
  physicalEntitiesTable,
  usersTable,
} from '../db/schema/index.js';

type OrganisationRow = typeof organisationsTable.$inferSelect;

// R-4: V1 flat university fields fold into organisations.metadata in V2.
function readMetadata(organisation: OrganisationRow) {
  const meta = (organisation.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return meta;
}

export function serializeUniversity(organisation: OrganisationRow) {
  const meta = readMetadata(organisation);
  return {
    id: organisation.id,
    name: organisation.name,
    code: organisation.code,
    email: organisation.email,
    phone: organisation.phone,
    website: organisation.website,
    address: (meta.address as string) ?? null,
    city: (meta.city as string) ?? null,
    state: (meta.state as string) ?? null,
    country: (meta.country as string) ?? 'India',
    postalCode: (meta.postalCode as string) ?? null,
    status: organisation.status,
    createdAt: organisation.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: organisation.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function createUniversity(data: {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  email?: string | undefined;
  phone?: string | undefined;
  website?: string | undefined;
  address?: string | undefined;
  city?: string | undefined;
  state?: string | undefined;
  country: string;
  postalCode?: string | undefined;
}) {
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: organisationsTable.id })
    .from(organisationsTable)
    .where(eq(organisationsTable.code, data.code))
    .limit(1);
  if (existing.length > 0) throw new Error('University with this code already exists');

  const metadata: Record<string, string> = { country: data.country };
  if (data.address !== undefined) metadata.address = data.address;
  if (data.city !== undefined) metadata.city = data.city;
  if (data.state !== undefined) metadata.state = data.state;
  if (data.postalCode !== undefined) metadata.postalCode = data.postalCode;

  const [organisation] = await db
    .insert(organisationsTable)
    .values({
      name: data.name,
      code: data.code,
      email: data.email ?? null,
      phone: data.phone ?? null,
      website: data.website ?? null,
      type: 'UNIVERSITY',
      status: 'PENDING',
      metadata,
    })
    .returning();
  if (!organisation) throw new Error('Failed to create university');
  return serializeUniversity(organisation);
}

export async function getUniversities(params: {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  search?: string | undefined;
  status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'PENDING' | undefined;
}) {
  const skip = Math.max(0, (params.page - 1) * params.limit);

  const conditions = [];
  if (params.search) {
    conditions.push(
      or(
        ilike(organisationsTable.name, `%${params.search}%`),
        ilike(organisationsTable.code, `%${params.search}%`),
      ),
    );
  }
  if (params.status) conditions.push(eq(organisationsTable.status, params.status));
  const where = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;

  const [rows, countRows] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select()
      .from(organisationsTable)
      .where(where)
      .orderBy(desc(organisationsTable.createdAt))
      .limit(params.limit)
      .offset(skip),
    db.select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` }).from(organisationsTable).where(where),
  ]);

  const total = Number(countRows[0]?.total ?? 0);
  return {
    universities: rows.map(serializeUniversity),
    pagination: {
      page: params.page,
      limit: params.limit,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / params.limit),
    },
  };
}

async function loadOrganisation(id: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(organisationsTable)
    .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  return rows[0];
}

export async function getUniversityById(id: string) {
  const organisation = await loadOrganisation(id);
  if (!organisation) throw new Error('University not found');

  const userCount = await db
    .select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
    .from(usersTable)
    .where(eq(usersTable.organisationId, id));
  const campusCount = await db
    .select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
    .from(physicalEntitiesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.organisationId, id),
        eq(physicalEntitiesTable.subtype, 'CAMPUS'),
      ),
    );

  return {
    ...serializeUniversity(organisation),
    _count: {
      users: Number(userCount[0]?.total ?? 0),
      campuses: Number(campusCount[0]?.total ?? 0),
    },
  };
}

export interface UpdateUniversityData {
  name?: string | undefined;
  code?: string | undefined;
  email?: string | undefined;
  phone?: string | undefined;
  website?: string | undefined;
  address?: string | undefined;
  city?: string | undefined;
  state?: string | undefined;
  country?: string | undefined;
  postalCode?: string | undefined;
  status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE' | 'PENDING' | undefined;
}

export async function updateUniversity(id: string, data: UpdateUniversityData) {
  const existing = await loadOrganisation(id);
  if (!existing) throw new Error('University not found');

  if (data.code && data.code !== existing.code) {
    const duplicate = await db
      .select({ id: organisationsTable.id })
      .from(organisationsTable)
      .where(eq(organisationsTable.code, data.code))
      .limit(1);
    if (duplicate.length > 0) throw new Error('University with this code already exists');
  }

  const currentMeta = readMetadata(existing);
  const metadata: Record<string, unknown> = { ...currentMeta };
  for (const key of ['address', 'city', 'state', 'postalCode'] as const) {
    if (data[key] !== undefined) metadata[key] = data[key];
  }
  if (data.country !== undefined) metadata.country = data.country;

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(organisationsTable)
    .set({
      ...(data.name !== undefined ? { name: data.name } : {}),
      ...(data.code !== undefined ? { code: data.code } : {}),
      ...(data.email !== undefined ? { email: data.email } : {}),
      ...(data.phone !== undefined ? { phone: data.phone } : {}),
      ...(data.website !== undefined ? { website: data.website } : {}),
      ...(data.status !== undefined ? { status: data.status } : {}),
      metadata,
    })
    .where(eq(organisationsTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!updated) throw new Error('University not found');
  return serializeUniversity(updated);
}
```

```typescript
import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { reportingPeriodsTable } from '../db/schema/reporting.js';
import { numericToNumber } from '../utils/numericSerialize.js';

type PeriodRow = typeof reportingPeriodsTable.$inferSelect;

// D-6 amendment: V1 stored statistics in dedicated UniversityStatistics rows with
// their own ids; V2 folds them into reporting_periods columns, so a "statistic id"
// IS the reporting-period id.
function serializeStatistic(period: PeriodRow) {
  return {
    id: period.id,
    universityId: period.organisationId,
    reportingPeriodId: period.id,
    studentCount: period.studentCount,
    staffCount: period.staffCount,
    totalAreaSqm: numericToNumber(period.totalAreaSqm),
    createdAt: period.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: period.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

async function loadPeriod(id: string) {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .limit(1);
  return rows[0];
}

export async function getStatistics(universityId: string) {
  const periods = await db
    .select()
    .from(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.organisationId, universityId));
  return periods.map(serializeStatistic);
}

const STAT_KEYS = ['studentCount', 'staffCount', 'totalAreaSqm'] as const;

export async function createStatistic(body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const reportingPeriodId = String(body.reportingPeriodId);
  const period = await loadPeriod(reportingPeriodId);
  if (!period) throw new Error('Failed to create statistic');

  // Preserved V1 behavior: unknown extra keys made Prisma throw -> generic 400.
  for (const key of Object.keys(body)) {
    if (key !== 'universityId' && key !== 'reportingPeriodId' && !STAT_KEYS.includes(key as never)) {
      throw new Error('Failed to create statistic');
    }
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({
      studentCount: body.studentCount === undefined ? period.studentCount : Number(body.studentCount),
      staffCount: body.staffCount === undefined ? period.staffCount : Number(body.staffCount),
      totalAreaSqm:
        body.totalAreaSqm === undefined ? period.totalAreaSqm : String(Number(body.totalAreaSqm)),
    })
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, reportingPeriodId))
    .returning();
  if (!updated) throw new Error('Failed to create statistic');
  return serializeStatistic(updated);
}

export async function updateStatistic(id: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const period = await loadPeriod(id);
  if (!period) throw new Error('Failed to update statistic');

  for (const key of Object.keys(body)) {
    if (!STAT_KEYS.includes(key as never)) {
      throw new Error('Failed to update statistic');
    }
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({
      studentCount: body.studentCount === undefined ? period.studentCount : Number(body.studentCount),
      staffCount: body.staffCount === undefined ? period.staffCount : Number(body.staffCount),
      totalAreaSqm:
        body.totalAreaSqm === undefined ? period.totalAreaSqm : String(Number(body.totalAreaSqm)),
    })
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!updated) throw new Error('Failed to update statistic');
  return serializeStatistic(updated);
}

export async function deleteStatistic(id: string) {
  const period = await loadPeriod(id);
  if (!period) throw new Error('Failed to delete statistic');

  // The folded storage means deletion clears the stat columns on the period row.
  const [updated] = await db
    .update(reportingPeriodsTable)
    .set({ studentCount: null, staffCount: null, totalAreaSqm: null })
    .where(eq(reportingPeriodsTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!updated) throw new Error('Failed to delete statistic');
}
```
