SHA-256: `c6d86117d5621e58471aa2123f7681d34a476b205e435059fda6b61a31f98e32`

```typescript
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { eq, sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { usersTable } from '../db/schema/users.js';
import { createAuditLog } from '../utils/audit.js';
import {
  getIdentityPort,
  NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError,
} from './neonAuthAdmin.js';

type UserRow = typeof usersTable.$inferSelect;

export interface V1User {
  id: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName?: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  role: UserRow['role'];
  status: UserRow['status'];
  universityId: string | null;
  lastLoginAt: null; // D-31
  createdAt: string;
}

function splitName(name: string | null | undefined): { firstName: string; lastName: string } {
  const trimmed = (name ?? '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) return { firstName: '', lastName: '' };
  const [first = '', ...rest] = trimmed.split(' ');
  return { firstName: first, lastName: rest.join(' ') };
}

/**
 * D-32: identity fields (name/email) are Neon Auth-owned. Reads join the synced
 * directory (`neon_auth.users_sync`) when the project has Neon Auth enabled.
 * When it does not, fall back to local columns so the API stays usable instead
 * of hard-failing on every request.
 */
export async function listUsers(organisationId?: string | null): Promise<V1User[]> {
  try {
    const result = organisationId
      ? await db.execute(sql`
          select u.id,
                 u.role,
                 u.status,
                 u.organisation_id as "universityId",
                 u.created_at as "createdAt",
                 a.email,
                 coalesce(a.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name', '') as name
          from users u
          left join neon_auth.users_sync a on a.id = u.auth_user_id::uuid
          where u.organisation_id = ${organisationId}
          order by u.created_at desc
        `)
      : await db.execute(sql`
          select u.id,
                 u.role,
                 u.status,
                 u.organisation_id as "universityId",
                 u.created_at as "createdAt",
                 a.email,
                 coalesce(a.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name', '') as name
          from users u
          left join neon_auth.users_sync a on a.id = u.auth_user_id::uuid
          order by u.created_at desc
        `);
    return mapUserRows((result as unknown as { rows: Record<string, unknown>[] }).rows ?? []);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!isMissingRelationError(error)) {
      const causeMessage =
        (error as { cause?: { message?: string } })?.cause?.message ??
        (error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error');
      throw new Error(`Neon Auth directory unavailable: ${causeMessage}`);
    }
    // Neon Auth not enabled on this project: degrade to local-only fields.
    const fallback = organisationId
      ? await db.execute(sql`
          select u.id,
                 u.role,
                 u.status,
                 u.organisation_id as "universityId",
                 u.created_at as "createdAt",
                 u.email,
                 coalesce(u.name, '') as name
          from users u
          where u.organisation_id = ${organisationId}
          order by u.created_at desc
        `)
      : await db.execute(sql`
          select u.id,
                 u.role,
                 u.status,
                 u.organisation_id as "universityId",
                 u.created_at as "createdAt",
                 u.email,
                 coalesce(u.name, '') as name
          from users u
          order by u.created_at desc
        `);
    return mapUserRows((fallback as unknown as { rows: Record<string, unknown>[] }).rows ?? []);
  }
}

function isMissingRelationError(error: unknown): boolean {
  const code = (error as { code?: string; cause?: { code?: string } })?.code;
  if (code === '42P01') return true;
  const message = [
    error instanceof Error ? error.message : '',
    ((error as { cause?: { message?: string } })?.cause?.message ?? ''),
  ].join(' ');
  return /neon_auth|users_sync|does not exist/i.test(message);
}

function mapUserRows(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]): V1User[] {
  return rows.map((r) => {
    const { firstName, lastName } = splitName(r.name as string);
    return {
      id: String(r.id),
      firstName,
      lastName,
      email: (r.email as string) ?? null,
      role: r.role as V1User['role'],
      status: r.status as V1User['status'],
      universityId: (r.universityId as string) ?? null,
      lastLoginAt: null, // D-31
      createdAt: new Date(r.createdAt as string).toISOString(),
    };
  });
}

export interface CreateUserInput {
  firstName: string;
  lastName?: string | undefined;
  email: string;
  role: UserRow['role'];
  // Required: every user must belong to an organisation (NOT NULL invariant).
  universityId: string;
  adminId: string | null;
}

export async function createUser(input: CreateUserInput) {
  // Duplicate-email guard against both the synced directory and app rows.
  const port = getIdentityPort();
  const name = [input.firstName, input.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  let identity: { id: string };
  let tempPassword: string;
  try {
    // D-30: V1's literal Password123! seed is replaced by an internal random
    // credential issued to the managed identity (never returned to clients).
    tempPassword = randomBytes(16).toString('base64url');
    identity = await port.createUser({ email: input.email, password: tempPassword, name });
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof NeonAuthAdminUnavailableError)) {
      if (/already|exist|unique/i.test(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '')) {
        throw new Error('Email already in use');
      }
      throw error;
    }
    // Neon Auth admin API is not available (v0.5.0-beta): create a local-only
    // user with a self-linked identity so the endpoint stays functional.
    tempPassword = randomBytes(16).toString('base64url');
    identity = { id: randomUUID() };
  }

  const existingAppRow = await db
    .select({ id: usersTable.id })
    .from(usersTable)
    .where(eq(usersTable.authUserId, identity.id))
    .limit(1);
  if (existingAppRow.length > 0) throw new Error('Email already in use');

  // Schema compatibility: the local users row stores a bcrypt hash of the
  // same internal credential (never returned to clients).
  const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(tempPassword, 10);

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(usersTable)
    .values({
      authUserId: identity.id,
      // Schema compatibility: username defaults to the email (the request
      // contract has no separate username field).
      username: input.email,
      email: input.email,
      password: passwordHash,
      organisationId: input.universityId,
      role: input.role,
      status: 'ACTIVE',
    })
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error('Failed to create user');

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'CREATE',
    entity: 'User',
    entityId: row.id,
    userId: input.adminId,
    organisationId: row.organisationId,
    newValue: { id: row.id, email: input.email, firstName: input.firstName, role: row.role },
    description: 'Added new user',
  });

  return { id: row.id, email: input.email, firstName: input.firstName, role: row.role };
}

async function loadUser(id: string): Promise<UserRow | null> {
  const rows = await db.select().from(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, id)).limit(1);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

function serializeUser(row: UserRow, email: string | null) {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    email,
    role: row.role,
    status: row.status,
  };
}

export async function updateUser(
  id: string,
  data: Partial<{
    firstName: string | undefined;
    lastName: string | undefined;
    role: UserRow['role'] | undefined;
    status: UserRow['status'] | undefined;
  }>,
  adminId: string | null,
) {
  const old = await loadUser(id);
  if (!old) throw new Error('User not found');

  // D-32 best-effort: mirror name changes into the Auth-owned identity.
  if (data.firstName !== undefined || data.lastName !== undefined) {
    const currentName = '';
    const first = data.firstName ?? currentName;
    const last = data.lastName ?? '';
    try {
      await getIdentityPort().updateUserName(id, [first, last].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Neon Auth name sync skipped:',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error,
      );
    }
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(usersTable)
    .set({
      updatedAt: sql`now()`, // guarantees a non-empty SET even for name-only patches
      ...(data.role !== undefined ? { role: data.role } : {}),
      ...(data.status !== undefined ? { status: data.status } : {}),
    })
    .where(eq(usersTable.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!updated) throw new Error('User not found');

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'UPDATE',
    entity: 'User',
    entityId: updated.id,
    userId: adminId,
    organisationId: updated.organisationId,
    oldValue: { role: old.role, status: old.status },
    newValue: { role: updated.role, status: updated.status },
    description: 'Updated user details',
  });

  return serializeUser(updated, null);
}

export async function deleteUser(id: string, adminId: string | null) {
  const row = await loadUser(id);
  if (!row) throw new Error('User not found');

  // Preserved V1 rule.
  if (row.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') throw new Error('Cannot delete a SUPER_ADMIN account');

  await createAuditLog({
    action: 'DELETE',
    entity: 'User',
    entityId: id,
    userId: adminId,
    organisationId: row.organisationId,
    oldValue: { id: row.id, role: row.role },
    description: 'Deleted user',
  });

  await db.delete(usersTable).where(eq(usersTable.id, id));

  // Identity-side removal is best-effort (D-32 limitation documented).
  try {
    await getIdentityPort().removeUser(id);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      'Neon Auth identity cleanup skipped:',
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : error,
    );
  }

  return { message: 'User deleted successfully' };
}
```

SHA-256: `94eb22f4f50f2a2497d82ab552f71c1df69bc67482538ca4329f9df6aab7be97`

```typescript
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

// DEMO-ONLY JWT helper. Signs/verifies minimal identity tokens for the V2
// demo auth flow. Not a production identity provider.

const DEFAULT_TTL = '24h' as const;

export interface TokenPayload {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  role?: string;
  universityId?: string | null;
}

function getSecret(): string {
  const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
  if (!secret) {
    throw new Error('JWT_SECRET is not configured');
  }
  return secret;
}

export function signToken(
  payload: TokenPayload,
  expiresIn: jwt.SignOptions['expiresIn'] = DEFAULT_TTL,
): string {
  return jwt.sign(payload, getSecret(), { expiresIn });
}

export function verifyToken(token: string): TokenPayload {
  const decoded = jwt.verify(token, getSecret());
  if (
    typeof decoded === 'string' ||
    typeof (decoded as { userId?: unknown }).userId !== 'string' ||
    typeof (decoded as { email?: unknown }).email !== 'string'
  ) {
    throw new Error('Invalid token payload');
  }
  const role = (decoded as { role?: unknown }).role;
  const universityId = (decoded as { universityId?: unknown }).universityId;
  return {
    userId: (decoded as { userId: string }).userId,
    email: (decoded as { email: string }).email,
    ...(typeof role === 'string' ? { role } : {}),
    ...(typeof universityId === 'string' ? { universityId } : {}),
  };
}
```

```typescript
export function numericToNumber(value: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed;
}
```

SHA-256: `eb1e631aafc2f57981c2f896688e8b23e94ffa6cee5c7ba38666bf60049e845c`

```typescript
export interface PaginationMetaV1 {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  total: number;
  totalPages: number;
}

export interface NormalizedPagination {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  offset: number;
}

export function normalizePagination(
  page: unknown,
  limit: unknown,
  defaultLimit = 20,
): NormalizedPagination {
  const safePage =
    typeof page === 'number' && Number.isInteger(page) && page >= 1 ? page : 1;
  const safeLimit =
    typeof limit === 'number' && Number.isInteger(limit) && limit >= 1
      ? limit
      : defaultLimit;
  return { page: safePage, limit: safeLimit, offset: (safePage - 1) * safeLimit };
}

export function buildPaginationMeta(
  page: number,
  limit: number,
  total: number,
): PaginationMetaV1 {
  return { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) };
}
```

### 195. `original-neon-backend/src/utils/physicalEntityTree.ts`

SHA-256: `4ece5455b1d41dc11117389e14eac9db4264a7a7c3b137eb9b7d6dbffae9c556`

```typescript
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';

export interface EntityHierarchyInput {
  campusId?: string | null;
  buildingId?: string | null;
  floorId?: string | null;
}

export interface EntityAncestry {
  campusId: string | null;
  campusName: string | null;
  buildingId: string | null;
  buildingName: string | null;
  floorId: string | null;
  floorName: string | null;
}

export function resolveMostGranularEntityId(input: EntityHierarchyInput): string | null {
  return input.floorId ?? input.buildingId ?? input.campusId ?? null;
}

function emptyAncestry(): EntityAncestry {
  return {
    campusId: null,
    campusName: null,
    buildingId: null,
    buildingName: null,
    floorId: null,
    floorName: null,
  };
}

type ChainRow = {
  origin_id: string;
  id: string;
  name: string;
  subtype: string;
  depth: number;
};

type SubtreeRow = {
  id: string;
};

export async function fetchAncestryMap(
  entityIds: string[],
): Promise<Map<string, EntityAncestry>> {
  const map = new Map<string, EntityAncestry>();
  const uniqueIds = [...new Set(entityIds)];
  if (uniqueIds.length === 0) return map;

  const idList = sql.join(
    uniqueIds.map((id) => sql`${id}::uuid`),
    sql`, `,
  );

  const result = await db.execute<ChainRow>(sql`
    WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
      SELECT id AS origin_id, id, parent_id, name, subtype, 0 AS depth
      FROM physical_entities
      WHERE id IN (${idList})
      UNION ALL
      SELECT c.origin_id, pe.id, pe.parent_id, pe.name, pe.subtype, c.depth + 1 AS depth
      FROM physical_entities pe
      INNER JOIN chain c ON pe.id = c.parent_id
    )
    SELECT origin_id, id, name, subtype, depth
    FROM chain
    ORDER BY origin_id, depth
  `);

  for (const row of result.rows) {
    const ancestry = map.get(row.origin_id) ?? emptyAncestry();
    if (row.subtype === 'FLOOR' && ancestry.floorId === null) {
      ancestry.floorId = row.id;
      ancestry.floorName = row.name;
    } else if (row.subtype === 'BUILDING' && ancestry.buildingId === null) {
      ancestry.buildingId = row.id;
      ancestry.buildingName = row.name;
    } else if (row.subtype === 'CAMPUS' && ancestry.campusId === null) {
      ancestry.campusId = row.id;
      ancestry.campusName = row.name;
    }
    map.set(row.origin_id, ancestry);
  }

  return map;
}

export async function fetchAncestry(entityId: string): Promise<EntityAncestry | null> {
  const map = await fetchAncestryMap([entityId]);
  return map.get(entityId) ?? null;
}

export async function fetchSubtreeIds(rootIds: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const uniqueIds = [...new Set(rootIds)];
  if (uniqueIds.length === 0) return [];

  const idList = sql.join(
    uniqueIds.map((id) => sql`${id}::uuid`),
    sql`, `,
  );

  const result = await db.execute<SubtreeRow>(sql`
    WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (
      SELECT id FROM physical_entities WHERE id IN (${idList})
      UNION ALL
      SELECT pe.id
      FROM physical_entities pe
      INNER JOIN subtree s ON pe.parent_id = s.id
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT id FROM subtree
  `);

  return result.rows.map((row) => row.id);
}
```

```typescript
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
import { db } from '../db/index.js';
import { activityCategoryEnum } from '../db/schema/enums.js';
import { taxonomyActivitiesTable, taxonomyVersionsTable } from '../db/schema/index.js';

export type ActivityCategory = (typeof activityCategoryEnum.enumValues)[number];

// Codes below reference the LIVE taxonomy (taxonomy_activities.code values are
// lowercase/snake_case in the current active version — e.g. 'electricity',
// 'stationary_fuels', 'refrigerants'). The live taxonomy is COARSE: it does not
// distinguish individual fuels, so all stationary-fuel categories map to the
// same node. Categories with no honest target are intentionally left unmapped
// (resolveTaxonomyActivityId returns null, which callers already tolerate).
//
// NOTE: this bridge is for taxonomy/matching bookkeeping only. Emission-factor
// resolution does NOT depend on it (see efResolverV1.ts: category + country).
export const CATEGORY_TAXONOMY_CODES: Partial<Record<ActivityCategory, string>> = {
  DIESEL: 'stationary_fuels',
  PETROL: 'stationary_fuels',
  LPG: 'stationary_fuels',
  NATURAL_GAS: 'stationary_fuels',
  CNG: 'stationary_fuels',
  GENERATOR_FUEL: 'stationary_fuels',
  BOILER_FUEL: 'stationary_fuels',
  REFRIGERANT: 'refrigerants',
  PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY: 'electricity',
};

export async function resolveTaxonomyActivityId(
  category: ActivityCategory,
): Promise<string | null> {
  const code = CATEGORY_TAXONOMY_CODES[category];
  if (!code) return null;

  const rows = await db
    .select({ id: taxonomyActivitiesTable.id })
    .from(taxonomyActivitiesTable)
    .innerJoin(
      taxonomyVersionsTable,
      eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.taxonomyVersionId, taxonomyVersionsTable.id),
    )
    .where(
      and(
        eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.code, code),
        eq(taxonomyActivitiesTable.status, 'ACTIVE'),
        eq(taxonomyVersionsTable.isActive, true),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);

  return rows[0]?.id ?? null;
}
```

### 197. `original-neon-backend/src/utils/unitConversion.ts`

SHA-256: `28c5580ee11a9a0800202bd2e5f50ab59a0ec3f8b960f8bbd37f7bd066c9346b`

```typescript
export const convertToEmissionFactorUnit = (
  quantity: number,
  activityUnit: string,
  factorUnitString: string,
  category: string,
): number => {
  const aUnit = activityUnit.toLowerCase().trim();

  // Extract denominator from factor unit, e.g. "kgCO2e/kWh" -> "kWh", "tCO2/TJ" -> "TJ"
  const parts = factorUnitString.split('/');
  const targetUnitRaw = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1]!.trim().toLowerCase() : aUnit;

  // Normalize target
  let tUnit = targetUnitRaw;
  if (['litre', 'liter', 'l'].includes(tUnit)) tUnit = 'l';
  if (['tonne', 'ton', 't'].includes(tUnit)) tUnit = 't';

  // Normalize activity
  let normalizedActivityUnit = aUnit;
  if (['litre', 'liter', 'l'].includes(aUnit)) normalizedActivityUnit = 'l';
  if (['tonne', 'ton', 't'].includes(aUnit)) normalizedActivityUnit = 't';

  // 1. Direct Match
  if (normalizedActivityUnit === tUnit) {
    return quantity;
  }

  // 2. Mass Conversions
  if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'kg' && tUnit === 't') return quantity / 1000;
  if (normalizedActivityUnit === 't' && tUnit === 'kg') return quantity * 1000;
  if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'g' && tUnit === 'kg') return quantity / 1000;

  // 3. Energy (Electricity) Conversions
  if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'wh' && tUnit === 'kwh') return quantity / 1000;
  if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'mwh' && tUnit === 'kwh') return quantity * 1000;

  // 4. Fuel Energy conversion (Volume/Mass to Energy)
  if (tUnit === 'tj' || tUnit === 'gj') {
    let energyMultiplier = 1;

    // Standard IPCC Default NCVs (approximate)
    if (category === 'DIESEL' || category === 'GENERATOR_FUEL' || category === 'BOILER_FUEL') {
      if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'l') {
        // Diesel: ~36 MJ/L => 0.000036 TJ/L
        energyMultiplier = 0.000036;
      }
    } else if (category === 'PETROL') {
      if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'l') {
        // Petrol: ~34.2 MJ/L => 0.0000342 TJ/L
        energyMultiplier = 0.0000342;
      }
    } else if (category === 'LPG') {
      if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'kg') {
        // LPG: ~47.3 MJ/kg => 0.0000473 TJ/kg
        energyMultiplier = 0.0000473;
      }
    } else if (category === 'CNG' || category === 'NATURAL_GAS') {
      if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'kg') {
        // CNG: ~48 MJ/kg => 0.000048 TJ/kg
        energyMultiplier = 0.000048;
      } else if (normalizedActivityUnit === 'm3') {
        // Natural Gas: ~38 MJ/m3 => 0.000038 TJ/m3
        energyMultiplier = 0.000038;
      }
    }

    if (energyMultiplier === 1) {
      throw new Error(
        `PENDING: Cannot automatically convert volume/mass (${activityUnit}) to energy (${tUnit}) for ${category}. Custom NCV configuration is required.`,
      );
    }

    let energyResult = quantity * energyMultiplier;

    if (tUnit === 'gj') {
      energyResult = energyResult * 1000;
    }

    return energyResult;
  }

  // 5. Unknown
  throw new Error(`PENDING: Unsupported unit conversion from ${activityUnit} to ${factorUnitString}`);
};

/**
 * Ensures the output is always kgCO2e, regardless of whether the factor is in kgCO2e, tCO2, etc.
 */
export const getCo2eMultiplier = (factorUnitString: string): number => {
  const parts = factorUnitString.split('/');
  const numUnit = parts[0]!.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (numUnit.startsWith('tco2')) return 1000; // tCO2 or tCO2e to kg
  if (numUnit.startsWith('gco2')) return 0.001; // gCO2 or gCO2e to kg

  return 1; // Default assumes kgCO2e
};
```

### 198. `original-neon-backend/src/utils/unitNormalization.ts`

SHA-256: `873bc37a4e21b9fa368626aadcd50638bc1821855f20bb3fca35ac00d9fbd078`

```typescript
export interface ResolvedUnits {
  activityUnit: string;
  factorUnit: string;
}

const COMPOUND_UNIT_RE = /^kgCO2e\/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.\-]*)$/;

export function splitCompoundUnit(unit: string): ResolvedUnits | null {
  const trimmedUnit = unit.trim();
  if (!trimmedUnit) return null;
  const match = trimmedUnit.match(COMPOUND_UNIT_RE);
  if (!match) return null;
  return { activityUnit: match[1]!, factorUnit: 'kgCO2e' };
}

export function resolveFactorUnits(
  unit: string,
  providedFactorUnit?: string | null,
): ResolvedUnits {
  const trimmedUnit = unit.trim();

  if (!trimmedUnit) {
    throw new Error('Unit is required and cannot be empty');
  }

  const match = trimmedUnit.match(COMPOUND_UNIT_RE);

  if (match) {
    const activityUnit = match[1]!;

    if (providedFactorUnit !== undefined && providedFactorUnit !== null) {
      const trimmedFactorUnit = providedFactorUnit.trim();
      if (trimmedFactorUnit !== trimmedUnit) {
        throw Object.assign(
          new Error(
            `Conflicting units: unit "${trimmedUnit}" implies factor_unit "${trimmedUnit}", but received "${trimmedFactorUnit}"`,
          ),
          { field: ['factor_unit'] },
        );
      }
    }

    return { activityUnit, factorUnit: trimmedUnit };
  }

  if (providedFactorUnit === undefined || providedFactorUnit === null || !providedFactorUnit.trim()) {
    throw new Error(
      `Cannot derive factor_unit from non-compound unit "${trimmedUnit}". Provide factor_unit explicitly.`,
    );
  }

  return { activityUnit: trimmedUnit, factorUnit: providedFactorUnit.trim() };
}
```

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

export const ACTIVITY_CATEGORIES = [
  'DIESEL',
  'PETROL',
  'LPG',
  'NATURAL_GAS',
  'CNG',
  'GENERATOR_FUEL',
  'BOILER_FUEL',
  'REFRIGERANT',
  'OWNED_VEHICLE',
  'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
  'PURCHASED_STEAM',
  'PURCHASED_HEATING',
  'PURCHASED_COOLING',
] as const;

export const SCOPE_1_CATEGORIES = [
  'DIESEL',
  'PETROL',
  'LPG',
  'NATURAL_GAS',
  'CNG',
  'GENERATOR_FUEL',
  'BOILER_FUEL',
  'REFRIGERANT',
  'OWNED_VEHICLE',
] as const;

export const SCOPE_2_CATEGORIES = [
  'PURCHASED_ELECTRICITY',
  'PURCHASED_STEAM',
  'PURCHASED_HEATING',
  'PURCHASED_COOLING',
] as const;

export const ACTIVITY_SCOPES = ['SCOPE_1', 'SCOPE_2'] as const;

export const ACTIVITY_INPUT_SOURCES = [
  'MANUAL',
  'CSV',
  'EXCEL',
  'INVOICE',
  'PDF',
  'API',
] as const;

const baseActivityDataSchema = z.object({
  universityId: z.string().uuid(),
  reportingPeriodId: z.string().uuid(),
  campusId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  buildingId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  floorId: z.string().uuid().optional(),

  category: z.enum(ACTIVITY_CATEGORIES),
  scope: z.enum(ACTIVITY_SCOPES),

  quantity: z.number().positive('Quantity must be greater than 0'),
  unit: z.string().min(1),

  activityDate: z.coerce.date(),
  description: z.string().optional(),

  inputSource: z.enum(ACTIVITY_INPUT_SOURCES).optional(),
  sourceFileId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  sourceFileName: z.string().optional(),
  sourceDocumentUrl: z.string().url().optional(),
});

export const createActivityDataSchema = baseActivityDataSchema.refine(
  (data) => {
    if (data.scope === 'SCOPE_1' && !(SCOPE_1_CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(data.category)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (data.scope === 'SCOPE_2' && !(SCOPE_2_CATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(data.category)) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  },
  {
    message: 'Invalid scope and category combination',
    path: ['category'],
  },
);

export type CreateActivityDataInput = z.infer<typeof createActivityDataSchema>;

export const updateActivityDataSchema = baseActivityDataSchema
  .partial()
  .omit({ universityId: true, reportingPeriodId: true });

export type UpdateActivityDataInput = z.infer<typeof updateActivityDataSchema>;
```

```typescript
  supported_calculation_methods: z.array(z.string()).nullish(),

  year_released: z.number().int().nullish(),

  // Measurement

  unit: z.string().min(1).max(100),
  factor: z.number().positive(),
  factor_unit: z.string().min(1).max(100).nullish(),

  // Extension
  metadata: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).nullish(),
});

// intentionally not declared here: Zod strips unknown keys, and the database
// owns primary-key UUID generation (emission_factors.id defaultRandom()).
```

### 213. `original-neon-backend/src/validators/onboardingV1.ts`

SHA-256: `4de0f64dc1f9acecad64d9233815ba41da0870a74ae36337b10c268d509b05d6`

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

// Onboarding payload validation. The seven sections mirror the frontend's
// wizard exactly; free-text answers are preserved verbatim (trimmed) instead
// of being constrained to enums that may drift from future frontend options.
// Only structural/format rules are enforced so arbitrary garbage cannot be
// persisted into the JSONB columns.

// Defence-in-depth for the JSONB mandate "no credentials in onboarding":
// reject any payload whose KEYS look like they carry secrets. Values are never
// inspected — only key names — so business fields are unaffected.
const SECRET_KEY_PATTERN = /(password|passwd|secret|token|credential|api_?key|auth_?key|private_?key)/i;

export function findSecretLikeKeys(body: unknown): string[] {
  const found: string[] = [];
  const visit = (value: unknown, path: string): void => {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      value.forEach((item, index) => visit(item, `${path}[${index}]`));
      return;
    }
    if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
      for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)) {
        const childPath = path ? `${path}.${key}` : key;
        if (SECRET_KEY_PATTERN.test(key)) {
          found.push(childPath);
        } else {
          visit(child, childPath);
        }
      }
    }
  };
  visit(body, '');
  return found;
}

function isHttpUrl(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === 'http:' || url.protocol === 'https:';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// Hostname-shaped bare domain such as "example.com" or "shop.example.co.uk".
// Users type these without a scheme; they are accepted AS SUBMITTED (no
// silent scheme is prepended). Anything with whitespace, a path, a query,
// credentials ("user@host") or multiple schemes is rejected.
function isBareDomain(value: string): boolean {
  if (!value.includes('.') || /\s/.test(value) || value.includes('//')) {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const url = new URL(`http://${value}`);
    return url.hostname === value.toLowerCase();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isValidDateString(value: string): boolean {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
  const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
  return !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) && date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value;
}

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

const text = () => z.string().trim();

const requiredText = (label: string) =>
  z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, `${label} is required`);

const textArray = () => z.array(z.string().trim().min(1, 'Array items must be non-empty strings'));

const websiteSchema = text().refine(
  (value) => value === '' || isHttpUrl(value) || isBareDomain(value),
  'Website must be a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com or example.com)',
);

const deadlineSchema = text().refine(isValidDateString, 'Deadline must be a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD)');

const MIN_TARGET_YEAR = 1900;
const MAX_TARGET_YEAR = 2100;

// Empty string means "not applicable / unanswered" (e.g. targets === "none")
// and is stored as submitted; anything non-empty must be a real year.
const targetYearSchema = text().refine(
  (value) =>
    value === '' ||
    (/^\d{4}$/.test(value) &&
      Number(value) >= MIN_TARGET_YEAR &&
      Number(value) <= MAX_TARGET_YEAR),
  `Target year must be a 4-digit year between ${MIN_TARGET_YEAR} and ${MAX_TARGET_YEAR}`,
);

// Accepts a number or numeric string (frontend submits "42") and validates the
// 0–100 range. The submitted representation is preserved — no silent coercion.
const reductionSchema = z
  .union([z.number().finite(), z.string()])
  .refine(
    (value) => {
      const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value.trim());
      return !Number.isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= 0 && parsed <= 100;
    },
    'Reduction must be a number between 0 and 100',
  );

// Comma-separated list of teammate emails. Every token must be a valid email —
// invalid addresses fail validation (nothing is silently discarded). Valid
// addresses are normalised to a lowercase, ", "-joined string.
const teammateEmailsSchema = z.string().trim().transform((raw, ctx) => {
  const parts = raw
    .split(',')
    .map((part) => part.trim())
    .filter((part) => part.length > 0);
  const invalid = parts.filter((part) => !EMAIL_PATTERN.test(part));
  if (invalid.length > 0) {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: 'custom',
      message: `Invalid teammate email${invalid.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}: ${invalid.join(', ')}`,
    });
    return z.NEVER;
  }
  return parts.map((part) => part.toLowerCase()).join(', ');
});

const companySchema = z.object({
  legalName: requiredText('Company legal name'),
  brandName: text().optional(),
  registrationNumber: text().optional(),
  industry: text().optional(),
  subsector: text().optional(),
  website: websiteSchema.optional(),
  orgStructure: text().optional(),
  consolidationApproach: text().optional(),
  employeeCount: text().optional(),
  annualRevenue: text().optional(),
  fiscalYearEnd: text().optional(),
});

const locationsSchema = z.object({
  facilityCount: text().optional(),
  countries: textArray().optional(),
  facilityTypes: textArray().optional(),
  ownershipStatus: text().optional(),
  floorArea: text().optional(),
  vehicles: text().optional(),
  onSiteEnergy: textArray().optional(),
});

const reportingSchema = z.object({
  primaryReason: text().optional(),
  frameworks: textArray().optional(),
  reportingType: text().optional(),
  deadline: deadlineSchema.optional(),
  previousReporting: text().optional(),
  assurance: text().optional(),
  audience: textArray().optional(),
});

const integrationsSchema = z.object({
  erp: text().optional(),
  accounting: text().optional(),
  utilityBilling: text().optional(),
  utilityBillingMethod: text().optional(),
  fleet: text().optional(),
  travel: text().optional(),
  procurement: text().optional(),
  iot: textArray().optional(),
  dataInputMethod: text().optional(),
  centralization: text().optional(),
});

const emissionsSchema = z.object({
  scope1Fuels: textArray().optional(),
  refrigerants: textArray().optional(),
  electricitySource: text().optional(),
  recs: text().optional(),
  steam: text().optional(),
});

const valueChainSchema = z.object({
  supplierData: text().optional(),
  spendCategories: textArray().optional(),
  commuting: text().optional(),
  businessTravel: text().optional(),
  logisticsOwnership: text().optional(),
  waste: text().optional(),
  cloudProviders: textArray().optional(),
  physicalProducts: text().optional(),
  franchises: text().optional(),
  leasedAssets: text().optional(),
  investments: text().optional(),
});

const strategySchema = z.object({
  targets: text().optional(),
  targetYear: targetYearSchema.optional(),
  reduction: reductionSchema.optional(),
  commitments: textArray().optional(),
  carbonCredits: text().optional(),
  role: text().optional(),
  teammateEmails: teammateEmailsSchema.optional(),
  workflows: textArray().optional(),
  primaryContact: text().optional(),
  contactEmail: z.string().trim().email('Contact email must be a valid email address'),
});

// ── Physical Hierarchy (Campus → Building → Floor) ────────────────────────────
// These schemas are used when onboarding creates the physical structure in DB.
// All structural fields are minimal — only name is required. Code is
// auto-generated server-side from the name to keep the frontend payload simple.

const onboardingFloorSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Floor name is required').max(100),
});

const onboardingBuildingSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Building name is required').max(255),
  floors: z.array(onboardingFloorSchema).min(1, 'At least one floor is required per building'),
});

const onboardingCampusSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(1, 'Campus name is required').max(255),
  city: z.string().trim().optional(),
  state: z.string().trim().optional(),
  country: z.string().trim().default('India'),
  buildings: z.array(onboardingBuildingSchema).min(1, 'At least one building is required per campus'),
});

// What infrastructure sources are available at this university.
// Stored as a flag map in JSONB — no new DB columns needed.
const availableInfrastructureSchema = z.object({
  electricity: z.boolean().default(false),
  dgSet: z.boolean().default(false),
  solar: z.boolean().default(false),
  vehicles: z.boolean().default(false),
  refrigerants: z.boolean().default(false),
});

// physicalStructure is OPTIONAL so existing onboarding payloads (without it)
// continue to work. When present, the backend will atomically create the
// Campus → Building → Floor hierarchy in physical_entities.
const physicalStructureSchema = z.object({
  campuses: z.array(onboardingCampusSchema).min(1, 'At least one campus is required'),
  availableInfrastructure: availableInfrastructureSchema.optional(),
});

export type OnboardingFloor = z.infer<typeof onboardingFloorSchema>;
export type OnboardingBuilding = z.infer<typeof onboardingBuildingSchema>;
export type OnboardingCampus = z.infer<typeof onboardingCampusSchema>;
export type OnboardingPhysicalStructure = z.infer<typeof physicalStructureSchema>;

export const onboardingPayloadSchema = z.object({
  company: companySchema,
  locations: locationsSchema,
  reporting: reportingSchema,
  integrations: integrationsSchema,
  emissions: emissionsSchema,
  valueChain: valueChainSchema,
  strategy: strategySchema,
  // Optional: when present, physical hierarchy is created in the DB atomically.
  physicalStructure: physicalStructureSchema.optional(),
});

export type OnboardingPayload = z.infer<typeof onboardingPayloadSchema>;
```

```sql
-- Migration: Reconcile emission_factors to target schema
--
-- Strategy:
--   Phase 1: Add new columns (nullable)
--   Phase 2: Backfill data from old columns
--   Phase 3: Add NOT NULL constraints
--   Phase 4: Drop old columns, indexes, and FK constraints
--   Phase 5: Create new indexes
--
-- Safety: All phases are additive first. Destructive drops happen last.

-- ============================================================
-- PHASE 1: Add new columns (nullable initially)
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "factor_id" varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "activity_id" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "sector" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "category" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "country_name" varchar(255);
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "source_link" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "source_lca_activity" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "factor_calculation_method" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "factor_calculation_origin" text;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "supported_calculation_methods" text[];
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "year_released" integer;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "unit_type" varchar(100);
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "unit" varchar(100);
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "scopes" text[];
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "constituent_gases" jsonb;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "valid_from_date" date;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ADD COLUMN "valid_to_date" date;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- ============================================================
-- PHASE 2: Backfill data from old columns into new columns
-- ============================================================

-- factor_id: from external_id
UPDATE "emission_factors" SET "factor_id" = "external_id" WHERE "factor_id" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- activity_id: resolve from taxonomy_activities.code via taxonomy_activity_id FK
UPDATE "emission_factors" ef
SET "activity_id" = ta."code"
FROM "taxonomy_activities" ta
WHERE ef."taxonomy_activity_id" = ta."id"
  AND ef."activity_id" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Rename methodology -> factor_calculation_method
UPDATE "emission_factors" SET "factor_calculation_method" = "methodology" WHERE "factor_calculation_method" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Rename calculation_method -> factor_calculation_origin
UPDATE "emission_factors" SET "factor_calculation_origin" = "calculation_method" WHERE "factor_calculation_origin" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Rename source_url -> source_link
UPDATE "emission_factors" SET "source_link" = "source_url" WHERE "source_link" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Copy activity_unit -> unit
UPDATE "emission_factors" SET "unit" = "activity_unit" WHERE "unit" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Convert scope varchar -> scopes text[]
-- Handles: 'SCOPE_1' -> '{1}', 'SCOPE_2' -> '{2}'
UPDATE "emission_factors"
SET "scopes" = ARRAY[REPLACE(REPLACE("scope", 'SCOPE_', ''), '"', '')]
WHERE "scope" IS NOT NULL AND "scopes" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Cast valid_from timestamptz -> date
UPDATE "emission_factors"
SET "valid_from_date" = "valid_from"::date
WHERE "valid_from" IS NOT NULL AND "valid_from_date" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Cast valid_to timestamptz -> date
UPDATE "emission_factors"
SET "valid_to_date" = "valid_to"::date
WHERE "valid_to" IS NOT NULL AND "valid_to_date" IS NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- ============================================================
-- PHASE 3: Add NOT NULL constraints
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ALTER COLUMN "factor_id" SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ALTER COLUMN "activity_id" SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" ALTER COLUMN "unit" SET NOT NULL;
--> statement-breakpoint

-- ============================================================
-- PHASE 4: Drop old columns, indexes, and FK constraints
-- ============================================================

-- Drop FK constraint on taxonomy_activity_id

--> statement-breakpoint

-- Drop indexes that reference dropped columns

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "emission_factors_taxonomy_country_year_idx";
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "emission_factors_external_id_idx";
--> statement-breakpoint

-- Drop old columns

ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" DROP COLUMN "external_id";
ALTER TABLE "emission_factors" DROP COLUMN "scope";
```

```typescript
import 'dotenv/config';
import { neon } from '@neondatabase/serverless';
const sql = neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL!);
const all = await sql`SELECT code, status FROM taxonomy_activities ORDER BY code`;
console.log('TOTAL:', all.length);
for (const r of all) process.stdout.write(`${r.code}(${r.status}) `);
process.stdout.write('\n');
const ver = await sql`SELECT id, name, version, is_active FROM taxonomy_versions`;

```
